tei:div.tei:p: 〉〉rgyu/ bongar+ghaṃ rang bsgyur ngape chag5 she ba/ 10rwaca ṭ+wāṃ 0༷ 1rdo ba sdu skya 0 ‘ ṭ+wāṃ5rngurwa d+ngha ༷2 tshitharngurdo~Xsdusdu~Xsdushādzipyi 5871 dzi bodi kyi 61 rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gdams bsgrigs/spyi'i 'done thengs 17wawawawawawawawawawawa0li'i 0smo wawalnge bye waskreXwarde wajiwawawawaXwawawawa wa

37'a larna5skoganako5/lta/(nalha4 r+sha(spyo/spyo45༷snanadzi(/sngu d+ngha (3bsta 8spyi'i 'don thengs 7pabod rang skyong ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgya cha yu yon lhan khang gis rtsom sgrig byas pa/mi rigs dpe skun khang /
nga dza sa 'jams pal rgyal mtsha

yin lugs la bsnyas pa'i don rkyen zhig/dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ (127)de snga byang khul hor spyi phyir bsdu byas te byang spyi bskos pa'i skor dang sog phogs khang gi lo rgyus rags rim/dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ (131)mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams kyi lo rgyus shes tshor cung zad /'phrin las dar rgyas/ (138)nye rabs kyi bod dmag dang bod ljongs dmag spyi khang gi skor sogs 'brel yod 'ga' zhig sding bya tshe ring rdo rje/ (149) hor tsho so dgu'i nang tshan khyung po dkar nag ser gsum dang de'i ya gyal nag ru dpon tshang gi lo rgyus rags bsdus/ chab mdo srid gros kyi shes rab rgya mtsho/ (181)bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma thob sngon gyi grong khyer lha sa'i skor gleng ba/o rgyan rdo rje/ (200)rang nyid gar pa byas pa'i 'brel yod gnas tshul rags rim/gar dpon pa sangs don grub/ (219)de snga lho kha sa khul du dbyin ji dang 'jar man slebs 'byor byung skor/lho kha sa khul srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas tshogs chung / (226) lha sdod dbyan ji ri car san gyis bod kyi nang srid la the jus ngan skul byas te bzos pa'i don rkyen zhig dang ngos bka' blon gnas dbyung rngaspro/spengarngo bye/5sdo/ bsdo sdormi95 zug (232)tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi par 'bul rgyu'i gser khri bzo skrun skabs kyi gnas sdo/05/ ba sa/ nga /(239)2
dzo 'e
ba 'a rgya ma sa

ra nyag dgon gyi nye 'dabs grong khul du bsdad pa red/gong lo'i bod zla 4 pa tsam gyi nang bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung gdan zhu'i sku tshab tu ched mngags mkhan drung twa bla ma nor brang blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / las bya rtse mgron byams pa rnam dag dang las tshan sle phu rje drung blo bzang phun tshogs/ zhabs sdod don dkyil bsod nams stobs rgyal sogs ra nyag tu 'byor zhing / mkhan drung nor brang pa ngo las rnams bzhugs sgar du 'byor rjes/ phyogs gcig nas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku gdung bod du gdan zhu'i gra sgrig las ka byas pa dang /phyogs gzhan zhig nas yang srid rtsad gcod zhu phyogs skor gyi gra sgrig byas shing /sku gdung bod du gdan zhu bya rgyu'i gra sgrig thad phyogs gcig nas rta khal sdod sgrig le thogs mi yong ched du sku gdung gdan zhu'i dus tshod dang / lam phyogs/ rta khal gyi grang 'bor skor mdo spyi dang / lha sa bka' shag tu snyan zhur btang khar/ rmā bu'u h+phang dang go min tang la'ang sku gdung bod du gdan zhu bya rgyu dang / mi sna khag gcig yang srid rtsad gcod du rjes sdod bya rgyu yin lugs skor snyan seng zhus pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas sku gdung gdan zhus kyis bod du 'gro mkhan gyi mi dang / yang srid rtsad gcod du rjes sdod byed mkhan gyi mi sna su 'os rang mos yin la/ gzhis byes gros mol yang byas pa brgyud gtan 'khel byas thog sku gdung dang mnyam du gtong rgyu'i sku chas dang / rta drel mdzo sogs gtan 'khel dbye 'byed byas pa red/sku gdung dang mnyam gtong bya rgyu'i sku chas kyi gras su gtso bo sku gdung gas ra bzhengs bya rgyu'i dmigs sgor rgya dngul rta rmig ma dang / gser (grangs 'bor blor nges mi 'dug) khra rgyan du pha lam dang / in+d+ra nī la/margad/ pad rag mu tig spos shel/ byu ru/ gzi/ ma na ho 2

sogs rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs dang / mchod rdzas kyi dmigs sgor u ru su'i rgya se sogs dar dgos/ gzhan yang rin po che'i khra sbyar gyi sku gong ma'i sku ber (gos chen gyi zla gam la g.yu byur mu tig sogs kyi khras brgyan pa )had lung / sbu la khi li ma/ dbyi sogs rtsa che'i pags rigs kyi nang ldan na bza' sog chas/ u ru su'i rgya se sgro mdongs ma'i stod 'gag sogs grwa chas sna tshogs/ pha lam dang mu tig gi khra sbyar gser gyi chu tshod sna tshogs/ rdzul dang ma na ho'i dkar yol la gser gyi stegs khebs rang 'grigs yod pa sogs sku'i nyer spyad sna tshogs/ sku gdung bod du phebs skabs mang 'gyed sogs kyi dmigs sgor dngul tā yang 'phon che bcas yod pa red/ sku chas dang / rta drel/ mdzo bcas la tho deb 'dra gnyis bkod de bod du bsnams rgyu'i tho deb de phran las tshan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i lag bris ma yin pa dang / nang sgang du nyar rgyu'i tho deb de zhabs sdod don dkyil bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi lag bris ma yin/paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid rtsad gcod zhu phyogs skor gyi gra sgrig las ka'i thad bzhugs sgar go bsdur gyis mkhan drung nor brang blo bzang rgyal mtshan ngo las kyis bod nas bsnams phebs pa'i dbus gtsang khul gyi bla lha'i lung brtag khag gi nang don dang / nang sgang gis mdo smad khul gyi bla sprul khag la zhus pa'i lung brtag rtse sdur thog nas yang srid rtsad gcod bya yul sa gnas gtso bo a mdo'i phyogs su gtan 'khel byas pa dang / yang srid rtsad gcod du rjes sdod byed mkhan gzim che 'brong shod blo bzang dpal ldan gyis gtsos pa'i khag gcig gtan 'khel byas rjes (lcags 'brug zla rapa'i nang tsam la yin snyam)mkhan drung nor brang pa ngo las dang / mkhan mgron che ba sa lung pa blo bzang thub bstan gyis gtsos nang sgang khongs nas mi sna khag 3

gcig (kha grang blor nges mi 'dug) gis gong gsal sku chas rnams dang bcas sku gdung gdan zhus kyis skye rgu mdo nas bod du thon pa dang / rtse mgron ngag dbang sbyin pa skye mdor las mjug skyong rgyur bzhag pa red/de nas lcags 'brug (1940) zla 11pa'i mjug tsam la yang srid rtsad gcod du rjes sdod byed mkhan rnams kyang skye mdo nas thon te shang sde brgyud sku 'bum du 'byor skabs tshe gling sprul sku dang / dngul chu sprul sku blo bzang chos 'phel/ sku 'bum dgon gyi bla sprul che khag dang las sne bcas kyis gdong bsu gzab rgyas byas/ sku 'bum du 'byor nas nyin 2 2song rjes gzim che 'brong shod blo bzang dpal ldan dang / a khu brtson 'grus/(sku 'bum zi ling khul yod 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'dzin dbang bdag skyong byed po/ paṇa chen dgu par dad zhen yod mkhan/ rjes su gzim che'i ming gnas blang pa'i mi zhig red/) rtse mgron blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ma byan che mo thub bstan nyi ma/ phran rtse mgron bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs rmā bu'u h+phang sar bcar te yang srid rtsad gcod zhu rgyu'i don gnad skor snyan bzhus thog rgyab skyor rogs ram yong ba zhes zhus/ skabs der 'bul rten khongs me skyogs gcig phul/ (me skyogs kyi ming dang / mde'u'i grangs zhu rgyu mi 'dug)rmā bu'u h+phang nas nang sgang skor bcas sku 'bum du sdod bde yong ba dang / yang srid rtsad gcod bya rgyu'i thad la rgyab skyor rogs ram bya rgyu'i khas len thob cing / mi ring bar khrung ching nas blo u yon (gsol che zur nub blo bzang rgyal mtshan ) dang rtse mgron lha smon ye shes tshul khrims/las tshan bkras mthong cis 'jigs med/ las tshan ha pa don (ming ngo ma bod skad la lhag pa don grub ces pa rgya skad kyi shan shugs khyer nas bod skad kyi zur chag pa de rgyun 'byams su gyur pa red ces gsungs)bcas rim pas 4

sku 'bum du 'byor te lcags 'brug (1940) zla 2pa tsam gyi nang yang srid rtsad gcod byed 'go btsugs te blo u yon ngo mas mtsho sngon khul du bskyod pa dang / tshe gling sprul sku ngo las a rdzogs khul du bskyod pa/ dngul chu sprul sku dang / sku 'bum gzhung gi sku tshab rnams sku 'bum tsha drug zer ba'i khul du bskyod pa/ gzim che blo bzang dpal ldan dang / a khu brtson 'grus/phran bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bcas rdi tsha dang / bya khyung / sud rta/ rgod me bcas khul du bskyod/ de bzhin shis khams khul yong grags su rtsad gcod byed mir tshe gling sprul sku btang ba dang / gsang ba'i sgo nas li thang du drung yig dpal ldan dang / gsol thab pa rgya khams blo bzang bzod pa mngags rdzong byas shing / gsang thabs kyis mngags rdzong byed dgos don ni li thang shog drug skyabs mgon gyis gsos nyar byas pa'i bu zhig la shog drug skyabs mgon dang / gting skyes sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan gnyis nas bu de'i dpral bar a yig gi ri mo yod tshul sogs kyi thog nas paṇa chen gyi yang srid yin tshul gleng phyogs rgya che bzo bzhin yod pa'i rkyen gyis red/ brtag zhib byas pa brgyud shes rtogs byung bar/ bu de ni sngar dkar mdzes su paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nang tshem bzo'i mi glar yong myong mkhan bza' tsho gnyis la dar mdo lce thog la'i brag phug cig tu sdod skabs btsas pa'i bu de yin pa dang /pha ma gnyis nas bu de 'khrid de li thang du 'byor rjes shog drug skyabs mgon nas gsos nyar byas pa zhig yin 'dug drung yig dpal ldan nas gsang thabs kyis brtag dpyad byas pa'i gnas tshul 'byor pa'i nang dpral steng gi a yig ces pa ni gnyer ma'i 'khrigs phyogs shig la mdzub mo btsugs te a yig rang byon yod tshul shod 'dug kyang / nga tshos gsal po mthong bro zhig ma byung zhes 'khod yod pa red/ blo u yon bskyod yul mtsho sngon khul nas paṇa 5

chen gyi 'os sprul tshe dpag rdo rje zer ba'i khye'u gcig tshe gling sprul sku bskyod yul nas a rdzogs chan hu'i bu skal bzang zer ba'i khye'u gcig gzim che blo bzang dpal ldan bskyod yul nas sgo me ka rgya mchod rten sked kyi lung rigs rgya mtsho zer ba'i khye'u gcig dngul chu sprul sku bskyod yul nas chos skyong bkra shis zer ba'i khye'u gcig bcas kyis gtsos a mdo dang / khams khul/dbus khul bcas nas mtshan bzang gi khye'u khyon bsdoms bcu bdun thon pa red/ khye'u de dag gi khong nas a mdo khul yod pa rnams rmā bu'u h+phang la snyan zhus thog nas sku 'bum du gdan zhus kyis ngos 'dzin brtag dpyad byed pa'i bya rim ni khye'u so so'i mdun du paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sku'i nyer spyad phyag 'phreng dang / phyag ṭam phyag dril sogs ngo ma dang ngo 'dra kha shas sgrig gshom byas pa'i nang nas khye'us gang zhig la lag pa 'chang ba'am dga' snang dang / do snang byed pa'i gnas tshul la brtag pa dang / khye'u rang nyid dang /de'i pha ma/ khang khyim bcas kyi ming sgra dang / bla ma'i lung brtag mthun pa gang yod la brtag pa/ khye'u so so'i spyod tshul dang / paṇa chen dgu pa'i mdzad tshul dang gsung tshul 'dra ba'i phyogs ji yod la brtag pa sogs red/brtag dpyad zhu sgo rnams zin mtshams sku 'bum dgon du gdan zhu byas pa'i khye'u rnams rang gnas so sor phebs bskyel zhus rjes lha smon ye shes tshul khrims dang / phran bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gnyis nas khye'u so so'i mtshan brtag dang / bla lha'i lung brtag rnams phyogs sgrig byas pa yin/ skabs der bla lha'i lung brtag dang mthun che la brtag dpyad byas pa'i nang nas mtshan ma ngo mtshar che tsam yod pa'i gras sgo me ka rgya mchod rten sked kyi khye'u de 'os sprul ang dang po dang / mtsho sngon khul gyi khye'u de 'os sprul ang gnyis pa/ a rdzogs chan hu'i khye'u de 'os sprul ang gsum par bkod pa dang /6

de dus paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan de nyid ang drug par 'khod yod pa red/ de lo'i dgun dus paṇa chen gyi yang srid 'os sprul gyi khye'u rnams so so'i mtshan brtag ji yod phyogs sgrig byas pa'i mtshan gzhung dang sbrags sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bkras lhun bla brang la 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu bskur te don gcod sku tshab tu dngul chu sprul sku blo bzang chos 'phel dang / rim bzhin sang rmad pa dbang 'dud nor bu/ rtse mgron byams pa rnam dag gsum bod du mngags rdzong byas/ khong tsho gsum nag chur 'byor mtshams 'os sprul gyi mtshan rim dang po sgo me ka rgya mchod rten sked kyi khye'u de sku gshegs 'dug dngul chus gtsos pa'i sku tshab gsum po lha sar 'byor skabs gtsang nas don gcod du mkhan drung nor brang blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / rtse mgron chos khang blo bzang dam chos/ dkyil khang mkhan po dka' chen blo bzang bzod pa sogs lha sar 'byor zin pas khong tsho thun mong nas/ srid skyong rwa sgreng dang / bka' shag yig tshang bcas par yang srid rtsad gcod byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams snyan seng zhus par sreg dpyad brdar gsum gang mtshams byas mthar/ bskyar du rtsad gcod bya dgos zhes phyir lan byas yod pa red/ de nas mi ring bar phran bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku srung dmag mi lan khrur 'gro dgos byung ba tshor rogs ram ched lan khrur mngags rdzong byas stabs yang srid rtsad gcod kyi las kar zhugs med kyang /go thos su bskyar rtsad byed skabs/ bkras lhun gdan sa nas shar rtse dka' chen lhag pa dbang 'dud sogs dge bshes tsho khag gnyis btang ba ste/ tsho khag gcig gis tsha ba dpa' shod khul dang / tsho khag gcig li thang khul du bskyod pa ma zad/ da dung gzim 'gag dge legs brtson 'grus can gsang gzhung khul du btang yod pa dang / de bzhin sku 'bum nas kyang lha 7

smon ye shes tshul khrims sogs san khyon khul du btang ba/ gsol 'degs pa dam chos yar 'phel sogs shon ha'o shan khul du btang ba sogs khag bgos kyis bskyar rtsad byas shing / de dus gsol 'degs pa dam chos yar 'phel bskyod yul nas bis mdo chan hu'i khye'u de nyid kyi rtags mtshan ngo mtshar can byung bas/ de nas bis mdo chan hu'i khye'u de nyid sogs 'os sprul rnams slar yang sku 'bum dgon du gdan zhus kyi ngos 'dzin brtag dpyad bskyar ma byas par bis mdo chan hu'i khye'u de mtshan rtags bzang shos su phebs/ de skabs ngos 'dzin brtag dpyad kyi gzhi 'dzin sa'i bla lha'i lung bstan gtso bo ni paṇa chen sku gong ma'i dbu'i rigs kyi cod paṇa a lag bla pho rin po che'i bka' slob dang / paṇa chen sku phreng gong rim gyi gnyer du gtad pa'i lha srung la mo tshangs pa'i lung / bkras lhun dgon pa'i gnyer gtad lha mo'i zan brtag bkras lhun mchod khang shar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal gyi sku gdung mdun zhus pa'i zan brtag rtse po ta la'i 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra'i spyan sngar phul ba'i zan brtag chos 'khor rgyal lha mo'i bla mtsho'i mtsho gsal brtag 'bras/ pha bong kha'i sprul sku byams pa bstan 'dzin rin po che'i lung bstan/ chab mdo'i shug rdzong dge bshes (skabs der mdo spyi bka' blon nas sa gnas srid gzhung gi bstan srid don gnad gal che'i skor la thugs brtag zhu yul de yin skad) rin po che'i lung bstan dgongs don rnams yin cing / bla lha'i lung brtag phal mo cher yang srid 'khrungs yul sa phyogs a mdo khul rang la bstan pa shas che khar/ dgung snying yang stag lo par bstan pa shas che/ lhag don chab mdo'i shug rdzong dge bshes rin po cher bskyar du brtan zhu phul bar yig thag thag chod po'i thog nas mdo khul rang du dgung snying stag lo par phebs yong zhes gsal ston 8

gnang yod pa red/ skabs der chos mkhor rgyal du mtsho mjal la bskyod mkhan ni bkra shis lhun po'i rtse mgon khang pa'i rdo rje slob dpon pad rin mkhan po/ drung ram pa spen pa tshe ring can yin cing / khong tshor mtsho gsal brtag 'bras 'di 'dra zhig byung yod pa ste/ nags tshal gyi ljongs shig na shing sdong chen po gcig gi 'gram du stag gcig byung ba de'i 'khris su ri bong bzhis stag der 'khrug rtsod byed pa'i rnam pa dang / stag de dal bus nags gseb tu phar 'dzul 'gro ba zhig byung rjes/ bkras lhun dgon pa'i mdun gyi phyag 'tshal sgang du yod pa'i maṇ+ḍal thang ser po de thon pa'i mdun ngos su mthun pa spun bzhi dang / rnga chen po gcig yod pa'i rnam pa de 'dra zhig gsal yod cing / mtsho gsal de 'dra byung ba ji bzhin ri mor bris pa'i thang ka zhig kyang yod pa red/ bskyar brtsad skabs bis mdo chan hu'i khye'u de nyid paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid su kun yid ches pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po nges gsal byung bar brten gzhi nas khong sku 'bum du rgyun zhugs gnang rgyur gtan khel byas thog bzhugs yul rgya yag sgar par byas shing /khye'u gzhan rnams phyir log gdan zhu byas/ yang sa gnas srid gzhung gis pha bong kha'i sprul sku byams pa bstan 'dzin gyi lung don du ‘‘bdag med bong bu'i rna ba 'dzin pa’’zhes gsal ba der gzhigs nas paṇa chen gyi yang srid de dgung snying yos lo pa can zhig yin dgos zhes nan bshad byas pa red/mdo khams khul du paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid rtsad gcod khag/ bgos kyis zhus pa brgyud yang srid kyi 'os 'char thog mar khye'u bcu bdun yin pa dang / de nas rim bzhin 'dams gses kyis khye'u bcu gsum yin snyam/ de nas drug yin pa/ de ltar brtag dpyad rim par byas pa'i mtha' don 'os sprul khye'u gsum la nges gtan 'khel pa ste bis mdo chan hu'i 9

khye'u de dang / tsha ba dpa' shod kyi khye'u/ li thang shog drug skyabs dgon nas gsos nyar byas pa'i khye'u bcas gsum yin cing / de gsum nas yang srid 'khrul bral nges rnyed cig gi thog tu gtan 'khel yong ba zhes nang sgang nas sa gnas srid gzhung la rim bstud zhus kyang / sa gams srid gzhung gis 'os cha'i thog nas gdan zhu byed dgos pa dang / gcig thog gtan 'bebs mdzad sgo lha sar gnang rgyu zhes bshad pa'i mur dus chod gang mtshams 'gor mthar/ nang sgang gis ‘‘paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu rgyu de a lags bla kho rin po che gang nyid nas gtan 'khel yong ba’’zhes zhus/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni de sngon me bya ( 1926) lo nas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma bod la phebs bzhes kyi lam bar rag rgya dgon du a lags bla kho rin po che dang mjal 'dzoms skabs paṇa chen rin po che nas bla kho rin po che la zhal gdams lta bu'i tshul du gsung don/ ‘‘bla ma rin po che nga'i rjes 'jug 'di rnams sdug la ma gyar ba zhig khyed kyis thugs rjes gzigs’’zhes gsungs yod pa dang / a lags bla kho rin po che ni paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i dbu'i rigs kyi cod paṇa yang yin pas red/ de ltar a lags bla kho rin po cher skyabs 'jug zhus par bla kho rin po che nas‘‘khyed tshos sku 'bum dgon gyi gser sdong rin po che'i spyan sngar zan brtag zhu dgos pa dang / zan brtag nang gang phebs pa de rang la 'khrul bral yid ches byas na chog’’ces gsungs yod pa de don ltar nang sgang nas ‘‘sku 'bum dgon gyi gser sdong rin po che'i spyan sngar zan brtag zhu dgos pa dang / zan brtag nang gang phebs pa de rang la 'khrul bral yid ches byas na chog’’ces gsungs yod pa de don ltar nang sgang nas sku 'bum dgon gyi gser sdong spyan sngar zan brtag zhus par/ bis mdo chan hu'i khye'u de nyid 'khrul bral yin par 10

phebs gshis/ nang sgang nas khungs lung de rtsa bar bzung ste rmā bu'u h+phang la nang snyan dang 'brel sku 'bum du phyi chod nang chod kyi sgo nas paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa gser khrir mnga' gsol zhu ba'i mdzad sgo byas thog gnas tshul de der sdod bkras bla'i don gcod brgyud sa gnas srid gzhung la glog 'phrin brgyud snyan seng btang ba dang / nang sgang nas glog 'phrin btang ba'i nyin de rang du sa gnas srid gzhung gis nang sgang la glog 'phrin btang 'byor nang gsal/ ‘‘paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid skor 'phags pa lo ke shwa rwa'i spyan sngar zan brtag zhus par bis mdo chan hu'i khye'u ang dang por phebs song bas khong yang srid 'os sprul ang dang po yin’’zhes 'khod yod pas red/de ni nang sgang gis paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid gcig thog gtan 'khel gyis gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus pa der ma sgrig lhun grub lta bu'i rgyab snon byung yod la/ dus mtshungs nang sgang nas go min tang srid gzhung la'ang‘‘paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid 'khrul bral nges rnyed 'byung bas gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus zin’’ces glog 'phrin btang ba red/ spyi lo 1945lo mjug tsam nang nang sgang gis bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas a lags bla kho rin po che ched du gdan zhus ltar/ bla kho rin po che dgung grang /1 la phebs yod rung / sku ngal khyad bsad kyis sku 'bum du ched phebs kyis zla shas bstud mar paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par dus 'khor dbang chen gyi mtshan dbang lung khrid gsum bum pa gang rīribyo'i tshul du 'bul gnang mdzad thog yongs 'dzin du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi a lags 'jigs med dang / yongs 'dzin gzhon pa sku 'bum rgya yag sprul sku bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gnyis bsko bzhag gnang ba red/ de dus nga rang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yang lan khrur sbyong brdar du 'gro mi sku srung ba dang mnyam du sku 'bum du phyir log slebs 11

yod pas/ de skabs a lags rin po ches dus 'khor dbang chen gnang ba'i dbang gral du rang nyid kyang tshud yod/spyi lo 1kha46zla 4tsam gyi nang bod nas yang srid skor gyi don gcod du nang sgang mkhan drung nor brang pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / las bya las tshan bde gzim dpal mgon/ zhabs sdod rtse drung gnas pa chos mdzad/tsho dpon nor khang bsod nams rdo rje ngo las sku 'bum du 'byor zhing / nang sgang gzhis byes thun mong nas sa gnas srid gzhung la‘‘bis mdo chan hu'i khye'u 'di nyid tshad ldan bla lha'i lung brtag gi thog nas paṇa chen rin po che'i nga/nga srid du 'khrul bral nges rnyed kun yid ches pa byung bar brten 'di ga sku 'bum du khri gsol mdzad sgo'ang zhus zin cing / des na da cha 'di nyid rang la gcig thog gtan 'bebs bka' bzang 'phral thog yong ba’’zhes 'gag don 'khod pa'i snyan seng rim bstud byas kyang / sa gnas srid gzhung nas sngar bzhin‘‘'os sprul gyi mtshan thog gdan zhu byed dgos’’zhes nyag rkyang mthar bkag byed pa las/ gcig thog gtan 'bebs kyi lan gsal ma byas pa dang / de bzhin go min tang srid gzhung gis kyang rnam 'gyur gsal ston ma byas par gya gyu'i ngang yun ring bzhag pa red/ me phag (1kha47)lor phran bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / rtse mgron bzhad pa don grub/(wang 'bu kon) gnyis de snga dkar mdzes su paṇa chen gzhung sger gyi dngos rigs khyon che lhag lus song rigs rnams la gun gsab slog sprod yong ba zhes pari skor cis 'jigs med dang / lha smon ye shes tshul khrims/ hā pa don sogs kyis de sngon nan cing du le'u 'un hu la thog ma'i gleng mol byas yod pa ra le'u 'un hu nas bsam zhib bya rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan yod stabs de'i mjug skyong byed pa dar mdor bskyod dgos byung bas dus mtshams der yang 12

srid skor gyi thad ka'i bya ba'i nang zhugs med kyang / go thos la spyi lo 194rdolo mkhan drung nor brang pa ngo las paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid sku 'bum du khri gsol zhus zin pa 'di rang gi thog gtan 'bebs yong ba zhu rgyu'i ched du chu thog brgyud lha sar bskyod kyang khong tsho gro mor 'byon nye'i mtshams sa gnas srid gzhung gis a drung rta shar ched gtong byas te khong tsho lha sar 'bod thog yang srid kyi gnas tshul skor tshig tho blangs yod pa dang / de nas mi ring bar sa gnas srid gzhung gis gting skyes sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan dang / ldan lhun tshe ring dpal 'byor gnyis bkras lhun gyi sku tshab tu bskos thog dbus mda' dpon kun bzang rtse (khe smad)tshe dbang don grub dang /lding dpon gcig gi dmag mi dang bcas tsha ba dpa' shod kyi khye'u lha sar gdan zhur mngags gtong gis bzhugs yul kun bde gling du byas nas bkur sti zhabs tog zhu gron bkras lhun bla brang nas nar gtong byed bcug pa dang / bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring lha sar yod mkhan tshang ma kun bde gling du sgrig rgyugs zhu ru bcug yod pa red/ dus tshod de'i gong tsam la gting skyes sprul sku dang / li tha nga shog drug skyabs mgon gnyis nas khong rang tshos gsos nyar byas pa'i khye'u de khrid nas lha sar 'byor zhing / de rjes khye'u de bkras lhun dgon par chos bzhugs byas pa red/ (de skor paṇa chen nang sgang gi mi sna 'ga'i nang shod srol 'di 'dra zhig byung yod pa ste/ gal te li thang gi khye'u de dang / dpa' shod kyi khye'u de gnyis gang rung zhig paṇa chen gyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel byung tshe gting skyes sprul skus de'i bya rim nang rang nyid kyis byas pa'i ngo gsor rten nas bkras lhun dza sag bla ma'i thob thang lon re byas pa red zer ba'i shod tshul byung yod) spyi lo 1949zla 6tsam gyi nang go min tang srid gzhung gis paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa 13

gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus pa'i mdzad sgor rten 'brel zhu ba'i sku tshab tu bod sog las khungs u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang kyon ci'i yu'i zer ba ces 'jigs med kyi phebs rogs 'og kong kru'u nas sku 'bum du 'byor te pa ṇa chen rin po che gser khrir mnga' gsol gyi rten 'brel zhus te sku 'bum du nyin bdun bsdad nas phyir log byas/ de nas mi ring bar paṇa chen rin po che bzhugs sgar dang bcas pa shar sder gnas spo byas pa dang / sku 'bum du yod pa'i sku chas bdag gnyer du las tshan blo 'phrin dang / las tshan zur shar rlis tshe ring gnyis bzhag pa red/ lha smon ye shes tshul khrims kyis nga rang la gsung myong ba'i bka' mol zhig la skabs der bcings 'grol thob nye'i mtshams su slebs pas dkrog gtam sna tshogs yod pa ma zad/ zi ling khul rmā bu'u h+phang gi dmag mis 'phrog bcom sogs zing cha bzo bzhin yod pa des rkyen pas paṇa chen bzhugs sgar shang sder gnas spo byed dgos byung ba dang / bzhugs sgar shang sder 'byor nas nyin bcu tsam song mtshams sgra sdud 'khor lo'i nang nas rlabs chen gyi krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i gtam bzang thos par brten paṇa chen rin po che'i mtshan thog nas pe cin du krung go gung khran tang la gus bkur zhu rgyu dang // krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes par bkra shis bde legs zhu ba'i glog 'phrin phul ba red ces gsung pa dran gyi 'dug gung khran tang la gus bkur zhu ba'i glog 'phrin phul ba dang dus mtshungs cis 'jigs med dang /ngag dbang sbyin pa/ tshal tshe ring gsum sku 'bum du mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la 'brel mthud zhu bar bcar ba dang / de nas nyin shas mtshams ngag dbang sbyin pa dang / tshal tshe ring gnyis shang sder phyir log byas rjes cis 'jigs med shis an du bskyod de nub byang khul dpung bskyod 14

gnang mkhan ye kran cun dang po'i dbu khrid sar mjal bcar zhus par thugs 'khur dang / gzigs skyong chen po thub yod cing / de nas spyi lo 1950tham pa'i zla 6pa tsam la paṇa chen bzhugs sgar dang bcas pa sku 'bum du phyir log phebs/ spyi lo 1951lo'i zla 4par ma'o kru'u zhis rgyal sa pe cin du paṇa chen rin po cher byams brtse'i mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ma'o kru'u zhi dang / tang krung dbyang gis paṇa chen rin po che ston mkhor la chab srid dang / dpal 'byor gang ci'i thad nas ma khyab pa med pa'i gzigs skyong gnang stabs de nas bzung bzhugs sgar la bde skyid gsar pa'i 'go gzhi nas tshugs pa red/ de'i gong go min tang gis paṇa chen nang sgang la dkar mdzes dmag 'khrug skor bka' dpyad drang po min pa'i nyes chad btang rkyen paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi mi sna rnams la 'tsho ba'i thog dka' ngal chen po byung stabs mi khag gcig gis paṇa chen shang sde zer ba'i sa char sa zhing 'debaṭasga skyong thog rnga mong dang / mdzo pa/ drel pa bcas skye rgu mdo dang / nag chu sogs su bdal gla skyel 'dren du btang ste 'tsho ba'i kha gsab yong thabs byas kyang / da dung khongs mi rnams kyi zla re'i phogs thob nas phyed phogs tsam las sprod ma thub par phyed phogs rjes sprod bya rgyu'i 'dzin yig sprod dgos byung zhing / phogs thob chung gras rnams zla rer phogs dngul tā yang lngas 'dum thabs kyi 'tsho ba skyo po skyel dgos byung ba'i gnas tshul mjug 'gril ba red/tang krung dbyang gis paṇa chen ston 'khor bod du phebs bskyod chog pa'i bka' bzang thob pa ma zad/ bod skyod kyi rta drel dang / rnga mong /mdzo bcas khri phrag brgal ba dang / paṇa chen rin po che dang / zhabs 'bring rnams kyi nyer mkho yong rdzogs smos med mkhar/ lag do sogs sger 15

gyi g.yog la'ang tha na mig shel dang / lag shub/ rkang pa'i u su yan chad kyi mtshon pa'i dgos mkho yong rdzogs bsgrub rgyu'i dgos dngul ha cang khyon che gsol ras gnang yod/ tang krung dbyang gis gang ci'i thugs 'khur gzigs skyong bla na ma mchis pa gnang ba'i bkrin la brten nas paṇa chen rin po che ston 'khor rnams lo ngo nyi shu rtsa brgyad ring gzhan yul 'khyar sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul mjug 'gril te mtshan don gnyis tshang gi sgo nas rang gi gdan sa gtsang ljongs gzhis rtse bkra shis lhun po dgon du zhabs sor 'khod thub pa byung ba bcas so/
nga dza sa 'jam pal rgyal mtsha

gcig rtag par rgyug gi yod par grags pa dang / sku 'khrungs skabs yum nyid khang pa'i ka phibs 'og tu gzim yod pas btsas ma tshar bar thog kha'i steng nas bud med gcig gis bltas nas bsdad pa'i snang tshul byung bar yum gyis‘‘ga re blta rgyu 'dug gam nga phru gu skye tshul bud med spyi la byung ba dang 'dra’’zhes gsungs yod cing / 'khrungs pa'i mtshan mor gangs chen babs shing /de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa khang pa'i thog steng gangs kyi steng du bod yig gis yongs su khengs 'dug kyang yab kyis yi gi mi mkhyen pas nye 'dabs kyi dgon par bskyod nas grwa pa zhig yi ge klog par gdan drangs/ 'on kyang grwa pa phebs skabs gangs rtsa ba'i cha nas bzhur zin pas yi ge mang che ba lta klog mi thub shā kyang zhib blta byed skabs gong la'i 'og tu dbu chen gyi yi ge‘‘ra’’dang‘‘sgreng’’ (pen nam‘‘sgren’’yin gsal po rang med pa re zung bsdad yod skad 'dugade ltar mtshan ltas mang po byung yod pas bzang ngan ji yin ba ri chos sde'i rje btsun 'jam dpal lhun grub la thugs dam zhus pa'i bka' lan du‘‘bu 'di mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi bla sprul zhig yin nges la lo gsum bzhi lon mtshams rngaklo gas po grwa tshang du chos zhugs byed du 'jug dgos’’zhes gsungs pa dang 'brel mtshan ‘‘'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ’’zhes gsol/de nas dgung lo gsum la bzhes skabs nyin zhig brag gseb nas brnyed byung zhes chos gos dang snam 'byar ha cang spus legs zhig nang du bsnams phebs yod pa yab yum khyer khos skyo bas gzhan la btsong dgos byung ljoridug yang khye'u des rdo la phyag rjes bzhag pa zhig yod pa de'ang yab mchod chang la mnyes gshis sreg shing gi gnyer pa la chang rgyu dang brje po bskyon nga/ red/ dgung lo lngar bzhes skabs thengs shig yur bu'i 'khyags steng du phebs par 'khyags pa chag nas chu nang du zhabs 'dred shor bas chu rdo zhig gi 18

steng du zhabs rjes shin tu gsal ba zhig 'jog gnang mdzad yod pa de nyid phyis rwa sgreng jo bo 'jam dpa' rdo rje'i sku mdun du yod pa dad ldan kun gyi mig gi dga' ston du bzhugs/ dgung lo 'dir chos 'khor rgyal grwa tshang du chos zhugs mdzad/ rwa sgreng sku gong ma dgongs pa rdzogs rjes rwa sgreng bla brang nas rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen por yang srid rtsad gcod skor snyan seng zhus par lho kha khul du btsal 'tshol byed dgos zhes phebs don rta sprul gyis gtsos bla brang zhabs gras kha shas lho kha phyogs su rtsad gcod du bskyod de yang srid 'os sprul gyi mtshan tho kha shas phul bar bka' lan ma gnang zhing / de nas dus tshod gang 'tshams song rjes sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos sa khra dang / brag seng ge 'dra ba chu g.yas su 'khyil ba/ sgo 'gram du smyug ma yod pa/ yab yum sras bcas kyi dgung rtags bcas gsal bkod gnang nas dwags por 'tshol du gtong gnang mdzad/ yang srid rtsad gcod byed mkhan dwags po rgya tshwa rwa smad du 'byor nye'i mtshams khye'u des‘‘nga'i rta 'dogs sa yin’’zhes brag la phur pa btab pa'i rjes shul dus phyis kyang mthong rgyu yod pa red/ ngos 'dzin zhu mkhan tsho 'khrungs khang du 'byor skabs chung srid gang des sku gong ma'i gsol dpon gyi pang du phebs pa dang / sku gong ma'i yab kyi phyag shan yod pa de nga'i red ces gsungs pa sogs mdor na ngo mtshar che ba'i mdzad pa so skye'i blo yul las 'das pas 'dir ma spros/ ngos 'dzin zhu mkhan tshos yang srid 'khrul bral brnyed pa'i dga' ba shin tu che rung tā la'i bla ma mchog gi bka' mngags su‘‘rwa sgrong gi skye sprul yin zhes pang du 'dzul yong mkhan yod rung thag gcod byed mi chog’’ces pa'i bka' yod gshis yab yum gnyis la bu la byams skyong byed dgos pa'i mngags bcol byas te lha sar phyir log gis tā la'i bla ma mchog la rwa sgrong rin po che'i yang srid 'khrul bral 19

btsal brnyed byung ba'i bya rim snyan seng zhus par tā la'i bla ma mchog nas‘‘rwa sgreng gi skye sprul dwags por yod dogs med’’ces gsungs pa dang 'brel zhabs rim mang dag cig sgrub dgos pa'i bka' slob gnang / de nas lo gcig song mtshams su tā la'i bla ma mchog nas‘‘ngos kyi mo lung dang / gzhan yang lha bla'i lung rtags/ lhag par khye'u rang gi mtshan ltas gang ci'i thad da lta dwags po rwa smad du 'khrungs pa de rwa sgreng gi skye sprul yin nges la 'phral du gdan sar khri 'don zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i bka' bzang phebs dgongs bzhin rwa bla nas ched mngags mi sna btang ba dang khong tsho dwags por 'byor rjes chung srid gang de'i yab yum dang / sku'i sring mo gsum dang bcas pa dpon 'khrol zhus te tshang ma mnyam du lha sar gdan zhus kyis sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i drung du mjal bcar skabs sku phreng bcu gsum pas sprul skur‘‘khyed rang yang srid phebs kyi min gsungs rung ma phebs par thabs shes mi 'dug gam’’zhes ra sprad gtong gnang mdzad pa dang / dbu skra'i gtsug phud bzhes rgyus mtshon sngar srol mdzad sgo gnang ba dang 'brel mtshan‘‘thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan’’zhes pa'i mtshan bstsal/ de rjes ser byes grwa tshang dang rwa sgreng dgon bcas la snga rjes su khri 'don chos zhugs kyi mdzad sgo rim grub thog yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten nas yi ge slob gnyer gyis mtshon mdo sngags gzhung lugs la gsan bsam mdzad de lcags lug ( 1921) lor lha ldan smon lam chen mor lha rams dge bshes kyi mtshan rtags bzhes skabs sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog tshogs phebs su gdan zhu gnang ba sogs mdzad sgo gzab rgyas gnang ba ma zad/ se 'bras dga' gsum dang de min bla brang gi khongs gtogs dgon khag la'ang sngar lam bzhin gtong sgo mang 'gyed sogs bstsal/ de nas 20

gdan sa rwa sgrong du chibs sgyur gyis bzhugs 'jags mdzad/chu sprel (1922)lo'i zla 5pa'i nang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog rwa sgrong dgon du chibs sgyur bskyangs te dgon ma lag bcas par gnas gzigs gnang ba dang / mnga' 'bangs lha sde mi sde yongs kyis skyabs 'jug zhus pa ltar mgon po tshe mtha' yas kyi rjes gnang bka' drin stsal skabs rwa sgreng rin po che dang dza sag gnyis la rgyal ba nyid kyis tshe bum dbu thog tu 'jog gnang mdzad pa dang / de byings la rwa sgreng rin po ches tshe bum bsnams nas dbang bskur mdzad/ dgyes brtse chen po'i ngang spro khang du spro 'cham la lhan du phebs skabs sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog nas‘‘rang lo na phra ba'i skabs su rtse po ta lar mthong rgya che bas skyid po yod/ lo na rgas dus nor bu gling khar bsdad na skyid po 'dug sprul pa'i sku khyed rang yang dbyar kha nor bu gling khar bzhugs pa dang / dgun kha rtse pho brang la bzhugs na yag gi red’’ces thol byung du gsungs pa dang / sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog rwa sgreng du nyin bco lnga tsam bzhugs ring thugs spro ba'i rnam pa kho na bstan cing lha sar phyir phebs mdzad khar sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel mdun lha mo'i mo dpe zhig rwa sgreng rin po cher 'bul rgyu bskur gnang ste‘‘phyis 'byung sprul sku'i ngos 'dzin sogs la mo dpe 'di gzhir bzung na 'khrul pa med pas sprul sku khyed kyi thugs la de ltar zhogs/ ngas kyang mo dpe 'dir gzhi bcol gyi yod’’ces bka' slob kyang gnang 'dug pa ma zad/ rwa sgreng nas lha sar phyir phebs mdzad pa'i phebs skyel zhu yul gyi sa gnas nas rwa sgreng rin po che dang phyag mdzod dza sag gnyis la mjal dar dkar gtsang re g.yogs pa gnang thog chibs zhabs sku bcar tshang mas kyang rwa sgreng rin po cher mejal dar re 'bul du bcug gnang ba dang‘‘nga tsho dang khyed rnams 21

slad 'phrad min mi shes skyel ma mdzad mi dgos ’zhes gsungs te thugs shin tu mnyes po'i sgo nas chibs bsgyur mdzad/ des na rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pas rwa sgreng rin po cher bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i dgongs pa yod pa ni gong gsal gyi bka' slob dang mdzad pa de dag gi thog nas kyang gsal por mngon thub/chu bya ( 192 2)lo'i zla 10nang rgya'/ ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs nga/ chos dbyings su thims shing skabs der srid blon glang mdun dang bka' shag gis sngar lam bzhin rgyal tshab srid skyong bsko gzhag bya rgyu'i skor bod ljo/ngas tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms la gros bsdur byas par tshogs 'du'i nang ser skya khag gcig gis‘‘rwa sgreng rin po cher rgyal dbang mchog gi thugs brtse che zhing / de gong rwa sgreng du chibs sgyur bskyang skabs kyang bka' slob mdzad lu/gas sogs gang la gzhigs kyang rgyal tshab srid skyong 'os gcig ma yicha/ ’’zhes bshad pa der rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dbyangs bde legs kyis‘‘de snga rwa sgreng sku phreng gsum pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos gong ma dang bod kyi ser skya'i bka' ngo ma zlog par rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan snga phyi gnyis bzhes mthar nga) bu nyes byung bas da cha rwa sgreng rin po ches rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 9ragan bzhes mi dgos pa dang / gal srid dgongs pa ma 'khrol na sngon du dgyo/ ra ldan khri pa gdan zur rnam gnyis dang / rgyal sprul khag lhan du rtse 9raphags mchog lo ki shwa ra'i spyan sngar zan brtag 'bul dgos ’’zhes pa'i re ba zhus pa ltar zan brtag 'bul rgyur gtan 'khel gyis dga' ldan khri pa dang / rwa sgreng rin po che/ yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che bcas kyi mtshan shog zan brtag phul ba'i nang nas rwa sgreng rin po cher bzang phebs byung bas rwa sgreng dgon du rin po che ched mangs gdan zhu 'byor don lha sar chibs bsgyur 22

mdzad rjes bka' shag dang sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po ngo bcar gyis‘‘rgyal tshab srid skyong gi 'os babs zan brtag phul bar rwa sgreng rin po che bzang phebs byung ba de ni rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i dgongs gzhi dang drung rigs ser skya yongs kyi re 'dun dang yongs su 'tshams pas mgon po mchog gis rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan gtsang bzhes yong ba’’zhes zhus par/rin po ches‘‘de snga rwa sgreng sku phreng gsum pas bod kyi srid skyong gnang ba 'phrod po ma byung bas nga tshos rgyal tshab byed rgyu de legs po yong gi med pas dgongs pa gnang rogs’’zhes gsungs rung / bkak+ṣ-ire shag sogs nasatshosnyan sgron nan che rim zhus la brten mthar rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang dgos byung ba bzhin shing khyi (1924) lo'i zla 1tshes 10gza' tshes dge bar rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes/rwa sgreng rin po ches rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes rjes mes bod kyi 'brel ba legs po byung yod cing / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod 'bul dang rwa sgreng rgyal tshab la bkris bde legs kyi rten 'brel zhu bar go min tang srid gzhung gi sku tshab bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab hong mung sung lha sar phebs skabs rwa sgrong rin po ches sne len gzab rgyas zhus gnang ba ma zad/ phan tshun mjal 'phrad kyang thengs kha shas gnang ba brgyud lha sar go min tang srid gzhung gi sku tshab don gcod pa btsugs pa des mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la srung skyong byung yod la/ rwa sgreng bla brang rang nyid kyi 'bul sdud pa ser byes dge bshes lung rtogs rgya mtsho mes rgyal nang sar sku tshab btang nas mes bod 'brel ba bskyar 'dzugs kyang thub pa byung yod/ dus de tsam nas rwa sgreng bla brang gi 'bul sdud pa dang tshong pa sogs ched btang mi sna yin phyin go min tang srid gzhung gis blta skyong 23

mtha' 'khyol byed kyi yod pa dang / de skabs paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang khul du bzhugs mus yin pas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nan cin du yod pa'i don gcod mkhan mgron lo gsum (mkhan chung dang rtse mgron/ lo tsā ba ) brgyud gdan zhu'i zhu yig dang tar 'phrin phul te lam seng bod du phyir phebs gnang dgos lugs zhus pa ma zad/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng sku sger nas kyang zhu yig dang tar yang yang 'bul gnang mdzad par brten kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches bod du phyir log phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes kyis skye rgu mdo bar chibs bsgyur bskyangs stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rim bzhi rdo ring ngo las skye rgu mdor gdan zhur btang zhing /skabs der paṇa chen zhugs sgar nang ma sgang nas gos chen ser po'i thog bris pa'i dza drag che ba'i mda' yig btang don du‘‘kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa skye rgu mdo nas lha sa brgyud gdan sa bkra shis lhun por chibs bsgyur gnang rgyur brten lam 'khel rdzong gzhis sa tshigs so sos rta 'ul chig stong dang khal ma chig khri/ mi hreng lnga brgya skor/ chibs pa chibs dril chig stong tsam gyi chibs zan/ 'bud shing ldeng nges bcas gra sgrigs dgos rgyu’’zhes 'khod pa de sa gnas srid gzhung du 'byor stabs rgyal tshab srid skyong dang srid blon/ bka' shag bcas kyis mda' yig de'i skor bod ljongs tshogs 'dur gros bsdur bya rgyur sprad pa dang / tshogs 'du'i thog‘‘de snga rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa rdzogs skabs paṇa chen bzhugs sgar nang ma sgang gi zhabs 'bring khag gcig gis bod kyi srid skyong thugs 'gan paṇa chen rin po ches bzhes dgos lugs skor go min tang srid gzhung la snyan seng zhus patshodang / da dung zhabs 'bring re zung nas khrom lam du gzhas btang nas da ga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan skad ma zad/ da cha gzhung sa mchog la mthong 24

chung gis sngar lam min pa'i mda' yig 'di rigs gtong dbang la gzhigs na rgyab tu rgya mi 'bor chen zhig 'khrid yong ste gzhung sa mchog gi srid dbang la yo 'khyom yong gzhi che bas tshul ldan gyis bod du chibs bsgyur gnang na sngar lam bzhin phebs sgrig zhu rgyu dang / da lta'i mda' yig gzhir bzung dgos na phebs sgrig phyir 'then bya rgyu yin’’zhes pa'i tshogs 'du'i tshig tho phul bar rgyal tshab srid skyong dang / srid blon/ bka' shag bcas nas gong gi tshig tho'i 'bru don gzhir bzung phebs bsu zhu mi rim bzhi rdo ring ngo las la bka' rgya btang bar brten paṇa chen sku gong ma gdan zhu ma thub pa dang / rwa sgreng sku phreng bzhi pa paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yongs 'dzin yin gshis/ rwa sgrong sku phreng lnga pas paṇa chen bod du gdan zhu thub rgyu'i thugs re gnang rung gzhung bla gnyis kyi zhabs 'bring re zung gis de snga'i phyogs 'gal gyi rkyen pas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bod du phyir log phebs rgyur ka kor dus 'gyangs btang ba'i mur mthar skye rgu mdo khul dgongs pa chos dbyings su thims/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs skor sngar lam bzhin chos 'khor rgyal lha mo'i bla mtshor mtsho gzigs su rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgreng ngo phebs thog sku 'khor du bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal dang / mkhan drung ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen/ mtshan zhabs ke'u tshang sprul sku sogs drung rigs ser skya nyi shu tsam ched phebs kyis chos 'khor rgyal du dprel ldan lha mo zhi drag sogs bstan srung rnams la gsol mchod dang 'brel gza' skar bzang bstun gyis lha mo'i bla mtshor mtsho gzigs bskyangs pa ma zad/ de min rta mgrin dang lcam sring gi bla mtshor yang mtsho gzigs mdzad cing / de nas dwags po rgya tsha rwa smad du rgyal tshab rin po che gang nyid kyi 'khrungs lha gsol ba dang sbrags dwags la sgam por 25

gnas gzigs mdzad de slar yang chos 'khor rgyal du chibs bsgyur gnang ste chos srung rnams la gtang rag gi gsol mchod mdzad grub bstun chos 'khor rgyal nas chibs thon gyis tshur lam lho khul gyi rtsa che'i dgon khag la gan/sa gzigs dang 'brel rgyal ba'i yang srid 'khrul bral btsanu/ rnyed thub pa'i zhabs rim mdzad pa dang lhag par du bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub nga/ ri gtsug lag khang la gnas gzigs dang 'brel chos skyong tsi'u dmar po sku gsol zhus nas rgyal ba'i yang srid skor lung zhu mdzad par tsi'u dmar pos khog brlams lung bstan gnang srol med kyang shar phyogs su mjal dar phu(la nas rgyal ba'i yang srid shar phyogs su sku bltams yod pa'i brda mtshon bstan /de nas rgyal tshab rin po che sku 'khor lha sar phyir phebs rjes gong gsal mtsho gzigs kyi nang don rnams srid blon dang / bka' shag bong ljongs chogs 'du bcas la gros bsdur bya rgyur gnang zhing / tshogre/sa 'dus rgyal chab srid skyong rin po che'i mtsho gzigs yig 'bru‘‘a rkya/ ma’tsho zhes nga/'i bo/ don ni a zhes pa a mdo sa khul dang / ka ma gnyis kyi don ni sku 'bum dgon gyi nye 'dabs su (skabs de'i gzhung yig ltar na ming gzhi ka'i ru/ mgo dang dbyangs phyis pas sku dang ming gzhi ma'i sa mgo dang rjes 'jug da phyis pas smad ces sku 'bum gyi shar smad ces pa'i go don mtshon lugs gsal ) tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid sku bltams yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byas thog brtsad gcod zhu mi 'phral du mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi zi ling du gtong dgos pa'i snyan seng zhus pa bzhin mtsho gzigs su lhan phebs mdzad mkhan gras mtshan zhabs ke'u tshang sprul sku dang / kun bzang rtse/ mkhe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus/ nag chu rdzong sdod rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ las bya rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang bcas la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i phyag 26

phreng dang / phyag ṭam/ phyag 'khar bcas ngo ma dang ngo 'dra re bskur te gtong gnang mdzad pa dang / ke'u tshang sprul sku dang rwa sgreng srid skyong bar phan tshun bka' mol 'brel mthud stabs bde yong ched gsang tar gyi yi ge sgrig pa'i 'dra ya bskur gnang mdzad don ke'u tshang sprul sku ngo las mtsho sngon du phebs pa dang / phur lcog yongs 'dzin sogs yang srid brtsad gcod mdzad mi khag gcig chos 'khor rgyal du mtsho gzigs dang bcas lho kha khul du gtong gnang mdzad/ ke'u tshang sprul sku ngo las zi ling du phebs nas sku 'bum nye 'khor du phebs 'byor skabs mtsho gzigs nang yod pa'i rgya khang ngo mkhyen nas der yod khyim tshang du ngo g.yog na bza' go brjes kyis phebs shing / de gar yab cho cho tshe ring dang yum tshe ring mtsho mo gnyis kyi sras lha mo don grub yod pa gang des ke'u tshang sprul sku'i pang du phebs pa dang / tā la'i bla ma sku gong ma'i sku'i nyer chas phyag phreng sogs ngo ma rnams re re bzhin phyag tu bzhes pa sogs kyi ngos 'dzin ha cang gsal po byung bas de skor lha sar gsang tar phul 'byor byung don rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gis srid bka' tshogs gsum la gang 'gab gros bsdur mdzad par tshogs 'dus rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgrong rin po che'i thugs dam dang / gnas chung gi bka' lung sogs gcig mthun gyi sgo nas yang srid gdan zhu thub pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu don bzhin de sngon sku phreng bcu gsum pas bstsal ba'i lha mo'i mo dpe gzhir bzung gis slar yang thugs dam mdzad par yang gong gsal lha mo don grub la thugs dam bzang phebs byung ba dang /de bzhin gnas chung chos skyong gis kyang rwa sgreng rin po ches mtsho gzigs mdzad pa bzhin 'khrul pa med pa'i bka' lung gnang ba rtse mthun byung rung /sku drag khag gcig gis bod nang khul du yod pa'i sku'i rtags mtshan legs 27

pa'i bu phrug re zung dang mtsho sngon du yod pa'i lha mo don grub bcas sngar lam bzhin gser bum brtag dpyad thog su bzang phebs byung ba de ngos 'dzin zhu rgyu'i 'dun zhus/ skabs der rwa sgreng rin po che'i dgongs par de snga sku phreng bcu gsum pa ngos 'dzin zhu skabs kun gling rgyal tshab kyis nor 'khrul mi yong ched glang mdun du sku bltams pa de 'os gcig mar ngos 'dzin gyis gong mar snyan zhu dang 'brel gser khrir mnga' gsol mdzad pa bzhin da lta'i yang srid kyang mtsho gzigs su gzigs pa bzhin gtan 'khel mdzad rgyu'i thugs 'dod yod kyang sngar lam gser bum brtag dpyad kyis yang srid gtan 'khel byed rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin mkhan yang yod par brten re zhig gcig thog gtan 9rakhel gnang rgyu ngang 'then mdzad/de rjes bod ljongs tshogs 'dus tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid gdacha/ zhu'i thad da bar nar 'gyangs byung song zhing / da cha rgyal tshab rin po ches thugs ‘ragan bzhes te 'phral mur gdan zhu gtan 'khel yong ba zhes zhus par rgyal tshab srid skyong rin po ches‘‘da bar phan tshun gcig khag gcig dkris (de skabs phyag rogs glang mdun gung yod pas red ) kyis nar 'gyangs song (geng da cha tshogs 'du'i re 'dun bzhin rgyal ba'i yang srid lha mo'i bla mtsho dang k+ṣ-ilha bla'i lung brtag bzhin myur du gdan zhu bya rgyu yin’’zhes gsungs par tshogs 'dus‘‘rgyal ba'i yang srid gdan zhu'i thad srid blon gyis phyag rogs mdzad rgyu'i thad la mdzad dka' yod tshe srid blon rang si/ thugs bzhes bzhin sred blon gyi las 'gan dgongs zhu 'bul rgyu dang gzhung sa'i thugs 'gan tshang ma rgyal tshab srid skyong rin po ches bzhes gnang yong ba'i’’skyabs 'jug zhus don bzhin de snga kun gling rgyal tshab srid skyong gi lam bzhin thugs 'gan gtsang bzhes gnang thog mtsho sngon du yod pa'i tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid bod du 28

gdan zhu dgos pa'i skor ke'u tshang sprul skur tar 'phrin gtong gnang mngod/zi ling kru'u zhis za rngams kyis yang srid gdan zhu byed na tā ③/nga nyis 'bum dgos lugs sogs baya/da de bka' 'gos/ byas stabs ke'u tshang sprul sku ngo las kyis rgya gar du gnas mjal 'gro mkhan hu'e rigs 'kho tu'e krang zhes par bod nas dbyin sgor sprod rgyu byas te tā yang gang 'tshams dngul brjes kyis sprad phros mi gta' bzhag pa sogs kyi bya thabs la brten nas mthar sa yos ( 1929) lor tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid bod du gdan zhu thub pa byung zhing / ya nga srid sku 'khor gyi phebs bsur bka' blon bon shod kyis gtsos pa'i sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum dang / mgron ba/zim/ gsol thab pa sogs gtong gnang dang / de nas rgyal tshab nyid nas 'dam gzhung dbu ma bkris thang du phebs bsur chibs bsgyur thog rwa sgreng du gdan zhus kyis nyin bdun bzhusas/ lha sa'i nye 'dabs sgang stod 'dod rgu thang du drung rigs ser skya yongs dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi bla ma las sne sogs phebs bsur bcar nas mdzad sgo grub bstun phyi nyin gtsug lag khang khag gnyis la gnas gzigs mdzad rjes nor gling du phebs/ yang srid rin po che bod du zhabs sor 'khod nyid rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgreng nas bod ljongs tshogs 'dur tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid mtsho sngon du bltams pa'i lha mo rdan grub gang der thag gcod gtan 'khel byed min thad gros bsdur byed dgos gsungs par/ tshogs 'dus mgrin gcig tu mtsho sngon du 'khrungs pa'i yang srid 'di nyid rang la gtan 'khel bya rgyur bod ljongs lha sde mi sde yongs kyis rtags the'u bzhag nas slad rgyal ba'i yang srid thad lab gleng mi yong ba'i khas len zhus/ dus mtshungs go min tang srid gzhung la lha sdod las don mi sna brgyud de skor tar 'phrin 29

baig nas snyan seng gnang sngar 'a 3 / 9dze+e ga— rgyu /rirwari tshab nyid na sa yo ngas/ 1ririrwa tso —ngagres pa'i mtshan bzhe tra/ dang ma cham/ phyobs tā han stag brag ngag ngabangag/sung rab la yongs 'dzin sku gzhon nga ri baṭīci sa'ag mdzadaca gong 'esna dwar+sāri boparle// khang/'i nang gtsug lag khang jo bo'i spyan s+dzar yang srid rin po che'i 5twasni bu n+t+ra nga/tsug baches5 dang dase bsten/ sdom nga/ phu'/ ba'i/ mtshan‘‘rje btsun 'jatre tropar+ṣa༈/ nga ga dbang blo bzang ye / r+shas bstan 'dzin rgya ma/tsho srid gsum dang — rkyu ra myo/tshungs pa med pa'i sme’’zhes gsol ba dang 'bas brtan gsol ngebs kru/nga balpoljo rtsom gnang / lcags 'brug ( 19'u rkya ) lo'i zla 1tshes —tsho rkanyi rlopyari/nga sri/da rin po chetshogang nyid pho brang po ta lar tā la'i bla ma'i sace ra khrirazuprengang gso la mdzad gtan 'khel zhing / bo niri myo tang srid gzhung sis zu ri/0rdzu'i/ gtong byas nga 'i bod sog u yor pye ḍasmo—ri be spyi khyab 'u krung zhin tā 95'i blo/ zu4 glusde lbe phebasarnakyi ma/dzad t+tariri ra rtekyo rko ‘rnyi rte ci ra cheng phebs skabs rgyal catsab rwa sgreng mas sne len 0zang rgyas 0 ṣ+ṭha gyi — da nga ci/ ( 3 krung 'in myo sa rgya‘swā rtu ḍāb rwa sgreng la go min tang gi rgyal dmadzoraci tshags che na lce rdorethus/ mi'i mtsham skyukanas dang / ‘ bsamatshosatan gyi slob dpon rwa sgreng ho thog thu'i garī ra tham/’tsho (zhes pa phul ba/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng nas kyang 'u krung 'i phya ci phyir phebaskyuci mdu5tsho ( nan cin srid gzhung 'a phyag bris dang rten chas 'bul/bskur mdzad yod / ṭā la'i bla ma gser khrir 'khod grub rjes rgyal tshab mi dgos pas‘‘srid skyong mongs 'dzin rwa sgreng hu thog thu’’zhes nga ra mtshan bsgyur/thing khyi( 192 4 ) lo nas lcasas 'brug ( 19'u 0 ) bar lo bdum riring rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes ring gdan sa se 'bras gnyis kyi tshogs chem/ dang / brag yer pa/ snye thang sgrol ma lha/ khang / bsam yas gtsug 'a/ga la/ nga / dwags lha sgam po/ chos 'khor rgyal sogs lo rgyus ri re (tsho

ri /gatrar+sha can gyi dgon pa nyams gso dang / dgon sde'i gtong sgo gtong ma thub nga ra bde sdug zhu mi tshor chos gzhis sam 'bru phogs kha snon stsal/ga'amyo yang ri pin btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rgyal nang du btsan 'dzul byed skabs ri pin gtor pham gtong thub pa'i zhabs rim thugs smon mdzad/ ri sa rgyal nang khul du 'bul sdud dang tshong pa snga phyir gtong gnang mdzad pa baṭad bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang mes rgyal dbar dang / mes rgyal dang rlo———d+melde dbar mthun lam zab mo byung /rwa sgreng rin po che'i dgongs par srid skyong gnang 'dod med pa gang kā5 gas she na/ srid skyong lo mang gnang tshe de snga lo rgyus thog rwa sgreng sku phreng gsu/ma par dbu nyes byung ba dang / bstan rgyas gling la yang dbu nyes byung snge rtepetrari sred skyong dgongs zhu gnang rtsis yod pas dgongs pa zhus na 'gab men slor dang / sa gnas srid gzhung gi chab srid/ tā la'i bla ma dang /rwa sgreng ny-id kyi sku 'phya bcas skor/ de snga rwa bla'i las don skor la pra phab ma kherkya/ seng ke sgang gi bla mar pra phab tu bcug gnang ba'i 'bras bur ‘‘de mus srengaskyi skyong chi kādziro tshe gzhung sa'i chab srid sra brtan dang / rin po che'i sku 'phya/bla brang bi las dom/ bcas la bzang po yod rung / rgyal ba rin po che dgung lo bcu gcig las ha lam bzhugs pa mi 'dug srid skyong dgongs zhu gnang na gong sa mchog sku tshe ring zhing rgyal srid chos srid kyi thugs 'gan phyag bzhes thub pa dang / srid skyong rin po che sku tshe ring zhing mdzad 'phrin rgyas po yong ba 'dug’’ces gsal bar brten srid skyong dgongs pa zhu rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de skabs der mdzod pa dza sag dang / las rogs bzhi sde smyung gnas sprul sku/ gzim dpon ngag dbang blo ldan/ mkhar rdo sprul sku// nga rang bcas par bka' bsdur gnang baྈ nga tshos rin po che'i dgongs bzhes 31

lta ra srid skyong dgongs zhu mdzad rgyur cho/sa mthun zhus/ de nas n+d+rahūṃ — skyong rin po ches bka' shag nang blo dkar ba'i bka(re blon gsu ma ngang drurwa rtsis thugs blos 'khe/ la ba'i mi snar‘‘nga rang sritro/ skyong gi 'a 'i 5 (zorigren yu5 re nga bzung na de snga'i sku 'phreng gsum pa ltar bkra mi shis pa'i sam/sa/ tshur+ṣa sdu lke nga sri ra nga/sa da cha dgongs pa zhu rgyur bkag 'bo/ga meng pa'i rogs ram gnang —bos / tshe/sa bka' mngags gnang ba bzhin ba/ sa len zhus / rwa sgreng rin tretre che ri ra hri/da skyong gsar bsko 'i thad the jus gnang rtsis mi 'dug kyang smyung samasku༄ t+tadhed myo/sa de sngon mtshams sbyor byas nas rwa sgreng 'a/ stag brag rin ngo che'i bro snye— 'o 4 〈gsang bde 'jigs sa/sum〉gyi bkare dbang zhus khar/ skabs dero ༅ parī kautre/nga gnas bla mas sku na'i babs nga/nga / sku yon/ bla brang dbar 'a brel ba rbehūṃgs/ gang thad na/sa stag brag srid skyong du ba skos na legs tshul zhus nga/ra rwa snyegyu/nga rin po che thugs mos chen po byung 'ing / de don phran dang mkhar rngo rjosgyul/ sku/ gzim/ dpon ngag blo bcas la bka' 'dri gnang byuro bas gzim dngo na nas‘‘srid skyong gsar bsko'i thad nga tshos the ju'ismi/ rma ri kaXne+e dzi na 9skugs shing / ngas bltas na stag brag de gting gnag mardos rtob smo redug ces zhus song / rwa sgreng rin po cher stag brag la blud skyo nga bsgo rgyur thugs mos shin tu che gshis/ bka' shag dang drung rtsis/ tshogs 'du'i nang ji/ rngakand che'i mi sna dang / de min blo dkar rnams la srid skyong gsar bsko stas/ ཿbug la byed rgyur khas len byed dgos kyi bka' mngags gnang ba dang /ཿ skabs der rtsis dpon klu khang pa tshogs 'du'i nang kha shus/sa che stabs 'a/ma du (regro dka' bas khong stod lung bde chen khul du rgyud smad grwa tshang gi sa zhib shāpre gtong gnang mdzad/ de nas lo de'i bod zla 11pa'i nang nyin gcig bka' shag dang drung rtsis / tshogs 'du bcas po ta lar 'dzom/sa dgos 32

pa'i bka' khyab thog srid skyong rwa sgreng gis 'bul mtshan dang bcas tā la'i bla ma'i gzim chung du phebs te dgongs zhu'i snyan seng zhus don‘‘de snga sku gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi zhu sgo spyi dang / lhag par gser gdung dge legs 'dod 'jo gsar bzhengs/ rgyal dbang mchog gdan zhu dang 'brel gser khrir mnga' gsol thub pa byung bas da cha nga rang tshe gegs che bas srid skyong yongs 'dzin gyi las 'gan dgongs pa yong ba dang / srid skyong gsar pa yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po cher bsko gzhag gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin pas gong sa mchog nas nga rang dgongs 'khrol thog yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po che srid skyong gnang dgos pa'i bka' khyab yong ba’’zhes zhu gnang mdzad/skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku na phra la/ gnyis ka yongs 'dzin yang yin stabs de phral bka' mol tshig gcig kyang ma gnang zhing / lam seng bka' shag rtse gzim chung du yong dgos pa'i bka' phab thog tā la'i bla ma dang yongs 'dzin stag brag bka' shag bcas lhan 'dzoms sar srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ches‘‘nga ni rgyal dbang don gyi bdag por dgongs zhus zin pas srid skyong gsar pa yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po ches thugs 'gan bzhes dgos skor ngas kyang zhus yod la/ khyed rnam pas kyang zhu dgos shing / don de nyi ma de ring thag chod pa zhig byed dgos’’zhes gsungs par bka' shag nas srid skyong gi thugs 'gan/ sngar bzhin rwa sgreng mchog nas bzhes dgos lugs zhus rung‘‘nga ni rgyal dbang don gyi bdag por dgongs pa zhus zin pas drung rtsis dang tshogs 'dur brgyud bsgrags thag gcod byed dgos’’zhes gsungs don bzhin drung rtsis brgyud tshogs 'dur gsungs par/ tshogs 'dus‘‘rgyal dbang mchog nas rgyal srid kyi thugs 'gan ma bzhes bar rwa sgreng natra/ sngar bzhin srid skyong yongs 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan bzhes dargo/sa’’zhes phyag 'tshal 33

skyabs zhu byas par rwa sgreng nas gong bzhin dgongs zhu mtha' skyel gnang /skabs der drung rtsis dang tshogs 'du'i nang rwa blar blo dkar ba tsho'i bsam par rwa sgreng rin po che dgongs zhu mtha' skyel mdzad tshe bka' blon bla ma dang bon shod gnyis srid blon du bsko rgyu dang / de bzhin bka' blon gsar bsko mdzad rgyu'i lam srol yod rung skabs der zhu ma nus/ de nas tshogs 'dus gros bsdur byas snying‘‘srid skyong rin po che'i sku 'phyar 'tshub cha yo/da tshe sku gegs ma sel bar srid skyong gi las 'gan dgongs zhu phul 'thus chog rung lo gsum song mtshams srid skyong gi thugs 'gan blar bzhes yong ba’’zhes pa'i tshig tho spyi dam drug 'byar phul ba dang de'i ring srid skyong gi thugs ('gan stag brag rin po cher skyabs 'jug zhu rgyur gros 'cham byas/ lcags 'brug( 1940)gi lo 'phros rwa sgreng nas srid 'gan bzhes pa dang / lcags sbrul( 1941) lo'i zla 1tshes 1nas stag brag gis srid 'gan bzhes thog stag brag nas‘‘ngas lo gnyis gsum gang 'khyol srid skyong yongs 'dzin gyi las 'khur chog pa dang / slad phyin tshig tho spyi dam drug 'byar gyi nang don bzhin rwa sgreng nas slar yang srid skyong gnang dgos’’zhes gsungs par rwa sgreng nas kyang khas len mdzad pa ma zad srid gzhung gi las don sgrub phyogs skor dang /rwa blar dad zhen yod pa'i ser skya dpon rigs la blta skyong mdzad dgos sogs nang ma'i bka' mngags kyang mdzad de bod zla 2pa'i nang gdan sa rwa sgreng du chibs bsgyur gyis lhod bzhugs mdzad/de rjes rwa blar blo dkar ba'i gzhung gi dpon rigs khag nas sngon du dgongs zhu'i skabs kyi spyi dam tshig tho'i snying don ltar lo gsum song mtshams rwa sgreng nas srid 'gan slar bzhes mdzad dgos kyi re 'dun zhu mkhan byung ba nga/nga / lhag par du mkhar rdo sprul sku dang bzhi sde smyung gnas bla mas srid 34

skyong stag brag gis lha sdod go min tang gi sku tshab zhung khru'u krang la gzan shing bcad pa ma zad/ mes rgyal du phyir log btang ba dang / tā la'i bla ma'i yab gzhis nas bod kyi lam lugs gsal shes ma thub rkyen drung rigs ser skyar nyes pa btang ba sogs la bsnyad de don du yab gzhis kyis khrims 'gal byed mi chog pa'i srid tham rtsa tshig bkram pa/ stag brag dang zhwa sgab pa tshong 'brel yin rung rwa bla lta bu'i tshong las byed kyi med pas sku sger bla brang gi ming 'khyer nas tshong las byed mkhan yod tshe sa gnas so sos 'dzin bzung thog bla brang la rtsis sprod dgos pa'i rdzong gzhis khag la bka' rgya btang ba/ zhabs pad drung rtsis sogs gal che'i las tshan bsko gzhag byed skabs rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs la bkag 'gog dang / las gnas su yod pa rnams byed 'dzol yod med la ma ltos par las 'gan phyir 'then byed pa/ las tshan che chung bsko gzhag byed skabs dngul lor kho nar blta ba bcas la brten rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs nas rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar phebs dgos zhes pa'i zhu yig yang yang phul 'byor byung bar rwa sgreng rin po ches gsol dpon 'jam dbyangs sbyin pa lha sar srid skyong stag brag sar ched gtong mdzad de bla brang gnyis dbar phan tshun dga' min dbyen sbyor dkrug shing gi rkyen pas dam tshig nyams chag tu 'gro nyen 'dug pas de rtsis gsan dgongs med pa dang /'di nas kyang nyan rtsis med pas de don dgongs 'jags mdzad dgos sogs kyi phyag bris bskur gnang mdzad pa gsol dpon nas stag brag la phul bar stag brag gis sngar bzhin bla brang gnyis dbar dam sel yong gzhi med tshul 'dra chags gsungs pa dang / tshur phul phyag bris nang du'ang che bstod 'jam mkhas tsam las don gzhan med stabs rwa sgrong rin po ches bla brang gnyis dbar dam sel mi yong ba'i dgongs gzhi gtso bor mdzad/ 'on 35

kyang ser skya dpon rigs kyi nang dang gdan sa khag gi mkhan po'i nang nas khag gcig gis rwa sgreng gis srid 'gan slar bzhes mdzad rgyu'i re ba byed pa dang / gzhan khag gcig nas stag brag gis srid 'gan mu mthud gnang rgyu'i re ba byed bzhin yod stabs shing sprel (1944)lo'i zla 2tshes 20nyin tshogs mchod ser sbreng gi mdzad sgo'i sar gdan sa'i mkhan po tshos‘‘'di lo lha mo'i zan brtag nang rgya dbang mchog dang srid skyong (stag brag) rin po che'i sku 'phyar gegs bar chen po yod ces thon gshis drung rigs ser skya yongs nas srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che yang sku drin chen po yin stabs rgyal dbang mchog dang srid skyong las zur lhan gcig la brtan bzhugs 'bul rgyu byung na legs’’tshul drung rtsis tshor gros 'go ston pa bzhin bka' shag la zhu skabs bka' bla bstan pa 'jam dbyangs nas ‘‘rwa sgreng srid zur dang gong sa mchod yon (tā la'i bla ma dang srid skyong stag brag la zer) lhan du brtan bzhugs 'bul stabs ma bde bas rwa sgreng rang du brtan bzhugs 'bul rgyu’’zhes pa'i gros 'go bton pa bzhin rwa sgreng du tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi ched btang gis brtan bzhugs phul/ skabs der mkhar rdo sprul skus ser byed grwa tshang nyams gso legs grub byung ba'i rab gnas mdzad par rwa sgreng gdan zhu dgos tshul byes mkhan po ngag rgyal la skul slong byas don bzhin ser byes grwa tshang gis gdan zhus ltar rwa sgrong rin po che lha sar phebs thog tā la'i bla ma dang srid skyong stag brag la brtan bzhugs 'bul gnang mdzad pa ma zad/srid skyong gsar rnying dang bla slob dbar dam sel mi yong ba'i ched du stag brag dang mjal 'dzoms kyang gnang / 'on kyang skabs der rwa stag gnyis kar phyogs khag yod rkyen stag brag phyogs gtogs kyis rwa sgreng lha sar phebs dgos don srid 'gan slar bzhes mdzad rgyu'i don du red bsam pa'i dogs 36

'drogs byung ba dang / rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs ser byes mkhan po dang /mkhar rdo sprul sku/ smyung gnas bla ma sogs kyis rwa sgreng rin po che nas srid 'gan slar bzhes mdzad rgyu'i thad stag brag la bka' mol gnang dgos pa'i re ba zhus rung rwa sgreng ni thugs gshis 'jam zhing thugs tsha smin stabs skabs der stag brag dang mjal 'dzoms thengs gsum gnang rung de skor tshig gcig kyang gsungs med pa dang / stag brag nas‘‘rin po che khyed kyi thugs 'dun bzhin srid skyong las 'gan gang 'khyol 'khur rgyu’’dang bla brang gnyis dbar mthun lam sngar bzhin yong rgyu'i bka' mol gnang bas phyi tshul dam gtsang lta bu byung rung nang don 'gal ba che ru song zhing / skabs der rwa sgreng rin po ches lha sdod go min tang srid gzhung gi sku tshab dra'an khru'u krang ngo las la gsol ston gzab rgyas gshams gnang skabs dra'an khru'u krang gis de snga‘‘rwa sgreng rin po ches srid 'gan bzhes skabs mes bod mthun lam che ba dang / da lta srid skyong stag brag gi srid 'gan bzhes rjes 'brel ba ji zhan du 'gro gi 'dug pas khyed kyis srid 'gan slar bzhes mdzad dgos’’zhes re ba zhus pa ma zad go min tang gis gsang ba'i mi sna ched gtong byas pa des kyang rwa sgrong gis srid 'gan slar bzhes mdzad dgos zhus par rwa sgreng nas‘‘rwa sgrong bla brang gi tshong pa mes rgyal nang khul du gtong gi yin pas de tshor rogs ram gnang rogs/ srid 'gan slar len bya rgyu'i thad rjes su rwa sgreng du log rjes gros mol byed kyi yin’’zhes gsungs/rwa sgreng du phyir phebs gnang khar rwa sgreng rin po ches ser byes mkhan por‘‘de snga ngas go min tang gi thugs 'dun bzhin rgya'i skad yig slob grwa btsugs pa der dpe bltas nas da lta lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs rtsis 'dug cing se 'bras kyis gtsos pa'i dgon sde khag nas kyang slob phrug bsdu 37

rtsis byed kyi 'dug pa de ni chos lugs kyi lta ba mi 'dra ba ma zad rang re bod mi rnams la phyi rgyal gyi shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs rgyur brten khyed kyis bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i nang nus shugs bton nas bkag 'gog byed dgos’’zhes gsungs par mkhan pos khas len zhus/ de rjes bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i thog dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu'i skor gros bsdur byed skabs ser byes mkhan pos ngo rgol byas par gdan sa gzhan gyi mkhan pobasdo rgyab skyor byas stabs dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs ma thub pa red/skabs der 'phan po lhun grub rdzong drung che chos 'phel thub bstan gyi thab rten du 'dzin gyi yod cing / de'i rdzong sdod ngo tshab la 'phan khul ser byes 'bru 'ded grwa pas nyes brdung btang ste shi rkyen byung bas drung che chos 'phel thub bstan nas sa gnas srid gzhung la gyod don snyan zhu phul skor rwa sgreng rin po ches gyod ya phan tshun gnyis ka rwa blar thugs snang dkar gshis khrims sar slong 'bebs(gyod gzhi khrims sar gtugs zin kyang bar 'dum byas chog pa zhus par zer) zhu rgyu byas par drung che chos 'phel thub bstan gyis rtsa ba nas khas len ma zhus pa der rwa sgreng rin po che thugs pham po byung ba ma zad/ ser byes grwa tshang gi las sne yang yid thang chad de stag brag gis legs po mi byed pa'i dogs pa chen po byung yod/ 'on kyang rwa sgreng rin po ches ser byes mkhan po sogs la‘‘gnad don de'i thad srid gzhung nas drang bden gyi thag gcod yong shag la/ nga rang nas srid skyong stag brag la'ang bka' mngags zhus chog’’ces gsungs te gdan sa rwa sgrong du chibs bsgyur bskyangs/de nas gong lo'i zla 12pa'i zla mjug tu lhun grub rdzong sdod nyes brdung gtong mkhan ser byes kyi 'bru 'ded pa tsho'i nang gi gtso bo rnams zhol las khungs su btson 'jug byas rkyen ser byes mkhan po ngag rgyal gyi bsam par 38

smon lam chen mo'i skabs dang bstun nas se ra'i 'bru 'ded pa rnams re re bzhin 'bras spungs zhal ngor rtsis sprod kyis 'dzin bzung byas yong snyam pa'i dogs char chen po skyes te dgon pa'i las sne dang sna chen rgyas 'dzoms kyi tshogs 'dur lhun grub rdzong sdod rkyen lam shor ba'i gnad don de'i skor gros bsdur byas don snying por smon lam chen mor phyin na srid skyong stag brag gis le 'khri 'bru 'ded rnams zhal ngor 'dzin bzung byed dgos kyi bka' phab rgyu yin pas/ des na lo der ser byes dge 'dun rnams smon lam du mi gtong rgyu'i thag bcad/ lo der tshe smon gling ho thog thu mtshan rtags bzhes rgyu yin pas/ rwa bla dang / phur lcog bla brang gis gtsos ser byes grwa tshang gi khongs gtogs rnams kyis sa gnas srid gzhung la lhun grub rdzong sdod rkyen lam gtong mkhan gtso bo ser byes 'bru 'ded zhol du btson 'jug byas pa rnams glod 'grol yong ba dang ser byes grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rnams smon lam du phebs dgos pa'i kha zhe gnyis med kyi zhu 'bul byas pas sa gnas srid gzhung gis btson pa de rnams glod pa dang / ser byes grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rnams smon lam du phebs thub pa byung yod/ rwa sgreng rin po ches lhun grub rdzong sdod kyi don rkyen 'di skor srid skyong stag brag dang ser byes grwa tshang gnyis dbar 'gal ba che ru mi 'gro ba'i thabs shes mdzad rung drung rigs ser skya re zung gis ser byes smon lam du mi yong rgyu'i gnad don de rwa sgreng gis snga lo ser byes mkhan por ngan bslab byas pa'i 'bras bu yin tshul srid skyong stag brag la zhus par brten der stag brag dogs gnad chen po byung yod pa 'dra yang skabs der rwa sgreng rin po ches srid skyong stag brag la ser byes grwa tshang smon lam du ma bcar bar dgongs 'gal med pa dang lhun grub rdzong sdod rkyen bsad kyi gyod gzhi'i skor slong 'bebs yong ba/ gal te slong 'bebs 39

mdzad dka' mchis tshe bka' dpyad gang yang yong ba sogs kyi phyag bris phul gnang ba ma zad/ nga rang (dza sag) la'ang srid skyong stag brag rin po cher dgongs sel zhu dgos pa'i bka' yig kyang stsal 'byor byung don bzhin nged nas srid skyong stag brag mjal bcar zhu skabs stag brag gis ‘‘srid skyong las khur skabs ser byes grwa tshang gis sngar byung myong med pa'i lha ldan smon lam chen mor ma yong ba de blo pham che rung rgyal zur rin po che'i phyag bris gnang bar brten ngas gang drag byas chog 'on kyang bka' shag dang zhib sar yag po zhu dgos’’zhes gsungs pa las zhal bzhes ma byung bas gus pas rwa sgreng du bang mi ched btang gis srid skyong stag brag rin po ches gsungs don rnams zhu yig dang sbrags stag bragagi phyag bris bcas rwa sgreng rin po cher phul ba yin/de rjes rwa sgreng rin po che thugs khral chen po byung yod stabs dza zur 'jam dbyangs bde legs la'ang gnad don de'i skor stag brag la dgongs sel zhu dgos pa'i bka' slob gnang don dza zur nas stag brag sar bcar skabs kyang gong bzhin‘‘bka' shag la legs po zhu dgos/ ngas 'di nas gang yag byas chog’’ces gsungs pa las zhal bzhes ma mdzad khar/ de lo zla 2pa'i nang stag brag gis ser byes mkhan po dang / stod pa mkhan po/ sngags pa mkhan po gsum gyi mkhan po'i go gnas phyir 'then thog gyod ya drung che 'bum thang pa chos 'phel thub bstan phud/ drung rtsis bdun sbrel gyi zhib dpyod pa bsko gzhag byas nas lhun grub rdzong sdod nyes brdung gtong mkhan dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan las sne bskong 'gugs kyis 'dri zhib byas pa dang / byed gte'i grwa pa rnams la rta lcag gzhus te glang la bskyon nas rgyang 'bud btang ste rdzong gzhis khag la rtsis sprod kyis tshe btson tshe sgo tshe lcags kyang rgyag rgyu'i thag gcod lag bstar byas stabs rwa sgreng rin po che thugs pham chen po byung yod 40

cing / skabs der go min tang srid gzhung gis btang ba'i mi snas rwa sgreng rin po cher slar yang srid skyong mdzad dgos kyi re zhus bka' lan du‘‘go min tang krung dbyang nas srid skyong stag brag khri bshol byed rgyu'i bka' 'bebs dgos pa dang / yang na dngul mang tsam dngul rjes yong ba dang bod nang khul nas thabs shes byed rgyu/ yang na go lag mang tsam gtong gnang gis rgyab skyor gnang na krung dbyang gi thugs mdun bzhin 'grub pa yong rgyu las ngas 'di nas srid skyong byed kyi yin zhes shod bde po mi 'dug ’’ces gsungs par go min tang krung dbyang nas gsang tar thog‘‘sku don 'grub yong’’zhes lan thengs gnyis gsum tsam phul 'byor byung yod la/ de rjes go min tang gi 'thus tshogs thengs drug par rwa sgreng rin po che sku ngo phebs thub na rab dang de min sku tshab do chod gtong dgos kyi tar 'phrin yang phul 'byor byung bar rwa sgreng sku ngo ma phebs rgyu dang bla brang zhabs gras gtong rgyu de ni sa gnas srid gzhung dogs 'drogs yong gzhir brten skabs der be ri rgya dpon bu don rnams lha sa nas pha yul du phyir log byed nyer rwa sgreng du bcar bar‘‘da lam khyed dang a thub la dkar bu gnyis nas ngos kyi tshab byas nas go min tang gi 'thus tshogs su bskyod de srid skyong las 'khur slar len byed rgyu'i gnad don skor gang 'gab las don sgrub dgos ’’zhes bka' mngags dang 'brel cang tsung thung la phyag bris dang 'bul tshan bskur gnang mdzad/'on kyang go min tang srid gzhung ni de skabs nyams zhan rul sungs su gyur zin pas gong gsal nga tsho'i gsang gnas phyi gyar gyis skabs de'i tshogs zhugs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mas shes rtogs byung phral srid bkar tar thog snyan seng zhus yod stabs sa gnas srid gzhung gis lam seng bya thabs spel te srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che dang / dza sag las zur gnyis/41

yab gzhis phun khang gung yab sras/ mkhar rdo sprul sku/ ser stod mkhan zur/ sa 'du 'gyur med sogs do dam byas nas zhu ba blangs pa dang /skabs der rwa sgreng nas sngar gyi byas rjes la gzigs nas srid bka' tshogs bcas lha dgongs dwangs ba dang srid skyong stag brag dang ngo mjal yong ba'i re zhu gnang rung don smin ma byung ba ma zad mthar sku bkrongs/ 'on kyang bka' dpyad nang‘‘gzhung bstan srung ma'i mthu la brten nas srog rlung gis sku tsha ma zin pa red’’ces bshad yod la/ da dung ‘‘rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal gyi skye srid brtsad gcod mi chog pa dang / khri ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi skye srid brtsad gcod chog rung tshogs chen sprul sku'i go gnas ma gtogs srid skyong 'os khongs su zhugs mi chog bod chos srid gnyis ldan gyi rgyal khab 'di phyi rgyal rgya mi'i lag tu skyel rgyu'i bya ngan tshabs cher brten rwa bla'i mkhar dbang tshang ma gzhung bzhes dgos rung rgyal dbang don gyi bdag po'i gser zhal la bltas nas chu byi( 1kha12lo)tshun gyi 'dzin dngos gzhung bzhes dang /chu byi phan gyi rwa bla'i mkhar dbang dang tshong pa'i ma rtsa rnams rang 'jags thog dza zur 'jam dbyangs dge legs nas mdzod pa'i 'gan khur rgyu’’bcas la thag bcad/ skabs der gus rang lo na phra rung dpyad mtshams nang‘‘rang nyes tshang ma rdza kha bsubs kyis sba gsang byas pa'i tshabs che'i byed 'dzol la gzhigs na dmar gsod gtong dgos 'dug rung rgyal dbang don gyi bdag po'i dgung skeg la brten mig gnyis bton te zhol btson khang du tshe btson du 9 dijog rgyu ’’thag bcad byung / de nas gang 'tshams song rjes srid skyong stag brag gis rwa sgreng dza sag dang mkhar rdo sprul sku'i dbang po gcod breg ma dgos par de min bka' dpyad gang 'os gtong dgos skor shod 'gag brgyud bka' phebs pas nged gnyis kyi dbang por gcod breg ma dgos par rta lcag 42

nyis brgya drug cu re btang nas tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab ste sku srung dmag sgar la tshe btson du rtsis sprad‘‘gal te bros byol phyin na dmar gsod btang chog pa dang / glod grol zhu mi byung na kho pa gnyis kyi nag nyes yongs rdzogs 'gel rgyu dang mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes byed rgyu ’’bcas kyi bka' dpyad btang /se rwa dang rwa sgreng zing 'khrug gi byed gte rnams la rta lcag zhus nas tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab ste sde dpon khag la rtsis sprod bcas byas pa red/mdor na de snga btsan nye phyogs khag gis rwa sgreng phyogs khag rtsa gtor gtong rgyu'i bya ngan ji ltar spel rung rwa sgreng sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gang des tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i dgongs gzhi dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi re 'dun ltar bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong gi mtshan gnas bzhes thog tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i zhabs 'jug legs grub mdzad pa dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid brtsad gcod gdan zhus kyis gser khri mnga' gsol mdzad pa/ paṇa chen dgu pa'i yang srid gtan 'khel gnang ba/ mes bod 'brel bar shugs snon/ bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang sra brtan du btang ba/ gna' rabs kyi dgon sde dang gtsug lag khang mang por nyams gso dang mchod rgyun btsugs pa/ 'bangs rnams bde bar bskyangs pa sogs bod mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo dang yongs su mthun pa'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes ngo mtshar can ji snyed cig 'jog gnang mdzad yod pa rnams ni ji srid mi nub bar lham mer gnas thub pa lags so/43

bde smon mda' dpon rnam rgyal phun tshogs mdo smad khul du bskyod skabs kyi lo rgyus dang skam thog gru kha'i dmag 'khrug skor/bde smon g.yung drung sgrol mas/sa 'brug ( 192〈)lo bde smon rnam rgyal phun tshogs spo bo kaḥ gnam pa'i gyen log lhing 'jags btang zin rjes cung zad bsnyun mus su/ de lo bod zla 6pa'i nang mdo spyi sa dbang sman stod pas bkod rgya btang don‘‘mtsho sgo bar ja dang mda' dpon bsko gzhag bstsal bas ja dang dmag sgar gyi go lag spyi rdzas 'go dmag yig rigs bcas rtsis sprod khams dwangs byas te/khyod rang la bsko gzhag sngon bstsal sa ngan 'go pa'i las 'khur byed par phyir log byas 'thus’’zhes gsal ba ltar nga tsho ngo g.yog rnams‘‘chab mdor phyir log thog lo de'i zla 9pa'i nang sa ngan du thon te sa ngan rdzong sdod rnying pa shod drung 'bri yul bsod nams dbang rgyal gyi ngo tshab zung gi lag nas rtsis sprod rtsis len gyi sprod dpang go 'jo rdzong sdod rtse drung thub bstan 'phel rgyas nas byas/ de lo zla 10pa'i nang sngar lam rdzong gi yong 'bab rnams bsdu mus skabs chab mdo nas mdo spyi sman stod pa'i bkod rgya zhig 'byor don/4 4

‘‘mdo las bka' drung sreg shing pa nad mnar la brten bka' drung las rogs su khyod rang chab mdor 'phral du yong dgos’’zhes gsal ba ltar lo de'i zla 10pa'i tshes shar la sa ngan nas chab mdor 'byor/ ‘‘sa sbrul zla 1po'i nang lha sa bka' shag nas bka' rgya btang 'byor du khyed nas spo bor gzhung don dmag 'thab zhu sgo mi dman pa byung ba dang / rnam kun mdo spyi'i gsung bkod dang len tshul mthun byung 'dug pas/ da lam ja mda' bye phad sras tshe ma zin pa'i tshab tu mtsho sgo ba mda' dpon bsko stsal gyis 'phos tshab tu khyod rang la nya dang dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon bsko gzhag song ba gsar mjal snyan thog nas zhus te sde dge spyi khyab gtsang mda' bkras mthong pa gzhis 'khor du thon rgyu'i tshab tu khyod rang 'go dmag rnams ka kor med par chab mdo nas shar thon byas te sde spyi gsar rnying gi sprod dpang grwa bzhi ru dpon bla shar bar bkod rgya zur song ltar rtsis blangs te gzhung don zhi drag zhu sgo gang cir 'thus tshang yong ba byed dgos’’zhes gsal don bzhin gsar mjal snyan 'bul zin 'phral sa sbrul zla 2pa'i nang sde dger thon/ zla 2pa'i nang sde spyi gsar rnying rtsis sprod rtsis len zin mtshams gtsang mda' bkras mthong pa 'go dmag dang / grwa ru bla shar bcas lo de'i zla 4pa'i nang lha sar thon/ de nas sde dge rdzong khag lnga la sa srung gtong rgyu dang / sde dge sa spyod pa'i 'tsho 'dzin zhu sgo sde dge dpar khang gi dpar 'debs rgya bskyed yong sgo 'phar thabs/ sde dge 'khor lo mdo phu mda'i gser brko ba rnams nas gser 'bab dus thog 'bul dgos pa'i brda khyab dang /bskor g.yeng la bskyod rgyu/ rnam kun khral bsdu khrims gnon sogs kyi dus 'da' ba'i skabs der lo de'i zla 6pa'i nang tre hor dar rgyas dgon pa'i spyi so bsam gtan dang / brtson 'grus/ de min rgya dpon gyi skad sgyur khams 45

pa gcig bcas 'byor nas‘‘rong pa tsha dar dgon pa'i 'gram du rgya mi 'go dmag khag gcig 'byor te brjod don/ rgya nag tu nang 'khrug gis rkyen pas nga tsho sa gnas 'di nas bod du 'gro rtsis yod pas 'gro lugs thad dar rgyas dgon pa nas rogs ram dgos lugs zer don bzhin bde mdas thag gcod thub na dang / de min mdo spyi dang / lha sa bka' shag 7rgyal ba sbug bcas la snyan 'bul dgos lugs dbu nan che ba de skor bde smon nas thag gcod thub min la brten mdo spyi dang / lha sa bka' shag la snyan zhu gtong rgyu'i khas bzhes thog lha sa bka' shag dang / mdo spyi sogs la snyan 'bul zhu mi 'go dmag gnyis ched gtong gnang song / de nas nyin nyi shu skor nas 'go dmag gnyis phyir 'khor gdong 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sbug dam bka' dgongs su ‘‘rgya dpon 'go dmag rnams sde dge sogs brgyud bod lhags mi chog pa dang / rgya nag tu nang 'khrug lhing 'jags mtshams rgya nag gzhung nas rnyog gra ji gsung rtogs dka' bas 'gro sdod nges med kyi rgya mi 'go dmag rnams snga 'phros sde dge'i sa khongs dza khog tsam du gnas bcas bsdad 'thus yong 'gro bas de don khyod nas 'brel mthud mol khyab yong ba byed dgos’’zhes phebs dgongs rnams gong gsal dar dgon gyi spyi so bos ma gtan can snyan sbugs gsum por brgyud bsgrags kyis khong gsum phyir log byas rjes de skor 'di byas gnas tshul gang yang med par rgya dpon 'bo dmag rnams rong pa tsha nas thon te gar song mi 'dug ces dza khog sa srung nas gnas snyan byung gshis/ lding bcu mi lnga nang chen dang skye mdo k+ṇidrogs su rgya mi 'gro bskyod byas min rjes gcod du ched gtong byas/ de nas nyen bcu lhag tsam nas lding bcu phyir 'khor gyis skye mdo dang nang chen brgyud 'gro bskyod byas pa mi 'dug ces zhus 'phral de don mdo spyi dang / lha sar 46

gnas tshul snyan 'bul rta shad ched gtong byas te sde srung dmag snon las rogs mda' dpon re zung gtong gnang yod pa zhes yang yang zhus mthar lcags rta zla 2par dbus mda' khe smad sras 'go dmag sde dger 'byor byung /yang lo de'i zla 5pa'i nang dar dgon spyi so brtson 'grus ngo g.yog gsum sde spyi gnyis sar 'byor nas/ tre+e hor gzhis ser brgya dpon a pho rgyal lu dang bu don grub rnam rgyal khyim tshang dang / dar dgon chos yon snod gcig la brten a phos gser zangs(skabs der gzhis ser tshang gri gang byas gang yong tshong dpon ya phrug zer ba gcig kyang yod 'dug)kyi spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi snang brnyan mi tshad tsam zhig gsar bzhengs kyis dar dgon la 'bul rgyu sngon gtan 'khel zin pa de 'gyur nas brag mgo be ru dgon par 'bul rgyu zhus pa'i skor la nang gros thengs mang byas kyang ma 'grigs par be ru dgon pas zi khron lu'u ci chon la ma dag yud che snyan seng zhus rkyen gyis lu'u ci chon nas phyogs lhung gi yi ge gcig btang donayodad ldan sbyin bdag rang mos las dar dgon pas bsnyad 'dogs byas mi chogagal te bsnyad 'dogs byas na dar dgon par zhi drag gang 'os nyes chad gcod rgyu’’zhes 'khod pa'i yi ge ngo ma dang bcas spyi so bsam gtan lha sar bka' shag dang / sku phreng bcu gsum par snyan 'bul du byang brgyud nas thon zin pa dang / nga rang(spyi bso brtson 'grus)sde spyi dang / mdo spyis de skor ma pang bu 'dor du ma song ba'i skyabs zhur bcar lugs snyan seng byung bar nged sde spyi gnyis nas de skor 7rgyal ba sbug(tā la'i bla ma)dang / lha sa bka' shag la snyan zhu phul zin pas/ rjes su rim pa gong 'og nas bka' ji stsal sde spyis 'gal med zhu rgyu yin’’ces brtson 'grus phyir slog byas/ lo de'i zla rapa'i nang lha sa nas 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum/ pa'i bka' lan du47

‘be dar gyod gzhi'i thad khyod rang bde smon mda' dpon rnam rgyal phun tshogs rta dmag 50skor dang bcas dar dgon du 'phral thon gyis gzhis ser a pho rgya lu ngo thug byas te yong rkyen brtsad gcod dang 'brel/ be dgon (rethus mi ched 'bod thog dge 'dun sde 'khrug tu ma song ba'i legs lam gang che'i 'grigs thabs byed sgo khyod nas bar gzu'i tshul bzung thabs shes nan tan 'don dgos/ dar dgon 'di bzhinatshogazhung dgon bsnyon med la brten gal te zi khron rgya dpon gyi phyogs lhungs zer rjes su yan por btang tshe mtshan lar phan med gnod 'gal yong gzhi las ma 'das na zhi drag ya lan 'phrod nges dgos rgyu bcas de don yid 'doms gyis ’’zhes phebs 'phral bde smon mda' dpon rta dmag 20dang bcas dar dgon du phebs nas be dgon 'thus mi dang / gzhis ser a pho ched 'bod kyis phan tshun dbar nyin bstud bar gzu mdzad skabs brgya dpon a phos nad dgong zhus te nyin zhas 'byor thub min la dar grwa gnyis ched 'bod du gtong skabs a pho zi khron phyogs la thon te nyin 〈tsam song lugs la brten snga 'phros lag ya'i zlog dper song / do bdag dgon pa gnyis kyi 'thus mi so sor‘‘brgya dpon a pho gar song dgon pa phyogs gnyis kas brtsad gcod mdzad de a pho 'byor mtshams slar yang 7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mcho'i dgongs gzhi bzhin kho bo(bde smon mda' dpon) dge 'dun sde 'khrug 'grigs thabs su bcar rgyu dang / snga 'phros sde dgon nas phyir log bya rgyu yin’’zhes brjod de lo de'i zla khapa'i nang sde dger phyir log phebs byung / de nas sde spyi gnyis gros bsdur gyis 7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshor bsam snyan 'di 'dra zhig phul don‘‘be dar gnyis kyi gyod gzhi'i rtsa ba gser zangs kyi spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong mi tshad tsam yod pa gcig la thug pas gzhung sa mchog nas snang 48
