brnyan de 'dra ba spus legs shig bstan 'gro'i don la dmigs nas gsar bzhengs mdzad thog dgon pa gnyis su rung gcig la stsal na 'khon med nyi ma sprin bral du 'gyur rgyu gdon mi za ba lta bu 'dug pa dang / de min brgya dpon a phos zi khron rgya dpon lu'u ci chon la g.yo zhus drag 'thab mdzad dgos shar tshe nga tsho khams bod lam thag ring khar/ sa rong tsub cing / la klung mang ba/ lam 'khel chab 'bangs rnams 'khos kha nyam thag bcas la brten dpung snon dang dmag phogs/ rdzas mdel sogs bskyel 'dren dus thog 'byor min gyi rkyen pas dpa' bo rgyab chad lta bu'i dmag 'thab zhu dgos shar na 'go dmag rnams rang srog shor rgyu smos med khar gzhung sa'i go lag rnams kyang dgra lag tu dbang med shor rgyu sogs gtam don gnyis med du 'gyur dogs kyis lhag bsam zol med du gsol ba las wa rtags sngon bstan zhus pa min’’lugs sogs 'khod pa'i snyan zhu 'bul mi 'go dmag gnyis ched gtong gnang song zhing / 7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos snyan zhu de'i bka' lan ni yongs su ldog phyogs shig rtsal ba ste slokhyod gnyis kyi bsam snyan 'byor ba'i thad/ mdo spyi sman stod par bkod rgya zur song ltar mdo spyi'i ngag bkod dang len tshul bzhin dgos rgyu dang / dar dgon spyi bso bsam gtan yang phyir slog byas yod ces phebs pa dang sbrags/ mtshon srung du (rdo rje'i go khrab) zhes ma he'i rdo rje'i phyag tshwa 'thum ser brgyab pa shing sgam gang stsal 'byor byung ba dang / de mjug mdo spyi sman stod pas bkod rgya btang don‘‘dbus mda' khe smad sras (bsod nams dbang 'dus) 'go dmag nas sde spyi'i zhu sgo 'thus tshang dgos rgyu dang / nya mda' bde smon pa dmag mkho'i yo chas cha tshang dang bcas sde dge yid lhungs lha ri sgar du tho na te dmag byings yid lhungs tu bzhag thog khyod rang sngar ltar rta dmag 49

dang bcas dar dgon du thon te gzhi ser brgya dpon a pho rgyal lu 'byor yod na/ slar yang be dar gyod gzhi 'grigs thabs gtso bzung dgos rgyu dang /de min be dgon gyi rgyab langs zi khron li'u 'un hu'e nas byas te dar rgyas dgon par drag po'i tshur rgol byas tshe dar dgon ni gzhung dgon bsnyon med mkhan po na rim bod nas gtong lam la brten mthar drag 'thab la gyar rung ya lan 'phrod nges slog dgos pa las don med gzhung gun 'khur thabs med gshis/ de skor gnas tshul ji thon 'phral 'phral rta shad snyan 'bul zhu dgos’’zhes 'byor bas nya mda' bde smon 'go dmag rnams thon khar/dmag mi'i bud med bu phrug gsum brgya skor gyi 'tsho jus 'don mir lding dpon gcig dang bcu dpon gcig bzhag ste lcags rta zla 12tshes shar du bde smon 'go dmag rnams yid lhungs phyogs su phebs/ de nas mdo spyi'i bkod rgya'i nang don ltar bde mda' rta dmag lnga bcu skor dang bcas dar dgon du phebs skabs gyod ya'i gtso bo brgya dpon a pho phyir log byas med pa dang / be ru dgon par gyod don 'grigs thabs thad la dgon 'thus ched 'byor dgos pa'i yi ge thengs mang gtong gnang mdzad 'dug rung yig lan tsam med par/ nyin gcig rdza chu'i nyag rag zam sner zi khron rgya dmag brgya skor 'byor nas 'dzing rags rgyag pa'i gnas tshul 'byor 'phral dar dgon gyi ser dmag lnga bcu tham par go mtshon rang 'grigs bcas rdza chu'i tshur rol du zam srung gtong gnang mdzad pa red/ dar rgyas dgon par ser dmag go mtshon rang 'grigs lam seng btang chog yod pa de ni tre hor khul der dgon pa re zung ma gtogs mang che'i dgon par grwa pa gsar bzhugs skabs su rta gcig dang gri gcig me mda' bod mda' 'am 'khrul mda' gang byung spus legs cha tshang re spyi 'jog byed srol yod 'dug pas red/ nya mda' 50

bde smon pas chu phar kha'i rgya mi'i 'go par be dar gyod gzhi rgya cher mi 'gro ba'i ched du de skor 'grigs thabs gtso bzung gi phyag bris thengs mang gnang bar yig lan je zhan je sdug tha na bde smon pa dzam pa ba mal phi'i sogs bkod pa'i yi ge ngo ma dang / nyin re'i gnas tshul ji thon mdo spyi sa dbang sman sdod par snyan 'bul yang yang mdzad/ zam sne phar kha'i rgya dmag nas tshur khar me mda' yang yang 'phangs yang / re zhig me lan ma slog par bka' lan sgug de nas mdo spyi sman stod pas lan du ‘‘skabs bstun khyod rang nas blos dpyad bgyis ’’ zhes 'byor thog dpung snon rdzas mdel/dmag phogs sogs dus thog gtong rgyu'i khas len thob pa bzhin/ phar rgol bya rgyu'i bkod sgrig gnang zhing / dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i thog mar zam sno mtshan 'gebs gtong rgyu de red/ byang gi ri rtser nya dang dmag 150bar rir dar dgon ser dmag 200 gzhung rur nya dmag byings dang /mda' dpon bde smon pa/ ser dmag rdo0bcas nas gong lo'i zla mjug tu phar rgol gyis zam srung sdod gnas la mtshan 'gebs byas te mthar skrod gtsang mar btang / de nas gong gsal 'thab sa phyogs gsum so so nas phar rgol shugs chen byas shing / gzhung ru nas bcu dpon grib pa rdo rje sogs dmag mi khag gcig gis gri khyer te zi dmag gi 'dzing rags nang gdong mchongs byas nas/ de nyin zi rgya 'go dmag 112gson bzung dang / phyogs gsum nas bsad rmas mang po bzos/ de nas zi dmag rnams dpa' khum ste ya lan cher slog ma nus pa red/ thengs de'i dmag 'thab nang grib pa rdo rjer byas rjes su lding dpon bsko gzhag dang / dmag byings la dgra lag nas thob pa'i dngul 'gyed dang / lto chas gzab par gnang / de nas mu mthud dmag 'thab byas te/ lcags rta zla 12tshes 51

20nyin dkar mdzes dgon zhol blangs/ 'go dmag rnams dkar mdzes rang du sgar bcas te bsdad/ skabs der chab mdo nas dpung snon du ga ru snyan gong pa ru shog gcig dang / me skyogs brgya dpon dbang 'dus brgya shog gcig la me skyogs sogs 'gel drel shed bzang lnga bcu tham pa 'byor zhing / de dus dkar mdzes yul dgon rnams drag chas de dag la ha las/mu mthud lcags lug zla 1tshes rdonyin nas dmag btegs te bre'o dang / be ru brag mgo rgyud du dpung 'jug gis nyin lnga las ma 'gor bar brag mgo bar sa blangs/ skabs der mdo spyi sman stod pas ga dang mda' tshab skyid sbug pa bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / thang dpon mda' dpon 'go dmag rnams sde dge 'jo mda' rgyud dpung snon du rim bzhin btang yod lugs bka' rgya btang 'byor ltar dang ༈/ nya mda' bde smon pa dang ga ru snyan gong pa/ me skyogs brgya dpon dbang 'dus bcas nas rgyal kha thob mur dar rtse mdo bar sa blangs chog pa'i skor sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa dang / bka' shag gong 'og bcas par snyan zhu phul kyang khas len ma thob par phyir lan du‘‘khyod rang zung(bde smon pa dang ga ru snyan gong pa sogs) gnas skabs brag mgo yan srung 'doms tshul mthun dgos pa dang / da lam de snga'i nyag rong tshur len bya rgyu 'os babs che bas sde spyi dbus mda' khe smad sras 'go dmag nyag rong du dpung 'jug byed par thon bskyod dgos pa'i bkod rgya zur song ltar khyod rang zung nas mthun 'jug byed sgo 'dzol med gyis’’zhes 'byor bas/ bde mda' zung nas hor khog sa khul srung 'doms dang / gzhis ser a pho'i khyim dngos rnams gzhung len dang 'brel de'i sku gsung thugs rten yong rdzogs dar dgon du gdan drangs/lcags lug zla 2tshes 20skor la dbus mda' khe smad sras 'go dmag 52

rnams sde dge lcang ra nas rdog thon gyis nyag rong du 'byor skabs nyag rong sa sgo ngo las 20skor nas 'thab sems bral te mgo btags zhus/ (skabs der mdo spyi gsar rnying 'phos len gyis gsar pa nga phod phebs) nyag rong nas sa sgo ngo las 2rkyaskor dang / dkar mdzes nas zung dmag 20rkyaskor bcas sde dge brgyud chab mdor bskyel bar 'gro skabs lcang rar kho mos (g.yung drung sgrol ma)mthong bar zi dmag rnams ni lo nyi shu yas mas las ma zin pa'i lo chung zhe gcig dmag dpon rgan gzhon gnyis lo lnga bcu yas mas slebs pa/ dmag gos ni 'og la ras nag po dang sngon po/ sngo skya'i stod thung / gu thung khams lā rgyu rtsings kyi tā yi'i dkar po re gyon pa/sked par gu gu sha'i phor pa re btags/ mgo ras nag po dkris/ ras dkar po'i u su/ ras nag gi lham/ nyal chas sring bal pho khebs la ras dkar phyi g.yogs can re bcas 'dug bzung dmag rnams chab mdor 'byor nas dmag dkyus rnams mdo spyi'i khyab khongs rdzong gzhis khag la bgos nas rtsis sprad pa dang / 'go pa gnyis lha sar btang ba/ nyag rong sa sgo ngo las chab mdor bkag nyar bcas byas pa red zer ba thos/de lo lcags lug zla 4pa'i nang dbus mda' khe smad sras kyi sras dgung lo bcu gsum tsam la son pa gcig sde dge lcang rar 'das pas/ dbus mda' khe srasanyag rong nas dgongs zhus kyis lcang rar 'byor nas/ sde dge'i dbu bla khag lnga gdan zhus kyis phyag mchod rgya che byas te sdod mus su gong lo'i zla 6tshes shar tsam la nyag rong sa sgo ngo las rnams rang gnas zi khron la log chog pa'i lag 'khyer dang / rta khal bskul rgyu'i mdo spyi bka' shag gi lam yig dang bcas sde dge lcang rar 'byor song / de nyin kho mo khe smad sras sdod shag tu yod cing der sa sgo rgan gzhon gnyis dang skad bsgyur 53

bcas dbus mda' khe sras sar bcar te yud tsam phan tshun gleng mol byas rjes/ ‘‘khyed rnams nyin shas sde dge dgon chen du sdod dgos pa dang / nga rang nyin gnyis gsum nas mar yong rgyu yin’’ces bshad song / de nas nyin shas mtshams dbus mda' khe smad pas khong gi g.yog po gcig kho mo'i sar btang 'byor gyis‘‘nyag rong sa sgos sde spyi dang lcam/ bde smon lcam(kho mo) sde dge rgyal sras lcam sring gnyis bcas la gsol ston 'bul rgyu yin pas phebs rogs ’’zhes dang / ‘‘sang nyin nga tsho mnyam du phebs dgos ’’zhes gsung lugs brjod don bzhin kho mos kyang bskyod/ de nyin gong gsal nga tsho dang mnyam du gsol ston thog skad bsgyur mi gcig kyang 'dugakha lag za ba'in par dbus mda' khe smad sras kyis‘‘mdo spyi nga phod pas nga la khyed rnam pa'i skor la bka' rgya phebs rigs ma byung bas re zhig lhod bzhugs mdzad dgos pa dang / nga rang nas kyang khyed rnams par gsol ston stabs bde zhig 'bul rgyu yin’’zhes sogs bshad song / gsol ston zin rjes nga tsho de nyin dgong dro lcang rar phyir log byas/ dbus mda' khe smad sras kyis gsol ston grab bshoms byed mur mdo spyi nga phod pas/ bka' rgya btang 'byor nang‘‘nyag rong sa sgo ngo las rnams gnas skabs sde dger bkag nyar dgos pa dang / dbus mda' khe sras snga 'phros nyag rong du thon bskyod ma dgos par sde dger bsdad 'thus zhes gsal bas/ khe sras sems rab tu 'khrugs shing‘‘dka' ngal mang po sprad kyang dgos pa mi 'dug mdo spyi nga phod pas nga la 'di byas bka' rgya tsam med par nyag rong sa sgos lam yig dang /lag 'khyer sprad nas rang dgar phyir slog zin rjes da cha sde dger bkag nyar zer ba'i bka' rgya gzhi nas btang bar the tog byed dgos don med’’ces yid ma rangs pa chen po byed pa ma zad/ don du nyag rong sa sgor gsol 54

ston yang ma bshams par nyag rong sa sgo ngo las sde dge nas phebs na 'grigs zhes sde dge rgyal sras brgyud lan brda btang ba ltar sa sgo ngo las sde dge nas thon te dkar mdzes su 'byor skabs nya mda' bde smon pas nyag rong sa sgo ngo las rnams bkag nyar gyis sde spyi dbus mda' khe sras par dgongs skor rta shad ched gtong byas par gong gsal mdo spyi'i bka' rgya'i gnas tshul sogs phyir lan btang bar brten bde smon gyis kyang sa sgo ngo las shad gtong byas 'dug gong zla tshes 15yas mas su gtsang mda' thang dpon pa lha thog tu 'das tshab khyung ram pa bsko gzhag gis sde dge lcang rar 'byor nas dbus mda' khe sras dang thug 'phrad byas/ de nas khyung ram pa hor khog tu thon pa'i sang nyin der kho mos khe smad sar phyin par/ khe mdas brjod gsal/‘‘dka' las skya bas brgyab/ rnam spyod gzar bus btang zer ba'i dpe ltar dngos su mthong byung / 7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos mda' tshab khyung ram par sde nyag hor gsum gyi spyi khyab bsko gzhag gnang bas ma tshad/ ‘‘khyod rang khe bde gnyis mda' dpon ngo ma rloms sems bcangs te mda' tshab khyung ram par snang chung brtsi med gtan nas mi chog pa dang / khyung ram pa'i ngag bkod dngas len 'gal med dgos rgyu zhes sbug dam lag khyer nang 'khod 'dug pas/ mda' dpon ngo mas mda' tshab kyi gsham du bsdad nas zhwa phud byed dgos pa red/ sngar gyi gtam dpe gcig layodus deng sang lhag pa'i brgyab phyogs kyis mda' sgro med tsha kha len pa'i dus’’zer ba ltar rang red’’ces yid ma rangs pa'i bshad gleng mang tsam byed kyi 'dug rung / don du brtsi bkur zhu rgyu las ma 'das/ bde mda' yang yid ma rangs pa khe mda' dang gcig mthun byung 'dug skabs der khyung ram pa dkar mdzes khang gsar tshang du bsdad/55

de nas yun ring ma 'gor par sde nyag hor gsum (sder dge/ nyag rong / hor khog)gyi spyi khyab khyung ram pas dbus mda' khe sras 'go dmag sde dger sdod dgos pa dang / nya mda' bde smon pa 'go dmag dang / grwa bzhi ru dpon gnyis pa na rag ru shog gcig bcas nyag rong sa srung du thon dgos/ gzim brgya dbang 'dus 'go dmag go lag dang bcas smar khams su rang gnas log dgos pa sogs kyi bkod sgrig byas pa ltar lcag lugs zla 7tshes shar du nya mda' bde smon pa 'go dmag rnams nyag rong du rdog thon byas shing / mda' ru gnyis pos nyag rong sa 'gag gnad che khag la sa srung gtong rgyu dang / sa mtha'i chab 'bangs mi ser thog chag yang gang che'i khral bsdu khrims gnon gyi srol gtod rgyu/ nyag rong khul nas thon pa'i gser 'don tshong gang byed bkag rgya glod rgyu sogs dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas zam pa chad par dar mdo'i phyogs su zi rgya'i byed phyogs nyul zhib btang ba'i gnas tshul rnams spyi khyab khyung ram par gnas tshul btang 'dug skabs der lcags lug zla 9tshes shar tsam du mdo spyi nga phod las rta dmag brgya skor tsam sde dge lcang rar 'byor byung zhing / sde spyi dbus mda' khe sras dang mnyam du kho mos kyang nga phod sar phyag 'bul du bskyod par khong gis‘‘da res gong sa'i bka' dgongs bzhin gtso bo dkar mdzes khul du dmag don rtog zhib tu bskyod rgyu yin’’tshul zer don bzhin/ de'i phyi nyin lcang ra nas rdog thon gyis de nas sde dge rdzogs chen du 'byor mtshams gtsang mda' khyung ram pas zi khron phyogs nas 'ba' thung ling zer ba'i rgya dpon gcig dang / ja bdag rig 'dzin rdo rje zer ba gnyis 'byor nas zi bod zhi gros byed dgos tshul bshad pa'i skor la snyan 'bul rta shad btang ba/ sde dge rdzogs chen du mdo spyi nga phod pa slebs pa dang dus 'khel gyis snyan zhu phul bas mdo spyi nga 56

phod pa nyin bco lnga tsam nas lcang rar phyir log ste nyin gsum bsdad thog 'bri chu nub srib mdar bskyod sdod byas pa dang / zi bod zhi gros 'grigs rgyur yid ches kyis dmag sgar khag gi bud med rnams zla bsgril/ kho mo yang lcags lug zla 10tshes nang nyag rong du bskyod/ de nas zla gnyis tsam song mtshams rmi li brgyud dar mdo'i phyogs su nyul zhib tu btang ba lding bcu gnyis phyir log 'byor zhing / mgar mthar brgal te zi dmag khyon chen rmi lir 'byor lugs snyan seng zhus pas/ mda' ru gnyis nas gnas tshul dngos zhu byed par lding bcu gnyis spyi khyab khyung ram sar ched gtong byas thog4zi dmag khyon chen nyag rong phyogs su kha gtad yong lugs la gzhigs na dmag 'thab byed dgos min cha ma rtogs pas sngon tshud dpung snon rdzas mdel dang / dmag phogs bcas gnang rogs’’zhes pa'i snyan zhu phul ba ma zad nyag khul sa gnas khag la sa srung sngar yod thog lding 'og re dang / sa 'gag che bar brgya shog re btang / mdo spyi nga phod par yang de skor snyan 'bul zhus par mdo spyis dpung snon dang / dmag phogs/ rdzas mdel sogs dus thog gtong rgyu'i phyir lan 'byor khyung ram pas phad lta 'ba' thung ling dang zhi gros byed bzhin par rgya phyogs nas tshur rgol gtan nas byed mi srid ’’ces dang yodamag phogs rdzas mdel btang 'thus’’zhes phyir lan btang 'byor yang / don du dmag phogs kyang dus thog 'byor min la brten mda' ru gnyis nas khyung ram par 'ba' thung li dang / ja bdag rin rdor gnyis kyi zhi gros la blos ling 'gel byas na mi 'grigs pa'i skor bsam shog yang yang bskur/ de lo'i lo gsar gong tsam la mgar mthar dang rmi li'i rgyud du zi dmag khyon chen 'byor ba dang / dmag sbyong byed kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul rgasal po yang yang 'byor/ 'on kyang rang phyogs kyi dmag 57

phogs dus thog ma 'byor stabs nyag rong sa gnas rang gi lo gcig gi khral rigs bsdu 'bab mang che mar dang / 'bru 'bab nyung shas nas 'go dmag rnams la phogs sprad/ skabs der dmag mir phogs thog mar khyon che tsam sprad par brten dmag mis 'bru mar brje tshong thub min gyi skad cor mang po brgyab par/ mda' ru gnyis pos dmag mir thabs mkhas kyi slob gso btang bas nyan tsam byung yod/de nas lo gsar rjes chu sprel zla 1tshes 2 0tsam la mda' ru gnyis pos sde nyag hor gsum gyi spyi khyab khyung ram par sngar bzhin dpung snon sogs gtong dgos pa'i snyan zhu btang ba dang / de bzhin mdo spyi nga phod par yang snyan 'bul zhib phra byas rung / da dung khyung ram pas zi bod zhi gros 'grigs re yod lugs dang / mdo spyis dmag phogs dpung snon sogs 'phral gtong bya rgyur sngar ltar gzhung don lhod med dgos lugs tsam las don du nyin 'gyangs zhag phud kho na byas te tha na dmag phogs tsam ma 'byor ba'i mur chu sprel zla 2tshes 2nas bzung nyag khog sa srung khag bdun gyis yas mas gang sa nas zi rgyas tshur rgol byas byung bar mda' ru gnyis pos rang phyogs dpung nyung la phogs rdzas kyang med pa'i gnas tshul la bsam gzhigs dang bcas phar rgol byed stangs dgra tshod dgras ma longs pa lta bus yas mas gang sar dmag shugs che sa der mtshan mo dmag btang 'thab ra sprad de phar tshur bsad rmas ci rigs byas pa dang / khyung ram dang / mdo spyir yang gnas tshul yong rkyen snyan 'bul yang yang btang rung / spyi khyab gong 'og gnyis kas rbad de dpa' bo rgyab chad lta bur bzhag mda' ru gnyis pos sgar thog tu bsdad pa'i ru brgya lding bcas bskongs te sa srung thabs skor nyin ltar gang dga' ci legs kyi gros byas kyang lag zad dpung thug lta bur gyur/58

nyag rong rang gi lo gcig bsdu 'bab phran yod 'bru rigs nas rtsam pa btags pa dang mar bcas dmag sar bskyel ba sogs byas nas ha lam zla gcig tsam 'gro grabs skabs nyin gcig sba khug nas lding dpon gcig dang /dmag bco brgyad skor rang sar bsad rmas kyis shor ba dang / rmi li la mda' nas lding dmag bcu gsum skor bsad rmas kyis sa shor te rmas ma rnams nyag rong ri nang pho brang sgar du 'byor byung / de dus ru brgya rnams bskongs 'dzoms yod mus kyi sar bde mdas na rag ru dpon la‘‘khyod sku na bgres pas 'dir bzhugs thog khyung ram dang mdo spyir gnas lugs snyan 'bul yang yang mdzad dgos pa dang / sa srung yas mas la phogs rtsam/rdzas mdel phran yod nas bgo sprod mdzad rgyu sogs gnang dgos/ ngos nas sba khug dang / rmi li'i la mdar thengs gcig dmag 'thab byed par 'gro rgyu yin ’’zhes ngar sems dang bcas bskyod rtsis kyis kho mor yang gsol chas sogs gra sgrig dgos lugs gsung byung yang / na rus de ma thag yar langs zhwa phud pa dang / ru brgya gzhan dag rnams nas kyang yar langs zhwa phud thog na rus ‘‘mda' dpon sku zhabs lhod tsam mdzod dang / nyag rong gi sa babs ni ri tshogs mthug pos bskor zhing / lam phrang dog la rang dpung 700tsam las med pa/ dmag phogs dang rdzas mdel ni rdzogs la nye bar thug de bas ‘bros kyang dpa' bo dang 'thab kyang dpa' bo’zer ba'i dpe ltar/ snga 'phros 'go dmag la pham nyes cher ma byung gong phyir 'then byas te sde dge tsam du phebs na dbus mda' khe sras dang bka' gros kyis mdo spyir gnas lugs snyan 'bul mdzad na legs gnad’’sogs dbu nan byas mthar bde smon gyis kyang mos mthun byas te/ phyir 'then byed stangs skor gros bsdur byas don/ 'go dmag hrag sgrug nyis brgya skor lam 59

sne sa rgyus dang bcas sngon la thon te dgra bo'i nyen srung bya rgyu dang / rmas ma dang nad gcong / bud med phru gu/ spyi rdzas 'gel khal bcas par do dam byed mi 'go dmag khag gcig bar du thon rgyu/ de 'phros 'go dmag hrag sgrug sum brgya skor dang / mda' ru byings rjes sdod kyis dgra bo'i rjes 'ded byung na ya lan slog rgyu bcas la thag bcad nas 'thab sa yas mas khag la phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i bang mi btang ba dang / sgar thog tu yod pa rnams la yang brda btang ste chu sprel zla 4tshes shar la thon rtsis kyang / zla 2tshes 2khyenyin gyi nyin dgung yol tsam la ri nang shar ri'i rtse la rgya dmag 'byor nas glo bur du ser ba 'bab 'dra'i mda' char thengs gsum bstud mar ri nang pho brang yang steng du brgyab byung / shar ri dang ri nang pho brang bar 'gyangs thag mi gom sum brgya tsam las med pas/ de 'phral na rag ru dpon dang / nya dang dmag sgar gyi ru brgya rnams 'dzoms sar‘‘shar ngos kyi zam pa mer sreg gtong dgos pa dang / de nas gong gsal bkod sgrig ‘star ri nang pho brang gi nub ri'i grog shur brgyud phyir 'then byed dgos ’’zhes bkod khyab byas/ de dus kho mo rang lo 2 0yin/ bu mo rigs chos lo gnyis tsam la son yod nga tsho'i bde smon mda' dpon nas kho mor ras dkar gyi pho chas shig g.yogs/ rta gcig la sga chas brgyab pa dang(da lta'i nga'i zla bo yar 'phel lags kyi ming la de dus dgra nor zer) dgra 'dul nor bus/skyon med zhabs zhu dgos pa dang / rta dmag bsod nams nas bu mo rigs chos dang / ma ma lha sgron gnyis skyon med lam sgrol dgos pa/ zla dgras rgan pa mgron gnyer lhag tshe nas be dar gyod gzhi thog ma byung ba nas mtha' ma'i bar gyi yig rigs yod tshad sgam khal rgyab gcig la 'gel rta gcig dang /lhag tshe rang la bzhon rta gcig bcas rtsis sprod kyis yig sgam bor brlag mi 60

'gro ba dgos lugs bcas khungs so sor bkod mngags byes thog rta drel drug la mdel sgam rgyab drug dang / de nas dmag mi rmas ma dang / bud med phru gu/ nad pa rnams dang mnyam du dgong ja tsam la dgra bo'i me mda'i bar gseng du ri nang pho brang gi rgyal sgo nas thon te nub ngos ri zur (mi gom nyis brgya tsam gyi bar thag yod)phyogs su bskyod/ bod zla 2tshes 20dgong dro bskyod pa'i nam phyed tsam la me dpung chen po zhig ri sked nas mthong byung bas bud med dang nad pa rnams yud tsam dngangs tshabs chen po skyes/ de nas spyi rdzas 'gel khal dang dmag mi rnams rim 'byor gyis brjod gsal ‘‘rjes sdod tsho thon khar ri nang pho brang me skyon song ba las/ 'go dmag byings la nyer 'tshe med lugs ’’bshad pas blo bder gyur/ de nas mu mthud mtshan mo der la 'dzegs nas phyi nyin nam langs skabs rim bzhin la rtser 'byor/ nyen srung pas tshang ma der ngal gso rgyag dgos pa dang /thab chas yod mkhan tshos ja bskol zhes brda btang byung / ri rtse der rjes bzhugs pa tsho yang rim 'byor gyis tshang ma tsha phogs brgyab/ em chis rmas ma dang nad par sman bcos rags tsam byas/ zla 4tshes 1nyin nas nyin ltar zhogs snga langs kyis dgong dro bar mi med lung stong / la nas la brgyud bskyod pa'i shul lam du 'chi ba dang / skye ba/ rmas pa/ nad pa bkres ltogs bcas kyi ngal dub tshad med myang mthar stag khog gsum mdor (tha se bzhi mdo yang zer/) zla 4tshes 11nyin 'byor dus 'go dmag rnams la zas rigs yongs rdzogs chad cing sa der bca' zhag nyi na gsum bzhi tsam sdod rgyu byas thog dar dgon khas nyer yod pas dar dgon du rtsam pa dang ja mar/ tshwa sogs gnang rogs zhu rgyu dang / khyung ram pa gar bzhugs su gnas tshul snyan 'bul zhu bar bcu dpon gcig dang dmag gcig btang 61

zhing / nyag rong nas sa shor stabs khyung ram pa dkar mdzes nas dar dgon du spos yod pa dang / zhi gros pa rin rdor dang thung ling gnyis re zhig phyir log byas pa red/ chu sprel zla 4tshes 15yin dgung ma zin gong tsam la dar dgon dang / khyung ram pas rtsam pa rgyab 60dang / ja sgam2tshwa do1 mar do bzhi/ bshas g.yag brgyad bcas skyel bar btang 'dug cing / nub ngos kyi ri zur nas khal bkal ba'i g.yag pa don pa dang rtsam dri sgar nang du khyab byung bas 'go dmag bud med/ bu phrug rmas ma cung thang ba dang bcas yar langs nas dga' 'bod byed pa dang / la las g.yag pa'i phyogs su rgyugs 'gro ba/ mda' ru gnyis kyang dga' tshor chen pos de ring nas 'go dmag rnams bkres ltogs kyi sdug bsngal laṭasdo grol song’’zhes dgod 'dzum cung zad byed/ de nas 'go dmag tshogs chung brgyad la rtsam pa sogs bgos/ g.yag gsod skabs phru gu chung chung tshos kyang phor pa khyer nas khrag bzed stangs byed pa sogs kyi ltogs rngam de 'dra byung / de nas de'i phyi nyin dar dgon dang khas nye rong pa tsha grong tshor bskyod gtan 'khel zhing / bkra ma shis pa zhig la phyi nyin zhogs pa nyi shar tsam la sku zhabs grwa ru gnyis pa na rag nga tsho'i bde mda'i sar yong ste‘‘nga ni 'di nas 'go dmag rnams khrid nas sde dger log rgyu yin/ bde mda' yang chabs cig phebs na legs tshul phan tshun bsam 'char mang dag shod gleng gi mthar grwa ru na rag bshol thabs med par sde dger bskyod pa dang / nga tsho nya mda' bde smon 'go dmag rnams khyung ram dang thugs 'phrad byed dgos par brten de nyin rong pa tshar bskyod/ zla 4tshes 17zhogs pa nya mda' bde smon pa ru brgya dang bcas dar dgon du khyung ram par 'byor/ nya dang dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag rnams la zla gcig gi phogs thob dar rgyas dgon 62

pas sprad 'dug de nas gong zla'i zla mjug der dbus mda' khe sras 'go dmag rnams rong pa tshar 'byor bas/ khyung khe bde gsum(khyung ram dang /khe smad/ bde smon) dar dgon du mnyam 'dzoms gros bsdur byas don/dmag sgar gsum dang dar dgon gyi ser dmag 20rkyalhag tsam bcas nas slar yang zi rgyar dmag 'thab bya rgyu gtan 'khel byas stabs nga tsho'i bde mdas kho mor‘‘khyed rang ma bu kun rtse'e(khe smad)lcam dang lhan du sde dge nas 'phral thon gyis lha sar shar bskyod byed dgos/ gang lags she na zi rgyas hor khog shar rgyud nas bod phyogs su dmag gra bsgrigs pa dang / stod rgyas mtsho sngon phyogs kyi skye mdo brgyud chab mdor nyen kha yod pa/ smar khams su spom mda' stobs rgyal gyi shog khas me skyogs brgya dpon dbang 'dus bza' tsho dang dmag mi sogs dmar gsod btang bar brten smar khams su ga mda' skyid sbug 'go dmag phebs dgos byung ba dang / yang skyar dmag 'thab dgos lugs skor gsungs byung / de nas kho mo ma bu rong pa tsha nas thon te sde dger 'byor skabs/ khe sras lcam lha sar thon zin 'dug kho mo sde dge nas mkhar gong du 'byor skabs nga phod lha lcam (da lta'i bod kyi bud med kru'u ren mtshan 'dzin tshe brtan sgrol dkar) bzhugs pa dang mjal te gong gsal gnas tshul mdor bsdus zhus pas/ skabs der mdo spyi sa dbang nga phod pa sde dge 'bri chu nub srib mdar bzhugs lugs sogs gsungs/ kho mo chab mdor 'byor dus mdo spyi'i sku tshab zur khang zur pa 'dug cing / kho mor lha sa bar rta khal kha shas kyi lam yig zhu bar phyin pas gong gsal gnas tshul skad cha dris byung bar gnas tshul yong rkyen mdor bsdus bshad/ chab mdo nas shar thon gyis zla 7tshes shar du lha sar 'byor byung zhing / zho ston nyin gsum par lcags po 63

ri'i zur du nga rang mi ltad la phyin/ lo der grong drag dmag sgar gsar btsugs byas 'dug mda' dpon g.yu thog pa (skra rang 'jags dang /ru dpon nga phod da lta'i u yon krang gzhon pa sogs dbu skra bcad de dmag dkyus gcig mtshungs/ dmag dar gsar pa gangs ri seng ge kha sprod/dar 'gor rgyal mtshan zangs ser tog ldan yin pa de kho mos mthong ba de dus dang po yin/) da dung grong drag dmag mi bsdu dang bsdu bzhin 'dugaskyes pa rnams skra bcad de rna long bkrol dgos byung bar brten nang mi bza' zla sogs ngu 'bod byed pa'i gnas tshul gang sar byung 'dugakho mo sde dge nas lha sar thon rjes chu sprel zla 5pa'i nang khe khyung bde gsum nas dkar mdzes phyogs su dmag thengs gnyis brgyab 'dug kyang /mang sne nyung gis ma brtan par yongs su pham ste sde dge 'bri chu nub rgyud yas mas su sa srung du khag bgos shing / grwa bzhi dmag sgar dang / me skyogs dmag sgar ldan khog phyogs su 'khel/ mdo spyi nga phod srib mda' nas chab mdor phyir log byas 'dug de skabs slar yang ja bdag rin rdor nas khyung ram la btang ba'i zi bod dmag 'thab ma dgos par zhi mol mu mthud mdzad dgos pa'i skor 'khod pa'i yi ge ngo ma de khyung ram nas mdo spyi nga phod par btang lan du‘‘gros mol 'grigs gtso byed par/ ja bdag rig 'dzin rdo rje ngo ma skam thog tu ched 'bod byed dgos’’zhes gsal don ltar khyung ram nas yi ge btang stabs rin rdor skam thog tu 'byor nas khe khyung bde gsum dang thug 'phrad byas yod pa dang / khong gsum pos 'ba' thung ling dang /de min zi khron sku tshab gzhan dag kyang yong thub na legs gnad sogs gleng 'go tshugs tsam du/ chu sprel zla 6tshes 1〈nyin ri bo che nas bkras khang mkhan drung dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas nas mda' 64

dpon khe khyung bde gsum dmag don nyes chad zhu bar yong dgos kyi bka' rgya 'byor don ltar khong gsum ri cher bcar zhing / khe khyung bde gsum la dza drag gi zhu ba blangs pa dang / khe bde gnyis nas thog mtha' bar gsum gyi yig rigs rnams rtsis 'bul zhus/ khong gsum srog thog nyes pa chag yang dang / khe khyung bde gsum gyi mda' dpon go ming gnas dbyungs btang /khyung ram par nyes chad ser srang 150 bkal/ bkras khang ngo las dang se 'bras gsum gyi 'thus mi rnams chab mdor mdo spyi dang mnyam gros kyis skam thog tu zi bod gros mol byed mi sku tshab gtan 'khel bya rgyur/ khyod rang gsum yang dmag 'khrug gi yong rkyen shod par snga 'phros skam thog tu sdod dgos bshad don ltar mda' zur khe khyung bde gsum skam thog spu khar phyir log byas/ bkras khang ngo las sogs chab mdor bskyod rjes mdo spyi nga phod pa sku 'das te lo gcig ma song bar sku phreng bcu gsum pas zur khang zur par dza sag go gnas gnas spar gyis mdo spyi dang / las rogs mkhan chung zla ba bskos/ de nas skam thog tu 'ba' thung ling dang / ding thon krang 'byor/ dang thog nga tsho'i gros mi bkras khang ngo las dang 'bras se dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi/ chab mdo nas mkhan chung zla ba dang / rim bzhi bo gdong smon tsho bcas bod kyi sku tshab tu gtan 'khel byas/ skabs der gros mol thengs gnyis byas pa'i snying por rgya nag tu nang 'khrug lhing 'jags ma byung bar lo bco lnga'i ring la zi bod dbar don rkyen ji ltar byung rung zhi mol ma gtogs phan tshun su thad nas dmag 'khrug mi rgyag rgyur gtan ha lam 'khel mtshams/ skye mdo nas stod rgyas ldan khog phyogs su 'khrug rkyen bslang / grwa bzhi dmag sgar dang me skyogs dmag sgar/ stod rgya 'thab ra 'phrod cing / stod rgyas grwa ru na rag dang / me sgrogs ru dpon snye thang phyin 65

tha'i gnyis dang / dmag dkyus khag gcig bcas gson bzung byas te dmag pham/ ru dpon gnyis mtshan mo btson bcug dang / nyin mo lus sha rjen par shing phur la btags te bzhag/ nyin bdun brgyad tsam song skabs sde dge rgyal sras lcam sring gnyis nas/ bya rgod stobs ldan dang /yang 'go tshe mgon zung stod rgya'i sar mngags te ru dpon gnyis la blu rin tā sgor brgyad stong sprad de skam thog gros mol thag gcod ma grub bar du dgon chen du nyar/ de rjes bod la rtsis sprod bya rgyu yin pa/ skye mdo'i dus zing skor la gros mol byas mthar ding thon krang dang / 'ba' thung ling / ja bdag rin rdor bcas nas skye mdo'i dus zing 'jags thabs skor la 'khur nyams len bya rgyu dang / dus zing mjug bsgril mtshams gros don la ming rtags 'god la nye ba'i dus der lha sa bka' shag nas khe bde gnyis chu sprel zla 9tshes 20'gyangs med 'byor dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang 'byor ltar zla 10tshes shar du skam thog nas khe bde gnyis lha sar thon bskyod kyis 'byor byung / gong gsal chu sprel zla khapa nas zla 10bar gyi gnas tshul rnams nga tsho'i bde smon mda' zur nas kho mor gsungs pa ltar du bkod pa lags so/66 —

ngam ring rdzong gi lo rgyus dang / bar skabs rdzong sdod 'ga' zhig gi byed phyogs/ rang nyid las drung byed skabs bcas skor rags bsdus/phran rtsa rta mgrin rgyal pos/ngam ring rdzong ni lo rgyus thog byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal zhes pa'i pho brang red ces zer srol yod la ri khyung gzugs lta bu'i dpung steng du chags yod stabs ming la khyung rdzong dkar po zer/ lta ngam phun gsum bkras blar chod tshun rdzong sdod mi 'gro bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring ser skya'i 'gro khungs yin rung / sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bkras lhun ble brang dbar 'gal ba je cher song rkyen paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma mchog mes rgyal nang sar gsang phebs gnang rjes bkras bla'i 'gan dbang gcod po sa gnas srid gzhung gi dza bla ngo las dang / rdzong gzhis khag tu gzhung zhabs ser skya re bsko gzhag byed lam ltar ngam ring rdzong mtsho sgo bas 'dzin skabs te phran rang lo 1〈du son pa/chu sprel(1922)lo bkras lhun dza bla'i 'go mchan don bzhin las drung gi gsar mjal dang 'brel las 'khur byas pa yin/ rdzong der mnga' khul mi ser brgya tsho drug gi khongs su rkang gzhung rtsa 'dzin lcags sprel zhib gzhung zer 67

bar byed kyi yod cing / der gsal gzhung sger chos gsum rkang gsum brgya drug cu lhag tsam yod/ de dag chags yul brgya cha drug cu tsam phu chu dang chu mig la brten dgos pa'i zhing khul dang / sa ma 'brog 'brog pa'i sa khul nyung shas bcas yin/ khong tshor lag 'don khral rigs sna tshogs rnams grangs ha lam bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu skor 'khri sgrub dgos pa nas sger chos khongs 'khri dang mi 'khri'i dbye ba phran bu yod pa las mang che ba 'khri sgrub byed dgos pa dang / rkang 'gro sa tshigs so sos ga sel dang rdzong skyel rta khal mi gsum 'khri yul smad rgya bzhi'i khongs chag chod phud rta 'khri rkang zer ba rkang nyis brgya lnga bcu lhag tsam yin/ rdzong der rdzong skyong gzhis ka che ba brgyad dang / le lag gzhis chung bzhi bcas yod cing / de dag gi nang khral gzhis g.yog 'khri yul gzhung rgyugs mi ser yin/ gong gsal gzhis ka bcu gnyis kyi son 'bor bsdoms khal chig stong bzhi brgya skor 'gro zhing /lo re'i ston 'bras 'bring la cha gzhag na cha snyom khal bdun stong skor thon gyi yod/ de thog nas son 'bru zur 'jug thog ngam ring chos sde dang /bsam dga' dgon gnyis kyi dbyar dgun chos thog lag 'dzin nang gsal gtong sgo dang / de min dgon chung khag la mchod phogs sogs khyon dgon khag che chung nyi shu rtsa gcig la lo ltar 'bru/ mar/ sha/ rtsam/ snum sogs gtong sprod pa 'brur bsgyur rags rtsis khal lnga brgya skor 'gro zhing /lo dus nges med bkras lhun dgon pa dang / lha rtse chos sde gnyis nas grwa bskor ba yong dus rdzong nas khong tshor sha dang / rtsam/ ja/ mar sogs gang 'tshams gtong sprod dgos kyi yod/ da dung 'char 'phar zhabs sgrub dang bkras bla'i dpon rigs smos ci dgos/ sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs stod khul dmigs bsal 'grul bzhud byed mkhan la'ang bkras 68

bla'i bka' rgya nang gsal bzo chas(bza' bca' 'os 'tshams) 'phar ma sprod dgos kyi yod/ rdzong sdod ngo g.yog dang / rta gsos las khungs kyi rgyun ja/ lo gsar gyi 'gro cha khag bcas kyi khar las drung gsum dang / bre kha ba/ khang gnyer bcas kyi lo re'i phogs 'bru khal brgya dang brgyad cu dang /sha khog bzhi bcu/ snum zangs bre bzhi bcu/ dus 'khor dang bkras dpal lha khang gi sku gnyer gnyis la lo ltar phogs 'bru khal bzhi bcu zhe brgyad thog sha snum gong bzhin yong bsdus pa dang bkar rgya ba gnyis la bzo chas dang dgos cha grangs tshad nges zhu mi 'dug kyeng gang 'tshams sprod dgos pa bcas gang ltar rdzong skyong gzhis khag rnams kyi bcu 'bor 'bab ngam ring yongs bsdus par rtsis rgyag dgos par thonari 'bab gtan 'bebs khal chig khri skor dgos pa nas/ gong gsal son 'bor dang / 'char 'phar sna tshogs bza' 'then gyi yang snying gtong lhag ces pa lo rer gtong 'phar yod med kyi bka' 'jug 'bru khal chig stong bzhi brgya nas chig stong drug brgya skor re dgos pa yong bsdus pas bsdu tho tham 'byar bkar rgya bar sprad gsal 'bru 'bab rdzong nas bkar rgya bar sprod dgos kyi 'dug gtan 'jags yig thog tu gsal ba'i bcu 'bor gyi grangs tshad las lag 'bab dngos nyung ba yod bzhin par mkhyen ldan rnams kyis da dung gtong lhag de tsam yong don gang yin nam dgongs srid kyi red/ de ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs skabs ngam ring rdzong khongs dgon sde khag la gtong sgo gzhis 'bru sbar bdun ma zer ba 'bru phran bu yod pa las mang che ba rtswa sogs bsres nas sprod srol dang / sha/ rtsam/ tshwa/ snum sogs dngul bsgyur sno sel las med pas dgon sde khag la mchod phogs kyis mtshon gtong rigs rnams rtsis dus tshang zhing tshang dus yal zer ba'i dpe ltar kha yod lag med la brten gong 69

gsal gtong lhag 'bru 'bab bkar rgya bar sprad rung / da dung rdzong sdod so sor lo re 'bru khal bzhi brgya nas lnga brgya'i bar re za rgyu yod la gzhung rgyugs mi ser rnams nas chu 'brug ma skyed zer ba rkang re nas 'bru khal gcig bre bzhi re bsdu rgyu yod pa de khongs nas ma skyed bkar 'jug ces lo rer khal brgya re bkar rgya bar zur sprod dgos pa phud 'bru khal brgya lhag tsam yang rdzong la za rgyu 'dug gzhung sger chos gsum mi ser yongs nas spus mar zhes rkang re nas mar mkhar nyag gi khal gcig nyag bcu re dang / gzhung rgyugs khongs nas bkar mar zhes rkang re nas mkhar nyag lnga skor re bsdu rgyu yod khongs nas lo re bkras lhun bla brang phyag mdzod du mar khal brgya lhag tsam 'bul dgos phud de 'phros rgyun ja dang 'char 'phar gtong dmigs red/phyogs mtshungs 'brog rigs rkang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis skor nas rkang rer rtsid pa'i re lde rgyug 'dom bco lnga re dang / bal gyi re lde rgyug 'dom drug re/ra spu'i re lde rgyug 'dom bzhi re bcas bsdu rgyu yod khongs nas gong bzhin bla brang phyag mdzod du sgrigs 'bul zer ba rtsid bal ra gsum gyi re lde bsdoms rgyug 'dom brgyad brgya lhag tsam re 'bul dgos phud de 'phros kyang rdzong la 'bab cing / stod kha gtsang zur rgya tsho gnyis dang 'brog rigs khongs nas lo re spus lug zer ba lug grangs brgya dang sum cu skor bsdu rgyu yod pa de ngam zhol lcags pa zer ba bshas pa them grangs drug yod par bshas su bcug pa de thog nas gtong sha mngon mdog phran bu las mang che ba rdzong la za rgyu yod/las shog rgyu cha gzhung rgyugs mi ser rkang re nas shog shing gad ma skam seng mkhar nyag bcu gnyis dang / dug thal snur ba mkhar nyag bzhi re/ 'ul gla dngul srang brgyad re bcas bsdu rgyu yod pa de dag lo ltar dbyar zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig nas 'go btsugs te 'ul mi ngam zhol khral spyi nas yong dgos mi 70

grangs nyi shu skor la gla cha lug gi nang cha dang / rtsam snum sne sel re sprod pa dang / 'go pa rdzong gi bre kha bas byed srol gyis las yun zla gnyis tsam 'gor gyi yod/ shog bu yug chen bcu sdems brgya lhag tsam dang sgrigs shog(sgrigs 'bul gyi shog bu) yug 'bring bcu sdems lnga brgya skor yug chung bcu sdems nyis brgya skor bcas thon pa nas bla brang phyag mdzod du lo rer sgrigs 'bul yug 'bring bcu sdems brgya dang bdun cu dang / yug chung bcu sdems sum cu/ yong sdud pa dang bkar rgya ba gnyis la las shog yug che chung bcu sdems grangs nyi shu skor re sprod dgos shing / rdzong gi las shog tu gang 'tshams 'gro ba las de byings rdzong sdod sger la bdag gi yod/ 7kun gzigs paṇa chen sku thog rim par stod khul nas dad 'bul 'bri g.yag gang byung ngam rdzong la rtsis 'khrir gnang ba'i ru ba khag gnyis la sems can pho mo ngo grangs sum brgya lhag tsam yod cing / she ma khag gnyis la gla cha 'brur phab so sor khal sum cu re sprod dgos/ she mar lo re 'bri bi'u mar mkhar —khal gcig nyag bcu re dang / yar mar mkhar khal gcig re/ de byings la rgyab mar zer ba sems can ngo rer mkhar nyag gi spor do re bcas 'bab pa de thog nas bla brang rtse phyag mdzod du lo ltar mar khal brgyad cu skor re 'bul dgos pa'i 'phros rdzong rang la bdag gi yod/ de snga gor ṣas bod la btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug bslangs rjes phan tshun gros mol gyis chings yig bzhag pa'i chings don nas gor ṣa bar gor shugs zer ba'i chings dngul sprod dgos pa'i bkras bla'i 'bab sa gnas 'brel mtshungs ngam rdzong nas ding ri bzhugs mda' brgyud lo rer gor ṭam chig stong nyis brgya sprod dgos pa'i ma rtsa ngam ring mnga' khul skabs de'i grong drag la chings g.yag ces pa g.yag re'i rin dod bod dngul srang bzhi re dang / tshwa khal bzhi re sprad pa 71

der lo ltar rgyab dod gor ṭam brgyad re bsdu ba khyon g.yag nyis brgya'i ma rtsar dngul tshwa 'grems sprod byas pa der lo ltar gor ṭam mngon mdog yod na dang /de min gor ṭam rer 'dza' bod dngul srang gang zho do re bsdus te khyon lo rer gor ṭam chig stong drug brgya skor zin pa nas ding re bzhugs mdar gor ṭam chig stong nyis brgya re sprad 'phros gor ṭam bzhi brgya skor rdzong la za rgyu yod/ de snga dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas bod la dmag 'khrug bslangs rjes rgyal rtse lcang lor dbyin ji'i dpon dmag dang / slob grwa btsugs sdod la 'gag sgo'i rtswa shag ces gzan pa dang / me shing / lug khul rtsid sogs bod nas sprod dgos pa'i bkras bla'i 'bab nye 'khor rdzong gzhis nas mngon mdog sprod dgos shing / sa khad 'gyangs pa'i rdzong gzhis rnams nas rkang rtsis las khungs brgyud rgyal phag las g.yor zhes dod dngul 'bul dgos pa'i ngam ring mnga' khul rkang re nas lo ltar dngul srang bzhi re bsdus te dngul srang dgu brgya lnga bcu rkang rtsis las khungs su phul 'phros dngul srang bzhi brgya lhag tsam re rdzong la za rgyu yod/ de snga zi ling dpon chen zer ba 'gro skabs zi ling g.yag khral zhes ngam khul 'brog dud rkang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis la rkang rer bod dngul srang gang zho brgyad re dang / bod rkang(zhing pa)re nas srang med zho dgu re bcas bsdus te rkang rtsis las khungs su 'bul dgos phud lhag 'phro phran bu yang rdzong la za rgyu yod/ lo ltar rdzong khang gi wa kha thigs tshags dang / dkar rtsi gtong rgyu bcas smad kha brgya tsho bzhi'i khongs 'brog rigs dang sger chos phud lo gnyis song gsum thog dang / lo gnangs 'char du brgya tsho gnyis re re skor gyis sgrub dgos pa/ dkar rtsi 'ul gla rkang rer dngul srang bdun re dang / wa thigs 'ul gla rkang rer dngul srang gsum zho do re bcas bsdus te 'ul mi ngam zhol mi rer gla nyin re 72

srang gang re dngul dang rtsam snum gang dgos sprad de skul 'ded kyis dkar rtsi gtong mkhan 'ul mi nyi shu skor gyis nyin bzhi dang / wa kha thig tshag byed mi gnyis res dbyar dus gza' 'khor rer thengs re byed dgos pa khyon mi nyi shu rtsa bzhi bcas kyi gla 'bab dngul srang brgya dang bzhi 'gro ba phud 'phros dngul srang bdun brgya lhag tsam rdzong la za rgyu yod cing / dkar rtsi thon khungs gad kha gzhis khongs mi ser spyi nas lo re dkar rtsi do brgya dang nyi shu re 'bul dgos pa bcas rdzong de'i yong 'bab che gras dran rigs de tsam yin/ de min da dung za bed chung rtsag rnam grangs mang po yod kyang 'god du mi lang /rdzong skyong gzhis khag rnams kyi sa zhing ston 'bras brtsas ma rnga ma ran tsam la sngo skor zhes lo ltar rdzong ngo g.yog dang las drung re 'gro srol thog sa zhing dud 'gros zas rnyog byung rigs la chad pa son 'gro 'di la 'di 'gro zhes 'ol tshod son 'gro tho bkod rjes ston bsdur rdzong ngo g.yog 'gro skabs tho bkod nang gsal la lnga skor dang / rig bzos la son 'bor tho gsal ngo bo de rang bcas gzhis g.yog rgyugs mkhan mi ser spyi nas len gyi yod/ dper na/son 'gro skor stangs ni dud 'gro'i bzas rnyog smos ci dgos/ ston 'bras zas shul sngo thogs pa med rung / soms can gyi rmig pa'i shul zhig yod na rmig bre zhes rmig rjes rer chad pa 'bru bre gang re 'gel rkyang byed kyi yod/mnga' khul smad rgya bzhi nas gcung pa rgya tsho'i khongs su rdzong skyong gzhis ka med pa phud/ smad rgya gsum khul rdzong sdod ngo g.yog dang las drung re bcas lo ltar sngo skor dang / ston bzhes zer ba'i dbyar ston thengs gnyis re dang /stod rgya gtsang zur gnyis dang / gcung rgya bcas par lo re mar bsdus ces dgun dus thengs re khral bsdur bskyod skabs mi ser spyi nas sa mjal dang /grong drag ming chen rnams nas sger mjal sha mar/ dngul sogs 'bul 73

srol len rkyang khar khrims chad nyes dngul dang / rnam kun khrims gtugs byed mkhan gyi sa nas skyabs rten dngul dngos 'bul len/ nyes chad gcod pa sogs rdzong thog rim pas za bed byed lugs rdzong sdod mi 'gro so so'i byed phyogs yin cing / rgyu rngams za bed che shos kyi gras te dper na/ rdzong sdod thog mar mtsho sgo ba'i g.yog gras tsho dpon phun rgyal zer ba lo gsum tsam ring ngo tshab tu bzhag pa dang gcig bla zhabs e pa'i mi khongs me 'bar ye shes(rjes su sa skya'i drung che yin) zer ba rdzong las drung gi tshab gcig yod pa de dag shod drung mtsho sgo ba'i mig lam du 'jug ngo byung gshis bla zhabs e pa'i sa nas 'khrol 'dzin blangs te rdzong sdod mtsho sgo ba'i ngo tshab tu bzhag pa dang gnyis/ mkhan che dom po ba'i g.yog khongs bkar rnying bzod pa zer bas ngam ring bkar rgya ba lo rgyun gang 'tshams byas pa de dang gsum bcas nas mi ser thog bza' bed 'phar brdabs chen po byung tsang mi ser rnams 'u thug bzod bral gyi gnas su gyar zhing / sa sbrul ( 1929) lo tsam la sa gnas srid gzhung gis bal rnga pags rigs nyo sgrub bsdu dam spom mda' tshang la lag khyer dang sbrags bsko bzhag byas pa nas gtsang khul gyi bsdu dam spom tshong chos ldan gyi ngam khul ngo tshab bkar rnying bzod pas byed skabs bal rnga pags rigs ji yod kho par tshong dgos pa las gzhan la sne rtags tsam btsong mi chog pa'i mtha' 'doms 'gan len byas shing / bal rnga pags rigs la lag khyer nang rin gong yul thang gzhir bzhag sprod dgos lugs gsal tshod kyang kho pas rgyu rngams dbang shed kyis rin gong mig rin zhes sne sel tsam las mi sprod khar phran bu lkog tshong byed mkhan dang / tha na lag khyer du ma gsal ba'i gla rtsi sogs sman rigs nyo tshong byed mi shes thos byung 'phral nyo tshong byed po do bdag gnyis ka ngo 'gug thog dngos rigs gzhung len dang 'brel nyes 74

dngul ma las bu che ba 'gel len byas pas mi tshad da dung 'ga' rer rta lcag gi mtshon nyes brdung yang btang ba bcas mi ser nyam thag la rang rgyu dgrar lang lta bu'i brdabs bsigs ha cang chen po byung yod pa red/ skabs der tshabs che'i brdabs mnar byed po de dag gi bya ngan zhib phra dang der ngo rgol byed pa'i tshigs bcad ka phreng zhig ngam zhol gnas bcu lha khang gi gyang ldebs su sbyar ba de bzhin khul der yongs grags su gyur pa ma zad rang nyid nas kyang dngos su mthong byung /rdzong tshab e drung me 'bar ye shes kyi skabs te/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi lcags lug(1921)lo dbus gtsang rgya khyab rdzong khongs nas grong drag gi bu rang lo 1ṭ+wāṃ— 25bar son pa rnams dmag zhugs dgos pa'i lag the'u rgyag mi drung rigs ser skya'i khongs nas btang zhing / ngam ring khul skabs de'i phun gling rdzong sdod gzhung zhabs rtse drung dge 'dun dam chos kyis grong pa drag rigs kyi bu na tshod son pa rnams mi cha yod med la ma ltos par ming tho bkod de gcig kyang ma lus par lag the'u phab pa'i ming gzhung bka' shag la sprad khongs bka' shag nas 'dems sgrugs kyis ngam khul grong drag ming chen khag gi ming gsal mi grangs sum cu so lnga rdzong brda dgos rgyu'i ngam rdzong la dus bkag bka' rgya 'byor ba red/ de dus ming gsal khag smos ci dgos/ de min lag the'u phab tshad 'gro dgos lugs bskongs 'gug byas shing / pha mas bu la mi gces pa med khar dmag mir gtong 'dod byed mkhan de bas med stabs tshang mas mi cha med tshul dang /khral 'gan lci lugs/ gzugs gcong yin tshul sogs grub bya 'dra min sna tshogs kyi sgo nas dmag 'gro mi dgos pa'i dgongs zhu skyabs 'jug zhu rten dngul dngos sems can sogs 'bor chen sprod dgos byung 'dug ming 75

'khod rnams nas thog ma'i mjal dngul tsam las skyabs rten len ma shes pa phud/ de min rnams kyi skyabs rten gang sprad len rkyang byas thog dgongs 'khrol yong ba'i snyan zhu gang yong phul 'thus kyang gal te dgongs 'khrol ma byung na rjes su 'gro dgos kyi red ces nang don dmag 'gro mi dgos pa shes tshod kyang phyi tshul 'dra chags po zhig bshad de ming 'don zin pa'i mi grangs sum cu so lnga po rdzong brda brgyab 'phros phyir log byas pa red/ dper na rang la cha mtshon na lo khongs su tshud de lag the'u bzed dgos byung rung skyabs rten dngul srang brgya tham pa phul te dmag la 'gro mi dgos pa mol skabs khong gis(rtse drung dge 'dun dam chos) ‘‘khyed rang rdzong gi las drung yin la bu spun gzhan dag kyang med tsang snyan zhu gzab nan phul 'thus zhes bshad byung /ngas skyabs rten dngul u tshugs byas kyang ‘‘don med kyi skad cha ma shod’’ces blangs ma byung / yang chu bya( 192 2)lo ngam rdzong ngo tshab e drung me 'bar ye shes nas bka' dgongs yin tshul gyis ngam khul 'brog rigs khag dang /sa ma 'brog zhing khul grong drag ru ba yod mkhan bcas nas 'bri na spus gnyis ldan grangs 'bor 'di dang 'di spus tshong dgos lugs bshad par/ khungs so sos zhu rten spam mi chung ba btsugs te grangs 'bor de tsam spus 'bul zhu yas med lugs nan zhu byas par zhu rten ji sprad za rkyang byas rjes 'bri nyo tshong bya rgyu chu'i lbu ba ltar khul ba de ni kho pas mi ser thog rang 'tshams brdabs mnar byas pa zhig las gong rim gyi bka' dgongs yin tshod mi 'dug kho pa tsho ni dang thog rta sgro stong pa zhig las khyer rgyu med pa nas rjes su skad grags ldan pa'i 'byor phyugs tu gyur cing / lam lugs ngan pa'i 'og mi ser gyi 'go la sdod mkhan zhig yin phyin bshu gzhog gtong mkhas lod dang za rngam che chung tsam ma gtogs rtsa ba'i cha nas bshu gzhog mi gtong mkhan med/ 'on 76

kyang lcags yos (1951) lor bkras lhun bla brang gi rdzong gzhis tshang ma gzhung 'dzin byas rjes za bed 'phar brdabs che rigs byung med/ dper na ngam rdzong rtse las tshan smon skyid pa 'go khrid ngo las skabs mi ser 'tsho skyong cung legs pa byung tsang khong la mi ser gyis bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes 'bod kyi yod pa red/ lam lugs de'i nang las drung so sor yang ri che chung la kha ba che chung gi dpe ltar mi so so'i 'jon thang byed phyogs la gzhigs pa'i za bed che chung yod/ nga rang la ltos na skabs der las drung khri pa zer ba'i go ming yod kyang lam lugs ngan pa de'i thog bya thabs cung zad mkhas pa'i stabs kyis mi ser yongs nas brtsi bkur che tsam yod tsang de bas bshu gzhog kyang che ba byung yod pas khul de'i mang tshogs la dgongs dag thugs bden zhu 'os pa zhig yin/ rdzong de bkras lhun bla brang gi khongs gtogs song gshis rdzong sdod bla zhabs kher rkyang bsko gtong byed kyi yod cing / paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma mes rgyal nang sar gsang phebs rjes bkras bla'i dza bla ngo las sa gnas srid gzhung gis bsko gzhag thog rdzong gzhis khag la'ang gzhungari zhabs ser skya re bsko rdzongs byas pa red/ nga rang las drung thog ma byed skabs rdzong thog mtsho sgo ba yin cing / chu bya(1922)lo'i dpyid dus paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma mes rgyal nang sar 'tsho bzhugs skabs bkras bla'i skor sa gnas srid gzhung la 'phros mol zhu bar sngags cheṇa bdar pa mchog dang / drung che mdang chen pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan gnyis btang gnang ba dang / 'dir yod rim bzhi bde rab rdo rje g.yu rgyal dang / rim bzhi btsag ser bsod nams stobs rgyal/ rtse drung mgron chos khang blo bzang dam chos sogs lha sar don gcod du 'byor te sa gnas srid gzhung la 'phros mol byas rjes shing phag (1925) lo rdzong gzhis khag gi mi 'gro bkras bla rang khungs nas 77

btang 'thus byang ste de nas bzung lcags yos( 1kha51)lo bar rdzong sdod bla (ste/ rir shārjeste )redro sherdor+sha rwate/ rngo | 311 /re/zhabs ra skya ga tsho sa ci bsko gatsho nga byas nga / /nga nas rdzong ga sa tshang ma gzhung 'dzin gyis mi 'gro ngo las btang ste sngar lam gtong sgo khag dang /bkar 'jug sgrigs 'bul sogs 'gro cha khag phud/ yong 'bab rnams bum pa sib blugs kyis bla brang phyag mdzod dang / rtse phyag tu rtsis zhu byed kyi yod de'i skabs nga rang yang las bya'i khongs mi yin pas yong 'bab zal thon ang gnyis pa byung gshis/ ang gnyis pa'i bya dga' yang thob byung / sa phag( 1kha5kha)lo'i lo 'gor krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi bka' ltar bod kyi mtho rim ru tshogs kyis bslangs pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su btang gnang ba dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas te rdzong sdod kyi las ka'i le'u mjug bsgril ba bcas so/78

ngas zur khang gi 'gag pa byed skabs sger zur khang pa dang zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyi lo rgyus rags rim mthong thos byung rigs 'ga' zhig/chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis/zur khang ni de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag sger pa rnying khungs shig yin pa ma zad/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus 'gor byung ba'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i (1rdorkya5—1ṭ+wāṃ15) yab gzhis dang zla bsgril bar brten bod kyi zhing bran bdag po cung che gras kyi khyim tshang zhig chags shing / de snga mi rabs gong ma 'ga' shas kyis bka' blon byed myong bas mi drag ces bu rgyud rim can sras rnam pa byed chog pa sogs lha sa'i nang gzim shag che khag zer ba'i ming grags yod pa'i dpon tshang gi gras shig kyang yin/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs ni/ pha zur khang dbang chen tshe brtan (rjes su zur khang nas zur du thon stabs dza sag zur khang zur pa zer ) dang / skyes ma sde dpon lha rgya ri ba'i bu mo chos 'dzoms zer ba gnyis kyi bur bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa khyi (1910)lor skyes pa'i bu thu bo de yin 'dug cing / khong la gcung po gnyis yod pa'i gcig la lha dbang ri 79

stobs rgyal (kha dang gra bzhi dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon byed myong ba ) dang /chung bar mkhyen rab dbang phyug (mkhan chung ) zer/ de bzhin gcung mo rgan pa rdo rje g.yu sgron (g.yu thog lha lcam zer ) dang chung ba lha sgron (rong brag lcam zer)bcas yod/ngas shes pa'i zur khang gi gnas tshul ni/ gtso bo chu lug 1942lo nas me khyi 1946lo'i bar nga la zur khang gi 'gag pa bsko bzhag byas ring lo 'khor gsum tsam gshib pa de'i skabs kyi mthong thos shes tshor tsam yin pa las/ de min snga rjes su phan tshun gshib 'dris med stabs ngas khong gi lo rgyus mang po mi shes pa smos ma dgos shing / bka' blon dang 'gag pa'i bar gyi 'brel ba de'ang ha lam dpon g.yog lta bu zhig yin kyang mdun g.yog nang bzhin nyin mtshan rtag 'grogs ma dgos stabs cha rgyus zhib phra zhig kyang yong thabs med pa bcas yin/ gang ltar 'dir rang gi blo la nges pa rnams phyogs bsdus byas nas bkod yod/zur khang gis bka' blon dang / ngas gzim 'gag zhu stangs skor/khong gis bka' blon zhu rtsom byed stangs thad rang la cha rgyus dngos su med kyang / mgron gnyer bstan 'dzin snyan grags sogs nas nga la bshad myong ba ltar na/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs tā la'i bla ma'i phebs byams 'go pa byed mus thog nas/ zhu mos ltar mdo smad spyi khyab kyi las bya rim bzhir gnas spos bsko bzhag byung ste bka' bsgyur mjal dar yang phul zin pa red/ chu lug ( 1942) lo 'go tsam zhig la bka' blon gnang 80

byung pa glo bur gnas dbyung btang ba'i tshab gsar thad/ dmag spyi dza sag mdo mkhar ba dang / tha'i ji bsam pho ba/ rtsis dpon ka shod pa/ rtse phyag zhol khang pa sogs dpon rigs che gras mang pos ang nyan dang zhu 'tshang byed kyi yod pa red/ de dus zur khang gis phyogs gcig nas chab mdor gtong rgyu'i tshong zog sogs sgrub rtsol rdog chas dang 'brel rta drel lag gcig gnyis shig sngon la thon rkyang byed bcug pa ma zad/ rang nyid kyang thon nyer yod pa'i gra sgrig sogs brel brtson ngang byas pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas ches gsang ba dam po'i bya thabs spyad de srid skyong stag brag la phyag mdzod che mo sogs dngos brgyud thabs sgo gang gzab kyi sbyar kha brgyab thog kha gtad rnams gnon thub nges kyi rtsib rdo (dngos po dang kha grangs sogs bshad ma byung) brgyab ste bka' blon tshab gsar rag thabs zhu 'tshang shugs chen byas pa red/ nang don don smin yong rgyu'i gdengs tshod lon pa'i mtshams zur khang gis skabs de'i bka' blon las thog gsum gyi sar skyabs rten 'os 'tshams re bskyal thog nga'i pā lags(dza sag zur khang zur pa)da res bka' blon gsar bsko'i 'os 'char gyi brtag zhu'i khongs tshud pa zhig skyabs 'jug yong ba zhes zhu skul byas pa red/ bya thabs de ltar spyod don ni rjes su don son byung mtshams khong tsho dang mnyam gshib byed dgos stabs‘‘rlung gseng 'gog byed ’’kyi thob skal lta bu re sprad pa dang / gal srid bsam yul las 'das pa'i 'gyur ldog 'dra byung nas don smin mu thob rung /‘‘gro ma 'dur ba’’ (dpon gnas 'phar nas gsar mjal zhu skabs rten 'brel gyi gro ma 'tsho dgos shing / don son ma byung na btsos pa'i‘‘gro ma 'dur ba’’ste 'phro brlag phyin par zer) dang‘‘rkub brdabs pa’’('chang kha brgyab mthar mi gzhan gyis 'bud rgyag btang ste 'gyel nas rkub brdabs 81

song zer) zer ba sogs kyi spyi tshogs thog gleng phyogs ngan pa'i 'phya smod de rigs bzed mi dgos par the jus dang / thob shor gang yang med pa lta bur 'jam thing thing ngang chab mdor thon rkyang bya rgyu'i ched du red ces bshad byung /skabs der zur khang gis stag brag la skyabs rten chen po bskyal ba'i skor la rjes su lha sa'i grong khul du zur za'i dmangs gzhas kha shas btang ba red/nga rang gis nges pa ni/ ‘‘gser gyi rtsig pa brtsigs nas/ zur la dar lcog btsugs song / stag gi zhwa mo gyon nas/ ri klung med par rgyugs gid’’ces go myong ba de las zur khang gis stag brag la gser lcug mang po bskyal nas bka' blon rag song zer ba dang / zhwa sgab pas stag brag gi dbang shugs bed spyad nas gang sa gang du 'phag 'tshag rgyag gi 'dug ces zer tshul go myong / de bas cha tshang ba zhig nye char bod kyi dmangs khrod rig rtsal tshags par 〈spang rgyan me tog〉19〈4lo'i 'don thengs dang po'i par ngos gnyis pa'i rtsom yig gcig gi nang 'khod pa ni/ ‘6zhal tog slo ma'i nang la/gser gyi rtsig pa brtsigs bzhag bla rgan snang ba 'khrul nas/ zur la dar lcog btsugs so/ zur zur zur nas bltas pas/ gser gyi rtsig pa brtsigs 'dug chig khri nyis stong byung na/ zhabs pad phru gus byas chog’’ces btang tshul gsal ba ltar na zur khang gis srid skyong stag brag la phyi tshul zhal tog 'bul ba'i rnam par brten nas slo ma'i nang gser lcug mang po sgrig nas phul ba'i snang tshul dang / grangs tshad thad bod dngul du phab na rdo tshad chig phri nyis stong tsam zin lugs zer ba de'ang dpyad gzhi tsam du bkod pa yin/ gang ltar de'i skabs sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon zhu bar dngul rdo tshad khri phrag skyel dgos pa ni yongs grags shig yin/ rjes su bka' shag nas ba7'a blon 'os 'char mi bzhi lnga zhig brtag zhur(shod drung 82

dpon rigs gzhan dag bsko dus bka' shag nas 'os dang gnyis 'char gzhi phul bar srid skyong gis 'thus mchan bkod kyang rung / bka' blon thad thog mar bka' shag nas 'os sgug pa 'ga' shas kyi ming bton te tā la'i bla ma'am/ srid skyong ste srid dbang sus 'dzin la gsung brtag zhu —dgos/de'i nang su la phabs pa de gzhi nas 'char gzhi 'bul dgos)phul skad kyang /srid skyong stag brag gis 'os 'char nang bkod pa tshang ma g.yugs bzhag nas/bka' blon tshab gsar thad mchog gsum bden skul gyi brtag pa nan tan byas don rim bzhi zur khang sras dbang chen dge legs 'phral phugs las skal 'phrod lam bzang phebs byung lugs brtag lan sprad par brten sngar lam ltar bka' shag nas/ thengs de'i bka' blon gsar bsko'i 'char gzhi — dngos gzhi'i 'os dang por zur khang ma btang ka med ltar 'char phul de'i thog stag brag gis 'thus mchan phab ste shod 'gag nas/ zur khang gi phyag mdzod ming thog bka' sgyur yig chung btang (dpon rigs gzhan dag bsko dus ngo ma shod 'gag tu bskongs te bka' sgyur byed kyang / bka' blon ni srid gzhung gi sku ngo'i gdan thob yod zer bas khyim tshang de'i phyag mdzod la yig chung btang nas don de sku ngor snyan seng zhu dgos zhes 'god srol snang)ba bcas de ltar brgyud nas bka' blon gtan 'khel ba red/ngas gzim 'gag zhu stangs ni/ skabs der nga rang gzhis skor du gtsang bskyod kyi pha khyim lha rtse smon skyid par bsdad yod/ lha sar nga'i zhang po rim bzhi chab spel 'jigs med kun dga' bzhugs mus ltar khong gis bka' blon gsar pa zur khang yin pa shes 'phral bcar te/ da lam gzim 'gag gsar pa nga tsho'i zhabs sdod pa'i thog bsko bzhag gnang rogs zhus skabs zur khang nas/ da lta rang sding yon rim bzhi phebs te 'gag pa khong 83

gi bu la bsko rogs zer bar khas len thal song / khyed rang gom pa gang gi phyis drags pa red ces brjod 'dug nga'i zhang po de dang kun bzang rtse'i dza sag gnyis mthun po yod cing / khong ni zur khang gi a khu ngo ma yin par brten khong brgyud nas slar yang u tshugs brgyab pa red/ mthar zur khang gis sding yon la zhib bsam skabs da lam nga bka' blon thog ma'i 'gag pa dang po yin gshis/ mi bslu ba dkon mchog yin pas 'os cha gnyis 'phral phugs la skal su bzang jo bo rin po cher zan brtag gcig ma phul na 'grig pa min 'dug ces bshad de zur khang gi phyag mdzod dang / sding yon dang chab spel gyi ngo tshab re bcas mnyam du jo khang nang btang ste zan sgril zhus par nga'i ming thon nas gtan 'khel byas pa red/ spyi tshogs rnying par bya ba chung rtsag de lta bu zhig la'ang zan brtag zhu ba de ni/ dkon mchog la yid ches byed pa kho na tsam min par skabs re rme4ribag/la ba thag gcod kyi bya thabs dmigs bsal can zhig tu spyod pa'ang gsal po mthong thub/ de 'phral zhang po nas nga la yi ge btang 'dug pa ltar gtsang nas shad thon gyis lha sar 'byor/ thog mar gzim 'gag zhu skabs skyabs rten dngul ṭam rdo bcu tham pa phul 'dug kyang ma blang par brten ngas thugs rje legs 'bul dang 'byor gdong phyag 'bul chabs sbrags su 'bras ltang gcig dang / gtsang rum gyi kha gdan cha gcig phul nas bcar ba yin/ 1kha42bod chu lug lo'i zla 6tshes 14nyin bka' blon gsar pa khri 'don gyi byed sgo sngar lam gzhir bzung gzab rgyas byaso song / de nas bzung res gza' spen pa nam yin (gza' spen pa dzeni tā la'i bla ma 12si dang 14pa gnyis ka'i gshed gza' yin pas gzhung gi las khungs tshang ma gung seng zhog lam yod)la las seng ngal gso yin pa phud/ de min rgyun ldan nyin ltar rtag bcar zhabs 84

'degs byed dgos par brten phan tshun 'brel 'dris rim bzhin che ru gyur/zur khang gi rig gnas shes yon gyi skor/khong ni chung dus nas bod yig la sbyang pa che zhing / rig gnas thad dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho sogs slob dpon du bsten nas sbyang brtson gang 'tshams byas pa ma zad/ mthong rgya dang thos rgya che ba bcas skabs de'i bka' blon gyi nang(bon shod la yi ge legs pa'i skad grags yod pa ni gtso bo srid rnying gi las don yig rigalogang cir cha rgyus dang myong byang che ba des byas pa las/ rig gnas rtsom rigs sogs gang yang sbyang myong med)yi ge gzugs 'don dag gsum dang snyan rtsom sogs rig gzhung gi chu tshad drag shos yin 'dug 'on kyang khong gis/ ‘‘ bka' blon bogres pa tshos bzo bcos gnang rgyur lus pa'i yi ge dag min rigs ngas kyang bzo bcos rgyag gi med/ mkhas nyams bstan na mi la phog thug 'gro gi red’’ces nga la bshad myong / de min gzim shag tu log rjes nga la 'di 'dra dang de 'dra'i skor 'bri dgos zhes rtsom thung mang po rgyag tu 'jug myong yang / nang don ni mang che ba bud med kyi ming ྾ ྾ ྾ ྾la tshig rgyan dang / mdzes chos la bstod bsngags sogs rul sungs kyi spyod tshul mtshon byed de rigs yin zhing / de min dgung gsar zhu yig gi lan sogs chab shog dang / gad mo slong ba'i rtsom thung / deb kyi 'go brjod sogs red/ de dag la khong gis tshig don gang sar bzo bcos rgyag gi yod pa rnams gnad la 'khel po mchis pas nga rang la'ang yar rgyas cung zad byung / 'o na zur khang rang gi snyan rtsom ci 'dra yod dam snyam na/ da lta rang blor nges pa dpe mtshon tsam zhig 'dren 85

rgyur de dus zur khang gi spun nye lha rgya ri'i rgyud 'dzar blo bzang thub bstan lags zer ba zhig e nas lha sar 'byor song / zur khang gis nga la khong ngo sprod byas te snyan sum sogs rig gnas yag po yod tshul brjod thog khyed gnyis nga'i mthong sa 'di rang du snyan rtsom dang rtsom lan spel res shig byed dgos zhes nga gnyis so sor snag shog sprad nas 'bri ru bcug byung / ngas ming bstod sogs cho med pa'i rtsom yig sho lo ka kha shas shig bris te sprad pa yin/ gcig shos kyis tsher snang lta bus mi 'bri bar zur khang gis u tshugs brgyab na yang bris ma song stabs 'bri shog yar blangs te sho lo ka gcig shar mar bris song ba 'di ltar/ ‘‘blo bzang thub bstan lha yi rnga bo che ma mthong rgyang nas thos tshe ngo mtshar 'gyed/ lhan gcig gam du gnas na tshigs bcad gcig smra ba'i spobs pa nam mkha'i me tog 'thu’’zhes bris 'dug de min khong gis gab tshig gi rtsom sho lo ka zhig bris pa ni/ ‘‘rgya mo mchu ring ska rags gnyis bcings pas/ (rgya si'i smyu gu tshigs can la zer/) zangs kyi bum pa'i nang nas 'dam zhig blangs/ (zangs kyi snag bum nas snag tsha len par zer) brag dmar thog so bzhi la ngal gsos nas/(lag g.yas pa'i sor mo bzhi la brten par zer) pad ma stong phrag sgrog rtse'i steng du bshos/’’(yig 'bru mang po shog bu'i thog tu bris par zer) zhes pa de gnyis mtshon byed tsam du bkod/ 'on kyang rtsom yig che gras ni gang yang yod pa ma thos/zur khang gis 'jig rten chul 'chos la do snang chen po byed pa'i skor/zur khang ni 'jig rten tshul 'chos kyi sbyor bar byang chub pa zhig red 8khyi

'dug dper na/ nyin ltar bka' shag tu 'gro skabs (mdzad sgo gzhan khag kyang tshud)drung chas dang tog zhwa sogs cha tshang gyon zin rjes khong rang gi gzim chung nas thon te yum gyi bzhugs sar bskyod de ‘‘a ma lags/ nga bka' shag tu 'gro gi yin ’’zhes zhu ba dang / dgong dro zur khang du 'byor 'phral shar rgyag yum gyi gzim chung du phyin te ‘‘a ma lags bka' shag grol song ’’zhes snyan seng zhus rjes gzhi nas rang gi gzim chung du gyon chas brje ba bcas kyi sgrig srol de lo gsum gyi nang ha lam chag med rgyun 'khyongs byas yod/de bzhin khong gi pha zur khang nas zur du thon rjes a ma dang 'gal zla chags pas tshur gom pa rgyag myong med pa red ces zer gyi 'dug 'on kyang bka' blon gsar mjal skabs dang / lo re'i bod kyi lo gsar nam shar sogs la spo'o gling kha'i khang pa gsar par phyag 'bul du bskyod de gus zhabs chen po zhu ba dang / kun bzang rtse dza sag zur khang du yong dus kyang pha.a khu lags ’’zhes phebs bsu gus 'dud dang 'brel gral 'gor bzhag nas sri zhu chen po byed pa ma zad/ spyir btang gzhung zhabs rgan gras bcar skabs kyang bka' blon gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar gus lan 'dra chags po byed pa sogs la mi tshos bstod bsngags gtong ba bcas mthong thos byung skabs rang bsam la khong ni ya rabs gus srol dang ldan pa'i mi zhig 'dug snyam pa'i yi rangs chen po skye myong / 'on kyang gshib 'dris brgyud don dngos ni de las ldog pa zhig yin pa dbe mtshon gcig gis gsal bshad thub pa ste/ skabs der zur khang gi gzhis ka so so'i lo re'i yong 'bab dang / phyi 'gro'i rigs sogs gtong yong tshang ma phyag mdzod khang nas yum la dgongs bskor do dam dang 'brel lo re'i byung song gang ci yum chen sar rtsis zhu byed dgos pa sogs khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor dbang cha a ma'i lag tu bzung yod pa red/ der 87

brten/ shing sprel (1944) lor bka' shag thugs spro gtong res zur khang la 'khor ba'i nyin dang po'i zhogs pa der rgyun ldan ltar zur khang yum gyi sar bskyod skabs a mas srang gsum sgor mo brgya tham pa dru'u tse mtshal ka'i pha' tse'i nang sgril ba zhig nga la sprad nas/ sku zhabs gzim 'gag 'di sa dbang rnam pa phyag sho (sa dbang khang du mā cang brgyab mi chog pas bka' blon rnams shog bad rtse) gnang skabs kyi phyag sne yin zhes zer ba dang /yang bod dngul brgya lor shog chag gcig bton nas 'di mtshan mo sku rtsed gnang rgyu'i phyag sne(thugs spro gtong res bka' blon de'i ring gling khar nyal lam ltar mtshan mo mā cang rgyag pa'i rtsed rgyan la zer/)yin zhes zur khang rang la sprad song / khong gis shog chag gtsir tsam byas te/ a ma lags rtsed rgyan la dngul mang po 'di 'dra ga la dgos zer bzhin shog chag kha phye nas grangs kha brgyab song bar brgya lor nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dug hang sang mdog gis/rdo tshad lnga bcu tham pa/ 'di 'dra mang thag chod song zhes brgya lor bco lnga bton nas yum la phul 'phros shog sgril brgyab ste khong rang gi am phrag nang bcug thog a ma lags thugs rje che zhes zhus nas bka' shag tu bskyod/tshang ma 'dzoms nas drung spyi gling khar 'byor rjes chab gsang du 'gro skabs rgyun gtan ltar nga zhabs phyir phyin par gsang spyod kyi sgo nang du brgya lor bcu yod pa'i shog chag de bton nas/ 'di gzim 'gag rang rtsed rgyan gyis ang zhes nga rang la ster byung / gnas tshul de ngas mgron gnyer bstan 'dzin snyan grags la bshad par khong gis gad mo 'tsher 'tsher ngang am phrag nas dbyin sgor brgya lor rkyang rkyang sgril ba'i shog chag gru bzhi zhig bton nas/mtshan mo'i phyag sne 'di'i nang yod/ brgya lor bcu po des mā cang dkrug thengs gcig kyang ldang gi ma red zer/ ngas dngul ga nas blangs pa red 88

dam zhes dris par khong gis yum chen gyis dngul srang bcu grangs la'ang rtsis bsher nan po byed kyang / rgya gar du bal tshong brgyab pa'i khe 'bab dang /sa tham du tshong zog btang ba'i ma khe sogs ji yod gang yang mgo tshos kyi ma red/ ‘‘chen po gar song mi shes/ chung chung blos kyis mi thong ’’zer ba'i dpe ltar red/ rgya gar du dngul khang 'gar sgor mo 'bum ther kha shas bcol yod pa de tsho rmo'o lags kyis shes kyi ma red/ sa dbang che mo'i mgul la rgyun bcangs gnang ba'i phyag tham chung chung de brgyab pa'i ngos 'dzin zhig gnang na dngul sgor mo khri stong gang dgos bal po zhwa mo dkar po'i tshong khang nas blangs chog chog red/ shog chag 'di'i nang dbyin sgor brgyad stong yod/ kha sa ngas len par phyin pa yin zer bshad byung / de'i thog nas khong gis yum la don dam brtsi bkur ci 'dra zhig zhu gi yod pa de gsal rtogs byung / yab dang bgres rabs la gus zhabs zhu ba'i dmigs yul yang de bzhin yin pa smos ma dgos/gzhan yang de dus ser skya drag zhan mang po zhig gis bka' shag la zhu don sgrub phyir bka' blon rnams la dngose po'i mjal zhu dang / dngul gyi skyabs rten grangs las 'das pa zhig skyel dgos pa ni spyi tshogs de'i nang lugs mthun rgyun srol zhig chags yod/ 'on kyang zur khang gis mjal rten dngos po'i rigs len pa las/ don zhu'i skyabs rten dngul dngos rnams spyir btang phyir slog nan po byed kyi 'dug da dung khral pa mi ser gyi rigs yin na khong tshor spam mtho'i 'bul tshan skyel rgyu med pas nges par phyir slog byed pa ma zad/ ngag 'jam ngang ring gis rgyu rkyen rnams zhib lhod nyan rjes/ snying rje/ snying rje rogs phan gang thub byas chog ces dbugs dbyung byed pa dang / da dung 'khos zhan la lar gnyer tshang nas rtsam pa dang ja 89

sogs bza' chas sprod du bcug pa'ang thengs kha shas mthong myong / de dus nga'i sems la zur khang ni deng sang dpon po'i nang nas mi bzang zhig red bsam gyi yod/ 'on kyang rjes su nga gzim 'gag lo dus thims nas rgyal rtse rdzong sdod bskos pa ltar thon phyag zhu bar bcar dus khong gi bslab byar/‘‘gzim 'gag rang rdzong du 'byor rjes spyir btang mi ser gyi lag nas skyabs rten za rgyu med/ kho tshos bskyal ba'i nyung shas de tsam gyis nga tsho'i skyid sdug la mi phan/ de bas kha 'jam po byas te mi dmangs nang snyan grags yong thabs bya rgyu de phugs nas phan thogs che/ mi tshang che gras tshor yang mthun po yong thabs byed dgos shing / de tsho'i lag nas kyang dngul phran bu za ba las khong tshor tshong skal len rogs zer ba'am/ bdal gla skyel rogs zer ba/yang na thon khungs spus tshong byed rogs zer ba sogs bshad nas tshong 'khos 'thab len gyi thog la phan 'gyur yong thabs byas na don phan che ba yong gi red/ rang don mi sgrub mkhan med kyang sgrub mkhas po zhig dang rtsis rgyag shes pa zhig byed dgos/ ltogs hral byas na ming don gnyis ka shor rgyur brten de tsho sems la zhog’’ces bshad byung / skabs der rang bsam la de dag ni dngos 'brel pha ma'i bslab bya lta bu red bsams myong / da lta byed dus khong gis skyabs rten mi len pa de'ang de las lhag pa'i snyan grags dang khe phan thob ched yin pa gsal po red/ zur khang ni srid don gyi gnad 'gag yod pa'i mi la 'gro gron 'dzems med kyis mthun 'grig byed thub mkhan zhig yin la/ de yang go skabs dang bya thabs 'tshol mkhas po zhig kyang red 'dug dper na khong bka' blon ma byas gong ste phal cher spyi lo 1941lor yin tshod bka' blon bla ma bsta na pa 'jam dbyangs (de dus bka' shag nang kha shugs che shos red) la bka' shag thugs spro gtong res 90

'khel ba red/ de dus kho pa khyim gzhi chen po de tsam chags med stabs spro skyid kyi 'dzin chas sogs gra sgrig rgya che byed dgos pa'i ca zing chen po 'phrad skabs/ zur khang gi ma skul dang blangs ngang thengs de'i bka' shag thugs spro zur khang nas 'gan len zhu rgyu khas blangs thog 'dzin chas dang 'gro song yongs rdzogs btang ste tshab skyin gang yang ma blangs pa red zer gyi 'dugade nas bzung bstan 'jam dang zur khang dbar nang ma snod gcig gi 'brel zab cha gas shing / rjes su zur khang gis bka' blon zhu 'tshang byed skabs kyang kho pas srid skyong stag brag la zhu brgyud rgyab skyor byas skad go rgyu 'dugangs dngos su shes pa zhig la rtsis dpon klu khang pa(bde mkhar ba yang zer)ni gzhung zhabs nang drang tshugs dang gzhung zhen chen po yod khul byed mkhan zhig yin la/ dpon rigs che kha sogs la'ang sra snyi mi brtsi bar phog thug gtong mkhan zhig yin tshul skad grags kyang yod pa red/ der brten tā la'i yab gzhis dang / bka' blon/ bla brang che kha sogs tshang mas khong la dogs zon byed pa dang / kho pa'i ming grags don gnyer byed stangs de'ang mi gzhan dang mi 'dra bar che btsan su la'ang re bcol mi byed pa'i rnam 'gyur ston mkhan khyad mtshar po zhig yod pa red/ 1947lor drung spyi dbyar skyid(rim bzhi sras rnam pa yan mi tshang gnyis rer 'khel ba)ces mi tshe gcig la thengs gcig 'khri ba'i rdog phres de klu khang pa'i mgo thog tu babs pa red/de ni sger pa dkyus ma zhig la cha mtshon na dngos 'brel chag sgo gcig yin/'gro gron chen po gtong dgos pa smos ci 'phral sel 'dzin chas gra sgrig kho nar mtshon rung / bka' shag thugs spro las kyang gzhi khyon che ba zhig byed dgos/der brten 'gro song dngul bun blangs nas gtong thub pa'i dbang du btang na'ang / rgya che sne mang gi sgrig chas de dag sde dpon mi drag dang / gling che 91

khag sogs gang sar rgyugs nas g.yar po ma zhus na sgrub thabs med pa red/klu khang pa blo sbug ha cang dog la rang gi gshis spyod gyong po yin rloms byed pa de khungs mi 'khyol ba'i mtshams la slebs te nyal gnyid zas bcud bral ba'i gnas su gyar yod pa red/ de lo'i bka' shag thugs spro gtong res zur khang la 'khor bar brten tag tag khong gis go skabs de bzung nas klu khang si ra/ da res dbyar skyid dbu res de gang 'dra gnang rtsis yod dam zhes gleng bslangs par kho pas rang nyid kyi4'khyer 'khos sogs rgyas bshad dang 'brel ci bya gtol bral du gyur lugs sdug skad brgyab par brten zur khang gis gdung sems mnyam skye'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas de 'dra yin na thugs g.yengs gnang mi dgos/ dus tshod thad bka' shag thugs spro'i mu mthud (dbyar skyid de gnyis ka gtong yul drung spyi gling kha yin) nas gtong rgyu'i gtan 'khel gnang dgos/ sgrig chas tshang ma nga tshos rang 'jags bzhag na 'grig pa ma zad/ 'gro gron rigs kyang lhag 'khrol nas btang chog pas gang ltar khyed kyi phyed 'bab byed sgo gang yod nga tshos yongs rdzogs 'gan len zhus chog ces khas blangs pa red/ klu khang pa dga' thag chod nas mig chu shor grabs kyis bka' drin rjes dran zhu rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan 'dugadangos 'brel rkang 'gro lag 'don gang thad nas rogs ram chen po de lta bu byas pa ma zad/ tha na spyi khyab las byed pa rnams kyang rang 'jags byed dgos zer ba ltar nga rang gis kyang mu mthud nas zhabs phyi zhus pa yin/mdor na ‘‘rgyu nor gyi bslu brid byed mi thub pa ’’zer ba'i mi der yang ltag 'then rgyag thabs med pa'i sna thag cig bkon pa de dang len zhu dgos byung ba red/92

zur khang gis dbang sgyur pa nang khul gyi 'gal bar do snang chen po byed pa'i skor/gzhan yang zur khang ni dbang sgyur pa nang khul gyi 'gal bar do snang chen po byed mkhan zhig red 'dugadaper na shing sprel(1944) lo'i smon lam che mo'i rjes 'brel rgyug ring gi sta gon ‘‘ze dam ’’zhes pa'i zhogs par rtse pho brang gi rgyab tu rgyug ma 'gran bsdur gyi ang grangs shing byang len skabs bka' bla bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi g.yog po dang / bka' gung phun khang gis g.yog gras phan tshun shing byang 'phrog res kyi 'khrug rtsod thug nas phun khang gi g.yog po mang la hrag pas bstan 'jam gi g.yog gras la nyes rdung btang ba red/ de nas nyin shas song rjes rgyug ring dngos gzhi'i nyin bstan 'jam༈gyis g.yog gras 'phar snon thog 'bras spungs kyi grwa pa rdob rdob dang / kho pa dmag spyi yin stabs grwa bzhi'i dmag mi 'ga' shas bcas ltad mo ba yin khul gyis btang ba dang / phun khang gis kyang g.yog gras 'phar snon byed tshul sogs zur khang gis shes rtogs byung ba red/ der brten zur khang rang gi rgyug ma'i shing byang len mkhan yang g.yog po mang po 'gro rgyu mi 'dug ces lo na rgan pa gsum tsam zhig bkod sgrig thog kho tshor shing byang len sar 'tshang ga rgyag mi dgos/ rta so so'i sgal ba'i steng ming yig chen po sbyar yod pas su'i rgyug ma sngon la thon min lha sa'i khrom mi dmangs tshos gsal po shes kyi red/ mi gzhan dag rgyag res shor na khyed tshos the jus gtan nas byed mi rung bar rgyang ring sar sdod dgos zhes mngags dam byas song / nyin der 93

sku 'bum thang kyi shing byang sprod sar sngar lam ltar rgyug ring spyi khyab dza sag gcig dang / las bya shod drung bzhi/ zhol pa'i nang zam sogs yod pa rnams nas kyang bde 'jags yong thabs tsa/nga yong byas rung / rgyug rta slebs long med par shing byang 'phrog 'dzengs byas te lam seng rgyag res thug cing / bstan 'jam gyi shog khas mi mang lag rub kyis rdo dang dbyug pa gzhus nas phun khang gi g.yog por nyes rdung drag po btang rkyen 'ga' shas la rmas skyon tshabs chen bzos pa red/ de'i skor bka' blom/ gnyis dbar 'gal zla rno ngar je cher gyur nas phun khang gis rdung rdeg byed gte rtsis sprod dgos lugs dang / bstan 'jam gyis dang thog ze dam nyin 'khrug rkyen slong mkhan rtsis sprod dgos tshul sogs mkhregs bzung byas rkyen nyin shas bka' shag tshang 'dzoms kyang byed ma thub pa red/ skabs der bka' blon bon shod dang zur khang gnyis nas gros kyis bon shod (bu) phogs dpon dang / zur khang (gcung po) rtse mgron gnyis mnyam gtong gis/ phyogs gnyis kar dgongs sel dang 'brel nang 'grig yong ba'i babs gsed thengs mang byas na yang / gnyis phyogs nas nga bden nga yus kyis pha rol pos dgongs dag thugs bden ma zhus na nyan rgyu min zhes a 'thas ma khregs bzung byed skabs/ nyin zhig rtse mgron nas zur khang rang la ‘‘jo lags/khrims med kho rang tshos byas te gshe gshe nga tshos bzed dgos kyi 'dug de bas g.yugs bzhag na yag ’’ces bshad song bar khong gis gad mo dgod kyin du‘‘o'o lags/ da res rang rer ca sing phran bu byung rung skyon med/phyin chad bka' shag nang bon shod dang nga rang tshor phan pa yod pa red ’’ces bshad nas mu mthud bab gsed byas mthar phyogs so sor dkar gsol mtshan 'degs yin zhes dngul ṭam rdo 25re dang kha btags nang mdzod re 94

bon shod dang zur khang gnyis nas bar mi rgyu 'don gyi phul te ltar snang du 'dum 'grig byung khul byas pa red/ 'on kyang khong du sbas pa'i 'khon 'dzin ni je sdug tu 'gro bas mgo 'dren gtong phyogs sogs kyi thad rtag par khong gnyis a ngan zhe kyag gis phan tshun 'gog res mtha' gcig tu byas gshis/ dngos 'brel skabs shig gi ring bon shod dang zur khang la khe phan rag pa'i cha rkyen du gyur pa red/zur khang gis phyi rgyal 'byor ldan gral rim gyi byed lugs byed stangs la do snang chen po byed pa'i skor/ tshokhong la phyi rgyal 'byor ldan gral rim gyi shugs rkyen nges can zhig thebs yod par snang / zur khang rang gis dbyin skad phran bu las dbyin yig sogs de tsam shes kyi med pa 'dra/ 'on kyang khong gi gcung po lha stobs lags dbyin ji'i slob grwar zhugs myong bas dbyin yig kyang go 'phe ra shes par brten dbyin ji dang / a ri'i tshags par dang dus deb/ brnyan par sogs bde skyid gling ga(lha sdod dbyin tshab) brgyud mngags mus zla re bzhin 'byor gyi 'dug khong gnyis de tsho'i nang don nyan bshad bya rgyur dga' po yod pa red/ 'on kyang skabs der ltar snang du bod kyi gnas tshul zhi lhod la brten chab srid thad kyi snang tshul ya mtshan rigs gang yang ma tshor rung / shing sprel (194〉)lo'i dbyar khar/ bde skyid gling gar bca' sdod dbyin ji'i ngo tshab ri car san nas blo 'don byas pa ltar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa zhig gsar 'dzugs byas pa red/95

ring min se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus sogs nas ngo rgol byas rkyen zla shas song rjes dbyin slob de mtshams 'jog mi byed ka med byung skabs/dbyin gzhung nas ched btang dge rgan par kar sa heb zer bar bka' shag nas phebs skyel gsol ston zhig bshams song / phal cher 1945lo'i lo 'gor yin tshod kyi nyin zhig gtsug lag khang gi snang srid nyi 'od du dkyil ngos kyi ka ba bzhi la sman rtse'i yol bcad btang ba'i nang / bla phyag nas gsol sgro'o gcig rgyal gshom thog bka' blon bla ma(bstan 'jam shi tshab) ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / bka' blon bon phun zur gsum/ spyi mkhan ser byes ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ skad sgyur rim bzhi byang ngos pa/dbyin ji par kar sa heb bcas mnyam 'dzoms thog gsol ston phul song /nga tsho 'gag pa rnams yol ba'i phyi logs su srung bya lta bur langs nas sdod dgos stabs sbug tu skad cha bshad pa rnams tshang ma go gi 'dug bka' blon tshos dbyin yig slob grwa mtshams 'jog byed dgos byung bar blo pham yod tshul dang / par kar sa heb 'o rgyal gang min byas song zer ba sogs bshad song bar kho pas‘‘las ka gang zhig yin rung / mi gzhan gyi kha la nyan rkyang byas na sgrub mi thub/ nga tsho dbyin ji'i phru gu tshor sgrung 'di 'dra zhig yod/de snga pha bu gnyis kyis bong bu zhig khrid nas lam du 'gro dus/ mi zhig thug pa des/ bong bu stong par khrid nas ci byed zer bas de ma 'grig snyam pha des bong bu bzhon zhing bus rkang thang du bskyod/ yang mi zhig 'phrad pa des/phas bong bu bzhon nas phru gu rkang thang du gtong ba zer te 'phya bas de yang ma 'grig snyam bu de bong bur bzhon nas phas rjes su 'brangs/ yang mi zhig thug pa des bus bong bu bzhon nas pa pha rkang thang du gtong ba thabs sdug zer bas te yang ma 'grig 'dug snyam pha bu gnyis kas u tshugs ngang bong bur 96

nyis bzhon brgyab nas phyin/ yang mi zhig 'phrad pa des mi go thang gnyis kyis bong bur cab bzhon brgyab pa ngo tsha zer bas te yang ma 'grig snyam/mthar bong bu'i sug lag bzhi thag pas bsdams pa de rgyug pa ring po zhig gi thog bkal nas pha bu gnyis kyis gzhogs 'degs brgyab ste 'gro skabs zam pa zhig gi steng slebs shing / yam yom ngang bong bu de zam pa'i sgang nas mar lhung ste chu nang du shi ba red’’ces bshad de bka' shag la phru gu nang bzhin red zer ba'i zur za rno po zhig byas song yang / khong tshos de ni kyal ka yin pa lta bur btang nas ha ha/ ha ha zhes gad mo bgad pa las lan gang yang slog ma song / dgong dro nga tsho zur khang du slebs rjes khong gis/ ‘‘de ring nga tsho ngo tsha po bzos ma song ngam/ nga rang tsho'i las kar 'di 'dra zhig las yong gi ma red’’ces blo pham pa'i rnam pa ston gyi 'dug lhag par zur khang khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor gra rgyas gtong rgyu'i skor gtso bo phyi phyogs kyi tshong las kho nar bsam blo gtong mkhan zhig red 'dug khong gis khams bod tshong pa che khag dang / zhwa mo dkar po dang mu tig tshong khang sogs bal po tshong pa/yun nan gyi legs rgya tshang sogs rgya rigs tshong pa bcas la 'brel 'dris dang brtsi mthong chen po byed kyin 'dug (de tsho tshang ma bal phyir tshong dang /rgya gar gyi tshong zog le sgyur byed bde'i ched red) nga la'ang tshong las byed dgos zhes yang yang shod myong / ngas‘‘nga tsho'i pha mes nas tshong las gnyer myong med la/ nga rang gis kyang mi 'jon’’zhes brjod par lan du/ slosngon chad dang deng sang 'dra sa med/ tshong rgyag ma shes na pha gzhis kho nas a log rgyag thub kyi ma red/ da lta khyed la tshong gi bro ba ma rnyed pas byas pa red/las ka tshang ma byed kyin byed kyin shes rgyu red’’ces bshad byung /khong ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sgrig srol mang por bsun snang dang /97
