dpon po'i sgrob nyams ston rgyur dga' po med mkhan zhig red/ phyi rgyal srid gzhung gi sngar srol rigs ma byas mthu med kyang / gzim shag nang yum gyi gnon shugs dang nang mi phyag mdzod sogs nas de'i skor gsal 'debs yang yang byas te che nyams gang thon byed dgos kyi 'dug dper na khong ni ha lam dgong ltar mā cang dang mig mang sogs rtsed mor dga' bas mtshan phyed yol dang / tha na tho rengs bar mi nyal stabs zhogs pa langs rgyu ha cang phyi po red/ zhogs ltar bcar mkhan mang po bstud mar yong ba de tshor mgron gnyer sogs nas/ ‘‘da lta ljags thun grol ma song’’zhes phyir slog byed pa lta bu red/ don la khong ni ljags thun phar bzhag dpe cha rgyun klog tsam yang byed kyi med/ dgong dro ni bcar mkhan tshor kha ya byed pa'i dus tshod yin/spyir btang bka' blon tsho'i sar dpon rigs bcar skabs dza tha'i dang / tā bla ma sogs la gdan steng nas rkub bkyags tsam mam yang na sgur tsam byed pa las/ de min mkhan rim sogs che gras gzhan tshor mgo cog tsam gyi gus lan byed srol yod/ 'on kyang zur khang gis ni dza tha'i rgan gras yong na gdan steng nas babs te bsu ba byed pa dang / drung rtsis sam mkhan rim gnad che rigs la'ang yar langs pa sogs mdor na tshang mar rang nyid bka' blon gzhan las rim pa gcig gis dma' ba lta bu'i gus lan 'jal ba ma zad/ tha na dpon rigs chung gras dang tshong rigs 'byor ldan sogs la'ang mar bzhugs zhes sdod du bcug nas ja bster ba dang /'tshams 'dri byed pa sogs mi chos ha cang mkhas po byed mkhan zhig yin stabs de dag la spyir btang tshang mas dga' mos dang bstod bsngags gtong gi yod pa red/ khong gis nga la brjod don‘‘'di 'dra byed dgos/ ‘mi 98

dga' na chos yin’zer ba ltar chos la 'gro min mi shes kyang / de ni gang ltar 'gro song med pa'i don dag tshang thabs shig red’’ces shod myong /mgron gnyer tshe ring dpal 'bar lags nas nga la bshad don/ ‘‘nga tsho'i sbyin bdag gis nang tshags 'dris che ba tshor mi chos de tsam rang gnang gi ma red/ ji tsam rgyang thag ring na de tsam gyis 'dra chags po gnang ba ma zad/lhag par nang don 'gal zla yod pa'i sku drag rigs la de bas kyang gus zhabs che ba gnang gi red’’ces zer ba ltar do snang byed dus dngos gnas de 'dra zhig rang 'dugagazhan yang khong gis/ phyi rgyal gyi stobs 'byor dang 'byor ldan tsho'i 'tsho ba skyel stangs skor sogs nga tshor bshad nas yid smon chen po byed pa dang / 'jar man gyi he kri lar zer ba'i 'tshar longs kyi lo rgyus sogs kyang shod myong ba ma zad/ ‘‘kho ni 'dzam gling la g.yo 'gul gtong thub pa'i mi sna thun mong ma yin pa zhig red’’ces 'ud bstod kyang byed kyi 'dug (skabs der 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa rgyag bzhin pa'i sgang red)zur khang gis snyan grags brtson len dang gleng phyogs la do snang chen po byed pa'i skor/zur khang ni rang len dang / spyi tshogs kyi gleng phyogs la do snang chen po byed mkhan zhig red 'dug rang nyid la ming grags yong rgyur 'bad brtson byed pa ni gong gsal gyi gtam brjod nang nas mthong thub pa ma zad/dpe gcig gi thog nas gsal bshad byas na/ nga gzim 'gag 'phos pa'i phyi lo ste me phag (1947) lo'i dbyar smad du/ zur khang la bka' shag 99

thugs spro gtong res thengs gnyis pa de 'khel song / gra sgrig las ka'i skabs thugs spro'i ‘‘spyi khyab las byed’’zhabs phyi zhu chog pa zer mkhan dpon rigs che chung mang po 'tshang kha shig shig yod pa ltar nga'i zhang po chab spel rim bzhi dang nga gnyis kyang de'i khongs su zhugs pa yin/ thugs spro'i mdzad gzhung nang gsal spyi khyab che chung dang / drung spyi gling kha'i sa dbang khang dang / lha lcam khang / tshogs chen khang / mgron drung khang / zur bzhugs dbu gur/ zhabs phyi khang che chung zer ba sogs so sor sne len mgron rdzi byed mkhan 'di dang 'di yin zhes zur khang rang gis mchan 'god bkod sgrig byas song / de'i nang chab spel zhang lags(khong ni las ka 'di rigs bya rgyur ha cang 'jon po yod) dang nga gnyis zhabs phyi khang che chung khag bzhi'i mgron rdzir bzhag 'dug mi gzhan tsho phyir log rjes nga gnyis la zur du brjod don/ ‘‘sa dbang khang du nga yod pa dang / lha lcam khang nang bde skyid lags yod/ tshogs chen khang du ni lha stobs lags yod pas de tshor mgron rdzi su bzhag rung ma byed byas kyang hur thas/ byed kyi red/ g.yog po dang g.yog mo yod sar mi 'bor mang la/ zing cha che bas sku drag gzhan tshos btsog snang dang mthong chung byed rgyur brten lta skyong yag po yong gi ma red/nga'i sems khral che shos yod sa der khyed gnyis bzhugs rogs zhu dgos byung /ngas ltas na mgron po de tsho ni khyad mtshar po zhig yin/ sku drag re zung la gal te lto chas yag po ma rag kyang kho tshos sdug skad rgyag shes kyi ma red/skad cha yag nyes tshang ma sger g.yog 'di tshos bzo gi red/ ‘pho rog sha khyer de lung pa'i phu dang / sprang po gtam khyer de lung pa'i mda'’zer ba'i dpe de la rgyu mtshan yod/ der brten khyed gnyis nas g.yog rigs gcig kyang ma lus par lto chas brgyags tshad bster thub pa zhig dang / lhag par du sger 100

g.yog de tshor chang yod tshad u tshugs kyis blugs te ‘khyi dang pad pe'i ngo mi shes pa’ zhig bzo dgos pa de gal chen po zhe drag 'dug’’ces nan tan mngags byung / nga tshos nang ma blos 'gel gnang ba red bsams nas dka' tshegs la ma 'dzems par de don yong ba'i skul 'ded dang lta skyong gang gzab byas pa yin/ tag tag lha sar zur khang gi da lo'i bka' shag thugs spro de gzhan las lhag pa zhig btang song zhes dngos 'brel skad grags chod pa red/ don chung de tsam la'ang don gnyer chen po ci 'dra byas mi 'dug gam/zur khang ni spyi tshogs kyi gleng phyogs la do snang chen po byed mkhan zhig red/ khong gis lha sa'i nang nges gtan gyi las rigs gang yang med pa'i mi sna mang po rtag par dbu skor zhu mkhan du 'bod nyar la sne len dang 'brel rtsed mo rtse ba'am skad cha nyan bshad bya rgyur ha cang dga' po yod/ da lta dran pa'i cung yong mang ba ni kha che pan cab zer ba dang / sog po blo bzang /hu'e rigs a kong rma lags/ rma kon yang / cha lu rtsis zur/ bsam pho'i dbang chen lags sogs de rigs mang po yod/ khong tsho brgyud lha sa'i ja khang dang / chang khang / sbag khang / tshong khang sogs kyi nang shod pa'i phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi skad cha mang po nyan nas bsam gzhigs byed pa ma zad/skabs re gnas tshul ya mtshan po 'dra go dus tha na zur khang rang gi zhabs gras mngon chung ba re zung la chang rin dang ja rin sogs sprad nas ched mngags btang ste gnad don de skor skad cha'i yong sa yong khungs sogs rtsad gcod thub thabs kyang byed kyi yod pa skabs der 'gro mkhan gyi zhabs phyis nga la bshad myong /zur khang ba'i rul sungs kyi 'tsho ba skyel stangs skor/zur khang ni bshu gzhog gral rim gyi rul sungs 'tsho ba skyel stangs 101

goms gshis su gyur pa zhig red/ ma gzhi spyi tshogs rnying pa de'i nang gang byung gi pho mo'i 'brel ba byed pa de gang sar khyab gdal che tsam yod la/lha/ga par sku drag gi khrod bag med 'chal spyod la rol mkhan de bas mi nyung ba zhig mchis mod/ 'on kyang spyod rul de'i thad zur khang dbang chen dge legs ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khrel med rtser son zhig red/ dper na spyod ngan de rigs spel mkhan mi su zhig yin rung rang gi bza' zlar 'dzem zon mi byed mkhan med kyang / khong gis ni lha lcam bde skyid lags su 'dzem bya byed rgyu phar bzhag ngan byas ngo khyer gyis 'di dang 'di 'dra byas pa yin zhes ched mngags bshad nas brnyas bcos byed kyi yod pa red/ nyin zhig khong gis nga la brjod don/ ‘‘skye dman zer ba de khyad mtshar 'dug ngas bud med rgan mo dang mdog nyes pa de 'drar log g.yem byas pa'i skor bde skyid lags la bshad dus/ de 'dra skyug ma bro’’zer nas gad mo bgad kyi 'dug ‘‘gzhon nu ma rnam pa yag pa de rigs la chags pa spyad tshul bshad na/khong khong khro langs kyi 'dug’’ces bshad byung / khong gi spyod rul de'i thad bud med rgan gzhon dang / mdzes mi mdzes sogs gang la'ang ma bltos par yod tshad la log par g.yem pa'i spyod ngan brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig red/dper na skabs der zur khang nas yum dang lcam gyi zhal ta ma che chung dang /a war gyi ma ma dang rtsed grogs bu mo/ chang ma/ bal ma/ gad ma sgo srung sogs bud med rgan gzhon nyi shu yas mas shig yod pa de tsho'i nang zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis log g.yem ma byas pa gcig kyang med pa red ces rtag bcar zhabs gras tshos nges gsal dang re re bzhin nga la bshad myong /bud med de tsho'i nang rgan gras lo lnga bcu brgal ba dang / chung shos lo bcu bzhi las ma son pa de 'dra yod/ de min lha sa'i grong dbar gyi smad tshong ma 102

smos ci/ bdag po yod med kyi bud med drag zhan sna tshogs dang / tha na mtshams khung dgon pa'i gra chas spras pa'i a ṇi sogs khong gis brnyas bcos byas rigs ni bgrang tshod med la/ phyogs mtha' nas gsar du 'byor pa'i bud med mdzes ma zhig mthong na dbang dang / rgyu nor/ 'brel yod sogs bed spyad de thabs brgya jus stong gis rag thabs byed pa sogs mdor na zhabs gras nang ma re zung gi las 'gan gtso bo ni de'i thad la bkol spyod byed pa red/ gnas tshul de dag ni sgro btags gtan nas min pa zur khang dang 'brel 'dris cha rgyus che tsam yod pa'i mi tshang mas shes kyi red/ de'i skor 'dir phyogs bsdus kyi mtshon 'don tsam smos pa las/ zhib phra'i spyod tshul thad ngas shes pa mang po min rung de gras ni byed mkhan ngo ma tsha yang shod mkhan ngo tsha dgos pa'i tha shal khrel med kyi gtam spyod sha stag la brten rje sa paṇa gyis/ ‘‘ngan skyug khron pa su zhig sngog’’ces gsungs pa ltar mang du brjod pa'i dgos pa ma mchis snyam pa bcas mdor na ngas shes pa'i sger zur khang dang zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyi gnas tshul gang dran de tsam zhig lags so/ — 103

‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud don rkyen ’’gyi snga phyi'i mthong thos/khrang zhi wu'u yis/1kha47lo'i (bod me phag ) zla 4pa'i zla mjug tu de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi nang nas dbyin hin dga' nyer brten te srid dbang g.yo 'phrog byed mkhan tshos srid zur rwa sgreng sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rgyal mtshan 'dzin bzung gis btson khang du bkrongs pa dang mngon sum 'dzems med kyi sgo nas mi rigs kyi khe phan phyir tshong sogs khrims 'gal bya ngan rab dang rim pa spel nas krung dbyang srid gzhung gi khongs su gtogs pa'i rgya bod kyi 'brel lam bcad de mes rgyal la rgyab gtod dang ‘‘bod rang btsan’’gyi re ngan bcangs yod/rwa sgreng rin po che btson khang nang bzhugs skabs go min tang srid gzhung bod sog u yon lhan khang bod sdod don gcod khru'us nan cin krung dbyang srid gzhung la ‘‘rwa sgreng dus 'gyur skor gyi glog 'phrin snyan zhu rim par phul thog don rkyen de dag thag gcod kyi bya thabs dang gom rim yang bton yod/ de dang dus mtshungs su se rwa dgon pa'i dge 'dun thun mong nas bod sdod don gcod khru'ur krung dbyang la 'phral du brgyud 'bul zhu rgyu'i yi ge btang ste rwa sgreng rin po che skyob thabs byas rung go min tang srid gzhung khyon yongs nas thor nye'i mtshams su slebs pas dus thog tu phan nus ldan pa'i bya 104

thabs 'don thub med/rwa sgreng rin po che bkrongs rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i rwa sgrong rin po che'i sdig nyes kyi gras su ‘‘rwa sgrong gis krung dbyang la ngan 'brel gyis srid skyong stag brag la gnod 'tshe btang ba ’’zhes 'khod yod stabs rgyal gces kyi bsam blo yod la rgya'i dpon rigs dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i bod rigs mi sna khag gcig gis kyang rang zon byas te 'brel ba rgyang du btang ba dang krung dbyang gis bod du las don byed par btang ba'i mi sna rnams nas kyang bag khum bzhin par rang nyid skyob thabs ji ltar bya rgyu'i don kho nas dus 'da' bar byas/194shrīlo'i lo mjug tu go min tang srid gzhung bod sog u yon lhan khang bod sdod don gcod khru'u'i (gsham du bsdus ming bod sdod don gcod khru'u zhes brjod rgyu)khru'u krang las tshab gren shi'i krang dang / bod yig drung yig li'i go ling / dbyin yig drung yig li'u hreng ji'i/ kron yon li'u yu'i hung / kron yon yu'i cing te/ kron yon khrang zhi'i wu'u/ skad yig phab sgyur ba bkras dbang (bod rigs)'gebs srung las don pa rmi'i hu'i (rgya rigs grwa pa)sogs las mjug skyong mir bsdad pa phud mang che ba rgya gar nas mtsho thog brgyud nang sar thon/1949lo'i lo 'gor bod sdod don gcod khru'u'i kron yon yu'i cing te dang dbyin yig drung yig li'u hreng ji 'i/ gren shi'i krang gi bza' zla dang bu mo bcas snga rjes su rgya gar brgyud bskyod rjes don gcod khru'i gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur mi sna bzhi ma gtogs lhag med cing / sngon tshud nas bsko gzhag zim pa'i khru'u krang gsar pa zhung ya'o win gar song cha med du gyur pa sogs rnyog 'dzings che zhing 'gyur ba nges med kyi ngang tshul de lta bu'i khrod du las mjug 105

skyong thabs bral gshis bod gzhung phyogs dang gus srol mtshon byed kyi 'gro 'ong yang chad nyer gyur/ rgyal nang du go min tang gi srid dbang thor zhig 'gro nye'i mtshams su dbyin hin dga' nyer brten nas bka' shag gi dbang cha bzung mkhan tshos ‘‘bod rang btsan ’’bya rgyu'i dus su babs pa'i ngos 'dzin byas nas dbyin hin la ngan 'brel bya rgyur shugs snon gyis sngon tshud nas btsugs zin pa'i ‘‘phyi 'brel las khungs’ kyis byed sgo shugs che spel thog nub phyogs rgyal khab khag tu sku tshab tshogs pa 'dra min btang ste bod rang btsan yong rgyu'i re 'bod byed par btang /rgya mi phyir 'bud kyi snga nub tu/de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis g.yu thog bkra shis don grub rgya gar du dbyin ji'i go mtshon nyo sgrub dang bod kyi dmag dpung la me skyogs dang 'phrin gtong lag rtsal sbyong brdar gyi dmag don slob khrid pa gdan zhu byed par btang / rwa sgreng rin po che 'dzin bzung byas rjes bod dmag gis se rwa dgos par 'phen byed kyi me skyogs ni dbyin ji nas nyos pa dang / dbyin ji ba skang rngane+e/ de'i bkod 'doms kyi dmag las nang the zhugs byed du bcugag/kyi thog gi g.yog po lhag pa rta mgrin gyis dbyin ji bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la (grang gzhi bcos sman) yin khul gyi sman ‘‘sa/ rgo2’’sgam bcu grangs/ shig sprad yod pa de dag mi rnams mgo skor gtong ched kha byang tsam las tshe pyon dngos dmag mkho'i 'bar rdzas yin pa dang da dung ser skya dpon rigs rnams la me mda' lnga brgya tham pa lag rtags su sprad pa go thos byung zhes bshad byung / 194〈lo'i lo mjug tu bka' shag gis mi sna ched btang 106

grong khyer byang phyogs nye 'khor du sa thig blangs te gnam gru thang bzo skrun gyi 'char gzhi bting skad/ phyogs mtshungs dmag shugs rgya bskyed kyi 'char gzhi bkod de bcu gnyis drug sna (gzhung rgyugs rkang bcu gnyis re dang /sger chos 'don drug re nas dmag re'i bsdu rgyur zer) dang / grong drag tshang ma nas dmigs bsal 'phar dmag re bsdus pa dper na/ rgyal gnyer lha sa slob chung(skabs de'i lha sa stod skyid pa'i nang btsugs pa'i slob grwa) nang slob sbyong byed myong ba'i khren te (de snga bod sdod don gcod khru'u'i sman khang nang las ka byed myong yod pa)dmag khongs sman pa byed par btang ba dang / rgya mi khyir 'bud kyi don rkyen byung rjes mā ren rung dang / hran 'ji'i dbying / ti hung te/ grin kri/ yi'u su'u h+phu/ the pu la bcas kyang dmag mir 'jug rgyu'i khongs su gtogs te nag chu sa khul lha ri rdzong du bka' sgug par btang / chab mdo bcings 'grol btang rjes mi de dag rang 'tsham gyis lha sar log de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rwa sgrong don rkyen kyi rjes su mi rnams blo rmongs su bcug ste 'bru khral bsdu ba dang / dmag mi skong bsdu sogs kyi byed sgo khag bde blag tu sgrub ched lhar lung zhu phul ba'i phyir phebs su ‘‘shar du phung gzhi yod ’’‘‘dmag gi 'jigs nyen shar phyogs nas 'ong ’’zhes lung bstan lugs dang gal te mtsho sngon mā pu h+phang gi dmag dpung bod du yong ste nga tsho'i bstan pa rtsa brlag tu gtong rgyu'i bsam ngan bcangs tshe nga tshos srog bsdos kyis dgra 'gog bya rgyu yin lugs sogs kyi dkrog gtam gang sar bsgrags pa dang / bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis mes rgyal la rgyab gtod kyi dmag don gra sgrig dang khrims 'gal gyi byed sgo spel ba de dag bod kyi bstan srid kyi bya gzhag chen po'i don du yin zhes mdzes rgyan spras te rgya 107

che'i ser skya mang tshogs la mgo skor btang yod/tshogs khro kha sbyab sogs mngon spyod kyi las thabs la brten nas gung khran tang bzlog thabs byas pa/ 1rdzo4ṭ+wāṃlo'i zla 4pa'i nang bka' shag gis gnas chung gi sku rten rwa sa 'khrul snang gtsug lag khang du gdan zhus kyis lung zhu phul ba ltar sku rten nas lha rdzus 'dre rdzus kyis ‘‘deng 'dir nga tsho'i bstan srid kyi bya gzhag chen por gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bo shar phyogs nas yong nyen che zhing / bod du yod pa'i rgya mi yang nga tsho'i khrod du gab 'dzul byas pa'i byur rkyen zhig yin stabs gang mgyogs phyir 'bud byed dgos/ de ltar ma byas na phyi nas dgra bos btsan 'dzul byas tshe nang nas mi de dag gis gzhogs 'degs byed nges ’’zhes bshad pa'i rkyen gyis bka' shag gis rang gzhan gnyis phung gi bya ngan rgya mi phyir 'bud dang tshogs khro kha sbub mngon spyod kyi las thabs la brten nas gung khran tang bzlog thabs bya rgyu'i gtan 'khel byas/ gong lor gung khran tang bzlog thabs su lha sa smon lam 'phar ma zhig 'tshogs rjes klu sbug thang sder du gnas chung chos skyong mi khog tu brlams khul ngo bskyod kyis gtor rgyag dang 'brel tshogs ja 'khol bzhin pa'i tshogs khro kha sbub/ nyin gsum song mtshams tshogs khro bslangs te dgra phyogs la gnod rkyen ji byung 'dam bag dang thal rdul sogs la rtog zhib byas/yang sa skya phun tshogs pho brang gi bdag chen gdan drangs nas lha sa gtsug lag khang e waṃ nang gtor bzlog rim 'gro byed skabs chog grwa dang 108

'bag mo'i chas gos sogs sa skya dgon nas rang gshoms kyis gar 'cham dang 'brel ba'i gtor rgyag cig brgyab pa de yang gung khran tang bzlog thabs yin par grags/de mtshungs lha sa smon grong du sdod pa'i rnying ma'i bla ma zhig la sa gnas srid gzhung gis dmag bzlog rim gro byed du 'jug skabs thog brtsegs gnyis tsam yod pa'i sog phung nas ja mar 'bru rtsam do grangs bcu phrag kha shas bcug pa dang / spags las bzos pa'i gzugs tshad khru do tsam yod pa mgo skra dang stod gos thung zhing smad gos ring po g.yogs pa'i bud med kyi gzugs brnyan dang / stod gos thung zhing smad la 'phying zhwa g.yogs pa'i skyes pa'i gzugs brnyan nyi shu sum cu(go thosu su de dag gung khran tang gi lus tshab red zer) skor bzos pa sogs gra sgrig legs grub mtshams gong gsal bla mas thog drangs cho ga grwa tshos sog phung gi mtha' 'khor du rol mo dkrol zhing cho ga bton pa dang rags stobs a pha dang a ma bcu grangs kyis drag sbyor las mkhan gyi chas su zhugs te‘‘ngan sems mtha' dag meg med du zhi bar gyur cig’’ces pa'i ngar sgra dang bcas lus tshab rnams me phung gi khrod du 'phangs/dbyin jis thabs rī'adon jus 'god byas pa dang rang phyogs nas thabs lam btsal ba/1949lo'i zla 5par go min tang srid gzhung gsang srung cus lha sa gsang 'phrin babs tshugs kyis lha sa glog 'phrin yan lag las khungs (de'i 'og tu gzhis rtse dang / chab mdo/ lho kha bcas nying lag las khungs gsum yod)la snyan zhu 'byor don/ ‘‘bde skyid gling gar bca' sdod dbyin 109

ji bas bka' shag la gsang ba'i gnas tshul 'don sprod byas pa ri nang rang re'i 'phrin gtong skor dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don yod la ‘pe/nas phyogs ston byed 'phrul 'khor spyad de lha sar yod pa'i gas nga ba'i glog 'phren las khungs gnas yul tshad len shes rtogs byung lugs dang bka' shag nas sngog bsher gnang dgos/ de yang 'phral du lag len bstar tshe lag sorwa thub nges red ces gros 'go bton 'dug pas yan lag las khungaru/ kyis bab bstun grwa sgrig yag po byed dgos ’’zhes yig thog gi brda tho btang /de nas go min tang srid gzhung dmag si ling pu'u thing gnyis nga /ri khongs gtogs lha sa gsang 'phrin tshogs chung gi glog 'phrin las khungs nge (tha'e krang than zhi'i red) tshogs chung gi tsu'u krang cang shin thi'i nas los rogs mi sna btang ste bde 'jags kyi gnas yul zhig tu spos/nga dang yan lag glog 'phrin las khungs kyi 'gan khur ba blo rgyan go bsdur byas te nga tsho'i glog 'phrin las khungs mngon chung gi sa gnas shig tu spos rung nyin ltar 'char can gyi las ka byed dgos gshis gal te nyul zhi ba pas rgyu ma phu 'ded kyi rjes snyegs byas tshe shes par sla zhing / gre/'an yang kho pa tshos sngog bsher byed par gdeng tshod dang dbo/sa pa yod med 'a/ bas ma gzhigs byed nges yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gcig gyur byung ba ltar gnas skabs rang 'jags bzhag ste gnas tshul la lta rgyu'i gtan 'khel byas pa yin/194rdolo'i lo mjug tu le'o hren dang / phing cing / ho'e has bcas g.yul 'gyed chen po gsum brgyud go min tang gi dmag dpung go hrag tshang ma gtor pham btang ba dang bcings 'grol dmag dpa' rgod khri tsho brgya phrag 'bri chu'i rang byung btsan 'gag brgal te nan cin bcings 'grol btang nas go min tang srid gzhung thor zhig tu 'gro kha'i dus skabs su nga tsho 110

mtha' khul bod ljongs su yod pa'i a phrug rjes 'brang pa rnams gang gi phyogs su bskyod dgos sam/mi khag gcig nang sar phyir log bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byed pa dang / kha cig gzhan dang mnyam sdeb kyis tshong 'khos 'thab len/ kha cig gis rgyan rtsed khang 'dzugs gnyer/ sngon tshud nas 'gro gron gyi dmigs sgo med pa'i cang shin shi'i tshogs chung gis ci bya gtol med ngang sgug ste sdod thabs bral bas ma dngul bsdu gsog gis gong lo'i zla ba lnga pa nas 'go 'dzugs kyis cang shin shi'i ming thog nasayoganas mchog za khang’’zhes pa 'dzugs gnyer byas shing /za khang de'i 'du 'dzi'i bsti gnas bar skor shar phyogs su yin pa de dag rgya che zhing bkod pa legs pa/ rgyan rtsed kyi yo chas sna tshogs yod pa/ ma byan mkhas pa gdan zhus kyis bzhes spro'i rigs tshang ma spus dag la gong khe gshis za khang sgo phye ba nas bzung nyin ltar sku mgron rgyun mi chad pas yong 'bab che tsam byung yod/thog mar gzhung gi dpon rigs mi nyung ba zhig kyang yang yang yong gi yod rung rjes su bka' shag gis 'gro mi chog pa'i bkag sdom byas/bka' shag gis‘‘gnas mchog za khang ’’ni gung khran tang gi las khungs dang chab srid kyi byed sgo spel yul gsang ba'i gnas gzhi zhig yin pa'i dogs pa byed kyi yod la za khang der ma rkang 'jog mkhan kro'u min gyis kyang ‘‘gan sa mchog za khang’’ni chab srid kyi dmigs yul yod pa zhig yin zhes bshad myong yod/rlung 'tshub drag char bab nye'i mtshams su/ 1949lo'i zla 6par bod sdod am ban gyi sdod gnas ya mon nang 111

bod dmag bca' sdod byas pa dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi dmag mi'ang mang du btang yod/ kha cig gis de dag ni rgya mir kha gtad gcog mkhan red ces dang / kha cig gis de snga bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis rgya mi ha cang mang po dmar bsad btang ba'i rjes shul rgya 'bum sgang zhes pa da lta'ang mthong rgyu yod ces skor gtam sna tshogs shod par brten/ skabs der mā khrung kri(go min tang cun thung cus lha sa thad gtogs gsang 'phrin tshogs chung hu'u min khrun tshogs chung gi tshod spyod gsang 'phrin mkhan)nged gnyis mnyam du gong gsal sa gnas su ched mngags mya ngan zhu bar phyin pa yin/zla 7tshes 7nyin yun nan gyi tshong pa li'u h+phu'u thang gi bu mor go rma ga bsus te gnyen ston gra rgyas bshams/ gzhung gi dpon rigs kyang gdan zhu byas yod cing sku mgron dang grogs po rnams phan tshun 'dri rmed 'tshams zhu dang bcas bzhugs gral du 'khod skabs/ tā rung tshong khang gi li'i h+phu leng dngangs 'tshab chen po'i ngang der yong ste‘‘chags sgo langs song / khrom srang tshang ma bod dmag gis khengs pa dang tshong khang tshang ma sgo brgyab 'dug’’ces bshad stabs der yod tshang ma dngangs 'tshab dogs 'drogs kyis rang rang gi gnas su logagong tshes nyin snang rtse shag las khungs nas mi sna ched btang gis khyim dud re re bzhin du ‘‘khams pa g.yo ga por nyar mkhan sbyin bdag tshos de ring nas bzung pho mo dbyer med tshang ma phyir slog byed dgos pa las mu mthud nyar spyod byas na mi 'grig gal srid de las ldog na nyes chad gcod rgyu yin’’zhes bka' shag gi bkod don khyab bsgrags byas/zla 7tshes rdonyin/ bod sdod don gcod khru'u'i khru'u krang las tshab gren shi'i krang bka'atshoshag tu bskyod de sa rub khar ga'i nas nang du log skabs 112

der nga'i yid la bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis nga tshor snyad 'dogs kyi bya spyod spel mi yong ngam snyam pa zhig byung /zla 7tshes 9nyin/ nga pe cin tshong pa krang ji'i dbying gi za khang nang zhogs zas za skabs don gcod khru'u'i zhabs 'degs pa cang ces brel brel 'tshub 'tshub ngang yong ste‘‘khru'u krang gis don gal chen zhig yod pas khyed rang lam seng phebs rog gsung gi 'dug’’ces bshad byung bas ngas mapyogs myur don gcod khru'u la bskyod pa gren shi'i krang gis mthong ma thag‘‘khyed tsho'i sar gnas tshul 'dra min 'dug gam’’zhes dang yang yid dung dung gi ngang nas ‘‘kha sa bka' shag gis nga tsho tshogs 'dur skong 'gug thog bka' blon ram pa bas ‘nga tsho bod gzhung dang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis sems thag gtsang bcad kyis gung khran tang la ngo rgol byed kyi yod/ da lta nga tshor gsang 'phrin 'byor ba ltar na bod du bca' sdod krung dbyang srid gzhung gi las khungs nang gung khran tang gab ste bsdad yod pa dang / lha sdod rgya mi dang khams pa'i nang du'ang gung khran tang yod rung las khungs sogs gang gi nang du yod med da lta nga tshos gsal po shes kyi med kyang nga tsho'i bstan srid kyi bya gzhag gal cher gnod rkyen mi 'byung ba dang khyed tsho'i bde 'jags la 'gan srung ched bka' shag lhan rgyas nas bod du bca' sdod krung dbyang srid gzhung gi las don mi sna nang mi ltos bcas dus bkag nang bod nas kha bral dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang yod’ces bshad byung gshis de don 'phral du bod sog u yon lhan khang la glog 'phrin snyan seng zhu dgos rung 'grim 'grul pu'u lha sa glog 'phrin cus la dam bsgrags byas te bod dmag lta srung mkhan yod stabs glog 'phrin gyi ma zin 'di bzhin khyed nas gtong thabs byed dgos’’zhes bshad pa ltar ngas 'phral du cang ce 'khrid de blo rgyan gyi sdod gnas su 113

yod pa'i tar 'phrul yo byad ko sgam chung chung gnyis kyi nang du blugs pa dang /don gcod khru'u'i thog brtsegs gsum pa'i khang stong zhig gi nang du khyer nas gnam skud dang glog lam 'brel mthud sgrig sbyor byas te ‘‘ches dza drag’’rim pa'i thog nas chu tshod 1〈par khrung ching spyi khyab glog 'phrin las khungs la 'brel ba byas rung 'phrin lam 'gal rkyen che zhing 'phrin shugs chung bas dus tshod skar ma 20'gor ba'i rjes su gzhi nas btang thub tsam byung / nor 'khrul mi yong ched phyi nyin chu tshod ṭ+wāṃpa'i skabs su slar yang khrung ching spyi khyab glog 'phrin las khungs la 'brel ba bya rgyu byas pa yin/ de nub skabs 'phral glog 'phrin gtong gnas de rang du sgang ril mar nyal kyang mtshan gang gnyid ma khug par rdzi gsang byas/zla 7tshes 10nyin gyi zhogs pa chu tshod rdopar bde blag ngang khrung ching spyi khyab glog 'phrin las khungs la 'brel ba byas pa dang / khrung ching nas glog 'phrin gsal 'byor gyi brda lan byung rjes ‘‘de ring nas bzung 'brel ba mtshams 'jog bya rgyu yin’’zhes brda sprod dang‘‘bya①sbi’’zhes thengs 'ga' btang / de nas glog 'phrin 'phrul chas bsdu gsog brgyab ste yid blong blong por sdod gnas su logames rgyal gyi bod ljongs dang kha bral ba/zla 7tshes 11nyin bod nas kha bral te hin rdu brgyud 'gro mkhan thengs dang po lam du zhugs/ de'i khongs su cang shin shi'i dang / cang kren shi'i/min kri greng / ho'o bstan 'dzin/ mā greng wen/ phrun tas yang /kan wun h+phung / pa'i hri kren/ pa'i hri ji'i/ than shi'i/ wang shing 114

lung / kro'u min/ tseng theng tsha'i/ li'u yun h+phung / krang then pa'o ngo g.yog dang de bzhin nang mi ltos bcas khyon bsdom mi grangs sum cu tsam yod/gong gsal de dag gi nang nas li'u yun h+phung ni lag rtsal yag po yod pa'i tshem bzo ba zhig yin/ khong gis ru nga zhib tshags ngang bzos pa'i rgya bzo'i gyon gos bde po yod stabs rgya'i dpon rigs dang tshong pa tshang mas dga' po byas te bzo ru bcug gi yod/ khong gis kyang spyi phan gyi bya bar sems khur chen po byed pa dper na/ 1944lor bod don gcod khru'us lha sar ri 'gog gi zhal 'debs bsdu rgyur skul slong dang / 1945lor ri 'gog dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob par rten 'brel zhu ba'i byed sgo'i skabs su zi khron pa'i skyid sdug nang du hur brtson chen pos dril bsgrags dang / gang sar 'bod skul byas te phan 'bras ldan pa'i las don mi nyung ba byas gshis bod sdod don gcod khru'u'i dpon rigs dang tshong don mi sna tshang mas dga' po byas te 'brel ba zab po yod stabs bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs nas dogs pa byed yul du gyur te phyir 'bud bya rgyu'i khongs su bzhag pa dang /gong 'khod krang then pa'o pha bus lha sar smi'i ngos snyoms gru bzhi lnga brgya tsam yod pa'i tshal zhing 'debs skyong byas te 'tsho ba legs tsam yod pa khong gi spun mched cig lha sar bca' sdod cun thung gsang 'phrin 'bab tshugs kyi gsang 'phrin mi sna yin stabs zhor 'drud kyis phyir 'bud byas pa red/phyir 'bud byed thengs dang po'i khongs nas cang shin shi'i la rnyog dra che tsam byung yod/ phyir 'bud ma byas gong bod gzhung gis ho'o bstan 'dzin dang / kro'u min/ min kri greng / kan wun h+phung sogs kyi khyim tshang du sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon dmag sngog bsher byed par btang thog cang shin shir lta rtog byed mkhan yang bzhag yod/ lam bar bod dmag zhal ngo zhi ga 115

'bral med yod pa dang / zhag tshugs sar cang shin shi'i thog khang du bzhag rjes skas ka spos te babs sa med pa bzo gi yod/zla 7tshes 17nyin bod nas bral te hin rdu brgyud 'gro mkhan thengs gnyis pa thon/ de'i khongs su ha'u go kru'u dang / mā yan ling / kra'o kon nan/ ko'o yung yas/ g.yas hreng hu'i/ wang lu'u an/ dza'o shun/ khang kang min/ hu'u cis tsa'o/ ko'o ten dbying (las zhor mnyam spro hre'i ma byan/ rgya rigs dpon po dang 'brel ba zab mo yod stabs phyir 'bud byas )sogs yod/khang kang min dang hu'u cis tsa'o gnyis gzhis rtser rgyal gnyer gzhis rtse slob chung 'dzugs par 'gro mkhan yin pa dang / ho'u go kru'u dang /wang lu'u an ni gzhis rtse gsang 'phrin tshogs/ chung gi tsu'u krang dang glog 'phrin las khungs kyi tha'e krang red/bod sdod don gcod khru'u kho'o gsu ma pa'i kho'o krang dang chab mdor bca' sdod kron yon/ cun thung cus lha sa gsang 'phrin 'bab tshugs chab mdo gsang 'phrin tshogs chung gi tsu'u krang gcig lcog tso'o ren ci'i chab mdo nas shis khams dang / glog 'phrin las khungs kyi tha'e krang li'i mong min chab mdo nas mtsho sngon du bskyod/zla 7tshes 1khanyin gyi nyin gung khru'u krang las tshab gren shi'i krang dang /li'i go ling / li'u yu'i hung / zhing su'u kre(rgyal gnyer lha sa slob chung gi zho'o krang)zhi'i g.yus dbyis('grim 'grul pu'u lha sa glog 'phrin cus kyi cus krang )yan cun/ dbang tsa'o (ming gzhan grang shi'i wu'u)bcas bka' shag gi thon rdzong sar bskyod/zla 7tshes 20nyin bod nas kha bral te hin rdu brgyud 'gro mkhan thengs 116

gsum pa thon/ de'i khongs su gren shi'i krang dang / li'i go ling / li'u yu'i hung / zhing su'u kre/ zhi'i g.yus dbyis/ blo rgyan/ yan cun/shang ho'i khru'u/ dbang tsa'o (grang shi'i wu'u) de bzhin nang mi ngo g.yog bcas khyon bsdom mi grangs sum cu lhag tsam yod/bka' shag gis skyid tshal klu sdings su gur phub bza' btung bshams te thon thengs gsum pa'i mi snar thab skyel byas/srung skyel mkhan bod dmag ru dpon gcig dang / sne shan pa gcigadamag mi nyi shu rtsa grangs bcas yod/ lam bar rgyal rtser ngal gso nyin gcig dang / phag rir nyin gnyis brgyab/ gro mor thon thengs gnyis pa'i mi sna dang mnyam 'dzoms kyis ngal gso nyin gsum brgyab/don gcod khru'i zhabs zhu ba bkra shis dang / kro'u tsi ya'o gnyis kyis khru'u krang las tshab gren shi'i krang ka lon sbug bar bskyal nas lha sar log rjes snang rtse shag nas khong gnyis 'bod sgug gisahūṃzhu ba blangs thog gang byung 'brel ba byed mi chog pa'i bkod khyab nan po byas/mes rgyal bod ljongs nas kha bral te 'bras ljongs sa khongs su slebs skabs zhe blo lhag par dung nge ba zhig byung / ka lon sbug tu slebs rjes nyin gnyis par hin rdur gnas sdod pe cin gyi tshong pa leng tse kris khong rang gi spro khang nang gren shi'i krang bza' tsho gnyis la dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams pa dang bod nas yong mkhan thengs gsum pa'i mi sna mang che ba gsol ston thog gdan zhu byas/ skabs der leng tse kris ‘‘rlung 'phrin nas pe cin gyi rgyang bsgrags go byung ’’nang don gtso bo ni bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis bod du yod pa'i go min tang srid gzhung gi las don mi sna phyir 'bud byas pa ni mi 'os pa min 'on kyang mes rgyal la rgyab gtod kyis bod rang 117

btsan gyi stong bsam bcangs tshe krung go'i mi dmangs kyis sems thag gtsang bcad kyis ngo rgol bya rgyu yin/ bod kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs la krung go'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis nges par du dpung 'jug byas nas bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i tha tshig sgrog rgyu yin zhes bshad pa tshang mas nyan rjes sems nang g.yo 'gul tshad med thebs pa dang / mi ring bar bod ljongs 'di nyid slar yang mes rgyal gyi pang du log ste lo mang ring nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu bsam pa'i re don mngon du 'gyur nges yin pa'i 'char sgo lhan ne ba zhig byung /'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis bsgyur/118

de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod ljongs bcings 'grol 'thob rgyur 'gog rgol byed pa'i don rkyen gyi gras shigabyang ngos pa rdo rje dngos grub kyis/de snga rgyal yongs kyi khyon du bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob dang 'thob bzhin ma zad/ bod ljongs sa mthor yang bcings 'grol gtong nges kyi skabs der btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod ljongs bcings 'grol 'thob rgyur 'gog rgol byed pa'i bya ngan rab dang rim pa spel ba'i nang tshan 1949lor ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’zer ba'i don rkyen de ni khong tsho'i bsam par skabs der lha sa sogs la go min tang srid gzhung gi las khungs dang /mo slob grwa/ rlung 'phrin khang bcas kyi nang las ka byed mkhan dang / de min spyi tshogs thog tshong rigs dang / las ka 'di yin med pa khag gcig bcas rgya rigs mi nyung ba zhig yod pas/ de tsho'i nang gung khran tang gi mi'ang yod nges la/ de dag snga tsam gtsang ma bzo ma thub tshe khong tshos bcings 'grol dmag mir phyi nang gzhogs 'degs byas yong snyam ste bzos pa zhig red la/ de bas tshabs che ba zhig la kho pa tshos skabs der go min tang log spyod shog khag ni rgyal yongs kyi bcings 'grol dmag sa khag la pham nyes tshabs chen byung nas phar bros tshur bros kyis bod la do dam the jus byed pa'i nus pa bral ba'i skabs dang 119

bstun te don rkyen de dag bzo thub pa yin na/ de snga lcags phag gsar brje langs skabs chin gong ma'i bod sdod am ban sogs phyir 'bud byas rjes skabs de'i krung dbyang ste byang phyogs dmag shed can dang / cang ce hri srid gzhung gnyis phan tshun yun ring nang 'khrug gis dus 'da' bas bod sa gnas la do dam the jus byed pa'i nus pa bral gshis/ dus skabs nges can zhig nang bod kyi dbang sgyur ru tshogs la ‘‘bod rang btsan’’zer ba'i skad cor rgyag pa'i go skabs byung ba lta bu zhig thengs 'dir yang yong rgyu'i re stong bcangs te bzos pa zhig kyang red/ de yang bod sa glang ( 1949)lo'i dbyar stod du bka' shag (bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma/ spyi khyab mkhan po ngag dbang bstan 'dzin)dang / drung rtsis (mkhan drung tā bla ma thub bstan nor bzang dang /chos 'phel thub bstan/ ngag dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/rtsis dpon bde mkhar ba tshe dbang rab brtan dang / zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ rnams gling dpal 'byor rdo rje) rnams nor gling du gsang ba'i gros tshogs nyin bstud kyis 'tshogs te skabs re srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab sar ‘‘snyan zhu ’’zhes snyan seng dgongs skor zhu bar bskyod pa las kho pa tsho 'tshog sar ja zhu mkhan rdzu5nga ma btang bar sgo brgyab nas ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’zer ba'i skor gsang ba'i ngan gros byas pa ma zad/ gong lo'i bod zla5tshes shar tsam la rgyal rtser bca' sdod cha dang dmag sgar glo bur du lha sar bskong 'gug kyang byas shing / rnam sna kun dmag sgar bskong 'then gyi las don rnams bod ljongs dmag spyi khang nas byed dgos rung / thengs 'dir bka' shag nas thad kar bka' rgya 120

btang ste bskong 'gug byas stabs skabs der lha sar dogs 'drog dang dkrog gtam yang sna tshogs byung yod/de nas mi ring bar nyin zhig bka' shag nas btang ba'i brda tho zhig 'byor byung ba de'i nang rtse shod drung 'khor mi bcu (las tshan grags pa yar rgyas dang zhol khang thub bstan nyi ma sogs rtse drung lnga dang / las tshan phun rab pa dang / rtsis pa sgog mkhar ba/ ngos rang sogs drung 'khor lnga)dang / rtse shod phyag nang bcu grangs shig ming bton gyis sang nyin snga dro nor gling bka' shag tu yong dgos lugs 'khod 'dug cing / skabs der ngos rang gi bsam blo'i nang gzhung gis ga re byed rtsis yod med shes rtogs med khar/ glo bur brda tho 'di 'dra zhig 'byor stabs nga tsho gang byed par gtong rtsis yod dam snyam pa'i phran bu'i blo mi bde ba byung / de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa gong gsal brda tho'i nang 'khod ltar nga tsho tshang ma nor gling bka' shag 'gag tu 'dzoms shing / de 'phral bka' drung ldum rwa ba brgyud bka' shag lhan rgyas la snyan seng zhus par khong gis ‘‘da lta tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa 'tshog bzhin yod pas/ khyod tsho tshogs 'du grol mtshams bka' shag tu bcar dgos pa'i bka' phebs kyi 'dug’’ces bshad/ de nyin tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas par gzhug mkhan gras nga tsho'i ngo shes pa 'ga' zhig thug byung ba khong tshos ‘‘de ring gi tshogs 'du ni bod la yod pa'i go min tang gi las byed mi sna sogs rgya mi phyir slog bya rgyu'i skor red/ da dpe bzos mi yong ngam rgya mi de tshos yag po byas nas phyin e yong ’’zhes bshad byung bas/ bar lam bka' shag dang drung rtsis nyin bstud nas gsang gros byed don dang /de nyin bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa glo bur tshogs dgos don ji yin gzhi nas shes rtogs thub byung / tshogs 'du grol mtshams nga tsho mi bcu 121

por bka' shag nas bka' bsgyur btang don ‘‘khyod tsho ni bde zhib do dam mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan dang rtsis dpon rnam gling pa gnyis kyi las bya 'phar snon yin pas/ byed sgo rnams drung rtsis gnyis kyi ngag bkod dang len byed dgos’’zhes dang ‘‘da lta nor gling nas lha sar dang po bka' shag dang / de mtshams tshogs 'thus thon pa'i mjug tu khyod tsho 'gro dgos pa las/ khyod tsho gang byung du nor gling nas sngon la 'gro mi chog’’ces pa'i bka' bsgyur ba las/ nga tsho'i las 'gan 'di yin gang yang bshad ma byung /de nas bka' shag lha sar 'byor 'phral go min tang don gcod las khungs kyi gren khru'u krang zer ba 'bod 'gugs kyis thug 'phrad byas thogagung khran tang gi mi 'dres 'dzul byas rigs 'gog ched don gcod khru'u'i las byed mi sna dang / skud med glog 'phrin khang gi las byed/ skyid stod slob grwa'i dge rgan/ de bzhin sngar nas lha sar gtan sdod gzhis chags min pa'i rgya mi tshong pa sogs tshang ma bdun gsum gyi nang tshun la bod nas phyir log dgos lugs bshad don ltar khren nas khas len byed dgos byung 'dug nga tsho las bya 'phar snon bcu po gtsug lag khang du bde zhib las khungs tshugs sar bskyod cing / de gar bde zhib do dam drung rtsis gnyis dang / las bya rtse drung mkhyen rab ye shes sogs mi bzhi'i thog dmag spyi dza sag mdo mkhar ba phun tshogs rab rgyas kyang 'dug pa nga tsho de gar 'byor rjes de skabs ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’kyi zhib cha'i las ka de dag bde zhib las khungs kyis byed dgos pa'i 'gan sprad yod pa dang / mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas ni drung rtsis gnyis kyi rogs par btang ba zhig dang / nga tsho mi bcu po ni kho tsho'i las bya'i rogs par las don de sgrub mkhan du btang ba zhig yin pa bcas gzhi nas shes byung / de nyin lha sar zing cha byung dogs kyis kha 122

dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar lha sa grong nang bskongs nas gtsug lag khang dang /po ta la/ srid skyong stag brag dang bka' blon bzhi'i sdod gnas/ yab gzhis stag 'tsher bcas la srung dmag ched 'dzugs byas yod pa dang /bka' shag dang gren khru'u krang 'phrod mol zin rjes bde zhib do dam drung rtsis gnyis kyis thog mar kha dang mda' dpon mkhe smad tshe dbang don grub dang /las tshan phun rab pa sogs las bya mi bzhi dang / kha dang dmag mi gang 'tshams shig bcas don gcod khru'u yi skud med glog 'phrin khang du sgo zam 'then par btang thog bod dmag rnams srung char bzhag de rjes rtsis dpon rnam gling pas am phrag nas deb chung zhig bton te mi 'di dang de'i nang la glog 'phrin gtong len gyi yo byad yod med bsngog bsher byed dgos lugs bkod mngags dang 'brel kho tsho'i khongs nas tshong rigs sogs mang tshogs rnams bdun gcig tshun dang / dge —rgan sogs khag gcig bdun gnyis tshun thon dgos pa'i brda khyab byed par las bya mi gnyis re dang rtse shod phyag nang re/ bod dmag bzhi tsam re bcas khag bgos kyis gtong rgyu dang /phyag nang de nyid ni thon dgos pa'i mi de'i sar lta srung du 'jog rgyu bcas kyi bkod sgrig byas don ltar nga dang las tshan grags pa yar rgyas gnyis dang /shod phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring / bod dmag gnyis bcas mtsho sgo rnying pa'i nub ngos 'bras khang zer ba'i khang pa de'i thog rtsegs gsum par rgya rigs kra'u zer ba zhig bsdad yod pa de'i sar btang bskyod kyis bsngog bshe ra byed skabs glog 'phrin yo chas sogs gang yang thon ma song / phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring de gar lta srung du bzhag thog kho pa kra'u bdun gcig nang tshun phar sprod tshur len rnams tshar ba byas nas thon dgos pa'i brda sprad/ de nas nyin zhig glog 'phrin khang gi tha'e krang rnying pa than zer ba zhig yod pa kho pa rgya 123

gar du bskyod de bsdad med rung / kho pa'i bza' zla sdod sar bsngog bsher du btang ba'i las bya gzhan tshor yang glog 'phrin yo chas sogs gang yang lag par thebs mi 'dug yang nyin zhig zhol gnyer las 'khur 'brang stod pa sogs nga tsho khag gcig wa gling rgyud hu'e rigs mang tshogs sdod yul du lta zhib byed par btang byung yang glog 'phrin yo chas sogs gang yang thon ma song /rtsis dpon rnam gling pas ‘‘wa gling pa 'di tsho'ang rgya mi dang chabs cig phyir 'bud byed dgos pa 'dug ’’ces zer ba ma zad/ tsha sprul rin po ches skabs der skyid stod slob grwa'i bod yig dge rgan gnang gi yod pas khong yang phyir 'bud byed dgos pa 'dug ces bshad yod pa red/‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’zer ba de dngos su lag len bstar 'go tshugs rjes su'ang phyir slog byed phyogs sogs kyi skor bka' shag dang drung rtsis tshogs 'du yang yang 'tshogs pa ma zad/ ‘‘phyi rgyal las khungs ’’zer ba de'i do dam dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang / zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan yang bde skyid gling gar rgya gar gzhung gi don gcod mi sna ri car san gyi sar thengs kha shas btang nas rgya gar brgyud phyir slog gtong rgyu'i skor sogs gros mol yang byas yod pa red/ rgya gar brgyud phyir slog btang na lag 'khyer 'byar ma re dgos kyi yod pa shes skabs thon thengs dang po thon dgos mkhan rnams skyel sgrol du gong gsal rgyal rtse nas ched bskong cha dang dmag sgar gyi khongs nas 'go dmag khag gcig dang sbrags thon zin stabs drung rtsis gnyis nas ngos rang la ‘‘khyod rang gis par rgyag mkhan zhig glas te thon thengs dang por thon mkhan rnams mnyes thang dang chu shur gang 'phrad du lag 'khyer steng sbyar byed kyi par rgyag par lam seng thon dgos’’zhes bshad don bzhin ngos nas rdo ring 'og sdod pa'i par rgyag mkhan 'ba' bu zhig yod 124

pa khong mnyam khrid kyis bskyod cing / de'i phyi nyin nyi ma ma shar gong mnyes thang du 'byor skabs kho tsho mnyes thang nas thon rgyur bsdad 'dug pas do bdag ngo ma dang bza' zla bcas so sor 'dra par re rgyag tu bcug rjes nga tsho lha sar phyir log byas/thon thengs gnyis par thon dgos mkhan gras g.yul kha sgang smon skyid gling nang sdod 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / rnam bde legs nang sdod 'ba' pa cang shin shi'i/ bkras lhun khang gsar nang sdod rgya rigs kan zer ba sogs kyi sar gong gsal par rgyag mkhan de khrid nas khong tshor par rgyag tu bcug pa yin/ skabs der mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan sogs la rgya rigs phyir log 'gro dgos mkhan de tshos yag po byas te phyin e yong snyam pa'i blo dogs yod gshis thon thengs gnyis pa thon pa'i zhogs pa der mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan gyis zhol khang thub bstan nyi ma dang ngos rang la ‘‘de ring thon mkhan gyi gras rnam bde legs nang sdod cang shin shi'i zer ba de gang 'dra ze thon gyi 'dug gam khyod rang gnyis ltos shog’’ces bshad byung don bzhin zhol khang nged gnyis kyis phun khang gi thog kha nas zhib ltas byas shing kho pa thon bskyod zin 'phral nged gnyis phyir log gis chos 'phel thub bstan la thon stangs skor bshad rjes chos 'phel thub bstan can blo bder gyur/ —thon thengs gsum pa ni go min tang srid gzhung gi don gcod khru'u'i las byed mi sna rnams yin pas/ khong tsho ma thon gong gren khru'u krang gis bka' shag la nga tsho da res phyir slog byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhib 'khod kyi yi ge zhig dgos lugs brjod 'don bzhin bka' shag nas go min tang srid gzhung la da res gung khran tang gi mi 'dres 'dzul sngon 'gog byed ched don 125

gcod khru'u'i las byed mi sna rnams phyir slog mi byed ka med gyung lugs kyi yi ge zhig bskur dgos byung 'dug don gcod khru'u'i mi sna rmams lha sa nas ma thon gong rgya gar gzhung gi don gcod mi sna ri car san gyis kho tshor thug 'phrad byas pa ma zad/ phebs skyel gyi gsol tshigs kyang btang 'dug la/bka' shag nas kyang kho tsho thon khar lag rtags sprad pa dang / gsol tshigs btang ba ma zad/ dngos su thon nyin bka' shag gi ngo tshab tu bla phyag phreng ring 'jigs med sum rtsen ched btang thog bod dmag gi ru sgrig bcas kyis phebs skyel zhus/ de min chab mdo dang gzhis rtse khul du'ang ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’zer ba de gcig mtshungs lag len bstar 'dug‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’zer ba'i don rkyen de ni mes rgyal la rgyab gtod dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la gtor bshig bod mi dmangs yar langs bcings 'grol 'thob rgyur bkag 'gog bcas byed ched kyi tshabs che'i don rkyen zhig yin gshis/ skabs der mi dmangs kyis khong khro chen pos yi ma rangs pa byed kyi yod pa dper na/ lha sa'i mang tshogs tshos‘‘sde pa gzhung gis thabs rdugs kyi bya ba de 'dra byas song’’zer ba/ bza' mi ya bral dang /pha ma bu phrug spun mched kha bral byed dgos byung stabs yid gdungs shing /smre ngag 'don mkhan yang mang po byung 'dug pa bcas/126

nga rang shod phyag nang byed skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis go min tang gi bod sdod las don mi sna sogs gung khran tang gi gsang nyul yin lugs la bsnyas pa'i ci don rkyen zhig dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/ phran phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring / (chos ming blo bzang bstan 'dzin)gting skyes 'bras sgrub pa'i las 'khur byed mur 1kha49lo lha sar yong skabs gung khran tang gi nyul ma yin tshul gyi rgya rigs mi grangs 50skor zhig bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas rgya gar brgyud phyir 'bud byed skabs dang 'khel 'dug skabs der nga tsho bla phyag jo lags rnams dbyar mjal thugs spro tshugs te snga dro nor bu gling khar bcar nas tā la'i bla ma'i mjal kha zhus zin rjes phyag mdzod gling gi spro khang du phyir log gis nyin dgung bzhes thug rgya thug dang / gsol rgyab mchod chang btegs 'bul zin tsam zhig la phyag drung nas brjod gsal ‘‘bka' shag gi bka' 'brel gal che'i las don ched du jo lags mi grangs 12bde zhib las khungs su 'phral du yong dgos ’’zhes 127

bka' phebs 'dug cing / ‘‘jo lags gzhon pa mang che ba chang gis bzi 'dug pas da res gzhung don gal che yin 'dug gshis khyod rang yang 'gro rogs ’’zhes zer don ltar nga tsho mi 12bde zhib las khungs du bskyod pa yin/bde zhib las khungs sbug ma'i nang dmag spyi dza sag mdo mkhar ba dang mkhan drung 'bum thang chos 'phel thub bstan/ rtsis dpon rnam sras gling pa bcas ‘lhan tshogs 'dug pa dang / las khungs mdor rtse drung dang shod drung /phyag nang / gnyer nang bcas mi grangs 50skor dang / de min mi dmangs gang 'tshams bcas bsdu bskong byas 'dug mi dmangs de tsho ni so nyul dogs gzhi yod rigs kyi gnas tshang dang / khang gnyer yin 'dugadagong dro'i chu tshod 5tsam la ming tho shog lho dang sbrags sa khungs so sor phyogs bgos kyis btang song don ltar rtse drung grags pa yar rgyas dang / shod drung byang ngos pa/ phran phyag nang lha dbang tshe ring / grwa bzhi dmag mi go mtshon thogs pa bcu bcas lha sa bar skor lho phyogs mtsho sgo ba'i nub mtsho sna 'bras khang rnying pa'i nang sdod rgya rigs bsod nams rin chen dang / kra'u shan san zhes pa'i sar khang gnyer mnyam 'khrid kyis phyin pa yin/ khong gnyis thog brtsegs gsum par bsdad 'dug nga tsho khang pa'i nye 'gram du slebs dus byang ngos pas‘‘nga tsho'i byed phyogs gang dga' ci legs dgongs bzhes gnang dgos ’’gsungs nga/ra ‘‘phran gyi bsam tshul la dmag mi rnams smin drug nub kyi sgo rwa'i nang bzhag nga tsho kho tsho'i sar bka' mol gnang bar phebs na legs gnas dang / gal srid kho tshos khrims 'gal rtsing spyod 'dra byas tshe dmag mi 'bod rgyu gnang na snyam pa 'dug de ltar byas tshe gang 'dra 'dug gam dgongs bzhes gnang dgos ’’zhes bshad par/ ‘‘de rang byed do’’zhes gsungs don bzhin phran rang sngon la khong gnyis sar phyin te ‘‘nga 'dir yong 128

don ni deng sang lha sar gung khran tang gi so nyul ba mang po yod skad la brten da lta bde zhib las khungs nas gzhung zhabs gnyis khyed gnyis sar phebs kyi yod’’ces bshad rjes grags pa yar rgyas lags dang / byang ngos pa rnam gnyis phebs nas nged gsum pos gnas lugs zhib bshad kyis rdo don snying po ‘‘gzhung gi bka' dgongs bzhin khyod gnyis nyin 14'gyang med phyir log dgos pa dang / lha sa nas rgya gar sa mtshams bar rta 'ul dang / sdod sgrig sogs yod pa ma zad/ lam rgyus gnyis gtong gnang mdzad rgyu dang /'di gar bdun phrag gnyis ring khrom sogs la 'gro dus nga tsho dang khang gnyer mnyam bskyod byas 'thus ’’zhes khyab 'doms byas pa dang sbrags gsang tar sogs yod med sngog bsher byas kyang thon rigs byung ma song / bde zhib las khungs nas nga tsho thun mong thog rgya rigs de gnyis bros byol mi shor ba dam don dgos lugs zer kyang / grags pa yar rgyas lags dang / byang ngos pa rnam gnyis las khungs la gnas lugs zhu bar 'gro rgyu yin pas khyod rang 'di gar bzhugs ang gsungs pa de nas phyir log phebs ma byung /phran ngo g.yog gnyis dang khang gnyer ni nyin bcu bzhi ring nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu rgya rigs gnyis srung bya byed rgyu dang / khrom sogs la mnyam bskyod bya rgyu dka' bsun che tsam byung yang bgo skal sri zhu lhod g.yeng ma song ba bsgrubs shing / skabs de'i srung bya ba phal che bas rgya rigs 'gro mkhan tsho'i nang chas dngos po phyed rin tsam la nyos yod tshod 'dug gshis/ nga'i khongs kyi rgya rigs gnyis pos kyang ‘‘'dzin chas dngos khongs nas khyed rang la mkho ba gang yod nyar rogs rin 'bab mi dgos’’zer yang ‘‘nga la dgos mkho gang yang mi 'dug khyed gnyis kyi dngos po pham tshong ma shor ba byed dgos ’’zhes bshad/ khong gnyis nas dngos po kha shas pham tshong byas tshar 129

'dug kyang nyo mkhan tshor gnas lugs bshad de rin 'bab kha snon bskyar du sprod bcug pa yin/ lhag par kra'u shan san la lag dngul ldeng nges med pas rtag par ngu bzhin ya nga'i gnas la brten nga rang sger nas khong la zhal 'debs dngul srang brgya tham pa bster ba yin/ khong gnyis thon khar nga la snying nas dga' zhen gyis mig chu lhung lhung du 'bab bzhin par lag si dam por 'jus te ‘‘thugs rje che khyed kyis ngos gnyis la pha ma lta bu'i rogs ram gnang ba sems gting nas brjed mi yong / mgyogs po mjal yong ’’zer byung yang khong gnyis bod la bskyar du slebs ma byung /skabs der bod nas phyir skrod rgya rigs mi grangs 50skor btang khongs nas ngas shes gsal 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal rjes su bcings 'grol dmag dang mnyam du bo da la 'byor te phun dbang pu'u krang zhes pu'u krang gi go ming dang las 'gan 'dug pa las/ de byings bod la phyir log yong ba mthong rigs ma byung / rgya rigs phyir 'bud las 'gul nyin dang po'i nyin thog mar rgya gzhung gi rlung 'phrin yo chas tshang ma do dam byas pa tsam las rtsa ba'i gnad don ji yin gang yang zhu rgyu med pa bcas so/130

nge ste nga lal ngor si phir bgo sa ce nga / dzā 4 /༄ phro / pyu 4 / sngu 4 phro 4spyi bskos pa'i skor dang sog phogs khang gi lo rgyus rags rim/dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rjes/ hor spyi phyir bsdu byas nas byang sbyi bskos pa/rab byung bco lnga pa'i me 'brug(1916)lo mdo smad spyi khyab bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar bsko rdzongs bgyis pa dang dus mtshungs hor tsho so dgu zhes pa (da lta steng chen dang / spra chen/ 'bri ru/ snyan rong bcas kyi rdzong khongs su gnas— pa) de snga dim chi'i khongs nas bod khongs su gsar du gtogs te khral bsdu khrims gnon byed por ‘‘hor spyi khyab pa’’rtse shod res skor gyi mkhan rim re dang / las bya drung rigs ser skya gnyis/ ru dpon gcig dang / srung dmag lnga bcu tham pa bcas bsko gtong bya rgyur gtan 'bebs kyis hor spyi dang po mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal nas bzung stag brag bla brang gi 'dzin skyong bar hor spyi 'pho len rim pa dgu dzam byung zhing / rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sbrul (1kha42) lo hor spyi gzhung zhabs bsko gtong ma dgos par stag brag bla brang la srid skyong gi 'khyongs thebs su sprad de lo gnyis song mtshams/ 'bri ru rdzong (nag shod tsho dgu)stag bla nas mu mthud nyar ba phud/ de byings hor spyi'i khyab khongs shog khag 131

rnams gzhung la phyir 'bul zhus pas/ bka' shag nas de skor drung rtsis la go bsdur dang 'brel/ srid skyong stag brag rin po cher snyan zhus chog mchan thob don ltar/ slad hor spyi bsko gtong ma dgos par tsho pa so dgu'i sde shog rnams rdzong 'go khag drug tu bgos te/ rdzong sdod ser skya nyis sbrel re bsko gtong bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas don/ ar rdza be sogs 'go pa ser skya gnyis/ sbra chen rdzong sdod ser skya gnyis/ 'bri ru rdzong sdod ser skya gnyis (stag brag bla brang gi lde 'chang ) lho nem khri rdo 'go pa rtse drung gnyis/ ser tsha rdzong ser skya gnyis/ steng chen rdzong sdod rtse drung gnyis re bcas bsko gtong gis mi 'gro de dag la phyi'i rim pa lnga pa'i tog gnas dang / las tham gru bzhi kha ris su rdzong 'go so so'i ming 'khod re rtsis sprod byas/ dus mtshungs tsho pa so dgu'i khongs mi phyugs rigs bcas par zhib gzhung gsar 'god byed por tsho pa stod smad khag bgos kyis las tshan ser skya gnyis re'ang bsko gtong byas pa red/ de rjes chu lug( 1942)lo de snga byang rigs sde bzhi'i khral bsdu khrims gnon byed po/ ‘‘nag chu 'go pa mkhan nang (rtse drung der mkhan po dang shod drung der nang so zhes brjod srol ) sbrel po’’zhes gnas lnga pa'i rdzong sdod ser skya gnyis re 'gro srol yod pa de dag gi tshagu tu byang sa rgyab stong sa gnas 'du 'gag gal cher khyab 'doms che khyad yin ces byang rgyud spyi khyab mkhan rim gnyis dang / las bya ser skya gnyis (nag chu ja khral bsdu ba'i ser skya gnyis nas gcig lcogs) brgya dpon gcig dang dmag mi brgya tham pa re gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas don ltar bsko gtong byas shing / byang spyis khyab 'doms bya yul ni ri bo che bla gnyer yan nas gnam ru nag tshang man rgyal ston lha ri 'go tshun gyi rdzong 'go khag bcu drug gi mnga' khongs rnams yin pa dang / de dag gi gzhung sger chos bcas tshang mas byang 132

spyi'i mngag bkod dang len byed dgos pa'i srid tham lag khyer dang sprags byang spyi las thog dang po mkhan chung pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang / rim bzhi gsum mdo ba rgyal mtshan yon tan gnyis la bsko gzhag gis byang spyi'i srung dmag grwa bzhi brgya dpon don chos dang / grwa bzhi dmag brgya tham pa bcas nag chu sa gnas su mngag rdzongs byas/ de rjes byang spyi las thog gnyis pa mkhan chung lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar dang / rim bzhi zha sgab pa blo gsal don grub/ las thog gsum pa tsha rdor mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po dang rim bzhi ra sa rgya rgan pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ las thog bzhi pa mkhan chung thub bstan byang chub dang / rim bzhi smon skyid gling pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ las thog lnga pa rim bzhi sman stod pa blo bzang dbang 'dus dang / rtse drung las tshan blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ (thon zur)bcas 'pho len rim pa lnga byung ba red/byang spyi'i 'gan dbang ni/ khyab khongs rdzong 'go khag dang / byang rigs sde bzhi'i dpon 'go khag gi sa nas 〈spyi bsgrigs gan rgya〉len pa dang /bka' shag nas bkod rgya nam 'byor gyi nang don rnams brgyud bsgrags bya rgyu/rdzong 'go khag gis thag gcod ma thub pa'i gyod don khag byang spyir gtugs bsher gyis khrims gcod byed sgo/ de snga nag chu mkhan nang sbrel po'i skabs kyi mnga' khongs slobyang rigs sde bzhi’’zhes a mdo shog khag brgyad dang /bar rta shog khag lnga/ gsang gzhung shog drug lho ma shog drug byang ma shog drug smad ma shog bzhi/ sger pa shog brgyad bcas kyi khongs su gnas pa'i gzhung sger chos gsum gyi 'brog dud mi ser rnams la rkun jag gis gtsos gyod don mtha' dag la khrims gnon thag gcod byed cing / 'brog dud mi ser gyi lag nas mar dang / khul rtsid/ g.yag lug gi rgyab dod 133

so/gas khral rigs bsdu len/ de snga tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs tsam nas byang rgyud so sru/nga gtong srol rgyun 'jags kyis shog khag res mos byas te byang rgyud gdangs la dang chu rtse gnyis/ chu na ga khra bo la sogs sa gnas khag tu so srung byang rigs yul dmag lnga bcu skor btang ste sog po dang /mtsho sngon/ a mdo/ 'go log dim chi'i khul bcas nas bod du smad 'grul yong mi tshang ma'i mi dngos la zhib bsher gyis dogs can rigs sa gnas su bkag 'gog dang / de byings mi dngos go lag sogs kha gsal 'khod pa'i bka' shag tu snyan zhu gtong dgos pa sogs red/byang rigs 'brog dud mi ser rnams nas rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs sgrub 'jal dgos pa'i rnam grangs ni sger gzhung chos bcas kyi 'brog dud mi ser rnams kyi phyugs zog dkar nag la ‘‘mgo brtsi’’zhes sems can ji yod grangs brtsis te bags sbas bskungs med pa'i mna' gan blangs te 'bri rer skye med 'chi med kyi she mar khal gnyis re dang / ‘‘mdo smad me she’rizhes de sngon bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar gyis mdo smad khul lu'u cun rgya dmag gi lag mda' phyir len bgyis pa rnams byang rigs 'brog dud la bkram ste me she bsdu rgyu'i khral 'gel bgyis pa'i mar 'bab bcas lo rer mar khal lnga stong drug brgya skor ('di ga ser dgon gyi rgyun mar dang / nor gling mdzod sbug zhol spyi phogs khang bcas par bskyel dgos) dang g.yag gi rgyab dod (lha sa'i bar skor nang yod pa'i dar chen khag bkal bslong skabs dgos pa'i om thag dang / po ta la dang gtsug lag khang bcas pa'i thug ral dang / gzim chung khag gi sbra yol bcas lo gnangs kyis sgrub 'jal dgos pa)de bzhin nag chu sa gnas su gtan sdod byang spyi ngo las dang sa srung dmag sgar sdod rgyun ring mda' ru brgya lding bcas par sdod khang dang (byang 134

spyir las shag zur du yod/ de byings dpon dmag sdod gnas nag chur gtan sdod tshong rigs khag gi khang khungs g.yar te khang gla khyon che sprod dgos)gdan lcog 'bud shing / rta thab lag g.yog sogs rgyun gtong byed dgos pa dang / rkang 'gro'i khral rigs kyang byang spyi ngo las dang /dmag sgar 'go dmag sogs byang lam brgyud 'grul bzhud byed mi zhi drag dpon rigs zam mi chad pa yong mir lam yig nang gsal gyi rta khal mi gsum dang / dmag phogs/ byang spyi'i dbus 'bul gyi dos khal sogs grangs las 'das pa bskyel 'dren byed dgos pa red/byang rigs khul nas dmag khral bsdu bkug bgyis pa'i byang rigs rta dmag brgyad brgya tham pa ched 'dzugs kyis dgos gal nam byung la bsdu 'gugs bya rgyur shog khag so so'i khongs su dmag gzhung dang sbrags bzhag 'dug pa de dag nag chu mkhan nang sbrel po'i skabs nas lo gnyis gsum re'i mtshams nag chur dmag mi rnams bsdu 'gugs thog byang rigs dpon 'go khag kyang 'dzoms te ‘‘'char can dmag rtsis che mo ’’zhes mi rta go lag sogs la zhib bsher dang sbrags/ dga' spro'i ston mo yang nyin shas gtong srol yod/nag chu ja sho zhes/ nag chu sa gnas su ja khral bsdu ba'i rtse shod drung rigs ser skya gnyis yod pa de dag gis ja tshwa las khungs kyi bkod mngags dang lag rtsa'i don ltar nag chu brgyud dbus gtsang khul 'dren tshong bya rgyu'i ja rnams la tshong pa'i lag nas ja khral nyi shu zur re dang ‘‘brgya 'go’’zhes ja sbag brgya nas ja sbag re bsdu len byed pa/ khral bsdu las don tshang ma byang spyi ser skya gnyis kyi gnyer pas byed cing / ja sho gnyis ni sho gtong ming 'khur tsam las the jus de tsam med pa red/135

sog phogs khang /de snga am ban bod sdod skabs kyi sku srung rgya dmag dang / am ban gsar rnying brje len gyi dpon dmag khyon che lha sa nas chab mdo bar gzhung lam brgyud 'grul bzhud byed pas lam phogs rgyag dmigs su ‘‘rgya mda' phogs khang ’’ched 'dzugs bgyis yod pa de dag rjes su phyir bsdu byas pa red/de rjes rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing stag(1'a14)lo tsam nas mdo smad khul sa srung dmag sgar khag nang bkod rdzong bgyis pa'i 'go dmag rnams dmag phogs rgyag mkhan ‘‘mdo smad phogs khang ’’zhes zur du btsugs yod kyang /'go dmag 'pho len nam gzhis 'khor sogs la yar mar bskyod skabs dang /lhag par chu sprel (1rdzo22)lo nas byang rgyud sa srung dmag sgar 'ga' shas ched 'dzugs bgyis pa bcas de dag mang che ba byang lam bar ma (lha sa nas 'bri gung dang / pho ba rdza 'gag rmi ti kha/ 'bri ru rdzong sogs brgyud sog khul du bskyod lam) brgyud thon bskyod byed pas sa srung 'gro yul khad ring sar dmag phogs mnyam 'khyer bya rgyu dka' ngal gyi rgyur brten dmag sgar khag yar mar bskyod skabs kyi lam phogs dang / dgos gal nam byung la phogs 'bru btang chog ang gsar yong ched sog rdzong sa gnas su ‘‘sog phogs khang ’’zhes pa ched 'dzugs bgyis te phogs dpon las tshan ser skya gnyis bsko gzhag thog phogs 'bru dza drag gi skyel 'dren dgos gal la ched dmigs ‘‘phogs rta’’ zhes khal rta brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa dang /‘ phogs g.yag’’ces khal g.yag sum brgya tham pa ‘‘re dkar sog’’gsum kyi mi ser thog bgos 'grems rtsis sprod bgyis 'dug sog phogs khang 'pho len 136

rim lnga tsam byung yod tshod nas ming gsal shod zhu rgyu yod pa 'bri gung dga' spro khang gsar ba'i rtse mgron dang / shod drung ldum khang / rtse mgron blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / shod drung sreg shing pa/ rtse mgron thub bstan tshe dpag dang phran dge rgyas pa bcas yin pa dang / phogs khang gi phogs 'bru gshor 'jal byed mkhan phogs khang do dam nas sger btsugs gnyer pa gnyis dang / 'bru 'dren dang phogs srung bcas par dmag mi bcu tham pa bcas yod/ dmag phogs rgyag dmigs 'bru 'bab rnams kyi yongs khungs ni lho brag khul dang dwags kong / 'phan po/ stag lung khul bcas nas yin cing /de dag nas sog sa gnas dang 'bri rur 'or 'dren byed pa dang / gzhan yang steng chen dang / ser tsha khul de snga hor spyi'i skabs las bya ser skya gnyis dang / ru dpon gyi thab rten ‘‘gnas zhing ’’zer ba'i sa zhing rnams mi ser la sprad de ‘‘thog phud’’zhes pa'i 'bru khral bsdu rgyu bzos pa rnams kyi 'bru 'bab dang / 194〈lo stod shel dkar khul nas 'bru khal chig 'bum tham pa nag chu dang / sbra chen bcas par 'or 'dren bgyis (der 'bum 'bru 'or 'dren zhes brjod) pa bcas kyi thog nas 1949 —1950lo gnyis kyi ring byang rgyud sa srung dmag sgar khag la dmag phogs rgyag sprod byas pa red/ de snga dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi chab 'bang sa mi ser thog dmag sgar khag yar mar bskyod skabs dang / dmag phogs bskyel 'dren bya rgyu 'di dag rkang 'gro'i khral rigs dka' ngal che shos yim/ la/gong gsal ‘‘'bum 'bru 'or 'dren’’skabs lam 'khel mi ser thog rkang 'gro'i brdab 'phar gyis khag sbyong de bas ci cher byung yod pa bcas so/

mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams kyi lo rgyus shes tshor cung zad/'phrin las dar rgyas kyis/ru tsha mgon po bsod nams kyi skyes yul ni bod ljongs mdo smad chab mdo rdzong / rdza rgyud rdo lha mdo ru tsha gnas po zhes pa zhing pa'i khyim du sa sbrul (1〈69)lor btsas shing khyim gyi ming ru tsha zhes pa'i don ni rgyal po ru las skyes zhes pa'i tsha bo'i mi rgyud yin zhes grags pa'i dud ming ru tsha dang /gnas po zer ba'i ming don ni chab mdo bla brang gi las sne de'i rgyud du lo khral bsdu ba sogs la phebs skabs bzhugs gnas dang chab bla'i gnas khag gi gras shig yin pas gnas po'i ming thogs shing / khong chung ngu'i dus nas pha mas chab mdo bla brang gi bod yig slob grwa ru slob sbyong byed par bskyal ba red/khong lo na son mtshams grwa pa byas shing chab bla'i spyi mdzod dwa han skal bzang yon ta 'a gyi gsol dpon gzhon par bsko gzhag dang 'brel rdo lha mdo la ko spyan — nis gzigs zhes pa'i rdo thog rang byon yod pa'i lha khang dang / jo bo smṛ ti dzha na'i sku dmar gdung yod pa'i lha khang / ra sku 'bum dang / rta rong jo sngon ma/ wa la'i gdung 'bum bcas kyi lha khang nyams gso dang gsar skrun byed pa'i 'go par gtong skabs mgon po bsod nams nas (ragan 'khur te/ rdo lha mdo'i ko spyan ras gzigs rdo nag po'i thog ri mo dkar po thog brtsegs gnyis lhag tsam yod pa'i rang byon khyad 'phags can 138

de'i lha khang ka ring drug dang ka thung bco brgyad thog brtsegs gsum yod kyi khang pa gsar bzo dang / 'du khang g.yas phyogs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum gyi sku dang / 'phags pa lha sku phreng bzhi pa'i 'dra sku/nye sras bzhi/ khro bo rta mgrin gyi sku bcas dang / g.yon du jo bo shākya mu ne gtso 'khor gsum dang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ nye sras bzhi/ khro bo phyag na rdo rje bcas mi tshad tsam re byon gtsang gsar bzhengs kyis tshon rtsi dang zhal gser legs par gsol/ ra sku 'bum dang ma dgon zhes pa'i jo bo smṛ ti dzha na'i sku gdung yod pa'i mchod rten thog brtsegs gnyis tsam yod pa'i lha khang nyams gso dang / phyi'i khor yug tu 'khor khang yod pa/ ya dgon la 'du khang ka ring gnyis dang / ka thung bco brgyad tsam yod pa'i 'du khang gsar bzhengs dang rten gtso sman 'dam las grub pa'i shākya thub pa'i sku dang /gnas brtan brag ri ma bcas gsar bzhengs kyis tshon rtsi dang zhal gser gsol te byon gtsang legs grub/ rta rong jo sngon ma zhes jo bo smṛ ti snyo na'i sku dmar gdung mchod rten thog brtsegs phyed gnyis tsam yod pa'i lha khang dang / 'du khang ka ba drug tsam yod pa nyams gso dang / wa lis gdung 'bum zhes jo bo smṛ ti dzha na'i sku 'bum ther gcig nang bzhugs mchod rten dang / lha khang nyams gso legs par byas zin rjes/ chab mdo spyi mdzod dā han skal bzang yon tan dang / chab mdor bzhugs pa'i gong ma tshang gi sku tshab phogs dpon dang / dwa lu'u zhes pa'i dpon bcas sku 'khor rnams gong gsal lha khang nyams gso byas pa khag bzhi so sor gnas gzigs su ched phebs gnang ba dang / lhag par du skabs der gong gsal ko spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal rang byon yod pa'i lha khang gsar bzhengs kyis sgo mchor steng du gru 'dzin zhing mchog bhade chen thar 139

gling zhes pa'i mtshan byang / gong ma kwang zhu'i khri bzhugs grangs ka'i ming dang tham ga gru bzhi gnyis kyi ri mo yod pa rgya yig dang bod yig man ju'i yi ge bcas yod pa'i paṇa che legs gcig gzengs bstod gnang ba bkal 'dug de rjes rdo lha mdor yod pa'i mgon po bsod nams kyi khyim gzhis ru tsha tshang gi khang pa sngar yod me shor rjes/ chab mdo spyi mdzod dwa han skal bzang yon tan la khang pa gsar las byed mi ar las skul 'ded chog pa zhus don ltar chog mchan dang 'brel de snga'i ru tsha tshang gi khang pa'i rgya khyon las che la spus ka legs pa thog brtsegs gsum ldan gsar rgyag byas/ chab mdo rdza rgyud khul du skabs der yab tshang dang / ru tsha tshang gi khang pa zhes skad grags che shos su brtsis shing / de nas lha sa kun gling bla brang gi 'dzin khongs dpa' shod bla brang gi gnyer chen sras rdog nas ngan skul byas te/ rnga sgong rdzong dang / bkra shis rtse/ 'dem grong shog gsum bsgrigs nas skya ser mi hrag bsdus te dpa' shod bla brang la dmag rgyag rtsis byed par yong /dpa' shod bla brang gi gnyer phyag las sne mang pos kha gtad langs te skabs der dpa' shod bla brang gi phyag mdzod dang / rta ljang phyag mdzod nas gnyer chen sras rdog gsod dgos byung ba'i nang 'khrug skabs chab mdo spyi mdzod dā han skal bzang yon tan nas bla brang phan tshun gyi la rgyar bsam gzhigs kyis bar 'dum byed par ru tsha mgon po bsod nams mnyam khrid kyis dpa' shod bla brang gi gnyer phyag dang / sde shog nang 'khrug gi gyod gzhi bar 'dum mdzad pa legs 'grigs thub cing / chab spyi dā han skal yon sku ma gshegs gong gsol dpon gzhon pa ru tsha mgon po bsod nams dang skyid sdug zla bsgril btang ste spyi mdzod dā han skal yon 'das rjes/ dgongs rdzogs dge rtsa gang legs sgrub 'phros rgyu dngos dang / spyi mdzod kyi thob khongs sa 140

zhing sngo ra khag 21dang zog sems can dzi bo khag bcas gsol dpon gzhon pa mgon po bsod nams la bdag pa red/de rjes ru tsha mgon po bsod nams nas kun gling bla brang mdun bcar gyis lde 'chang go gnas zhus thog dpa' shod bla brang gi 'dzin khongs sho mdo sde pa'i gzhis sdod las 'khur lo mang byas shing / sho mdo sde pa'i sa khongs rdzong dkar zhes pa'i gzhis ka dang / nyi ma thang zhes pa'i sa stong zhing kha gsar sbol byas par son khal brgyad brgya skor 'gro ba'i sa zhing la dbyar nyal lang gis son 'debs byas nas sa zhing g.yog mi dud grangs 26skor yod/gzhis ka'i yong 'bab thog nas sho mdo sde pa la lo rer bogs ma 'bru khal brgyad brgya skor 'jal sgrub blangs pa'i zhing kha'i yong 'bab kyi khe bzang lo mang za rgyu byung ba dang / mi ser dbar gyod gzhi byung rigs la'ang zhib 'jug thag gcod byas pa red/ru tsha mgon po bsod nams kun gling lde 'chang gi go gnas thogabod sa gnas srid gzhung nas las tshan pa'i go gnas gnang ba dang 'brel sman stod dza sa/ga gi las byar stod mnga' ris phyogs su sa mi zhib dpyod byed par lo gnyis tsam ring las don ba sgrubs te mi ser sa mi zhib dpyod skor gzhung 'bangs gnyis dge'i gzhung drangs zhu sgo dang / dgon sde khag la nyams gso bcas gang ci'i thad la legs grub byung stabs mnga' ris dgon yul gnyis kyis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i mdun sar snyan 'bul zhus rjes/ sman stod dza sag la bka' blon go gnas gnang ba dang / ru tsha las tshan par mkhan chung gi go gnas bstsal ba red/ ru tsha mgon po bsod nams de nyid 'tsho bzhugs skabs gsungs pa rgan rabs rnams kyi ngag rgyun nas go thos byung /141

tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa nas ru tsha mgon po bsod nam/sa kha / mkhan chung gi go gnas bstsal zhing / bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar gyis las bya ser skya dpon dmag dang mnyam du bod du yod pa'i lu'u cun dmag dpon phing dwo ran dpon dmag rnams phyir skrod byed po'i wongs bsko gtong gnang skabs bka' blon byams pa bstan dar sku 'khor srung dam spu 'ga' shas dang bcas lho rdzong du bzhugs shing / de byings bod kyi dam/ga sgar khag dang / mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams sogs bo min tangadamag mtha' skrod byed par sngon mngags mdzad nas dmag 'thab rim bstu da kyis sde dge 'bri chu shar brgyud lcang ra sa gnas bar bod kyi sa khongs su tshur len thub pa dang / dmag 'thab dus yun kyang lo ngo bdun trem 'gor skad 'dug bka' blon byams pa bstan dar chab mdor 'byor skabs lu'u cun dpon dmag gis chab mdo bla brang dang / dgon pa'i 'du khang khag mer bsregs btang bar brten bla brang dang / dgon pa'i 'du khang gsar skrum/ ar po'i 'go 'doms su mkhan chung ru tsha bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar bla dgon las sne dang / mi ser bcas nas 'phyar ba gru 'degs kyis dang po sgrol ma lha khang 'og ma gsar bzhengs thog sman 'dam las grub pa'i rten gtso rje yab sras gsum dang / shākya thub pa'i sku dang sgrol ma dkar sngon bcas kyi sku thog brtsegs re yod pa tshon dang zhal gser gzungs gzhug na bza' rab gnas bcas dang / bla brang gi pho brang yang sngar yod ltar brtsegs shul sor bzhag gis gsar skrun gang 'tsham zhig thub pa dang / tshogs chen 'du khang yang ka ring bcu drug dang ka thung brgyad cu man gyi thog brtsegs re gsar bzhengs byas/ mgon khang chen mo 'du khang ka ring bzhi/ ka thung bcu drugagatsang khang sbug ka ring gnyis ldan thog brtsegs bzhi bcas gsar bzhengs 142

gnang / gtsang khang sbug tu sman 'dam las grub pa'i rten gtso rdo rje 'jigs byed thog brtsegs gnyis can dang / g.yas g.yon du thog brtsegs re yod pa'i srung ma rnams byon gtsang gsar bzhengs dang / gong ma 'du khang ka ring drug dang / ka thung sum cu so bzhi/ sgo mchor ka ring gnyis/ja khang / gnyer tshang sogs ka ba bco brgyad thog brtsegs gsum ldan/gtsang khang sbug ma'i nang ka ring drug sman 'dam las grub pa'i rten gtso byams pa'i sku brnyan thog brtsegs gnyis tsam yod pa/ g.yas g.yon duci sangs rgyas stong sku dang / 'du khang nang rje rin po che/ byang sems shes rab bzang po'i 'dra sku mi tshad tsam bcas byon gtsang gsar skrun thogatshon dang / zhal gser gzungs gzhug na bza' bcas legs par bzhengs yod pa dang / gzhan yang sgrub sde brgyad dang / rnam grol grwa tshang bcas kyi 'du khang / grwa shag rgyag phyogs sogs la rgyab skyor dang / rten bzhengs kyang gang 'tsham byas pa red/tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pas mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams spo pad khul du sa mi zhib dpyod byed par bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar bskyod cing /spo khul dang / mon tsho khag lnga/ lho grwa yul bcas kyi sa babs dang mi 'bor/thon khungs sogs zhib 'jug tho bkod dang / pad+ma bkod zhes pa'i gnas ri der lo ltar dbyar dus su sa phyogs nye ring khag nas gnas skor 'gro mkhan mang po yod pa de rnams sngon chad zhag sdod char 'gog khang pa med stabs dka' ngal che bas mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams de nyid gnas skor dang sbragame sa zhib skyod skabs lho pa'i mi dang gnas skor ba rogs pa glas te rjes su gnas skor 'gro mkhan la char chu'i nang sdod mi dgos pa'i 'grul khang gsar rgyag byas pa dang / kun 'dus rdor sems pho brang zhes pa'i lha khang 143

nyams gso yang byas shing / spo khul sa bab thon khungs sogs kyi gnas tshul tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par zhib phra'i snyan zhu 'bul bar mkhan chung mgon bsod ngo g.yog rnams lha sar bskyod pa red/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas/ mkham/ chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams la spo pad 'tshong spyi zhes pa bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar/ yang bskyar spo bo khul du mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams ngo g.yog rnams bskyod cing / spo bo dang / pad+ma bkod kyi sa bab dang / mi 'bor/yul gyi thon khungs sogs zhib 'jug tho bkod kyis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i mdun sar snyan zhu snga rjes su phul ba de dag la bka' lan bkod yig thengs mang gnang 'dug lo ngo gsum gyi ring las 'khur zhus rjes sa 'brug lor spo bo ka gnam pa dbang chen bdud 'dul dpon blon nas/mkhan chung ru tsha mgon bsod ngo g.yog spo khul sdod yun ring bas mi ser thog brda—bas bsigs che khar/ sa zhib yul bab zhib 'jug gang byas kyang ka gnam pa'i dbang cha bod pas g.yo 'phrog byed rgyu'i ngan jus shig yin 'dug gshis/ mkhan chung ru tsha ngo g.yog rnams gsod rgyu'i gros mol gra sgrig byed skabs gnas tshul de mkhar thog sde pa'i ma rgan o rgyan dbang mos go thos byung 'phral shul mo rdzong rdzi ra bu dang / mkhan chung mgon bsod gnyis rnam kun grogs po lta bu'i mthun sgril yod stabs mkhar thog sde pa'i ma rgan o rgyan dbang mo shul mo rdzong rdzi ra bu yi sring mo nye rgyud yin tsang chu mdo dgon rdzong nas mkhan chung mgon bsod sar gsang brda btang stabs mkhan chung nas mgron gnyer don rgyal la las tshab bsko gzhag dang g.yog dbang 'dus dngos rdzas bdag gnyer byed mkhan dang / gnyer chos dbang pha bu gnyis dang / blo rgyal pha bu gnyis bcas bzhag nas de byings mkhan chung ngo g.yog 144

rnams gsang stabs kyis chab mdor bros rjes/ gnyer chos dbang pha bu gnyis dang / blo rgyal pha bu gnyis bcas ka gnam pas sdug gsod btang ba dang / g.yog dbang 'dus shul mo rdzong rdzi ra tshang gi nye 'brel nyi log sde pa'i sar bros nas srog 'go thon tsam byung ba red/ don rgyal shul mo rdzong rdzi ra bu sar bros thub ste yun ring sbas skung byas nas thar ba red/ mkhan chung ru tsha chab mdor 'byor rjes mdo spyi bka' blon sman stod mdun snga phyi'i gnas tshul rnams zhul pas/ mdo spyis lha sa sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan 'bul zhus 'brel ja dang mda' dpon stag sna 'go dmag lnga brgya dang bcas spo sa gnas su btang ba red/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams gtsang sa skya dgon pa nyams gso byed par btang gnang bas nyams gso zhu sgo zin rjes/ sa skya dgon pa'i bdag chen khri 'dzin byed mkhan bla khag gsum yod khongs nas nag rtsi pho brang zhes bla brang gcig la bdag chen khri pa bgres song gcig dang / de'i gcung mo btsun ma gcig las sras rgyud med stabs bdag chen des mkhan chung ru tsha la khong bdag chen khri 'dzin byed mi sras rgyud med pas sku tshe rdzogs mtshams bla brang gi 'dzin chas rgyu dngos rnams tā la'i bla mar dad 'bul zhu rtsis yin pas khyed kyis gong sa mchog mdun snyan 'bul zhu rogs zhes bka' mngags gnang ba ltar mkhan chung ru tsha nas tā la'i bla mar snyan 'bul zhus 'brel gong gsal sa skya bdag chen sku gshegs rjes dad 'bul zhus pa'i dngos rdzas rnams lha sa mdzod sbug nas rtsis len byed par mkhan chung ru tsha dang / gzhis rtse spyi rdzong mkhan chung thub bstan chos ldan mnyam du sa skyar gtong gnang mdzad/ bla brang nag rtsi pho brang gi rgyu dngos thog nas bdag chen gyi gcung mo btsun ma de dag la skal ba 145

gang 'tsham bzhag thog de byings tshang ma sa rim mi ser 'ul lag skul 'dedatshokyis mdzod sbug la rtsis 'bul zhus pa red/ skabs der mkhan chung ru tsha sger la'ang sa skya nag rtsi pho brang gi nang rten gras li ma'i ston sku byon gtsang gcig dang sa paṇa gyi lhungs bzed dang / 'khar gsil/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dbu zhwa/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi chos gos dang snam sbyar na bza' cha tshang / rin chen ril bu/ byin rten rtsa che bcas gang 'tshams shig zur du lkog 'khyer thog chab mdo dgon par rten gtso gsar bzhengs rim pa'i gzungs gzhug tu phul ba red/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku gshegs rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams nor gling spyan bsal pho brang gi khang gnyer du bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar khang gnyer gyi zhu sgo lo gsum tsam zhus pa red/bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod namasasku dang / sras rnam pa'i gras nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gnyis la mdo smad phogs khang do dam bsko gzhag gnang zhing / phogs khang gi las don lo gnyis lhag tsam sgrub rjes chab mdo bla brang nas/ mtshan nyid sprul sku zhes chab mdo rdza brgyud mtshan nyid dgon zhes rnying ma'i dgon pa zhig gi sprul sku yin pa khong sgra snyan ngag dang rtsis rig sogs la mkhas pa zhig yod pas srid skyong rwa sgreng la rig gnas kyi sku yon 'bul mkhan yongs 'dzin gyi gras su gyur stabs khong brgyud chab mdo bla brang gi srid skyong rwa sgreng mdun mkhan chung ru tsha nas mdo smad phogs khang gi byed sgor kha g.yar nas mi ser thog brdabs mnar che lugs/ snyan zhu phul 'brel/ srid skyong rwa sgreng nas mkhan chung 'jam dbyangs don grub la mdo smad phogs khang gsar bskos kyis mkhan 146

chung ru tsha mgon bsod lha sar zhabs bcar zhu dgos pa'i bka' rgya phebs rung mkhan chung ru tsha lo na rgas shing nad mnar la brten drag skyes ma byung bar lha bcar zhu ma dgos pa zhes skyabs rten du rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan li ma byon gtsang zhig dang / snyan zhu bcas srid skyong rwa sgreng mdun phul bas mgyogs myur lha sar zhabs bcar zhu ma dgos tsam byung ba red/mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams dgung lo 72skor zin rjes 'bam nad snyun nas sku gshegs pa red/ mkhan chung gi mkhar dbang rgyu dngos rnams tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa zhal bzhugs skabs nas mdzod sbug la dad 'bul zhus zin 'dug kyang / mkhan chung ru tsha mgon bsod 'das rjes gnyer pa rnam rgyal don grub dang / chab dgon slob dpon dang spyi bso las sne bcas kyis mkhan chung gi rgyu dngos nas bod gzhung rtse shod gnyis la bsngo rten rtse 'phral bde las khungs kyi yig lam ltar 'bul rgyu'i dngos po dang / gzhan yang gdan sa chen po gsum gyi bla sprul dang mkhan po so sor bsngo rten 'bul rgyu'i dngos rdzas zur dbye zin 'phros mkhan chung gi rgyu dngos dang / rta zog sems can sa zhing sogs gang yod rnams gsum bgos byas te ru gcig chab mdo dgon pa'i mang ja'i thebs rtsa dang /ru gcig dbyar chos kyi thebs rtsa/ ru gcig chab mdo dgon pa'i tshogs chen 'du khang sbug gi gser zangs kyi rje yab sras gsum gyi sku che legs shig bzheng rgyu'i dmigs sgo bcas su gsol ras zhu rgyu dang / mkhan chung 'das po'i rjes shul shag tshang tsha bo 'phrin las dar rgyas yig rtsis go 'pher dang /lo na son mtshams rtse drung zhabs zhu chog pa zhes srid skyong rwa sgreng mdun chab dgon bla spyi nas bsngo rten 'bul mi zhabs phyi don nyi gdong snyan 'bul zhus pa'i bka' lan du/ mkhan chung ru tsha 'das po'i rgyu dngos kha dbang ji yod 147

rnams dgon pa'i snyan zhu ltar/ mang ja dang / dbyar chos rje yab sras gsum bcas bzheng rgyu'i dmigs sgor gnang 'thus dang / rjes 'jug tsha bo 'phrin las dar rgyas lo na son mtshams zhabs zhu chog pa bcas kyi chog mchan thob don ltar/ chab dgon bla spyi nas mkhan chung ru tsha 'das po'i rgyu dngos ji yod gsum bgos kyis mang ja dang dbyar chos/ rje yab sras gsum bcas bzheng rgyu'i thebs rtsa byas pa red/ gong gsal rgyu dngos nang gser dngul dang / zangs rag stung bcas kyi mchod chas/ grwa chas/sog chas/ rgya rum/ gam rum—/ gtsang rum bcas kyi gdan chas dang josprob chas/ dgos mkho'i dngos rdzas ci rigs bcas dang / rta drel/'tshong rtsa/ ja dngul sde 'bang thog 'bru dang / dngul bun btang ba'i gan rgya khag mang bcas yod pa red /148

nye rabs kyi bod dmag dang bod ljongs dmag spyi khang gi skor sogs 'brel yod 'ga' zhigasding bya tshe ring rdo rjes/nye rabs kyi bod dmagarab byung 15pa'i chu byi (spyi lo 1912)lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya gar nas rang sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes de snga gor bod bde gzar gyi dmag 'khrug snga rjes dang / dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul gyi dmag 'khrug rim byung la brten 'byung 'gyur btsan 'gog rang srung ched du sngar rab byung bcu gsum pa'i nang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa'i sku dus su btsugs pa'i rgya sbyong dmag sum stong gi dmag rten dmag rkang rer cha snyoms byas na sa zhing son khal 60—70la slar yang dmag mi 'gel skul byas pa ste —dbus khul rgya sbyong dmag rkang gnyis re'i sar sku srung dmag re dang /gtsang khul rgya sbyong dmag rkang bzhi re'i sar sku srung dmag re bsdu bskong byas pa khyon dmag grangs 100rkyatham pa yod pa'i 'go 'doms mda' dpon gcig dang / ru brgya lding bcas gsar bskos kyis tā la'i bla ma'i sku srung zhu byar nor gling du ka dang sku srung dmag sgar zhes pa gsar du btsugs pa dang /149
