dus mtshungs sngar yod rgya sbyong sum stong zhes pa dbus khul rgya sbyong chig stong la /ba dang / gtsang khul gzhis rtse rgya sbyong chig stong la ga dang / rgyal rtse rgya sbyong lnga brgyar nga dang / ding ri rgya sbyong lnga brgyar ca dang zhes ka ta bsgrigs pa'i ming btags/ sngar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i sku dus su btsugs : ger grags pa'i gzim pa lding khag khongs nas ru phyi bar gnyis cha dang gzim ( chung dmag sgar la bsgyur/ ru nang ma lha sa'i nye 'khor zhol 'og rdzong gzhis khongs su 'khri ba'i gzim lding 'go dmag rnams lo ltar lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i gzhung sgor bcar dgos pas rang 'jags su bzhag pa bcas byas yod/de rjes lcags stag zhib gzhung rtsa bzung gis zhabs sdod ngo chag dang /rgya sbyong dmag chag/ bkrus chag(sa zhing gi rgya khyon ji yod do bdag gis kha nas bshad pa la he bag med ces mna' bskyal ba der bden 'dzin gyis chags par zer) zhib chag (chag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhib rtog byas pa'i mchan bkod yod par zer) bcas chag chen bzhi phud/ de byings sger chos 'don bzhi dang / gzhung rgyugs rkang brgyad re nas dmag mi re bcas rkang 'don 'dur slong ('dur slong zhes pa ni sa zhing gi rgya khyon gzhir bzung khral rigs sgrub rgyugs byed phyogs kyi tha snyad cig yin cing / de yang sger chos la 'don dang / gzhung rgyugs par rkang zhes zer/ 'don gcig dang rkang gnyis sa zhing rgya khyon gcig pa yin rung / gal te 'dur slong ma byas na 'don gcig dang rkang gcig khral rigs sgrub rgyugs thog mang nyung gcig pa rgyugs dgos pa dang / 'dur slong byas na 'don gcig dang rkang gnyis khral rigs sgrub rgyugs thog gcig pa yin pas/ des na 'dur slong byas na gzhung rgyugs par khral rigs 'khri sgrub thad ldab gcig gis yang ba yod pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku dus su khral rigs mang po 150

zhig rkang 'don 'dur slong gis 'gel dkri gnang yod pas sger chos che btsan khag nas sa bzas khral mi rgyugs pa'i snang tshul der 'gyur ba chen po byung yod pa red/)gis rkang 'don brgyad bzhi'i dmag mi 2200skor bsdus pa rnams ja dang nya dang ta dang bcas dbus khul nas dang / tha dang gtsang khul nas bsdu skul byas pa zhig yin cing / skabs der khyon dmag sgar bzhi btsugs par dmag sgar rer 'go 'doms mda' dpon re dang / ru brgya lding bcas gsar bskos kyis klu sbug tu dmag sgar gsar pa zhes pa 'dzugs skrun byas pa red/ de snga so nam las khungs kyi mi khungs nas bsdus te btsugs pa'i pu li si (nyen rtog pa) rnams 'khu bsdu byas tshab gtsang khul brgyad sna'i dmag khongs lha ngam phun gsum (lha rtse/ ngam ring / phun tshogs gling) dang shel ding (shel dkar dang / ding ri) khul gyi tha dang dmag mda' khag gcig gi lhag 'phrol zur 'then gyis da dang pu li si dmag sgar btsugs/ de'i 'go 'doms lha sa mi dpon gnyis kyis zhor skyong byed cing / de 'og tu 'go byed brgya dpon dang lding dpon bcas yod/ pu li si 'go dmag gi dmag sgar ni khrom gzigs khang tsho khang zhes pa de red/ de sngon pu li si'i 'go 'doms dmag sgar rang khungs nas byed pa las/ lha sa mi dpon gyis 'go 'doms byed mi dgos par mi dpon gyi 'og tu bskor bya ba mi bcu dgu tsam yod pa khong tsho ni grong khyer nang bskor g.yengs dang /khrims 'gal byed mi 'dzin bzung gis rta lcag gtong mkhan yin pa dang /de'i skabs su lha khul tshem bzo ba dang / lha bris pa'i 'go 'doms la bzo khang do dam zhes pa'i las khungs dang / dngul bzo dang / zangs bzo sogs bzo rigs la zhol 'dod dpal do dam zhes pa'i las khungs/ rdo shing bzo rigs la dbu che chung gis 'go 'doms byed pa'i las khungs re 151

bcas yod pa de tsho tshang ma lha sa mi dpon gyi khrims 'doms 'og tu 'du ma dgos par khrims 'go rang btsan yin pas/ khong tsho'i khongs mi'i nang nas khrims 'gal nyes gsog gi spyod ngan la bskor bya bas dge skyon bshad kyang ma nyan par ngo rgol gyis bskor bya bar mi mang pos rdung rdog btang ba dang de min gzhan dag la'ang dbang shed nyes rdung gtong ba sogs kyi gnad don mi nyung ba zhig thon gyi yod pa/ dper na thengs gcig bzo khang pa'i tshem bzo ba bcu phrag kha shas nas lha klu'i nang gdong mchongs kyis lha klu'i g.yog po zhig 'dzin bzung thog ku shu gling gi nang 'khrid nas lus steng rgyug pa grangs med gzhus te ma shi tsam bzos pa lta bu red/ gong gsal lha klu'i g.yog rig rmedzin la nyes rdung btang ba'i gyod gzhi'i skor nas rkyen langs te tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku tshe'i smad char bzo rigs kyi khrims 'go rang btsan zhes pa yongs rdzogs med pa bzos/ dmag sgar khag gi dmag mi phud/ de byings tshang mas lha sa'i khor yug tu lha sa mi dpon gyi lbi/ mas 'doms la brtsi bkur zhu dgos pa las/ gang byung byed mi chog pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / de nas bzung mi dpon gnyis pu li si'i 'go 'doms su bsgyur ba red/ pu li si'i thad ka'i 'go khrid mi dpon gnyis yin kyang / dmag spyi khang ni dmag sgar yongs kyi spyi khyab yin pas mi dpon gyis dmag spyi khang gi bka' dang len zhu dgos pa'i phyogs kyang yod la dmag mi'i gyod don skor la mi dpon gyis the jus kyang byed mi chog tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i spyan bsal sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs (de ni nor srid dngul rtsis rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun las khungs gcig sdud lta bu red)kyi spyi khyab pa'i ming 'khur gyis bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor thog dbang cha chen po bzung skabs pha dang grong drag 152

dmag sgar zhes pa zhig btsugs yod kyang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa zhing du gshegs rjes dmag sgar de 'khu bsdu byas pa red/de rjes rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang stag brag srid skyong khrir 'dzegs rjes btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod la btsan 'dzul dang / sim 'dzul byed bde ba'i lam bu bshangs pa lta bur gyur nas kha bral gyi spyod ngan rab dang rim pa spel zhing / lhag par du bod mi dmangs kyis skom pa chu 'dod ltar re sgug byed pa'i bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur ngo rgol byed ched/me phag (1947) lo tsam nas 'go tshugs te mdo smad dang byang khul gang sar ‘‘rgya dmar gung khran tang gi nyen kha che bas nyen 'gog rang srung gi ched du drag po g.yul gyi 'du 'god mi gnang mthu med 7ces bsgrags thog dmag phogs gra sgrig dang / slar yang dmag dpung rgya che 'phar snon gyis rkang 'don brgyad bzhi'i 'khri khungs la chag chen bzhi phud/ rkang 'don 'dur slong gis sger chos 'don drug dang / gzhung rgyugs rkang bcu gnyis re nas dmag mi re bsdu skul byas par bcu gnyis drug sna'i dmag zhes zer ba dang /rgya khyab gzhung sger chos gsum gyi khongs 'khyer 'khos drag pa'i khyim tshang la bu gnyis yod pa nas bu gcig dmag mir bcug ste grong drag dmag mi zhes pa bcas gsar du btsugs/ de snga rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing 'brug (1904) lor dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug 'gog skabs kong khul nas dmag mi bsdus pa'i ming gzhung nang gsal gyi 'khri khungs nas slar yang kong dmag bsdu skul byas pa sogs lcags stag (1950)lor chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i snga nub tu dmag dpung 'phar btsugs kyis gtso bo mdo smad khul sa srung sngar yod thog dmag dpung 'phar snon khyon che btang ba dang / byang khul du sa srung sngar yod khar dpung snon btang ba dang / lha 153

sa dang gzhis rtser bca' sdod khongs dang bcas par skabs der khyon ka nas ma bar dmag sgar khag bco lnga(na med pa )la bsdoms 'go dmag chig khri ma zin tsam yod pa rnams kyi so so'i mda' dpon ni ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon yab gzhis stag 'tsher sras bkra shis phun tshogs dang / kha dang grwa bzhi rgya sbyong dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon bkra shis dpal rab rdo rje tshe brtan dang bsam pho sras bstan 'dzin don grub/ ga dang gzhis rtse rgya sbyong dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon mu bya tshe dbang nor bu dang dkar chung ba tshe ring don grub/ nga dang rgyal rtse rgya sbyong dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon mtsho sgo zur pa dngos grub rdo rje/ ca dang ding ri rgya sbyong dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon brag 'jun pa bstan pa tshe ring / cha dang gzim chung me skyogs dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon 'dzun pa ba ngag dbang dpal mo/ ja dang brgyad bzhi'i dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon phu lung pa grags pa tshe brtan/ nya dang brgyad bzhi'i dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon bla ma bya rigs pa bsod nams dbang phyugata dang brgyad bzhi'i dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus/ tha dang brgyad bzhi'i dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon shag byang zur pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ da dang pu li si dmag sgar gyi 'go 'doms mi dpon tsha rdi bde chen pa tshe brtan rdo rje dang lung shar ba o rgyan rdo rje/ pa dang dbus khul grong drag dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon mkhar sna ba mkha' khyab bde chen dang / mda' tshab sgog mkhar ba tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ pha dang bcu gnyis drug sna'i dmag sgar gyi mda' tshab dga' bde ba rnam rgyal rdo rje dang / mda' tshab rgyal mkhar nang pa tshe dbang rta mgrin/ ba dang kong khul yul dmag gi mda' tshab rdo grong pa tshe ring rdo rje/ ma dang gtsang khul grong drag dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon zhwa sgab pa blo gsal don grub dang /154

mda' tshab lce bde ba bstan 'dzin skal bzang bcas red/ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyi mda' khag gcig la dmag grangs 10rkya0dang / de byings mda' dpon dang / mda' tshab gang yin rung mda' dpon re re'i 'og la spyir btang dmag grangs 500re tsam dang /ru dpon gnyis re/ brgya dpon bzhi re/ lding dpon nyi shu re yod pa red/dmag sgar mang che ba'i lag mda' dbyin mda' kha thung yin pa dang /dmag sgar 'ga' zhig la me shin ghan dang lu'u si ghan/ bhi ring ghan/kreng ghan sogs yod la/ ka dang sku srung dmag sgar dang / kha dang grwa bzhi rgya sbyong dmag sgar/ cha dang gzim chung me skyogs dmag sgar gsum so sor dbyin ji'i me skyogs ha'o dzar dang / kran pho'o zhes pa'ang yod pa red/bod dmag gi go lag dang / dmag rtsed/ dmag dar/rgya sbyong dmag mi'i go lag ni thog mar sngar gyi gzim pa'i lag cha ltar bod mda' rang yin zhing / dper na rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing 'brug (1904) lor dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul dmag la rgol lan sprod pa'i dmag 'khrug nang rang dmag rgya sbyong dmag dang kong po'i yul dmag sho kar lho gsum gyi yul dmag gi lag cha gtso bo bod mda' dang / gri mdung / 'ur rdo bcas yin 'dug pas dbyin jis zhi 'ching byed tshul gyi rnam 'gyur rdzus ma bstan te rang dmag gi bod mda'i sbi sdi gsod du bcug pa'i lkog g.yo ngan jus 'og dgra phyogs nas 'phrul mda' 'phen te rgya sbyong dmag sgar gyi dbus mda' rnam sras gling pa dang / dbus mda' lha sding sras/ ru dpon dngos gzhi ba can 'go dmag 'ga' zhig bsad pa 155

thesmogs kyi lo rgyus thog nas mtshon thub/ dmag rtsed thad de snga lha sa dang ཿkazhis rtse so sor‘‘sbya'o khrang ’’zhes pa'i rtsed thang chen po re yod pa de ni ching ཿgong ma'i sku tshab am ban la rgya sbyong bod dmag rnams kyis dmag rtsal sbyong ཿbrdar gzigs 'bul zhu sa yin pa rgya skad kyi ca'u phrang zhes pa'i sgra nyams pa :pen tshod/ de'i skabs kyi dmag rtsed rtse stangs ji ltar yin ce na/ de ni ཿdper na/ de snga rme ru grwa tshang gi grwa pa tshogs yongs nas lo 'khor bcu ཿnanyis re'i mtshams‘‘rme ru dpon bzang ’’zhes pa'i 'khrab ston zhig byed lam yod pa de'i rgyal rabs 'khrab gzhung gi zhor du/ sgyu rtsal dang dmag rtsed sogs kyi ltad mo le'u 'ga' zhig rnam pa mtshon byed du 'khrab ston byed srol gyi gras su snga dus sbya'o khrang gi dmag rtsed ces pa zhig 'khrab kyi yod pa ni 'di lta ste/ dmag mi'i 'go byed rnams gyon pa gos chen ser po dang 'og tu gru tsi'i zhan tse lngang se/ lham 'ja' chen/ zhwa mo thu si li (rta rgyug skabs gyon :byed) bcas gyon pa/ lag tu gri 'khyer ba/ dmag dkyus rnams phyu pa snam rgya tshos/ sgog tse dkar po ris nag mo/ lham shol tsi/ zhwa mo sog zhwa bcas gyon pa'i mi khag gcig dang / yang dmag mi stod thung gu thung ser po stag ris can gyon zhing mgo ras ras sngon dkris pa khag gcig bcas phyogs /bag gnyis phan tshun dmag rtsal 'thab res byed khul skabs rnga chen brdung ba dang / sbub dkrol nas rtsal mchongs byed pa dang / de bzhin lag tu shing rdog rdog yu ba ring po yod pa re 'khyer nas phan tshun 'thab res dang / gri mdung 'khyer nas 'thab res byed tshul 'khrab pa'i thog nas snga dus rgya sbyong dmag gi gyon pa dang / dmag rtsed mtshon thub/ dus phyis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya gar nas phyir phebs rjes bod dmag 'phel rgyas btang ba dang chabs cig dmag mi'i chas gos dang / dmag rtsed/ dar cha/156

go mtshon sogs kyang 'gyur ba chen potshobyung zhing / de skabs bod dmag gi dmag chas ni hin rdu dang dbyin ji'i dmag mi'i dmag gos dang 'dra ba ras sa mdog gi stod thung smad thung dang / lham 'jur ta/ zhwa mo thug khog dang keb zhwa yin pa dang / dper na/ cha dang gzim chung me skyogs dmag sgar gyi thog ma'i dmag chas ras sa mdog gi stod thung smad thung thung thung thog ras sngon po'i ri mo'i rgyan ldan dang / ras sngon sul yod kyi gsham thab dum dum/mgo la ras ser gyi la thod ser skud lhung chab kyi rgyan ldan dkris srol yod/dmag sgar khag tshang ma'i mda' dpon rnams ther ma sa mdog gi dmag chas cha tshang dang / lham 'jur ta/ zhwa mo kem dang thug khog zhwa mo'i ngos le gser gyi mo sgor dang thug khog gyon skabs zhwa steng gser gyi phru tog kyang brgyab yod/ tā la'i bla ma pho brang yas mas la chibs bsgyur skabs sogs la mda' dpon rnams kyi gzab gyon dmag chas ni stod thung 'go snam ser por skyin khebs sam rgya se'i rgyan can si shan gyi 'ja' sgrig ris mos brgyan pa/ phyi rgyal nas thon pa'i gser skud‘‘rmug thung ’’zhes pa dpung par 'dogs dgos/ru sgrig‘‘sa lam’’gus 'dud zhu skabs lag tu phyi rgyal nas thon pa'i dmag gri ring po zhig 'khyer dgos pa/ dmag chas kyi smad thung dang zhwa lham gong ltar yin pa phal cher dbyin ji'i dmag dpon gyi dmag chas dang ha cang 'dra po 'dug rjes su srid skyong stag brag skabs ka dang sku srung dmag sgar ma gtogs dmag sgar tshang ma rim pas bod chas la bsgyur te snam sa mdog gi phyu pa gong par rnam rgya thig gi rgyan can/ zhwa mo dbyar kha phying zhwa sa mdogadagun zhwa 'phyi ba'i pags pa'i nang sbyar gyi dmag zhwa/ lham bod bzos shol tse snam bu sa mdog gi yu can bcas la bsgyur ba red/dmag rtsed thad thog mar phyi sog gi mi zhig dge rgan du bsten nas ka 157

dang sku srung dmag sgar la u ru su'i dmag rtsed bslabs nga/ dang / de rjes ri pin gyi mi zhig dmag rtsed dge rgan la bsten te kho par ru dpon gyi go gnas sprad nas gzhung zhabs dkyus ma'i skra cog kyang brgyab yod pa des ri pin gyi dmag rtsed bslabs pa red ces go thos byung / de rjes ka dang sku srung dmag sgar nas dmag mi na gzhon shes rig bkra la gzugs po thang pa mi grangs nyi shu skor dang gzhung zhabs 'ga' zhig bcas hin rdu'i sa khongs ko phrar du dbyin ji'i dmag rtsed lo shas ring slob sbyong byas rjes bod la phyir log gis dmag sgar tshang mar dbyin ji'i dmag rtsed bslabs te dbyin/ ji'i dmag rtsed kyi lam lugs gcig gyur bya rgyur gtan 'khel byas kyang / srid skyong stag brag dang / dmag spyi che ba bka' blon mdo mkhar ba phun tshogs rab rgyas dmag spyi chung ba dza sag mkhe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus dang dza sag skal bzang tshul khrims bcas kyi skabs su dbyin ji'i dmag rtsed kyi lam lugs de dag gi rtsa ba'i nang don dang byed stangs la 'gyur ba btang med rung bkod brda'i sgra dbyin skad de bod skad du mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel la bsgyur du bcug nas bod skad thog nas dmag rtsed kyi bkod brda bya rgyu gtan 'khel byas pa red/bod dmag gis dmag dar gna' dus bod dmag gis dmag 'thab skabs 'khyer 'gro ba'i dmag dar mtshon byed ni lha'i rten thug yin pa 'dra/smon lam rta pa'i 'go 'doms yar sor spyi khyab pa dang / rta dmag sngon la 'dam brgya shog brgyad kyi rta pa 'go dmag rnams kyis gdan zhu byed pa'i srung ma dmar nag (dmar po gnas chung chos skyong rdo rje drag ldan dang nag mo da pal ldan dmag gzor rgyal mo red) gnyis kyi rten thug thug 'ching dar tshon sna lngas brgyan par lcags rtse gsum gyi tog ldan dar gos dkar pos 158

bstums pa rgyug pa'i srog shing bsgar nas gdan zhu byed pa de dmag dar gyi mtshon byed lta bu yin pa red/ dus phyis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku dus su thog mar sa rta(191ra)lo bod dmag gi dmag rtsed dbyin lugs su bsgyur ba dang chabs cig dmag sgar khag gi dar cha tshang ma /gangs ri dkar po'i rtser nyi ma'i 'od zer kha dog sngo dmar bcu gnyis dang ldan pa/ seng ge dkar mo zung gi lag tu nor bu mig gsum 'dzin pa/mtha' lcags ser po yod pa zhig gtan 'bebs byas yod pa dang / de rjes lcags lug ( 1921) lo ka dang sku srung dmag sgar dang / chu spre( 1922)lo grong drag dmag sgar la gong gi dar cha gzhir bzhag thog ral gri'i gzugs la pad+ma dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i tog gi 'og tu tshon sna lnga ldan gyi rgyal mtshan chung chung yod pa zhig bstsal yod pa/ de rjes dmag dar gyi 'grel bshad bskyar bzo byas yod skad/me phag (1947) lor thi ji bsam pho tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang ci/mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal ngo las rnams rgya gar du e sha ya'i tshogs 'dur bod kyi sku tshab ming 'khur gyis skyod skabs dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis jus bskul 'og kha bral ring lugs kyi spyod ngan spel phyir bod kyi dar cha zhig 'khyir dgos stabs de'i ris mo dang / tshon mdog gi nang don 'grel bshad yi ge dmag spyi khang la yod med 'tshol zhib byas kyang ma rnyed pas tsha rong la rtsad gcod byas don tsha rong nas dar cha'i tshon ris kyi 'grel bshad shog lho zhig byung ste bka' shag la phul skad nang don ji yod mig mthong ma byung /dmag mi'i go mtshon thad/rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing stag(1914)lor bshad sgra srid blon ngo 159

las nas sim la'i chings yig bkod rjes dbyin gzhung gis legs 'bul du sprad pa red ces thog mar dbyin mda' kha ring ngo grangs 5000la mde'u cha tshang bcas yod pa nas dmag sgar khag gi lag mdar de snga'i bod mda'i tshab tu rtsis sprod byas 'dug dbyin mda' kha ring de rnams rnying song skul zad ཿsneng spus tshad kyang yag po med pas de rjes dbyin mda' kha thung dang /ma del/ dbyin ji'i me skyogs ha'o dzar dang kran pha'o/ de dag gi mdel/lto rdzas/ phe'u si/ me shin ghan/ lu'u si ghan/ bhi ring ghan sogs dang gzhan yang dmag mi'i rnga dung / 'ba' cha sogs khyon che dbyin gzhung gi lag nas nyo sgrub kyis gzhung zhabs g.yu thog bkra shis don grub dang /lngaṭīng ring / sding bya/ gro spyi spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel/ zhol khang sra sa bsod nams dar rgyas sogs dus rim 'ga' shas byas te ched btang me+e1ga rgya gar brgyud rim pas 'don 'dren byas shing / g.yul mkho'i yo byad de dag gi khongs nas dbyin mda' kha thung rnams kyi ma spor la grwa bzhi glog khang nas bod pa'i ang grangs bkod de rim pas dmag sgar khag gi lag mdar mdel bcas dang / gzhan yang dmag sgar khag la g.yul mkho'i yo byad gzhan dag gang dang gang rtsis sprod byas rigs la bka' tham lag 'dzin 9 didra gnyis bzos te rtsis sprod zhib phra byas yod pa red/ de'i 'phros bsdad rnams dang / lag mda' rnying pa kha ring phyir bsdus kyis lcags po ri'i 'og gi sman chu go mdzod dang / zhol dmag spyi khang gi go mdzod nang bsdu 'jug byas pa'i go mdzod bkar khang so so'i bcug khra'i ma deb la tho zhib bkod yodatshocing / go mdzod khag gnyis kyi bkar khang nas 'don sprod dang / bsdu 9 dijug dgos rigs tā la'i bla ma'am/ srid skyong dang bka' shag bcas par 'char phul phyag rtags dang 'brel dgos la rtse'i sku tshab rtse mgron gcig 160

dang shod sku tshab shod mgron gcig bka' shag ngo tshab bka' shag mgron drung gang rung gcig bcas dang dmag spyi ngo las tshang 'dzoms kyis bsdu 'jug la ma deb bcug khra dang / 'don sprod la bton khra kha gsal zhib bkod thog rtsis sprod bya yul la bka' tham lag 'dzin 'dra gnyis bzos te rtsis sprod byas rjes go mdzod bkar khang so sor rtse shod bka' shag gsum gyi dam bsnan byed pa las dmag spyi khang rang nas 'don 'jug byed pa'i dbang cha med/de snga'i bod ljongs dmag sbyi khang /dmag spyi rim byung ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya gar nas phyir phebs rjes dmag dpung 'phel rgyas btang ba dang dus mtshungs dmag spyi khang dang / dmag spyi zhes pa gzhi nas gsar du byung ste thog ma'i dmag spyi dang po tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i spyan bsal gnam gang ngam/zla bzang dgra 'dul ni lu'u cun dmag 'khrug gi dus skabs nang byas rjes nges can yod ces tsha rong gi bu mo'i go mag tu sbyar nas tsha rong gi sger pa'i ming thog gzhung zhabs zhus te bka' blon gyi go gnas dang dmag spyi che ba gcig lcogs su bskos pa dang / dmag spyi gzhon pa rim bzhi yul lha ba bstan pa tshe dbang la bsko bstsal gyis khong gnyis nas dmag spyi yun ring byas pa red/ de'i skabs dmag spyi khang nas dmag dpung gi drag po'i bya ba che phra tshang ma tā la'i bla ma dang / bka' shag sogs la dgongs skor snyan zhu ma zhus par dmag spyi khang rang nas thag gcod byed rkyang byas stabs gzhung zhabs mtho rim pa'i nang yid mthun mi byed par gleng phyogs bzos nas ngo 161

rgol byed kyi yod thog dmag spyi rgan pa tsha rornga gis gtsos dmag spyi gzhon rnga sga dang / mda' dpon khag gcig re gza' spen pa'i las gseng gi skabs so gas la cin tha'e za khang zhes par 'dzoms te za 'thung byed kyi yod pas/ཿder drag po'i dpon rigs nas srid bsgyur gyi ngan tshogs byed lugs dogs 'char byung ba ma zad/ dus skabs de ni tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i gzigs pa nyams 'gro ba dang / rtsis dpon lung shar ba rdo rje tshe rgyal dang / mgron gnyer chen mo bstan pa dar rgyas (ming 'dogs la chen mo a ra dkar po zer) khong gnyis la gzigs pa rgyas bzhin pa'i sgang yin stabs khong gnyis nas tā la'i bla mar snyan phra mang po 'bul gyi yod skad red/ 'on kyang tsha rong gis gtsos pa'i drag po'i dpon rigs rnams nas drag po'i srid bsgyur bya rgyu'i ngan tshogs byed tshul skor dpang rtags 'di yi na med gshis/ dbang cha sger gcod byed tshul gyi klan la btsal ba ste/ de sngon lo shas gong nya dang mda' dpon sa lung gi 'og brgyad sna'i dmag mi dang / so las mi khongs nas bsdus pa'i sa srung pu li si'i dmag mi phyogs khag dpung bsdebs kyis 'khrug 'dzings byas te phyogs gnyis ka'i dmag mi gsod res btang ba'i don rkyen byung bar dmag spyi khang nas drag gnon gyis khungs so so nas lag dmar ba 'dzin bzung thoganyes can rnams la dbang po gcod breg gi khrims gcod byas pa'i skor tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag la snyan gseng tsam ma zhus par rang 'tshams kyis khrims gcod byed 'dzol skor dang / de min go mdzod kyi 'phrul mda'i grangs 'bor tshang min sogs kyi gnad don skor nas dmag spyi che ba tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul bka' blon gyi go gnas dang dmag spyi gnas dbyung btang ste dza sag gi go gnas su phab/ dmag spyi gzhon pa rim bzhi yul lha ba bstan pa 162 (

tshe dbang rim bzhi dang dmag spyi'i go gnas gnas dbyung btang nas zhabs sdod dkyus mar phab/ skabs der tsha rong gi phyogs gtogs mda' dpon dga' bzhi ba bstan 'dzin nor bu dang / sne sdod pa/ mtsho sgo ba/ lding bya ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs so sor gnad don mi 'dra ba'i le thogs kyi 'gal nyes la brten tshang ma mda' dpon go gnas gnas dbyung btang ste mang che ba zhabs sdod dkyus mar phab pa dang / sne sdod pa ni las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung btang / nga tsho'i mi rabs rgan pa sding bya rdo rje rgyal mtshan yang / de sngon lo shas ring rgya gar gyi sa khongs ko phra dang / shel long du gzhung zhabs gzhan dag dang / sku srung dmag sgar nas dmag mi khag gcig btang ba rnams dang mnyam du bskyod de gtso bo dbyin ji'i me skyogs ha'o dzar dang / kran pho'o rgyag stangs/ de bzhin dbyin ji'i dmag rtsed dang / dmag 'thab skor gyi dmag jus thabs rtsal sogs slob sbyong byed ring phyi rgyal la tsha ba che bas skra breg dgos byung 'dug slob sbyong legs zin gyis phyir 'khor mtshams cha dang gzim chung dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon bskos kyang mdzad sgo khag sogs la skra cog ma brgyab par dmag chas gyon te bcar ba de ni lugs dang mi mthun pa red ces mda' dpon gyi go gnas gnas dbyung btang ste zhabs sdod dkyus mar phab pa sogs don du tsha rong gi 'go gtso byed pa'i drag po'i dpon rigs kyi stobs shugs kha 'thor du btang ba red/de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku tsha khyum pa bar dza sag gi go gnas thog dmag spyi gcig 'thus bsko gzhag bstsal yang bhum pa ba ni dal sdod skyid 'dod kyi g.yeng bas rkyen pas dmag spyi'i las 'gan yag po 'khur ma thub stabs/ dmag spyi'i las 'khur phyir 'then gyis rtsis dpon lung 163

shar rdo rje tshe rgyal la dmag spyi 'tsho 'dzin bsko gzhag bstsal te rtsis dpon dang ཿdmag spyi gcig lcogs dang / las rogs su sku srung mda' dpon snang ཿdkar ba mda' dpon dang dmag spyi gcig lcogs bsko bstsal gyis khong gnyis nas dbang cha chen po yun ring bzung ba red/ de rjes lung shar dang spyan bsal kun 'phel lags dbar 'gal zla byung bar brten lung shar ba'i dmag spyi'i 'gan dbang med pa bzos rjes sku srung mda' dpon snang dkar ba dmag spyi dang sku srung mda' dpon rang 'jags dang / las sbrel du mkhan drung bstan pa 'jam dbyangs la dmag spyi bsko bstsal gyis dmag spyi dang mkhan drung gcig lcogs byas/ de rjes dmag spyi snang dkar ba 'das tshab dza sag mdo mkhar bar dmag spyi bsko gzhag bstsal/ dmag spyi mkhan drung bstan pa 'jam dbyangs bka' blon bla mar gnas spar byas kyang dmag spyi rang 'jags thog dmag spyi che ba zhes pa dang / dmag spyi chung ba dza sag mdo mkhar ba'i las sbrel du mkhan chung skal bzang tshul khrims la dmag spyi bsko gzhag thog de rjes dza sag tu gnas spar yang dmag spyi rang 'jags byas/dmag spyi che ba bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs 'das rjes skabs shig ring dmag spyi gong gsal dza sbrel gyis 'thus pa byas/ dmag spyi dza sag mdo mkhar ba bka' blon du gnas spar byas kyang bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi lam srol ltar dmag spyi che ba gcig lcogs byas/ dmag spyi chung ba dza sag skal bzang tshul khrims kyi las sbrel du dza sag mkhe smad pa bsod nams dbang 'dus la dmag spyi chung ba bsko gzhag byas/ dmag spyi dza sag skal bzang tshul khrims nad mnar dgongs zhus tshab mkhan chung dga' brang blo bzang rin chen la mkhan chung thog dmag spyi chung ba bsko gzhag byed skabs mdo smad khul sogs la gung khran tang gi nyen 'gog gi ched du dmag dpung rgya che bsdu 164

bskong byed pa'i dus skabs yin pas/ dmag spyi'i las rogs su mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang / rtsis dpon rnam gling pa dpal 'byor 'jigs med gnyis drung rtsis yin mus thog dmag spyi'i las rogs su bsko gzhag byas/ dmag spyi mkhan chung dga' brang blo bzang rin chen spyi khyab mkhan por gnas spar bsko gzhag gi tshab mkhan chung blo bzang skal bzang la mkhan chung thog dmag spyi bsko gzhag byas pa bcas gong gsal bod dmag gi dmag spyi rim byung gi lo rgyus ni 1959zing 'khrug ma langs bar gyi gnas tshul yin/dmag sbyi khang gi sgrig gzhi dang 'gan dbang /rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu rta (1942)lor dmag drung rag rtsis pa gnas lnga pa 'phyongs rgyas rdzong sdod du 'phos tshab nga rang sding bya tshe ring rdo rjer dmag drung bsko gzhag gis lo drug tsam las 'khur byas shing / de'i skabs su dmag spyi las khungs kyi sgrig gzhi ni dmag spyi che ba bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / dmag spyi chung ba dza sag mdo mkhar ba dang dza sag skal bzang tshul khrims gsum gyi 'go khrid 'og las bya rim bzhi chab spel ba 'jigs med kun dga' dang / rjes su rim bzhi chab spel ba phebs 'gor (phebs byams 'go pa)'phos tshab rim bzhi tshes gsum phun khang skal bzang phun tshogs la bsko gzhag byas/ las tshan bye'u lham bzo ba/ rtse drung tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ dmag drung nor rgyas nang pa dang / rjes su nor nang pa gnas drug pa sa dga' 'go par 'phos tshab shod drung 'jun pa ngag dbang dpal yon dmag drung bsko gzhag byas pa dang / dmag drung 165

gcig nga rang yin pa bcas la dmag spyi ngo las zer/ de'i 'og tu ka ca nya pu li si bcas nas ched bskongs bod yig shes pa lding dpon gyi go gnas dang / phogs thob yod pa yig 'bri mi bzhi/ go mdzod srung bya dang dmag spyi khang gi gar dgos las 'gan sgrub mi tha dang brgya dpon gcig dang /dmag dkyus mi grangs lnga bcu tham pa/ khang srung cha dang lding dpon ga/cig dang / ma byan ta dang lding dpon gcig bcas ni dmag spyi las khungs kyi sgrig gzhi'i mi sna'i rim pa red/dmag spyi khang gi 'gan dbang thad dmag spyi khang zhes pa bod ljongs dmag sgar yongs kyi drag po'i 'go 'doms dbang cha che shos shig yin gshis/des lha sar bca' sdod dmag sgar khag dang / gzhan yang mdo smad khul dang / bya rigs khul/ gzhis rtse sogs la sa srung du yod pa'i dmag sgar khag gi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor gyi bya ba che phra tshang mar 'go khrid byed dgos pa ste dmag khrims gnon 'doms dang / dmag sbyong dang tsha sbyong la lta zhib/ dmag sgar khag gi dmag phogs 'don sprod/ dmag dpung gi gyod don sna tshogs la zhib dpyad thag gcod/ nyen 'gog sa srung ched drag po'i g.yul 'gyed dgos pa'i bya gzhag sogs dmag spyi khang brgyud nas thag gcod byed dgos kyang / 'gangs che'i rigs dmag spyi khang nas tā la'i bla ma dang srid skyong / bka' shag bcas la snyan seng dgongs skor dang /'char phul phyag rtags zhus te thag gcod byed dgos/ spyir btang byas na las bya rnams dmag spyi'i mdzub ston 'og 'char 'phar gyi las don mnyam sgrub dgos rigs phud/ rgyun gtan las bya so sor 'gan 'khur gyi las don mi 'dra ba yod pa ni dper na/ bka' shag nas dmag spyi khang du gyod zhib byed rgyur sprad pa'i rigs dang / gzhan yang dmag spyi khang rang la thad 166

kar zhu tho phul 'byor ltar dmag mi'i skor gyi gyod don sna tshogs/ mi bsad kyi gyod gzhi'i rigs sogs do bdag so sor zhu ba zhu len gyis dri zhib dang /thag gcod kyi dpyad phra bzo rgyu/ 'gangs che'i skor 'char 'bul phyag rtags zhu dgos rigs kyi 'char gzhi bzo rgyu sogs lta bu ni gtso bo las bya rim bzhi dang las tshan pa rtse drung bcas nas 'gan 'khur gyis bsgrub dgos/dmag drud gnyis kyi las 'gan ni/ dmag spyi khang gi go mdzod yas mas nang bsdu 'jug byas pa'i g.yul mkho'i yo byad bcug bton gyi deb gzhung dang / byang rigs 'brog khul nas yul dmag gi dmag dod bsdu gzhung dang / dmag sgar khag gi dmag mi'i ming gzhung / mdo smad sa srung khag gi dmag phogs 'bru dngul sogs mdo spyis thag gcod byed dgos pa phud/ de byings sa srung gi phogs 'bru 'brel mtshungs rdzong gzhis gang rung gi bkar steng nas 'don sprod dgos pa'i bka' tham bton rgya 'bri rgyu/dngul phogs grwa bzhi las khungs kyi gzhung dngul steng nas zhu rgyu'i bka' tham 'dzin yig byung song rtsis zhu'i bka' tham lag 'dzin bcas kyi ma zin yig rigs/ gyod don gyi dpyad phra/ phyag rtags stsal rgyu'i 'char gzhi khag gzengs bstod dang nyes bcad kyi yig cha/ ru brgya lding bcas gsar bsko'i 'os 'char gyi snyan zhu/ dmag tshab gsar 'dzugs dgos skor dmag spyi khang gi bkod rgya'i zin bris sogs dmag spyi khang gi yig rigs mtha' dag 'bri rgyu dang yig char bdag gnyer yig tshag gi 'gan 'khur dgos pa ma zad/gal che'i rigs la dkar chag zhib bkod kyis dmag drung 'phos len skabs las bya su rung zhig nas sprod dpang byas te dmag drung gsar par rtsis sprod khungs skyel zhu dgos/ gzhan yang lha sar bca' sdod ka dang sku srung dmag sgar dang / kha dang grwa bzhi rgya sbyong dmag sgar/ da dang pu li si dmag sgar 167

sogs dmag sgar khag gi khang srung dang go mdzod srung bya'i dmag mi/ sman rtsis khang du dmag sgar khag nas ched btang gi sman rtsis slob phrug bcas khungs so sos zla ba re re bzhin zla phogs zhu rgyu'i mi 'bor 'phar chag gi ming tho rnams dmag spyi khang du phul 'byor la/ dmag drung gnyis nas zhib (rajug gis dmag dkyus rer zla re phogs 'bru ru'i khal gcig dang bre bco :brgyad re dang ja mar tsha bul dod sngar lam bod dngul srang do zho lnga tsam re'i thog lding dpon dang / me skyogs me char dge rgan ru brgya bcas par go gnas la gzhigs pa'i skal 'phar thob lam ltar rtsa ba'i grangs 'bor thog bsnan te 'bru dngul ji thob khungs so sor ngos sbyor sprod rgyu (de nas dmag sgar rang khungs so sos zhol spyi phogs khang nas len dgos) sa srung dmag sgar khag dang / lha sar bca' sdod dmag sgar khag gi dbyar dgun gyon dod sngar lam dmag rer bod dngul srang bcu gnyis re dang dmag gla dmag mi rer lo re bod dngul srang bzhi brgya lnga bcu re lo ltar dmag 'khri gla bdag gi lag nas bsdu len dang / skabs re lo gnyis gsum re'i mtshams dmag mi rer dbyar dgun gyon dod bsdu len ma dgos par snam spu phrug 'doms bcu bzhi re dang tshem gla dang tshos gla dmag rer bod dngul srang lnga bcu nas brgyad cu'i bar gcig tu ma nges rdo don rdzong gzhis so so'i khongs kyi dmag 'khri gla bdag nas le thogs med par dbyar dgun gyon bsdu byed po brgya lding bcu dpon thog rtsis sprod byed dgos pa'i bsdu gzhung dang / lag 'khyer dmag spyi khang gi las dam 'byar ma dang / 'gel khal bzhon rta'i lam yig bka' shag gi dam 'byar dgos pa dmag spyi brgyud bka' shag la dam zhus kyis gyon bsdu byed po so sor rtsis sprod byed dgos(dmag spyi khang nas btang ba'i lag 'khyer dang / bsdu gzhung / lag 'dzin/ byung 'dzin/168

bka' rgya/ dpyad khra sogs tshang mar dmag spyi khang gi las tham phab yod na yang / gsham du dus skabs so so'i dmag spyi las thog ngo ma'i lag bris kyi sa yig rgyag lam rgyun 'khyongs byed pa de dag dmag spyi tsha rong skabs nas dar ba yin skad/)dmag sgar khag gi ru brgya lding bcas gsar bsko byed stangs kyi lam srol ni/ ru dpon gsar bsko'i 'os dang gnyis kyi ming tho'i 'os 'char dmag sgar rang khungs so sos dmag spyi khang la sprad rjes dmag spyi khang nas bka' shag brgyud srid skyong la phul te phyag rtags stsal thon mtshams shod 'gag brgyud sne mgron nas bka' bsgyur gyis bsko gzhag byed srol dang /brgya lding gnyis kyi 'os dang 'os 'char dmag sgar so sos dmag spyi khang la sprad de dmag spyis chog mchan bkod rjes dmag spyi khang gi 'gag nas dmag drung su rung zhig gis bka' bsgyur btang ste bsko srol mchis/'go dmag nad 'das dang / yul byol/ nyes khrims btang ste phyir phud kyi tshab gsar bsdu rgyu'i skor dmag sgar so so nas ming tho phul 'byor ltar dmag spyi khang nas dmag mi'i 'khri khungs gla bdag la tshab gsar dmag mi rang lo 1rdonas rang lo 25bar spyang grung dod cing dbang po skyon med/gzugs gzhi thang po bcas kyi ngo ma gcig dang / 'dra gcig 'khri khungs gla bdag dang bcas dmag spyi khang du dus 'byor rdzong brda rgyag dgos pa'i skor dmag spyi khang nas rdzong gzhis so sor bkod rgya gtong dgos/ 'byor mtshams ngo ma der ‘‘lag thel ’’(lag par gyon byed bal gyis lhas pa'i sgrog gdub lta bu'i sgor sgor zhig yod pa )la dam phrug phab ste sprad nas dmag mir 'jug srol dang / ‘‘lag thel ’’der dmag mi so sos ko bas bstums nas bdag gces byed dgos/ dmag mi yul byol phyin pa yin na gla bdag la 169

nyes pa gser srang bcu zhes don snying bod dngul srang dgu bcu go drug re sgrub dgos pa dang / dmag mi yul byol pa 'dzin bzung thub na rta lcag lnga bcu tham pa btang ste phyir 'bud dam rang 'jags 'jog 'os dmag spyi khang nas thag gcod byed kyi red/dmag spyi khang gi dpal 'byor yong 'bab/dmag spyi khang gi dpal 'byor yong 'bab ni gtso bo sngar rgyal po lha bzang khang dang / pho lha tha'i ji'i dus su srid dbang 'phrog res kyi nang 'khrug rim byung skabs byang rigs sde bzhi'i khongs 'dam brgya shog dang /nag tshang / sa dga'/ phyogs bcu stod smad/ 'brong pa/ shing sger/ltag sgo la rgyab/ phra tshang sogs 'brog sde mang po zhig nas yul dmag bsdu bskong byas rigs phyis ming gzhung gzhir bzung yul dmag 'khri khungs rnams nas dmag mi ngo 'dzugs ma dgos par dmag dod 'gel bkod byas pa'i dngul 'bab khyon che dmag spyi khang la 'bab pa dang / dmag spyi sger gyis btang ba'i bsdu 'ded mi snas dmag spyi khang gi bsdu 'ded lag khyer 'khyer te sa gnas/ khag tu bsdu 'ded byas pa'i yag dod (bsdu 'ded 'gro mis dmag dod bsdu rgyur khag btags nas bal 'bor chen spus nyos kyis rgya gar du tshong bsgyur byed kyi yod pas de ni mi ser thog rtsa ba'e dmag dod las/ bshu gzhog gi brdab gsig che ba yod pa red) gzhan yang dmag spyi khang gi yang steng dgra lha khang sogs kyi lha mi'i mchod thebs su dmigs pa'i lho kha dol khul nas dmag dod 'bru 'bab dang / byang 'brog sbas tshang khul u ru rong du de snga gnas chung sku rten zhig gi she 'bri khag gzhung bzhes btang ba'i mar 'bab/170

gong gsal dmag sgar khag gi dmag mi yul byol song rigs dmag 'khri gla bdag la nyes pa gtong srol gyi dngul 'bab/ dmag dod sogs kyi ma dngul steng nas gzhan dag la bun btang gi skyed 'bab sogs ni dmag spyi khang gi dpal 'byor gyi yong khungs red/dmag spyi ngo las so sor phogs thob dang de min gyi yong 'bab thad/phogs thob bka' tham lag 'dzin nang gsal lo re dmag spyi ngo ma so sor bod dngul srang 1000re dang / dmag spyi'i las bya rim bzhir bod dngul srang 750las tshan par bod dngul srang 500dmag drung gnyis dang las bya rtse drung dkyus ma gcig so sor bod dngul srang 250re yod la/ de min dmag spyi sogs la dmag sgar gang 'os nas dmag mi g.yog khongs 'then chog pa'i gtan 'bebs gzhir bzung dmag spyi ngo ma so sor dmag mi bdun re dang / las bya rim bzhir dmag mi lnga/ las tshan par dmag mi bzhi/dmag drung gnyis dang / las bya rtse drung dkyus ma gcig so sor dmag mi gsum re bcas bskongs bskul bya rgyu yod pa dang/ g.yog khongs kyi dmag mi de dag la mi rer zla re gzhung phogs 'bru ru'i khal 1bre1ṭ+wāṃre dang ja tshwa sogs kyi dod sngar lam bod dngul srang do zho lnga skor zla ba so sor phogs len bcu dpon gyis dmag spyi ngo las la rtsis 'bul byas pa rnams dang / lo ltar dmag bdag nas dmag gla dang dbyar dgun gyon dod sogs lo re'i dbyar gyon bsdu 'ded pa so sos dmag spyi ngo las so sor rtsis 'bul byas pa rnams bcas dmag mi spyi mtshungs len rgyu yod pa ma zad/ dmag spyi khang nas nyin so sor las ka gtso che ba gang byas la zla ba re'i mtshams su shod 'gag tu las tho snyan zhu re phul te nyin re las dod ces sngar lam bod dngul srang do re sprod srol de dag lo 'khor mtshams ngo las tshang ma cha snyoms kyis bgos 'grems 171

byas pa'i thob cha'ang len rgyu yod pa red/smon lam rta pa dang gzim pa'i skor/dmag drung gnyis nas lo ltar lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i rjes 'brel smon lam rta pa'i 'khri khungs las tshan 'phos len byung rigs kyi ming bsgyur byed rgyu dang / ru g.yas g.yon gyi rta pa rnams grangs 'bor mang nyung cha snyoms byas te rta pa'i ru gzhung zin bris shig bzos thog rtsis khang las khungs su zhib 'jug gnang rgyur 'phul dgos pa dang / rtsis khang nas zhib 'jug zin mtshams yar sor spyi khyab pas yi ge 'bru tsa bris nas ru gzhung gtan 'khel byed srol yod/smon lam rta pa'i 'khri khungs khag gnyis te gcig ni lo ltar 'gyur ba med par gtan 'jags gtong dgos pa'i gras g.yas ru dang po thu chi 'u cu sde dpon dga' bzhi ba rta pa 2 0dang / g.yon ru dang po thu chi nor phog yab gzhis bsam grub pho brang pa rta pa 2 0sde dpon mdo mkhar ba rta pa 12sger lha klu dga' tshal ba rta pa12‘‘gzhung sog rgyal po yab sras ’’zhes 'dam brgya shog pa rta pa 12 ('dam brgya shog pa'i sa rigs sems can mi rtsa dang bcas pa'i bdag dbang phyis ser rwa bla spyir sprad pas 'dam brgya shog gi smon lam rta pa rnams kyang ser rwa bla spyis gtong srol) 'khri khungs gcig shos ni so so'i go gnas 'dzin rgyun ring gtong dgos pa'i gras bka' blon gsum so sor rta pa 2 4re rgya sbyong mda' dpon dbus mda' gnyis dang / gtsang khul rgya sbyong mda' dpon gtsang mda' bzhi so sor rta pa 1rare/ rtsis dpon bzhi so sor rta pa 9re/ lha zhol gnyer mi dpon bzhi so sor rta pa 7re/ rtswa gnyer 172

dang rtsam bzhes pa gnyis dang chibs che gnyis/ bka' mgron drung gsum/bka' shag shod pa gsum rtsis pa gsum bcas so sor rta pa 6re/ bka' shag shod 'gag pa gsum so sor rta pa 5re bcas ru g.yas g.yon so sor rta pa mi grangs 250skor yod pa rnams bsdoms na rta pa ngo grangs 500lhag tsam yod pa red/smon lam rta pa'i chas gos ni dper na/ smon lam chen mo'i rjes 'brel gyi nang tshan grwa bzhi rtsis bsher zhes pa grwa bzhi thang du gur phub ste bka' shag dang shod skor gzhung zhabs tshang ma 'dzoms par gong gsal rta pa rnams bka' shag sa dbang rnam pa'i mdun du tshang bsher gtong skabs kyi byed sgo'i thog nas gsal po mtshon zhing / de yang grwa bzhi rtsis bsher nyin thog mar shod drung gcig nas rta gzhung gi go rim bzhin rta grangs tshang min snyan seng zhu dgos pa ste shod drung des rta grangs tshang bsher re re bzhin btang nas bka' blon rnams kyi mdun du bskyod de ‘‘g.yas ru dang po thu chi 'u cu sde dpon dga' bzhi ba gzab 'don dang bcas rta pa nyi shu tham pa 'grigs lags ’’zhes brjod/ de rjes rtsis phrug bzhi sbang sgrig pa'i dang po des gong ltar bskyod de ‘‘rta shed bzang mi go thang rta sga sga 'khor cha lag cha tshang dang bcas pa 'grigs lags ’’zhes dang / rtsis phrug gnyis pa des ‘‘sog rmog gshol ldan 'ja' la'i rma mdongs me long bzhi thag bcas byang khebs dang bcas pa 'grigs lags ’’zhes pa rtsis phrug gsum pa des ‘‘go cha'i a khrab kha sha'i gshag dor dpa' dam 'u thu zug 'go shub kha gsar rta mdung sog rnga dang bcas pa 'grigs lags’’zhes pa/ rtsis phrug bzhi pa des ‘‘sag btags mda' gzhu rgyun bcas me mda'i cha lag cha tshang dang bcas pa 'grigs lags’’zhes so sos skad gsang mthon pos brjod de snyan seng zhu dgos/ de dag gi 173

thog nas gna' snga mo'i rta dmag gi chas gos ji yen yang mtshon thub/ da dung de'i nyin yar sor spyi khyab 'go dmag dang / 'dam brgya shog pa'i rta pa 'go dmag nas shar phyogs su kha gtad de gus 'dud thengs sa/sumyo/ zhu ba de ni rgya nag gong mar sngar srol gus 'dud zhu lugs mutshon tshul red ces rgan rabs kyi ngag rgyun las thos myong /lo ltar smon lam chen mo'i mdzad sgo'i skabs ru nang ma'i gzim pa ldingatshokhag 'go dmag rnams bcar dgos/ de'ang / gzim pa zhes pa ni snga/ra sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dus su btsugs par grags shing / dus phyis smon lam gyi byed sgo'i ring de'i 'go 'doms dmag drung gnyis nas zhor lcogs kyis byed dgos kyi 'dug gzim pa lding tsāg gi thad ka'i 'go khrid dbus mdas (dbus khul mda' dpon) btsugs pa'i go mdzod gnyer ri gnyis dang / de 'og mda' bzang bzhi zhes yod pa (de'i 'khri khungs sger ram pa ba dang zhol khang pa/ spel bzhi ba/ sde drug bla brang bcas yin si red) gzim pa lding khag re'i 'og la gzim dmag bco lnga nanu/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar sna tshogs yod cing / cha snyoms byas na gzim lding bcu skorari pa gzim dmag grangs 2 00lhag tsam gzim pa'i nang rbang dang / ljab /sa rkyang gtong mkhan dbu che chung dang / tshogs chen dbu mdzad ces pa bcas yod pa de dag ni gzim pa 'go dmag gi sgrig gzhi'i rnam pa red/gzim pa ni gna' bo'i dmag dpung gi rnam pa can zhig yin pas/'khrab rmog gyon zhing / bod mda' dang / gri/ mdung / phub bcas khyer ba/ dmag rtsed ni ‘‘go rtsed’’ces phyogs khag gnyis su bgos te 'thab rtsal 'gran pa'i rnam pa mtshon byed byed pa dang / ‘‘rbad’’zhes nga/ phan tshun brjid nyams kyi ngar sgra sgrogs pa ‘‘ljas/sa rkyang ’’zhes lha la gsol bstod kyi 174

nang don ldan pa'i gdangs ring gtong ba sogs byed srol mchis/ gzim pa lding khag rnams lo ltar bod zla 12tshes 10tshun phyogs so so nas zhol dpa' bo'i lding khang zhes pa snga dus gzim pa'i dmag sgar yin pa der 'du 'dzoms byed kyi yod tshod kyang / phyis zhol dpa' lding ar ngo 'i do dam las khungs tshugs yul du sprad stabs gzim pa rnams po ta la'i rgyab glang khang gi mdun du 'dzoms te go rtsed dang / go gsol sogs nang sbyong dang 'brel lo smon mdzad sgo'i nang rang 'khri'i byed sgo le thogs med pa dgos rgyu'i skor dmag drung nas bka' bsgyur dang / go mdzod gnyer pas lo smon ring nyin so so'i byed sgo rim pa rag rim tsam gzim lding 'go dmag rnams la ngo sprod gsal bshad byed srol dang / zla 12tshes 15nyin gzim lding 'go dmag rnams dang / dmag drung bcas nyi ma shar tsam du zhol rdo ring nang mar 'du 'dzoms kyis rtse gzim chung 'gag tu tā la'i bla ma dang / srid skyong gi mjal khar bcar te sngar srol 'byor phyag zhus thog snam sbubs sogs kyi gnang cha yod pa rnams zhus zin rjes rtse bde yangs shar gyi gzhung sgo thon pa dang gzim pa'i khongs naṭashrī me pa(bod mda' stong mda' rgyag mkhan ) rnams kyis zil rngams dang ldan pa'i rbad shod bzhin du rtse pho brang du bskor bar bskyod srol 'dug pa de skor sa/na rabs kyi bshad srol ltar na/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ni grub mtha' ris su ma phyes bar bzhed stabs dge lugs pa'i dgon khag la dmigs bsal gyi rgyab skyor med rkyen ser 'bras dga' gsum nang lha bzang khang la dga' zhen byed mkhan mang ngo yod pas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / lha bzang khang gnyis 'gal zlar gnas pa'i gnas tshul 'og ser 'bras dga' gsum smon lam tshugs pa'i skabs dus zings mi 'byung ba'i ched 'jigs rngams zil gnon lta bu 'di dang de 'dra ba smon lam ring 175

gzim lding gi byed sgo spel dgos don yang de ltar red ces brjod srol 'dugazla 12tshes 29nyin dmag drung dang gzim lding 'go dmag rnams rtse po ta la'i bde yangs shar du 'dzoms te rnam rgyal grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling nas dgu gtor gyi 'cham gzigs ma don gong gzim lding 'go dmag nas sngar lam go rtsed dang / dmag sbyong gi rnam pa mtshon pa'i ru g.yas g.yon byas te mda' mdung bod mda' bcas kyi dmag rtsal gzigs 'bul zhus dgos la/ 'cham gzigs grub rjes zhol rdo ring phyi mar gtor gzor 'phen 'phral gzim lding me pa bas bod mda' stong mda' 'phen thog g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rten 'brel mtshon par byed/ lo ltar zla 1tshes 2nyin gzim pa lding khag 'go dmag rnams khag gsum du bgos nas gtong lam bzhin khag gcig gnas chung chos skyong spyan 'dren zhu ba'i gzab gsol zhu sgor gnas chung du bskyod dgos pa dang / khag gcig dga' ldan dar chen sku bzhengs zhu bar bcar dgos pa/ dmag drung dang / mad/'a bzang gnyis/ go mdzod gnyer pa gcig gzim lding 'go dmag phyed lhag tsam bcas rdzong rgyab tu tshes gsum thog mda'i mdzad sgor bka' shag gi sa dbang rnams dang / dza tha'i rim bzhis gtsos shod skor tshang ma dang / rtse gnyer tshang / bla phyag phogs dpon/ zhol gnyer bcas rtse skor yin na'ang phebs dgos kyi 'dug skabs de'i gzhung phyogs kyi rgyang mda' 'phen mkhan mda' bzang rnams dang / de bzhin bka' blon so so'i mda' pa/mda' dpon so so'i mda' pa/ 'dam brgya shog gi mda' pa 'ju 'bang sogs nas rgyang ring thung gi mda' 'phen 'gran bsdur byed dgos pa ste 'ju thal rgyang ma bcas mda' mi 'dra ba khag gsum 'phen dgos/ ang grangs dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa bcas la tshan grangs (dar sna lnga ) dang /176

rta re/ de byings rim bzhin ja 'khor drug dang / tshan grangs/ kha btags bcas sprod srol yod/ de skabs gzim pas go gsol dang / go rtsed brtsed nas mdzad sgo grol gyi red/bod zla 1tshes 15nub mo bco lnga mchod par tā la'i bla ma dang srid skyong mchod gzigs su chibs sgyur skabs bka' shag dang / drung rtsis sogs rtse shod drung rigs dang / gdan sa khag gi bla sprul mkhan po las sne bcas chibs zhabs su bcar dgos pa dang / dmag sgar khag nas bar skor khor yug tu ru star rkyang sgrig gis bde 'jags srung skyob byed dgos la/ dmag drung gis gtsos gzim lding 'go dmag gis kyang bar skor khor yug srang lam khag nas chibs sgyur ma grub bar mi gang byung mi gtong ba'i bkag sdom byed ched thag rgya bkram ste srung 'doms kyi 'gan 'khur byed dgos/ bod zla 1tshes 24smon lam gtor rgyag nyin dmag drung gnyis dang / gzim lding 'go dmag rnams zhogs pa nyi ma ma shar gong zhol rdo ring phyi mar 'du 'dzoms kyis go gsol sogs gna' srol dmag rtsal rtsed sbyong lam rob tsam nang sbyong byas rjes de nas brngams 'jigs ldan pa'i ngang gzim pa me pa rnams kyis lam du 'gro gin bod mda' stong mda' rgyag bzhin du rtse pho brang la bskor ba byed cing / dgon gseb shar du 'byor skabs go mdzod gnyer pas sngorge tshud nas gra sgrig byas pa'i gzim pa'i dkyil sgar du 'du 'dzoms byed cing /der yar sor spyi khyab dang / yar g.yog smon lam rta dmag 'dam brgya shog pa'i yar sor rta pa 'go dmag bcaso kyang rang so so'i dkyil sgar du tshang 'dzoms byed/ yar sor spyi khyab pa'i dkyil sgar las gur du yar sor ngo las dang / 'dam brgya shog pa'i 'go pa/ gzim lding 'go pa 'dzomanu/ pa'i sar gzhung nas sngar srol ston chen sder mchongs zhes pa'i kha zas dang /177

shing 'bras/ sha ston zhig gshom srol dang / de rjes yar sor spyi khyab pas gtsos pa'i 'go pa rnams kyis shar phyogs la kha gtad nas gus 'dud thengs gsum zhu dgos kyi 'dug pa/ de yang bshad srol ltar na ston mo de dag de sngon gong mas gsol ras gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu'i ched gus 'dud zhus pa red zer/ de rjes dgon gseb shar du so so'i dkyil sgar la ngal gso dang lto chas za 'thung zin mtshams yar sor rta pa 'go dmag rnams dgon gseb shar nas thon te bar skor la bskyod/ de nyin rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang 'bras spungs sngags pa grwa tshang gnyis nas sngar srol gtor rgyag byed pa'i gtor gzigs su tā la'i bla ma dang srid skyong rnam gnyis gtsug lag khang gzim chung du chibs sgyur gnang yod stabs yar sor ngo las dang / 'damyo/ brgya shog pa'i yar sor ngo las rnams kyis 'khyams rwa'i sgo 'phyor 'og tu phyag 'tshal zhu dgos/ rta pa'i byed sgo zin 'phral bar skor du bskyod/ de nas gzim pa 'go dmag rnams bar skor du bod mda' rgyag gin bskyod dgos pa//dbus mda' gnyis dang / dmag drung / go gnyer gzim pa lding dpon/gzim pa'i tshogs chen dbu mdzad ces pa bcas nas gtsug lag khang gi gzigs gdong du phyag 'tshal zhus rjes gzim lding 'go dmag gis go gso'/ dang / rbad dang / ljags rkyang gtong ba/ gzim pa gyon pa dkar ser gyon pa gnyis nas bod mda' dang / mda' mdung 'phen tshul gyi dmag rtsal gzigs 'bul zhu dgos pa/ gzim pa rnams nas rtsal sbyong ‘‘zhag sgor mo ’’dang ‘‘'bud sgor ’’zhes pa sogs kyi gzigs 'bul zhus zin bstun klu sbug ritu gtor gzor 'phen sar gzim lding 'go dmag rnams bskyod nas gtor mjug tu bod mda' stong 'phen byed pa dang / dus mtshungs klu sbrug na/ ther dmag gzor rdo spungs kyi 'gram nas gzim pa'i khongs gtogs shel 178

grong gnam lcags lding pa 'go dmag rnams nas bod kyi snga rabs kyi me skyogs khro lug brgyab ste bzos pa'i mdong mo 'dra ba ‘‘srin mo bgres gzhon ’’dang ‘‘gnod sbyin kha 'bar ma’’zhes pa sogs 'ga' zhig 'dug pa de'i nang bod rdzas dang / zhwa nye'i mde'u chen po re bcug thog shing bzo dbu chen gcig gis mtho dma'i thig tshad blangs nas so lta byas rjes gnam lcags lding dpon gyis rna rdzas la sbi sdi spar te chu pha rol gyi bya brgya ri'i ri sked tsam la brag rdo chen por sbra tshal nag po g.yogs pa'i 'ben la 'phen srol mchis/zla 1tshes 25nyin zhogs pa nam lang tsam la bar skor du ‘‘byams pa gdan 'dren ’’zhu skabs gsung chos rwa bar gzim pa 'go dmag rnams ru g.yas g.yon gnyis re re bzhin ber ka rdo 'gyogs zhes rdo chen ril mo zhig bkyag ste skor ba kha shas rgyag dgos pa dang / ber ka re re bzhin shugs rtsal 'gran nas rgyal ba rnams la kha btags sprod srol dang / de dag zin bstun rta rgyugs mi rgyugs kyi 'gran bsdur gzigs 'bul byas par ang rim bkod pa'i shing byang re sprod cing / shing byang gi ang grangs gzhir bzung gzigs bzos sprod pa dang / tshes 26nyin rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen zhes lha klu skor gyin gshongs su dkyil gur phub ste bka' shag dang / shod skor dza tha'i rim bzhi dang / sras rnam pa/ drung dkyus sogs kyi mdun du yar sor rta pa ru g.yas g.yon bsdoms 500skor re re bzhin nas rta thog nas bod mda' gcig dang / mda' gnyis re 'ben gsum so sor rgyugs thengs gcig la 'phen pa'i rta rgyugs kyi sgyu rtsal 'gran bsdur gzigs 'bul byed skabs dmag drung gnyis nas 'ben la me tsha dang / mda' tsha ji byung so so'i ming gsham tsha tho bkod nas dbus mdas tsha tho bklags rjes bla brang phyag mdzod nas tsha dar kha btags g.yogs rjes rta pa so sos 4dzog yus ’’zhes 179

sog skad kyi gus 'dud zhu dgos pa/ tshes 27nyin rdzong rgyab tu gnam mda' chen mo zhes cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i mdzad sgo yongs su grol ba'i grol ston chen mo'i nyin bka' shag sogs shod skor rnams 'dzoms pa/de'i zhogs pa gzim lding 'go dmag rnams nas go gsol dang / go rtsed sogs kyi gzigs 'bul dang / de rjes mda' pa 'khri khungs so sos rgyang mda' 'gran sdur byed par rgyang ring thung gi ang grangs bkod de gzigs bzos sprod stangs ni gong gsal tshes gsum thog mda'i mdzad lam dang gcig mtshungs red/ dgong dro gzhung zhabs nang nas bi shu'i mda' rtsal 'gran par tsha dar g.yogs rjes smon lam chen mo'i rjes 'brel dang bcas pa yongs su zin pa'i srol ston gyi bsangs btang ste mdzad sgo grol gyi red/gzim pa 'go dmag rnams la lo smon skabs kyi byed sgo so sor bla phyag dang /zhol las khungs/ rtse gnyer tshang sogs nas ja mar dang thug rgyu rtsam sdor/chang rgyu 'bru bcas gtong sgo len rgyu yod pa de dag sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gzim lding 'go dmag la gzigs bskyangs chen po yod pa'i skabs kyi gnang lam ltar las khungs khag nas sprod lugs kyi bshad srol 'dugagazim pa rnams lo re'i smon lam skabs kyi byed sgo rnams zin rjes rnam kun rang khungs so sor phyir log byed pa bcas so/180

hor tsho so dgu'i nang tshan khyung po dkar nag ser gsum dang de'i ya gyal nag ru dpon tshang gi lo rgyus rags bsdus/chab mdo srid gros kyi shes rab rgya mtshos/khyung po dkar nag ser gsum gyi lo rgyus khag cig lha sgrung lta bur snang bas zhib 'god ma lang / 'dir chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis zhang rgyal li mun bsgrungs zhes pa nas 'god rgyur/ bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang zhang zhung rgyal po li mun gyi skabs su khri srong lde btsan gyis zhang rgyal li yun sku bsgrungs/ zhang sde dang khyung po'i gdung rgyud mang po yod pa thor bur song nas dbus gtsang khul dang / mdo smad rgyal rong yan gang sa gang du khyab/khyung a bla'i sras rgyud gsum gyi sras lcam dral sgar tsho chen po zhig byang rgyud nas phebs pa rma yi char khri (da lta rma la bzhi)zer bar sgar rgyab nas bzhugs/de nas khyung a bla'i sras rgyud gsum gyi sras phyung rgod grags pa ser tsha ru bzhugs/ khyung ye shis rgyal mtshan dkar rur bzhugs/ khyung nang so kun dga' blo gros nag rur bzhugs te so sor gdan sa 'dzin/ dus de nas bzung khyung dkar nag ser gsum gyi sde ming thogs shing / khong rnam pas blo dpon gnyis 'dzin gyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang bar grags/ 181

dkar ru stod smad gnyis su gyes pa'i skor/khyung dkar nag ser gsum chags nas dus yun gang tsam song rjes dkar rur yod pa'i khyung po sku mched kha gyes te dkar ru stod smad gnyis chags/ dkar stod la bzhugs pa'i khyung po rgyal sa tshul khrims sku gshegs nas gdung rgyud rdzogs/ dkar smad la bzhugs pa'i khyung por lo 'ga'i mtshams nas sku mched sras gnyis byung nas de'ang so sor bsdad de sde chen dang / sde chung zer ba gnyis chags/ rjes su sde pa che chung nang 'khrug nas sde chung mi rtsa rgod pas sde chen pham nyes phung thor du song / sde chung gis dpon sa gcig 'dzin byas/ khyung rgyud ma chad phyis su'ang yod par bshad/ser tsha khag gnyis su gyes pa'i skor/ser tsha la bzhugs pa khyung rgod gracigs pa'i rgyud rim 'ga' zhig song mtshams de'ang khag gnyis su gyes pa da lta bya ze dang / sgar khong zer ba de red/ de gnyis la da bar khyung rgyud ma chad ngo ma yin pa'i shod srol yod/dkar stod khyung rgyud chad rjes brag g.yab skyong lung mda' nas yong ba'i bu spun gyis dpon sa bzung ste dkar nag nang 'khrug byung ba'i skor/brag g.yab skyong lung mda' nas yong ba'i pha blo bzang dang / bu rgan pa a rbang / chung ba mthu stobs zer ba pha bu gsum dkar ru tshang la mgo btags zhus nas bsdad/ de skabs dkar nag spyi khyab khyung po sde rgan bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal yin pa steng chen du dkar nag thun mong gi rten gtso bzhugs yul bum phra lha khang zer bar bsdad/ rjes su a rbang spun gnyis 182

stobs 'byor je rgyas song mthar dkar ru tshang gi dpon sa kho pa spun nas bzung bas ma tshad/ dkar nag spyi khyab sde rgan bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal rtsa med btang ste khyung dkar nag spyi khyab kyi dbang cha yang ham 'phrog bya rgyu'i ngan gros gsham lugs skabs der sde rgan bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal la gsang brda byung stabs bum phra lha khang nas bros te khyung nag rdzos du bsdad pa de nas dkar nag nang 'khrug lo gsum byas mthar bum phra lha khang nang dkar nag thung mong gis khyung po'i rten gtso rnams sde rgan bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyi lag tu yod pas nag rur dbang ba ma zad/ de min lhag 'phro rnams kyang dkar nag nang bgos brgyab 'dug de skabs nag ru la khyung po'i rten gtso khyad du 'phags pa ste rong phug bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi thugs las byon pa gtso mchog yab yum/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i ljags las 'khrungs pa shes rab smra ba'i seng ge/ dgra bcom rgyal ba gshen rab kyi thugs las byon pa 'phel gdung bya lcung ka'i sgong nga tsam/ gnas mchog bring mtshams tha dkar nas sprul sku gsheg chen klu dga'i gter ma rta mgo nor bu gtsug gi cod pan dang / 'jam dbyangs gong mas gnang ba'i le chen shel tham srid gsum zin gnon dang ba so'i tham ka dbang yig rigs lnga yod pa'i tham ka bcas dang / gzhan yang gser gri rgya mtsho khog pa dang / rol mo srid gsum zil gnon bkra shis kun grags sngon mo 'brug gi mgo bo sogs khyung po'i rten gsum 'gangs che'i lo rgyus don snying ldan pa gtso bo de rnams nag ru tshang la yod pa red/nag ru dpon tshang gi sgrig gzhi'i skor/nag ru dpon tshang la sngar dus rgya sog gong ma rim pas gnang ba'i 183

bka' gtan yig rigs dang / be 'u'i go gnas/ las gos cha tshang dang las tham/ de rjes bod dus su gnang ba'i bka' gtan she bam dang / be 'u'i go gnas/ las tham gling gsum ma/ las gos cha tshang rim 'brel yod pa bcas la brten sngar lam 'dzin dbang rdzong gzhis ma lag khag drug la khyon bsdoms lo re son khal 750skor 'gro ba'i sa zhing dang / nor khagalnga/ g.yag phyugs dang ra lug rta drel sogs dbyar dgun 'gro sdod byed yul gyi sa cha yag shos rgya khyon mi chung tsam sger bdag yin pa ma zad/ spyir na gsham gsal nag ru lding khag drug gi sa khul nas thon khungs gtso bo 'bru rigs yin zhing / dbyar dgun ston dpyid 'brog pa sdod yul gyi sa char rtswa chu gnyis 'dzoms rgya khyon mi chung tsam zhig yin khar/ de min gyi thon khungs shing cha/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ rdza nyungs/ be smug shwa rwa/ gla rtsi/gzig rus sogs yod/ gsham 'og ljang shod lding zhabs la lding dpon gcig dang mi ser dud grangs brgya dang sum cu/ chos lugs dge ldan chab rdzong dgon grwa drug cu skor dang / dge ldan rdzong chung dgon grwa drug cu skor/bon chos ljang phu bon dgon ser khyim pa grwa bco lnga skor/ phyogs bcu lding zhabs la lding dpon gcig mi ser dud grangs brgyad cu gya drug chos lugs dge ldan dil mgo dgon grwa drug cu skor/ bha ru lding zhabs la lding dpon gcig mi ser dud grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga lnga chos lugs dge ldan sgang sne dgon grwa brgya dang lnga bcu skor/ dge ldan ris rigs dgon grwa lnga bcu skor/ bka' rgyud pa la thog dgon nam zhag gcod dgon pa gtsang dgon grwa brgya dang nyi shu skor yod pa dkar ru stod smad gnyis dang / nag ru bcas kyi khungs nas yong srol yod/ chos lugs rnying ma jo dgon dbang ka ri khrod la jo mo bzhi bcu skor/ mgon ne lding zhabs la lding dpon gcig184

mi ser dud grangs brgya dang bcu/ bon chos bsam gtan gling ser khyim pa grwa brgya skor/ brag la lding zhabs la lding dpon gcig mi ser dud grangs brgya dang bcu/ chos lugs rnying ma paḥ tam dgon ser khyim pa grwa brargya lhag gnu gtam lding zhabs la lding dpon gcig mi ser dud grangs brgya dang bcu gsum/ chos lugs dge ldan skyid bsam dgon grwa bzhi bcu skor/ bon chos be sgo dgon ser khyim pa grwa lnga bcu skor bcas dgon khag bcu gsum yod pa nas rdzong gi lding zhabs khral bsdu'i skabs dgon pa so so nas mjal phyag dar zub dang / rang mos kyis 'bru 'bo do gsum yas mas sprod kyi 'dug pa phud gong gsal lding dpon drug nas gte khral 'go phud byed dgos pa dang / mi ser dud grangs bdun brgya bcu med bzhi yod pa nas nag ru dpon tshang la sngar lam deb gsal nang khral yong 'bab 'bru dang /gro/ sran khyon bsdoms lo re 'bru 'bo chig stong brgyad brgya skor dang / de bzhin gte khral tshags sha dang / dkar sha/ mar/ tsha ru/ bal rtsid/nyung ma sogs phon 'bor che tsam bsdu rgyu yod khar/ dkar smad zla thang pa zer ba grong khag gcig gi gte bdag nag ru tshang yin par brten lo lor gte khral dang / sho mdo khongs yo thung pa grong tsho gcig nas chu gte zhes pa'i gte khral/ dkar stod rdza sho mgo grong tsho nas zhing gte zer ba bcas deb gsal yong 'bab grangs tshad tan tan ma nges shing mdor na gang la de 'tshams shig bsdu rgyu yod thog yul lung so so nas thon khungs kyi shing cha dang / rdzo ma/ khrus rdzas sug pa/ nag rtsam sogs bsdu rgyu yod/ ri che khong ba shod pa dang / nag ru ljang shod pa gnyis 'brog pa sdod yul sa mtshams 'dabs sbrel gyi kha rtswa ba shod pa nas bed spyod gtong srol kyang /nag ru la lo re rtswa gte 'bri g.yag bzhi dang lug lnga gte de bzhin dpa' shod 185

rnga la ba nas rtswa gte 'bri g.yag gsum dang lug gsum re nor ma ba dud bzhi nas rtswa gte 'bri g.yag gnyis dang / lug gnyis re bcas sprod srol 'dugagazhan yang mi ser dud re'i sa nas ldom bu zer ba 'bru bre gang re bsdu len byed pa/ nag ru lding khag drug so so'i nang nas dud tshang che gras kyi mi ngo re 'dems sgrug byas pa mi drug yod cing / de ni rdzong phyi nang gi las gnyer byed mkhan gar btang go chod lta bu yin pa red/ sgar skor ma zer ba rdzong rtswar rgyun g.yog mi grangs bzhi bcu skor zhig yod pa de tsho'i 'byung khungs ni pha mes kyi dus su khrims 'gal nyes chad phog ste rdzong gi g.yog khongs su 'tshud pa de nas bzung rgyud bcas mi rabs su rang dbang med par skabs 'phral gar dgos mngags gtong bya rgyu'i bran g.yog tu gyur pa red/ nag ru rdzong la snga/ra lam bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi mtshungs btsan dbang dang gnya' gnon bya rgyu'i khrims kyi yo byad ske sgo dang khrims lcag btson khang / rkang lcagasako lcag sogs yod/ nag ru dpon tshang la rdzong khang ma lag bdun yod pa nas lte ba'i ma gzhis nag ru wa zhod rdzong yin zhing / le lag dkar po lha rag rdzong / dgar po wa li rdzong / sngon po g.yam pa rdzong / bran la dbyings gshis rdzong / gtam smad wa zhig rdzong / gnu pho nyin grong rdzong bcas dang / rtse drug dgon pa nas lo ltar bod zla 5 pa nang 'das mchod 'chogs skabs la lung phyogs mtha' kun nas mchod mjal du yong mkhan mi 'bor ha cang mang ba de skabs bde 'jags kyi ched du 'go 'doms khrims gnon byed po sngar lam nag ru dpon yin par brten rtse drug dgon du'ang nag ru rdzong zer ba zhig yod/186

nag ru dpon tshang nas sngar srol gtong sgo gtong dgos kyi skor/rdzong gi srung ma khang du sgrub bla bskang gso ba gnyis la nyin ltar kha lag sprod dgos thog gla yon lo re mi rer 'bru 'bo lnga re sprod dgos bsdoms 'bo bcu lo ltar dus mchod phul sgrub tshogs skabs bla grwa sum cu skor la nyin bcu'i ring mchod mar rgya ma bdun cu don lnga dang / mchod 'bru mchod rtsam 'bo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ ja sbag drug mar rgya ma lnga bcu nga lnga/ sha gzug nyi shu/chang rgyu 'bru 'bo sum cu/ tsha 'bo gang / ston rim mdos chen skabs su bla grwa drug cu skor nyin lnga la mchod mar rgya ma brgya skor dang mchod 'bru mchod rtsam 'bo sum cu/ ja rīsbag brgyad/ mar rgya ma dgu bcu/ sha bubs bzhi/chang rgyu 'bru 'bo lnga bcu/ tsha 'bo gnyis/ maṇ+ḍal ri khrod du rgyun sdod mtshams grwa gnyis la ja mar dod sogs yog pa zan sgril gyis lo re 'bru 'bo sum cu/ rtse drug dran pa sgrub phug mtshams grwa gcig la lo re phogs 'bru 'bo bcu gnyis gong gsal le lag rdzong khag bdun yod khongs nas rdzong gsum la rdzong srung rgyun sdod mi re yod par lo re phogs 'bru 'bo bcu re sprod dgos bsdoms 'bru 'bo sum cu/ nor ma khag bzhi dang rta pa/ lug ra bcas la g.yog byed mi grangs bco lnga yod par mi rer lo re phogs 'bru 'bo bcu gnyis re dgos pa bsdoms 'bru 'bo brgya dang brgyad bcu sgar skor ma bran g.yog mi grangs bzhi bcu skor yod pa de dag la rtsa ba'i thabs rten sa zhing phran bu tsam re yod thog phogs snon mi rer 'bru 'bo drug re dgos pa bsdoms 'bru 'bo nyis brgya bzhi bcu kho tsho phar tshur mngags gtong skabs su 'gor yun ji 187

song gi bza' chas rdzong gzhung nas sprod pa/ rdzong gzhis lte ba'i sa zhing dpyid smod skabs nye skor mgon ne lding zhabs mi ser nas rmon dor rang 'grigs brgya lhag tsam gyis nang ra'i zhing kha nyin gcig la rmos 'debs tshar ba byed dgos shing / de skabs snga dro ja thengs gnyis dang mi brgya lhag tsam yod pa mi re la sha skal ma chung ba rdog re dang / rtsam rgyu 'bru bre gang re son 'bru nas yos 'gas zer ba 'bru lag pa gnyis 'khyor gang re sprod dgos/dgong dro chang thengs gnyis btang rjes mi tshang ma chang gis myos thub pa yong gi yod de'i sang nyin rmon dor drug cu skor gyis phyi ra'i zhing kha nyin gcig la 'debs rmos tshar ba byed dgos/ de skabs lto chas sprod srol mi 'dug ma gzhis dbyar rmod skabs dpon tshang rang gis rmon dor bco lnga skor thong gshol rang 'grigs rdzong g.yog mi bco lnga nas 'phru bslog rgyag dgos pa de skabs rdzong nas kho pa tshor g.yag bshag cig gi phyi sha nang khrol tshang ma sprod pa ma zad/ 'gor rgyun ring nyin re chang dang / ja rtsam sogs lto dus bzhi re sprod kyi yod pa/ le lag gnas gzhis khag la rmos 'debs brnga bsdu sogs zhing g.yog byed sgo rnams sa gnas mi ser bskul 'ded lam lugs las/kho pa tshor lto chas sprod srol mi 'duganag ru khyung po'i gdung rgyud rim bzhin dze phrar gyur mthar khyung rgyud chad de brag g.yab mkhas grub kyis dbang cha bzung ba'i skor/nag ru la khyung po rong ston gyi sras rgyud dang / sde rgan bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyi sras rnam rgyal grags pa can gdung rgyud 'ga' zhig gis 'dzin 188

skyong gnang ba'i skabs sras mo gcig nang chen rgyal po'i btsun mor bsus pa de la rjes 'dzin byung mi 'dug kyang / phar tshur gnyen nye'i 'du shes spyir btang ma yin pa phyis su'ang 'brel ba yod pa red/ nag ru khyung po'i gdung rgyud rim bzhin je phrar song mthar khyung po lhun grub rgyal mtshan zhes pa bla ma gcig las med/ de'ang me bya lor sku 'das nas gdung rgyud chad/ shul sdod skyong za a zhe zer ba de dkar ru dpon tshang nas bag mar blangs pa zhig red/ rjes su a zhe la khyung po bya skye tshang gi sras po rnam sras grags pa go mag tu bsus te nag dpon bskos 'dzin skyong byas/ de la sras po gnyis dang sras mo gcig byung 'dug pa lo shas mtshams yab sras gsum ka bstud mar 'das grongs song bas gdung rgyud chad/ slar yang a zhe ma bu shul du lhagade nas phyogs bcu lding dpon dkon mchog lha rgyal dang / blon tshe dbang skyabs zer ba gnyis nas da ni nag ru rdzong gi phyi nang snod bcud la 'go 'don 'tsho skyong byed mkhan che kha zhig nas bsu len gyis dpon sar 'god ma thub na 'byung 'gyur phyi dgra nang brnyas ji yong ma nges pas 'di mus sdod thabs ga la yod gros mthar brag g.yab chung tshang sar zhu yig dang sbrags mi gnyis ched btang gis dpon rgyud ldan pa'i bu gcig nag ru'i go mag tu gnang rogs zhus 'dug cing / brag g.yab bla brang nas nag rur dpon gzhis yong sgo dang / sde khyon sogs ma chung tsam zhig yin tshod la babs 'brel che lugs khas blangs 'dug kyang / mi 'gro 'phral thag ma bcad par brten nag ru'i bang mi gnyis nas 'gor rgyun ring po ma bzod par de sngon bstan rgyal gling gi zhabs sdod zur pa yig rtsis go 'pher yod mkhan brag g.yab mkhas grub bsus 'byor byung ba skyong za a zhe'i go mag dang nag ru'i dpon sar bskos pa red/ de'i skabs su sngon ma dkar nag nang 'khrug 189

pa'i gyod gzhi 'dum sgrig thengs gcig byung 'dug skyong za a zhe la mkhas grub kyi bu gcig byung rung 'tsho ma thub/ de rjes mkhas grub la rgyud 'dzin bu phrug med rkyen nag ru dpon tshang gi 'dzin dbang lha bzhugs/ chung tshang bla mar phul te a zhe ma bu'i skyid sdug dang / nag ru mi ser gyi mgo 'don 'tsho skyong gnang rogs zhes skyabs bcol zhus/mkhas grub kyis nag ru'i dpon dbang brag g.yab chung tshang la phul te chung tshang gis nag ru'i dpon sa 'dzin pa'i skor/rjes su mkhas grub grong mtshams chung tshang bla mas phyag mdzod rtsi thur lags zer ba nag ru rdzong du btang 'byor lo shas song rjes a 'e bod du grongs nas dwa phrug bu mo dang / g.yog byed nag ru gu lu'i grwa pa gnyis chung tshang bla brang nas phan po grong dkar gzhis kar bzhag de skabs gu lu'i grwa pa chung tshang zhabs gras nas lkog bsad byas rkyen dwa phrug bu mo sems pham smyo nad kyis grongs 'dug de'i skor chung tshang dang nag ru gnyis bod gzhung sar zlos gyar skabs bden don khungs skyel thub pa red/ gong gsal phyag mdzod rtsi thur gyi brje tshab brag g.yab nyag re khang tshan gyi grwa bkra shis phun tshogs nag ru'i 'tsho 'dzin du bzhag pa red/nag ru rdzong mer bsregs btang ba dang slar yang rdzong gsar bzhengs byas pa'i skor/tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pa'i sku dus chu glang rgya bod g.yul 'khrug bod 190

nas rgya dmag phyir skrad rjes steng chen la lu'u cun dmag dpung yod stabs dmag phogs dang rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs zhu sgo dkar nag nyi shu rtsa drug mnyam sgrub byas na yang lu'u cun dpon dmag gis ngo so che chung lta bus nag rur mthong chung byed pa ma zad/ dkar rus rgya dmag la dbyene sbyor gyis nag rus bod dang lag 'brel byas tshul ma nyes kha g.yog byas par brten steng chen lu'u cun dmag sgar nas nag ru dpon blan sang nyin steng chen du 'byor dgos zer ba'i 'gug yig btang ste btson bcug srog nyes gtong rtsis byas pa red/ nag ru dpon blon steng chen du bcar blos ma bzod pur do nub lam seng mtshan bros kyis brag la nas rngu shod rgyud lho rdzong du bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar sar bcar te mgo btags zhus/ nag ru bros byol du song ba thos 'phral steng chen du yod pa'i rgya dmag dang dkar ru mnyam sbrel gyis nag ru mer bsregs rtsa med bzos pa dang / mi ser gtor brlag bcom 'phrog mang po byas pa red/ nag ru lding dpon mi drag khag bgos kyis sa lam rgyus mnga' yod pa'i sne khrid 'og shing rong brgyud nas bod dmag khag gcig dang / lho rgyud nas bod dmag khag gcig ser tsha yas mas su yod bzhin pa'i bod dmag dang dus bkag mnyam 'dzoms byas te steng chen nye khul gyi mtha' bskor nas dmag 'khrug mthar der yod rgya dmag dang / dkar ru dpon lding mi drag dang bcas sa cha shor nas ri bo che brgyud chab mdor bros pa red/ citsho sde gsum cu so dgu bod sder bsgrur nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbang sgrur byas pa'i skor/ rīhor tsho pa so dgu rgya sde yin pa bar lam bod sdod am ban lam lugs 191

thog mar 'dzugs skabs gong ma mchod yon zung sbrel gyi sde khongs su bzhag pa dang / rtsa ba'i bdag po gong ma red/ me 'brug lor gzhi nas tsho pa so dgu de bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sde khongs su bsgyur te ker leb sgur gsum gyi zhib gzhung dang 'brel bod khri skor bcu gnyis thog hor tsho so dgu khri sde gcig bsnan te khri skor bcu gsum chags pa red ces rgan po'i ngag lam nas thos/me sbrul hor spyi dang po mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal las bya rtse drung gnyis/sku srung ru dpon gcig lding dpon gcig srung dmag lnga bcu bcas yod pa khyung po steng chen sa gnas su 'byor/ skabs der tsho pa so dgu'i dpon rigs che chung tshang ma 'du 'dzoms yod bzhin pa'i thog hor spyi grags pa rnam rgyal nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsa tshig khyab bsgrags byas pa'i 'go brjod la/ ‘‘kun gsal 'chi med lam du srid pa'i sgron me zung gi mngon par 'dzin pa'i snang ba la longs su spyod pa'i gnam 'og sa steng skye rgu spyi dang / bye brag tu gser ldan rgyal po'i chab 'bangs lam lugs ’’zer ba sogs bka' khyab brgyud bsgrags byas pa dang 'brel 'byung 'gyur bka' brtsi khrims srung zhu dgos pa'i spyi sgrig gan rgya blang / sa rta lor sngar dus su hor jing gir rgyal po zer bas sbra chen tshang tsho sde so dgu'i spyi khyab yin pa de dag 'brog shog tsho khag gcig gi dpon la bsgyur zhing tsho pa so dgu la che hu dang /be'u/ be cang bsdoms dpon rgan gzhon sum cu so dgu dang / de 'og lding dpon sum/ cu so gsum yod pa bcas la thob thang go gnas rim pa so sor sprad/ dkar ru dpon ngo ma rgya dang lag 'brel mnyam bskyod song bar brten dpon gzhis ma lag dang bcas pa gzhung len gyis hor spyi rim pa'i thab rten khongs su bzhag ste zhing g.yog dkar ru mi ser nas rgyug dgos kyi yod/ dkar ru'i 'tsho 'dzin yang bkra shis bsod nams la be'u'i go 192

gnas sprad/ hor tsho so dgur sa rta zhib gzhung bkod pa'i zhing 'phar la thon phud ces pa 'bru dang / sems can mo rigs la ga mar/ pho rigs la ga dngul/ rta drel bong bu la'ang dngul bcas rkang 'gro lag 'don khral rigs kyi ming gi rnam grangs thog mar chags nas lo ltar 'jal sgrub byed dgos pa red/ skabs der zur du mi dang / sems can tshang ma'i rna co re nas rna ṭam zer ba ṭam dkar re bsdus 'dug pa rgyu mtshan ci yin ma shes/de nas hor spyi'i pho brang thog brtsegs gnyis ldan gyi g.yas g.yon la gzim chung dang / gzim 'gag dbus kyi mdun phyogs su lhan rgyas khang la sogs pa steng shod khang mig mang zhing rgya khyon che ba dang / de bzhin las shag khag gsum dang srung dmag khang bcas gsar rgyag byas pa de dag hor spyi rim pa'i rdzong khang yin pa dang / 'bo dang / bre/ rgya ma bcas gsar pa bzos te de'i ngos la sa rta gsar bzos zhes pa'i yi ge dang / hor spyi'i las tham sbyar ma yul lung so sor bkram ste tshad gzhi 'dzin dgos pa rkun jag rngon khrims zhes tshul min gyi bya ba byed mkhan la gsod rdung gcod gsum 'jigs su rung ba'i khrims gcod byed pa/ dper na krog rdis mgo zer ba'i mi gcig gi rkang lag bzhi ka bcad rung ma shi bar rjes su pus bgrod byas nas 'tsho ba bskyel ba nga tsho chung dus dngos su mthong myong / hor spyi grags rnam nas rgya bod dmag 'khrug skabs dgon pa nyams skyon song ba rnams nyams gso'i mthun rkyen gang la de 'tshams re sprad pa dang / bka' blon byams bstan sar nag ru mgo btags zhus bcar skabs nag rdzong mer bsregs rtsa med btang lugs snyan seng zhus par bka' bla byams bstan gyis 'tsho smad bcu bzhir ar las skul 'ded chog pa'i bka' phab par brten nag rdzong gsar rgyag thub pa dang / mi ser gtor brlag gang 'tshams shig 193

song bar sngon ma ser tsha bya sgar gnyis kyi spyi sde chags yul nag ru dang sa sbrel yin pa bha ru lding zhabs mi ser dud grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga lnga skor yod pa nag rur 'tsho snon gnang 'dug de'i skabs kyi nag ru dpon chung bla'i khongs mi bkra shis phun tshogs yin pa red/ chung tshang bla brang dang nag ru sde dpon ma mthun pa'i gyod dom/ skor chung bla'i khongs mi nag dpon bkra shis phun tshogs 'das mtshams chung tshang bla brang gis nag ru dpon lo gsum re'i mtshams brje len byas par brten sger shugs che bas rdzong gzhung nyams rgud je zhan du song zhing / mi ser la'ang brdabs mnar che tsam byung ba sogs de mus nam ring sgrung gis 'khyong re bral stabs nag ru lding sde gros bsdur gyis phyogs bcu lding dpon bkra shis rnam rgyal dang / mgon ne lding dpon rnam rgya'/ dbang grags gtsos lding khag drug so sos 'thus mi do chod re sa 'brug lor lha sar bskyod de bod gzhung bka' shag la bde sdug zhu dgos byung ba red/bod gzhung nas lo drug ring zhib 'jug mthar shing khyi khra ma'i dpyad mtshams rdo don nag ru dpon tshang gi yong 'bab nas chung tshang bla mar thab rten lo re bod dngul ṭam rdo nyi shu rtsa lnga re sprad zin rjes slad nag rur the jus mi chog pa dang / nag ru dpon nang khul lding sde mos mthun gyis 'dems bsko'i 'os snyan 'bul dgos pa'i bka' dpyad btang /phyogs lding bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis nag ru'i dpon dbang 'dzin pa'i skor/de nas nag ru lding sde tshang 'dzoms gros bsdur skabs phyogs bcu lding dpon tshang gi mi rabs rim can nas nag ru'i spyi don la phan nus thon pa'i 194

lo rgyus mang po yod khar/ lhag par phyogs lding bkra shis rnam rgyal nas da res chung tshang gyod don skor sde spyi'i ched du 'gan 'khur mtha' 'khyongs byas pa dang / yon tan che la gshis rgyud bzang po yin par brten nag ru dpon phyogs lding rang la bab 'os che lugs tshang ma'i mos mthun byung ste bod gzhung la 'os phul chog mchan thob ste shing phag lor phyogs lding bkra shis rnam rgyal nag ru'i dpon gnas su bskos/chung tshang gi gyod gzhi bskyar ldog byas pa'i skor/chung tshang bla mas bka' blon bon shod brgyud skul gyis dpyad khra sngon btang bogs dngul ṭam rdo nyi shu rtsa lnga thog slar yang ṭam rdo lnga bcu nga lnga kha snon rgyab ste mdo don chung tshang la nag ru nas lo re bogs ma bod dngul ṭam rdo brgyad cu re sprod dgos pa'i 'go mchan thob/ skabs der nag ru lding sde tshang mas chung tshang skor de sngon bod gzhung nas lo mang dbye zhib gnang ba'i dpyad khra ltar las sprod thabs bral lugs kyi bsam 'char mang po bshad/'on kyang dpon bkras rnam nas da res 'di skor rtsa ba'i bden don brdar sha gcod rgyu yod rung / snga 'phros ngal rdabs mi 'byung ched de don sprad na zhes chung tshang la bogs dngul ṭam rdo brgyad cu re lo ltar lha sar 'bul skyel zhus pa red/ rjes su nag dpon bkras rnam nas chung tshang bogs dngul lo ltar 'jal sprod ma dgos par rtsa ba'i ma 'dzugs zhus chog pa zhes gzhung la snyan zhu phul bar chog mchan thob ste ma dngulaphyed cha nag ru dpon tshang nas yod 'don thog de 'phrod lding dpon drug dang dgon sde tshang mas 'phyar ba gru 'degs kyis khungs sgrig byas te sa byi lor phyogs lding tshe dbang lha rgyal bod 195

skyod kyis chung tshang bla brang la ma dngul sdebs gcig tu 'dzugs 'jog zhus pa de nas bzung chung tshang dang nag ru dbar gyi 'gal zla 'jug bsgril thub cing /gzhan yang phyogs lding bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis nag ru'i dpon 'gan khur ba nas bzung rang khongs mi ser skyid sdug 'khos sbyor bzang zhag la gzhigs te lo gsum re'i mtshams nas khral bzo bkod sgrig thengs re byed pa dang /dkar nag dbar 'khon med mthun lam yong thabs/ hor tsho so dgu'i spyi don la'ang sems khur gang che byas par brten tshang mas yag po 'dug ces shod kyi yod pa red/chu bya lor hor spyi khyung ram pas hor tsho so dgu'i sa sde mi gsum dang phyugs rigs dkar nag khang pa dang bcas pa zhib gzhung bskyar 'god kyis khral rigs 'phar ma 'bab bzo gtan 'bebs byed kyi yin zhis bshad de khyung ram byams thog nas lha sar thon pa red/ de 'phral tsho pa so dgu'i dpon 'go rnams nas da res gsar bzos zhib gzhung gtan 'khel byas na mi ser chags re bral gshis gnas lugs yong rkyen bde sdug zhu bar lha sar 'gro rgyu'i blo mos nang gan bzhag ste 'gan khur gtso bo nag ru dpon dang /khrom tshang dpon yin pas lha skyod bod gzhung la snyan zhus skabs rgyal po rwa sgreng mchog khyung ram la rgyu mtshan gzhan gyi thog nas thugs dgongs 'khrug pa dang dus mtshungs zhib gzhung rtsa 'dzin ma dgos khar/ rkyen slong nyes 'dzol 'phar ma lta bus khyung ram kha dbang gzhung bzhes dang 'brel gnas dbyung rgyang 'bud du btang ba red/ yang de sngon nag ru don tshe zer bas zhang mgon lding sde dang nang khul 'grig min gyis rkyen pas pha gzhis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par dad 'bul zhus pa de dag hor spyi'i thob khongs su gyur te zhing g.yog zhang mgon mi ser nas rgyug dgos pa'i dka' ngal ci cher 196

brten nag dpon bkras rnam khyung ram skor lha sar yod skabs don che'i sa zhing 'khri khungs zhang mgon mi ser la bogs bsgyur kha 'dzin yong thabs snyan zhus don smin son te nor gling mdzod sbug la lo re bogs dngul ṭam rdo bcu bdun re phul te sa zhing mi ser dud tshang so sor cha snyoms bgos 'grems kyis bogs dngul gzugs rjes grib 'gro'i lo ltar bsdu 'bul zhus par brten hor spyi'i zhing g.yog bskul 'ded kyi dka' ngal de dag sel thub pa red/nag dpon bkras rnam 'das rjes lding dpon res bskor gyis dpon tshab 'gan 'khur byas pa'i skor/ sa byi lor nag dpon bkras rnam 'das grongs song shul du bu mo rang lo dgu la son pa gcig dang / bu rang lo gsum du son pa ma bu gsum la gces skyong bya rgyu dang / rdzong gi phar gtong tshur len 'gan 'khur drung yig kun bzang zhes pa khong yang son 'tsho ma zin skabs nag ru spyi'i phyi nang khral khrims zhu sgo lding dpon drug nas res bskor gyis dpon tshab tu lo re bsdad/steng chen du hor spyi mkhan rim lo gsum de res bskor gyis 'dzin skyong byed cing / me sbrul lor hor spyi dang po grags rnam nas lcags sbrul stan brag bar hor spyi rim pa brgyad song ba dang / chu rta lor hor tsho rdzong khag drug la bsgyur te rdzong rer bod gzhung nas ser skya gnyis re res bskor 'gro lam bzos shing / rdzong thog rim pa gsum song mtshams sa gnas srid gzhung gi hor tsho'i las mjug rdzogs nas lcags stag(1950)lor tang gi srid jus bod ljongs yongs la khyab ste bod mi dmangs la bcings 'grol thob nas mes rgyal gyi pang du log cing / gong spyi'i bod zla11 tshes 12nyin khyung po steng 197

chen du mi dmangs bcings 'grol rta dmag phebs skabs nag ru dpon tshab bha lding rta mgrin tshe ring yin pa khong dang / nged lding gtso kha shas kyis mi res mjal dar re dang sngon ma'i lugs bzhin mjal zhu mar/ 'bru/g.yag gcig gi sog par dar ka brgyan pa bcas phul/ bcings bkrol dmag nas nga tsho mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan yin pa las/mjal zhu 'di 'dra sprod len lugs srol med ces hang sang ste ma blangs kyang /u tshugs kyis bzhag nas nga tsho phyir log yong pa yin/ de'i sang nyin tā yang dkar po sum cu skor 'ig rin 'bab tu gan/nga bas nga tsho tshang mas bcings bkrol dmag gi sgrig lam bzang po yod par ha las byung / de nas dmag srid rim 'byor gyi chab mdo bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang steng chen don gcod las khungs ang dang go ridz+dzags nas hor tsho ar rdza be sog rdzong dang /nag shod 'bri ru rdzong / hor sbra chen rdzong / lho nem khri rdo rdzong / ser tsha rdzong / steng chen rdzong bcas rdzong khag drug thog rngon ma bod sde sog rdzong dang / gsar steng rdzong / dpal 'bar rdzong / lha ri rdzong bcas bsnan bsdoms rdzong khag bcu bkod sgrig gnang ste dmag srid gnyis kyi 'go khrid gtso bo wang si ling yon (skabs der phebs mkhan rta dmag gi dmag dpon zhig dang ) steng chen don gcod khru'u'i kru'u ren gzhon pa hor rgyal sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan red/sngar dus spo la bla brang zer ba phyis su ru 'khor dud grangs brgya skor zhig tu 'phel zhing / shing lug spyi lo 1955lor nag ru tshang gi shul 'dzin bu mo 'chi med tshe dpal la mi spyi'i bsam 'dun spo la bla ma'i bu gcig go mag turibasus te gdung rgyud skyar gso yong re byas kyang de skabs bu mo 'chi med tshe dpal rang lo bcu drug son rung go mag spo la bu rang lo drug las ma son 198

stabs kher tshugs ma 'pher bas rjes su pha ma gnyis kyi sdod gnas spo la khar song nas bsdad de rang lo bcu bzhi son skabs 'das grongs song 'dugame bya 1957lor steng chen rdzong gi 'chi med tshe dpal rgyun las u yon la bkod sgrig gnang / sa phag (1959) lor chu bzhi sgang drug gis jus skul 'og dkar nag ser gsum gyi zing 'khrug sgrig 'dzugs bzos te nag ru lding gtso nas 'chi med tshe dpal ma rgan nad mnar la khag 'dogs rdzong nas dgongs zhus phyir 'then gsang thabs kyi sgo nas lho brag la rgyu bskyal te yibs srung byed du bcug kyang sras mo'i 'dod blor ma bab pas de ru ma bsdad par rang 'gul gyis spo la kha rgyud sog rdzong la ba car tsis byas rung sog rdzong jag dmag gis bskor bas bcar sa ma rnyed stabs ya rnga mngo/ra mtsho sngon rta dmag yong ba dang 'phrad nas 'brel ba zhus te slar 1959lo'i zla 10tshes 17nyin steng chen rdzong du 'byor mtshams chab srid dang 'tsho bar bkod sgrig gang legs gnang ste/ me byi (1960) lor zing 'khrug lhing 'jags btang ba dang chabs cig dmangs gtso'i bcos rgyur skabs 'chi med tshe dpal chab srid brtson len gyi khongs su zhugs te chab mdo srid gros kyi u yon dang / de rjes bod ljongs srid gros kyi a yon gnang ste da cha chab mdo srid stogros kyi las 'khur dang 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba bskyel bzhin yod pa bcas so/ 199
