bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma thob sngon gyi grong khyer lha sa'i skor gleng ba/o rgyan rdo rjes/mna' rabs kyi deb ther lo rgyus nang lha sa ni dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas yul sa bkra khyad 'phags yin pa'i lo rgyus yod pa red/ de yang gnam 'khor lo rtsis brgyad dang / sa pad+ma 'dabs brgyad/ mtha' skor ri bor bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / 'dod yon gyi ri sogs tshang zhing / snga rabs su lha sa gtsug lag khang gtso bor gyur pa'i lha sa khul gyi 'go 'doms chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa zhes pa nas byed kyi yod pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs gtsang pa sde srid chos yon gyi dbang cha rtsa gtor btang rjes snang rtse sde pa nyams nyes su btang ba de'i sdod shag lha sar yod pa der spyi lo 1679tsam la lha khul khrims 'doms las khungs btsugs par snang shag las khungs zer zhing / de nas bzung chos rje dkon gnyer dpon par gtsug lag khang ma gtogs lha sa'i 'go 'doms kyi dbang cha mi dgos pa bzos zhing / dus phyis gtsug lag khang gi khrims 'doms lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs kyis byed pa red/ sngar dus lha sa ni rgya khyon chen po med cing /de'i skabs gtsang po yang da lta'i gling 'khor lho lam gyi 'gram nas rgyugs kyi yod pa ma zad chu rags kyi rgyab tu rags rgyab dur khrod zer ba mchod rten dang dur khrod kyang yod 'dug mna' rabs dur khrod der mi'i phung po khyi 200

la ster gyi yod pa ma zad dur khrod de rtsa chen yin lugs yod pas dus phyis gang 'tshams bar lha yod bal po'i phung po der ched mngags bskyel ba dang /bod mi stobs ldan dpa' bo zhes pa'i sku phung yang dur khrod der bskyal ba'i thod pa khyad 'phags yig 'bru sogs kyi rang byon yod pa rags stobs pa'i spyi rdzas su nyar ba de lo ltar sa zla'i tshes 15nyin gling bskor lho lam du mjal kha gtong ba dang / mi tshos thod pa de'i nang 'brel mtshon dngul sogs 'bul gyi yod/ de'i smad brgyud du tā la'i bla ma lnga pas gtsang chu'i kha gnon du gnyan mkhar nag gtso 'khor gsum gyi rten mkhar dang / gnyan mkhar nag gtso 'khor sku phyebs kyi rtsa sgo dbye zhing gnyer gtad mdzad thog gos chen gyi lha chas cha tshang thog zhal ja'i yu ring gser ljang brdung ma bcas stsal te rags smad btsan khang zhes ko ba gtong mkhan gnyan pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha mi lha bdag drag zhan mang tsam yod pa red/ lha sa'i mtha' skor sgang bzhi yod pa/ sa 'bog sgang / rje 'bum sgang / thal spungs sgang / phyag mtshal sgang / sbug bzhi yod pa/ 'od stod sbug gsol ra sbug smin drug sbug klu sbug zur bzhi yod pa/ gdung rtse zur/ sha gsar zur/ban rtsa zur / lcog zur/ gling bzhi yod pa/ tshe smon gling / bstan rgyas gling / tshe mchog gling / kun bde gling sogs sa gnas kyi ming bzhi tshan 'ga' shas yod pa red/ de snga sha ba skya rengs dar chen 'dzugs sa'i sa der gdung rtse zur zer ba de ni gtsug lag khang thog mar bzhengs skabs 'o thang gi mtsho bsub pa'i gdung ma'i rtse de sa der 'khel bas gdung rtse zur zhes btags pa red/ lha sa'i mi dpon gnyis ni sngar khungs nang gi las tshan rim pa lnga pa yin kyang dus phyis rim pa bzhi pa yin/ lha sa'i dar chen rnams kyi nang nas gtso bo gnyis yod pa'i gcig ni dga' ldan dar chen zhes — 201

pa rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis btsugs pa dang / gcig ni sha ba skya rengs zhes pa rje bla ma tsong kha pa'i phyag 'khar dar chen la brgyan yod pas bstan pa'i srog shing zhes zhu zhing / de min lha sa dang / rtse po ta la'i rgyab mdun/ nor gling sogs su dar chen yod nga bod kyi lo gsar tshes gsum gong na bza' sgron tshar ba byed dgos pa red/ dga' ldan dar chen dang /sha ba skya rengs gnyis lo gsar tshes gsum nyin na bza' gsar pa sgron dgos pa sngon la dga' ldan dar chen dang / de rjes sha ba skya rengs sku bzhengs zhu skabs dar chen gyi dbu tog la tā la'i bla ma'i thugs smon snyan shal dang sbrag rtse shod bka' shag bcas kyi sku tshab dang mi dpon ngo ma gnyis bcas dar chen sku bzhengs ma grub bar mig lta bya dgos pas der gro so phye mar dang ja chang sogs sgrig bshom dang sku tshab rnams gdan khri brgyab yod par bsdad de bkod 'doms byed dgos/ dar chen gnyis kyi nang nas sha ba skya rengs gtso che ba byed kyi red/ dar chen gnyis po phal cher dgong dro'i chu tshod gnyis pa trem la sku bzhengs tshar tsam yong gi yod pa de 'phral rtser tshes gsum gzab gsol sar shar rgyag phyin te dar chen sku bzhengs grub pa'i gtam snyan zhu bar 'gro dgos/ pas rtse 'gag tu 'byor 'phral 'gag mjal sar phyag gsum 'tshal te mgron brgyud kha btags phul nas dar chen sku bzhengs legs zhus zin pa'i bkra shis gtam snyan yin zhes zhu dgos/ yar phul kha btags phyir slog thog ljags mdud dang kha btags a she re/ chu ma rag tshogs (yos hral dang mar zhu sbrang rtsi sogs sbyar ba'i tshogs 'khor lta bu'i zas rigs bcud ldan zhig) spus dag re gsol ras yod pa red/ de nas mi dpon gnyis shar rgyag rdzong rgyab tu tshes gsum thog mda' zhes bka' shag gis gtsos shod skor yongs rdzogs grol ston mdzad sgo 'tshugs sar phyin nas 202

dar chen sku bzhengs zhus zin pa'i snyan zhu'i kha btags mgron brgyud phul te gtam snyan zhabs pad lhan rgyas la thad kar snyan seng zin 'phral stag gdan steng 'khod de kha btags rang slog thog mgron —ja dang gnang bya dkar spro dgu sder dang shing 'bras rgya cog re yod pa red/ dar chen de gnyis gzim bzhengs kyi las 'gan ni mi dpon gyi 'gan 'khri gtso che'i gras shig yin pas lo ltar rkyen sel zhabs rim rgya che sgrub dgos sogs sems 'khur chen po byed dgos pa red/ gal srid dar chen de gnyis gang rung la chag skyon byung na skabs 'phral mi dpon gnas dbyung btang ba'i lo rgyus yod mus red/snang sheg las khungs kyi nam rgyun las 'gan skor/las khungs gzhan dang zung 'brel byed rgyu'i las 'gan gsham 'khod dang / snang shag las khungs rang nas 'gan 'khur dgos pa spyi'i bde 'jags dang / 'phrod bsten/ bskor g.yeng / do dam byed dgos pa dang / dpal 'byor thog mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar lta rtog byas nas 'bo dang rgya ma sogs gcig gyur yod min rtog zhib dang / lha sa skyid chu'i chu rags stod rgyud kyi 'gan 'khur dgos sogs las 'gan sne mang 'dres 'dzings yod pa red/ bde 'jags thog pu li si'i dmag sgar te lo (1kha21)bod lcags bya lor legs ldan sa heb nas las lugs bslabs pa'i srol rgyun gzhir bzung nga tsho'i skabs da dung pu li si'i dmag sgar 'go 'doms mi dpon nas gcig lcog byed dgos shing / dmag sgar nang gi gnad don mi dpon gnyis nas thag chod na dang / de min dmag spyi khang du gnas lugs shod dgos/ dmag mi rnams tsho khang so so nas res mos kyis sa khungs so 203

sor nyin mtshan sdod bya dang bde 'jags bskor g.yeng byed dgos pa/dmag sgar rang du 'go pa brgya dpon gcig gtan sdod byed dgos pa de dag nga tsho'i las khungs su las 'gan mnyam sgrub byed par yong nas skabs so so'i gnas tshul ji byung las khungs su brjod dgos pa red/ sngar khungs bskor bya ba rnams nas bskor g.yeng lta rtog byed pas 'thus kyang / dus phyis mi khang 'phel rgyas babs kyis pu li si'i dmag sgar snang shag khongs su stsal te khrims non che khyad bzo rigs sogs khrims 'go rang btsan zer ba rnams phyi rgyar snang shag khongs gcig sdud byed dgos pa sogs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku dus gsar gtod mdzad 'duga'aphrod bsten gtsang sbra'i dpe mtshon/rgyun du gtsang sbra'i bskor g.yeng gal che'i skabs gnyer drung rnams 'gro ba tsam las/ nyin ltar bskor g.yeng du pu li si'i tsho khang so sos sa gnas bskor g.yeng byed dgos pa/ mi dpon ngo ma gnyis gtsang sbra'i bskor g.yeng du 'gro dgos pa lo gcig dus gcig yin pa de ni bod zla 10tshes 2 5nyin dga' ldan lnga mchod ces rje tsong kha pa sku gshegs pa'i dus chen khyad 'phags nyin rtse pho brang gi mchod khang khag la mchod 'bul 'khrus gsol du tā la'i bla ma dang / yongs 'dzin/ rnam grwa gsung zhabs/ gzhung zhabs tshang ma gser sdong so so dang / lha khang gtso che ba rnams la mchod 'bul du dgong dro sa srib bar skya ser mtho dma' yongs rdzogs gsung zhabs su sdod dgos pas gnam gshis kyang grang ba'i khar nyi 'od med pa'i thog 'og gdan srab cing ar kha grang mo'i steng sdod dgos kyang / mi dpon gnyis nyin gung 204

yol tsam nas bskor g.yeng du 'gro dgos pa'i mgron cher dgongs zhu'i snyan zhu byas te rdog thon thog lha sa'i bar bskor sogs sa gnas gal che ba rnams su mi dpon gnyis rta bzhon nas pu li si dang bskor bya ba sogs las bya rnams khrid de bskor g.yeng che mor 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dga' ldan lnga mchod dus chen la dgong mo grong khyer yongs kyi khang pa'i yang steng du sa srib mtshams rang rang 'byor 'khos la gzhigs pa'i mchod me khra thing nger spar gyi red/ de nyin mchod me rnams gtsang ma yong ched gtsang spra'i bskor g.yeng de gal chen por brtsi ba dang / de min lha sa'i sa 'og gi chu 'gro'i sa khungs so so'i yur lam gyi tho yig ltar do dam bya rgyu'i 'gan 'khri yod pa red/yang 'phrod bsten thad kyi dpe mtshon gzhan zhig ste/ lha sa'i bar bskor byang chub 'byor lam zhes gtsug lag khang gi mtha' khor khyad du 'phags par brtsi ba der rdzab yur yang yang lud yong ba'i sa cha ha cang btsog pas sa cha gzhan du de bas smos med kyang 'khos 'byor zhan pas 'gog bcos mi thub khar/ zas rigs btsog pa mang zhing / lhag par dgun kha mchin 'khyag tshong ba der dga' po byed mkhan mang po yod la de dag zas pas 'chi rkyen yang yong gyi yod/ skabs der rgyu rkyen rtsad zhib skabs de ring btsong ma tshar ba'i mchin 'khyag de dbo/nga dro chu tsha por bcug nas slar yang 'khyag btang ste sang zhog tshong gi yod stabs mchin 'khrab chags nas gzugs gzhir gnod pa shin tu che yang tshan rig gi rgyun shes dman pas 'gog bcos mi thub pa de bzhin deng dus tshan rig ltar na mchin pa dmar po'i nang 'bu phra mang po yod pa des gnod pa gsal bshad thub kyi 'dugami dpon gyis khrom rwa'i thog 'khur dgos pa'i 'gan/lha sa'i phyogs 'grul tshong pa bab sa'i gnas khag tu mar dang phyur ba/205

rtsam pa/ 'bru rigs sogs brje tshong skabs las khungs kyi rgya ma dang /'bo bre tham 'byar ma sprad yod par 'degs gshor byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs byas yod kyang / de dag la mjug gnon dang zhib 'jug ma/tha' 'khyongs byed mkhan med pa dang / lhag par sku drag dang / dgon sde༈mi tshang che khag sogs la gcis/ gyur mkhar 'bo mkhar nyag sogs yod kyang 'ga' shas kyis sger gyi rgya ma dang / 'bo la tshong bas gcig gyur med pa'i thog 'bru rigs dang mar sogs rin gong gang mtho sprod mkhan byung na tshong dang bla ma gang bzang gi dpe ltar so so'i rang 'dod ltar len rkyang 'a sa lugs mthun gyi tshad gzhi med khar/ 'bru mar sogs 'bel nyo dkon chong dang rin gong 'phar 'gro ba'i skabs yod mkhan rnams nas da dung gang mthor 'phar thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang de tsho che btsan dang 'byor ldan la brten mi dpon gyis bkag sdom byas kyang thub kyi med pa red/lha sa skyid chu'i chu rags do dam byed stangs skor/lo re dpyid ka'i mtshams bka' shag lhan rgyas lha sa'i stod dpal grong nas gzhung ko btang ste rags bskor brgyab nas rags gsos dgos rigs zhib 'jug tho 'god thog skyid chu'i smad rgyud rags gso'i do dam rma gron zhol gnyis dang / stod rgyud du mgron mi sbrel po zhes rtse mgron gcig dang mi dpon gcig zung sbrel bsko gzhag gis chu rags nyams gso byed dgos pa'i dgos dngul lag 'dzin dang 'brel ba zhu len thog dgos mkho ja mar rtse shos phyag mdzod gnyis nas zhu rgyu'i lam ltar bka' 'dzin zhus te len sprod thog lha sa tsho pa sogs rags 'khri so sor bkod khyab kyis nyams gso zhus zin 206

mtshams skyid chu stod smad so sor bka' shag lhan rgyas gzigs zhib tu gong bzhin ko thog phebs te gzigs zhib grub mtshams gling ga'i nang chu rags do dam so so'i rtsis khongs nas gsol ston gra sgrig gzab rgyas zhu rgyu dang chu rags do dam pa so sor sngar lam gnang cha dngul shog chag dang kha btags bcas yod pa red/ dbyar kha rgyun du sku 'bum thang du rags gnyer ba gcig 'gan dkri bsko gzhag byas yod pa kho pas dbyar kha gtsang chu rgyas che chung gi r+yā tshad mtho dma' ji yod skabs so sor chu tshad khyer yong ba mi dpon nas thad kar rtse 'gag dang bka' shag tu snyan seng gis chu tshad mthor slobs yod na/ du gnam bskul nas chu rags nyams gso byed dgos pa red/las khungs kyi sgrig gzhi'i skon/shod skor gnas lnga pa'i nang gi las tshan mi dpon gnyis/ 'dzugs khungs lha sa tsho pa yin pa'i drung yig gcig mi dpon sger so sos bsko gzhag byed pa'i gnyer pa gnyis/ pu li si'i brgya dpon gcig 'dzugs khungs zhol las khungs yin pa'i khang gnyer gcig de'i gsham du las ka byed mkhan gad pa gcig btson srung gcig bskor bya ba sogs kyi 'go 'doms 'gan 'khur rags rgyab 'go pa zhes pa gcig 'dzugs khungs so nam las khungs sogs las khungs 'ga' shas dang / sde dpon mi drag khagabla brang che khag sogs nas 'dzugs dgos pa'i bskor bya ba mi grangs sum cu/dar chen gzims bzhengs dang / btson pa bros byol 'tshol zhib/ btsog rigs kyi zhabs brtan rdzas cha bsdu nyar/ phyogs sprang sogs rags kha tsha tshul la rtsis sprad mi rtsa bdag nyar/ nag can khrag sbyor lag bstar bya rgyu 207

sogs kyi byed sgo yod pa'i rags stobs pa mi grangs sum cu/ de tsho'i 'go pa bskor bya ba'i nang gi rags rgyab dpon po phud/ da dung rags rgyab pa nang khul nas nā yas zer ba zhig yod pa red/ bskor bya ba rnams kyi nang nas sa ris bskor bya ba zhes pa de lha sa khul du sa bgos brgyab yod pa red/khungs so so'i sa khongs su gnas tshul lhag na sa res bskor bya bas las khungs su shod par yong dgos/ so so'i sa khul du phar bskyel dgos rigs sa res bskor bya ba so sos byed dgos/ sa res bskor bya bar dmangs khrod kyi ming 'bod srol du ‘‘zhabs chag lags’’zer ba red/khrims chas sna mang yod pa ni de snga 'grims ston khang nang bshoms gnang mdzad pa ltar gsal bshad dgos pa med cing / khrims yig thad zhal lce bcu gsum zhes pa rtsa 'dzin yin khul yang skabs sbyar gnas tshul la gzhigs te 'char gzhi phyag rtags 'brel nas thag gcod dang / chung rtsag rigs 'phral 'phral mi dpon nas thag gcod byed dgos pa red/ grwa rigs dang dmag mi'i gyod don dgon sde dang dmag sgar so sor thag gcod bya rgyur rtsis sprod byed srol 'dug tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pa gshegs rjes nga tsho'i pha dam pa de nyid kyi mig 'bras gnyis ka bton pa'i nyes chad dang /se ra'i zhal gzim gyis thengs gcig sgrig 'chal grwa pa gnyis kyi rkang lag bcad pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung ba red/snang shag las khungs kyi sprod khongs yig rigs su dam dmar nag 'khod pa'i rtsa 'dzin byed sgo'i yig rigs snga phyi yod cing / rgyun du 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i dbang tshad khyab khongs sa mtshams ni lha sa'i gling bskor nang tshun dang / nub kyi sa mtshams g.yu thog zam pa'i dkyil du yod pa'i a long tshur bcad yin cing / phar bcad zhol pa las khungs nas do dam 208

'gan 'khur dgos shing / chibs sgyur che mo'i skabs gro gzhas dang /khang yod khang chung / 'ju gzhung 'go pa sogs la lta rtog dang / rnam kun dam pos dam bcings kyi sgrig srol lag bstar dgos pa red/las khungs kyi khral 'bab bsdu rgyu'i skor/dar chen slong skabs om thag dgos mkhor nag chu khul nas khul rtsid 'dres ma'i thag pa do po bcu tsam bsdu rgyu yod cing / lo re om thag dgos mkho dngos do po gnyis tsam dang / las cha rnams la skal ba phran bu re sgrig 'bul la do po gnyis 'bul dgos phud de 'phros mi dpon sger so sor phyogs bgos rgyag gi red/ om rgyag byed om shing dang / sdig ra'i yu ba chu shur khul gling kha gar yod nas lo gnangs chag lcam shing ring tshad lon pa nyis brgya skor bcad nas skyel 'dren yang chu shur mnga' khongs rang nas byed dgos shing / lo re om shing gi dgos mkho dngos lcam grangs nyi shu skor dgos pa phud 'phros sger so sor phyogs bgos rgyag gi red/ de min rdza khral zer ba zhig kyang bsdu rgyu yod la/ rgyun du las khungs su khrims gtugs byed mi su zhig byung rung gnad don che chung la ma ltos par kha btags re gtong dgos pa de dag phyir slog byed srol med par len rkyang byed pa red/khrims lugs dbang tshad thog nas 'char gzhi phyag rtags 'brel dgos dang mi dgos sna tshogs yod/ dper na/ dga' ldan dgon gyi grwa log 'ar dpon zhes pas gtso byas mi bcu gnyis tsam sgrig btsugs byas nas la phreng bkag nas 'phrog bcom byed pa dang / rku ma sna tshogs rkus thog kho tshos lha sa bla brang rnying pa'i 'og tu khang stong chen po zhig bzung nas mtshan mo 209

tshogs 'dzom gyis bkod jus gtso bo 'ar dpon nas byed pa'i gnas tshul shes rjes dgong mo kha shas sgug ste dgong gcig mi mang tsam 'dzoms skabs mi bdun 'dzin bzung thub pa dang de 'phros bros shor ba red/ de'i skabs gnad don tshabs che ba brag la'i thog mi gnyis bsad yod pa de dag gi byed gte lag dmar ba 'ar dpon yin pa ra 'phrod byung bar brten tsha 'dri phud lag dmar 'ar dpon la rta lcag brgya tham pa btang nas btson 'jug byas pa dang / de byings so sor rta lcag bdun cu re btang nas rags kha tsha tshu'/ la rtsis sprod byas pa dang / rkus dngos rnams lha khul ngo shes 'ga' shas la bcol 'dug pa rnams bsdu len byas pa ma zad/ dngos po bcol khungs so sor nyes pa mgur mo nyi shu nas sum cu'i bar btang nas thag gcod byas pa red/ gzhan yang rku ma che chung gang shor rung rkun tho dngos ming kha gsal las khungs su nyin bcu tshun skyel dgos pa dang / rjes su rkun brtsad chod de dngos po thon pa byung na dngos po do bdag la phyir sprod kyis dngos po rin thang la phab pa'i bcu zur dngul 'bab las khungs nas bsdu ba dang / nyes pa mgur mo gtong skabs mgur mo rer dngul ṭam ka brgyad re brtse ba dang /snga rabs ṭam dkar mngon mdog sprod kyi yod 'dug kyang / rjes su ṭam dkar 'dza' thang mtho ba dang dkon du song bar brten mgur mo rer pad shag ṭam ka brgyad re len gyi yod pa red/ khrims sa gong ma zhes tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag gi bka' dang phyag rtags 'brel ba'i nyes chad gser srang 'brel ba'i nyes bcad bkod nas gtong ba gser srang gang rer pad shag srang dgu dang zho drug re brtsi ba de yang pho lo mo lo zhes khyad par phran bu yod pa red/gyod gzhi chung tsag la ma dan pa'i gnas tshul byung skabs shing gi sho 210

dkar nag chen po gnyis yod pa dang / bden don gyi dpang po yang med pa'i rtsod pa der sho ma rgyab gong slog sprod gtan 'bebs bzos rjes sho mig che chung bltas nas sho mig che ba bab mkhan der shor mkhan des dkar gsol kha btags shig dang sbrags slog sprod dngul dngos sprod dgos/ grwa pa dang dmag mi'i dbar rgyab 'dre brgyab nas mi bsad yang yang yong ba dang / mi gsod byed gte skabs 'phral 'dzin bzung ma thub par bros byol song tshe rab la chu shur dang rgyal rtse bar kha par gtong ba tsam las mi bsad byed gte kha shas mthar skyelu —'dzin bzung thub kyi med/ rnam kun dgong ltar lha sa'i chu tshod dgu pa'i thog las khungs sgo rtsa nang phyi mda' zhes nā pha'o brgyab nas mtshan 'grul byed mkhan mi gcig kyang phyir 'gro mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs yod pa red/ de min gnas skabs kyi gtan 'bebs gal che'i rigs bka' shag brgyud tā la'i bla ma'i chog mchan thob dgos pa red/ phyi mda' zhes pa phyi log 'grul mtshams gcod pa'i brda gtong me mda' yin pas phyi mda' brgyab zin nas mtshan 'grul byed mi skabs 'phral 'dzin bzung byas nas gnas tshang ra sprod byas te 'jog pa dang / gnas tshang ra sprod bya yul med pa yin na de'i dgong mo dmag sgar du bkag nyar byas nas sang nyin las khungs su skad btang ste 'dri brtsad byed kyi red/mi dpon so sor gong gi khral bsdu'i yong 'bab lhag ma sger 'bab gong 'khod dang / rkun dngos gzhung bzhes btang ba'i nang gyon chas sogs sna tshogs yod pa dang / lhag par dmag sgar nasru g.yog khongs mi gsum yod pa de dag dmag mi ngo 'dzugs ma dgos par sger gyis dmag dod len gyi yod cing / dmag dod mtho bar ṭam rdo brgyad cu tsam yod pa red/ zla re'i dmag phogs mi rer 'bru khal gsum re rtsis 'bru khal dgu re 'babari kyi red/211

de snga'i spyi tshogs thog las rigs tshogs pa khag nang rdo shing spyi pa ni nang khul du khrims 'go rang btsan zhig yin cing / ‘od ma gtong dgos pa zhig bzos byung’ zer ba'i gtam dpe de ni od ma btang nas khrims gcod byas chog pa las rta lcag gtong mi chog/ bzo khang pa zer ba tshem bzo spyi par yang nang khul gong dang 'dra ba'i nang khrims gcod chog pa/ zon mkhe ba ni zon pa'i las ka tsam ma zad/ dos po rgyag rgyu sogs kyi las 'gan yod pa der nang khul 'go pa yod kyang / 'go 'doms lte ba snang shag las khungs rang nas byed dgos/ rmar mdzo gsang gsum gyi 'go pa dang /gzhung sog 'go pa/ wa gling sha yon/ sing pa'i 'go pa sogs yod cing /lha bris par che mo ba drung gtogs zur du yod/ lha sa smon lam tshugs skabs snang rtse shag tu yod pa'i btson pa rnams sngon tshud nas zhol las khungs su skyel dgos pa dang / bod zla 1tshes 2nyin smon lam gral 'dzin tshugs nas smon lam zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / tshogs mchod zhag bcu gnyis ring lha khul khrims dbang 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngos rtsis len gyis gral 'dzin nyin snang shag rdo skas gsham du zhang po shing gnyer dang / chab bdag ma gnyis yong nas snang shag mdun gyi sa steng der dge g.yog rnams rdzig rngams gang che'i sgo nas mtha' bskor te sdod pa dang / zhang po shing gnyer gyis lag rgyugs sa la brdabs te skad shugs chen pos mar thon shog zer skabs bskor bya ba mi bcu tsam zhig las khungs rdo skas nas mar babs yong nas gsham der zhwa mo phud de bka' sgyur nyan dgos pa de'i thog chab bdag ma gnyis nas smon lam ring bca' yig che mo'i dgongs don ltar bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis dgos don med pas khrims kyi bdag po mi nga gnyis yin zer ba'i khyab bsgrags byed pa dang / (mi nga gnyis zer ba zhal ngo'i tshab yin lugs 212

bstan pa red)de rjes zhang po shing gnyer gyis dar chen yod pa der rgyugs pa bzhu tsam byas nas sdod skabs karma shar mgon po ba de'i sar bka' sgyur nyan par yong dgos pa dang / der chab bdag mas shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po'i blon po bya khri spyan gcig ni ga la yin/ chu shur bstan pa tshe ring rkyen lam du song ba skye gnas ma phyin par gnas yod par smon lam ring rnga rdung rdung du ba phyur phyur bsangs ab ra'i kha rlangs tsam btang mi chog zer ba dang / de nas rdo khung chu mig dang / khang pa'i chu mig sogs la gong bzhin phyin te tshogs chu ma chad pa gtsang ma 'bul dgos pa'i tshogs gtam gtong ba red/de tsho ni tshogs chen zhal ngos lha klu mi gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i mtshon byed yin/lha sar smon lam tshogs ring spyir btang khrims dbang yongs rdzogs tshogs chen zhal ngo gnyis nas 'dzin pa las mi dpon gyis the gtogs byed mi dgos kyang / tā la'i bla ma smon lam tshogs phebs pa dang / byams pa gdan 'dren/ tshogs mchod ser sbreng sogs la mi dpon gnyis spos sner 'gro dgos pa ma zad/ lhag par bco lnga mchod pa'i dgong mo mchod gzigs yod na rtsa ba'i 'gan 'khur zhal ngo gnyis nas byed kyang mi dpon gnyis kyis kyang bde 'jags 'gan 'khur mnyam du byas nas bskor g.yeng du skyod dgos shing / de nyin bod dmag rnams sngon tshud nas ru sgrigs kyis klu sbug sa stong du ang bsar byas te sdod pa nyi ma rgas khar bar skor nas mda' dpon so sos sne khrid ru sgrig kyis rnga dung sbar cha btang nas gzab mchor ldan pa'i ngang ru sgrig dang pos bar bskor gcig brgyab zin rjes sde dpon rdo ring pa'i khang 'gram nas bla steng du kha gtad de tā la'i bla mar ru sgrig sa lam zhu ba dang / ru sgrig gnyis pas bar bskor nang srang lam khag 213

tu dmag mi kha bkram nas 'jog pa dang / gzim chung pa rnams srang lam khag la thag rgya bkram pa'i skabs bar bskor nang nas phyir thon 'gro mi ma gtogs phyi nas bar bskor nang tshur mi gcig kyang gtong gi ma red/ sa srib nas bar bskor nang las 'gan yod mkhan ma gtogs 'gro mi chog pa dang / tā la'i bla ma mchod gzigs su phebs ḍi'i nang phebs skabs chibs zhabs su gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs rdzogs cab langs kyis 'gro dgos pa dang mchod pa so so'i 'gram du las khungs dang / dgon sde/ sde dpon khag sogs mchod bdag ngo ma so sos phyag 'tshal dang 'brel kha btags re phul ba mgron blangs rang slog rtsal zhus gus btud kyis sdod dgos/ skabs der yig tshang mkhan drung rgan pas mchod pa'i tho klog nas tā la'i bla ma'i bka' ltar ang ki 'god kyi red/ rgyud stod smad sogs mchod pa legs gras mang po yod/ nga tsho'i las khungs kyi mchod pa ni snga lo'i rnying pa der nyams gso phran bu byas nas 'jog pa yin stabs spag phyis 'dra ba zhig yod pas lo ltar ang grangs dma' ba'i gras red/ tā la'i bla ma mchod gzigs ma grub bar bar bskor nang gi khang pa steng khang tshang ma nas lta mi chog pa'i bskor g.yeng yang yang bya gi yod rung / steng khang rnams kyi bzhu mar bsad de ras sang nang nas lkog tu lta mkhan yod pa red/ mchod gzigs skabs tā la'i bla ma'i sku 'gram du sku srung dmag mis gling bu gtong bzhin sri zhu'i gus bkur thog mchod gzigs zin nas gtsug lag khang du phyir phebs gnang ma thag bar bskor nang gi thag rgya glod kyi red/ de skabs mi sdebs gcig tu 'ur nas sa cha dog sa la skabs re rgan rgon dang byis pa re tsam brdzis nas 'chi ba yang yong gi yod pa dang / nye skor grong gseb phan tshun bar bskor du sgor gzhas 'gran bsdur nam ma gsal bar byed kyi red/214

snang shag las khungs kyi brten pa'i srung ma gtso bo ni karma shar chos skyong red/ de la zla gsol gtong dgos pa ma zad/ lha sa khul nas tshes gsum dang tshes lnga zer ba sogs lha mi ba'i skyid sdug yod cing / nga tshos gtso bo bod zla 5tshes 15nyin 'dzam gling spyi bsangs zhes lha gsol dang sbrags gling ga gtong ba'i dus chen du brtsi ba dang / de nyin karma shar gling gar karma shar dang / rags rgyab btsan khang gi lha mi lha bdag 'khor bcas nas lding gur chen po phub nas de'i nang karma shar chos skyong dang / de'i 'khor rags rgyab btsan khang chos skyong gnyis snga po nas spyan 'dren zhu sar mi dpon 'gro dgos pas lha gsol zhu gnas chang dngul phor gtong ba dang / de nyin gur nang khong tshos gsol ston zhig bshom gyi yod kyang mi dpon gnyis so so sger gyi gling gar 'gro ba las gsol ston la sdod kyi med kyang / las bya dang lha mi rnams gling ga btang nas sdod pa red/ bod zla 6pa'i zla mjug tu karma shar du ru 'dren 'cham rgyag gi ltad mor mi dpon gnyis 'gron 'bod ltar bskyod kyi yod/ karma shar chos skyong lha sa'i sa bdag klu btsan dbang gi mdog tu 'bod pa de yin pas snang shag las khungs kyis bsten gsol dgos pa de red/las khungs kyi yong 'bab thog nas lo re smon lam skabs sgrigs 'bul zhus dgos kyi las khungs zhol pa dang / lha sa gnyer tshang / snang shagachibs che/ bsher khang / sku gnyer dpon sogs yod pa'i sgrig 'bul las khungs so so'i 'bab che chung la gzhigs pa'i ang grangs bkod nas de nyin do bdag ngo ma so so jo bo dbu skra'i steng gi rab gsal du ang grangs gzhir bzung gral sgrig dgos pas ang grangs dma' po chags na ngo tsha po yod pa red/sgrig 'bul du sprod byed dngos po las khungs rang gi yong 'bab thog gi dngos po sna tshogs yod pa'i thog dngul rkyang yang sprod kyi red/215

bsher khang las khungs dang 'brel yod skor/lha sa gtsug lag khang nang bsher khang las khungs yod pa der phyogs mtha'i rdzong khag gi btson pa 'byor ba rnams bsher khang la zur du btson khang med skabs thag gcod ma zin bar snang rtse shag gi btson khang du 'jog dgos pa red/ gtsug lag khang nang zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i las khungs btsugs pa'i nang gses drag po'i las khungs bsher khang las khungs de red/de'i ming cha tshang la (bsher khang bdud sde tshar gcod) brer/ dga' ldan khri pa dang / gnas chung chos skyong sogs la spos sne zhu dgos gal che'i skabs 'ga' shas su bsher dpang dang mi dpon mnyam bskyod byed dgos pa red/lha sa gnyer tshang dang zung sbrel byed dgos pa'i skor/bod zla 6tshes 4nyin sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin gtsug lag khang gi bar khang nang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i spyan sngar yod pa'i chos rgyal nyid sku dngos bzhugs skabs bed spyod gnang myong ba'i lo rgyus can gyi gna' rdzas rdza kho'i 'khrungs ban ngo ma yod pa de'i nang 'khrungs phud gsar du 'gengs 'bul zhu dgos pas nyin de'i snga dro nam skya rengs 'go gtong skabs lha sa gnyer tshang pa dang / mi dpon ngo ma rnams bar khang chos rgyal lha khang mdun du 'dzoms nas gdan khrir 'khod de bzhugs gral btang nas gro ma 'bras sil sogs sgrig bshoms kyis rten 'brel gzab rgyas byed skabs dpal gsol mas gzhas chen gyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang / gnyer mi dpon ngo las rnams kyis chos rgyal la snyan dar 216

sogs 'bul dgos/ drung ja'i dus su chos rgyal 'khrungs ban gyi 'khrungs phud khyer nas nor gling du tā la'i bla ma'i sar srong btsan gyi 'khrungs phud phul nas mjal kha zhu ba dang / bka' shag tu de bzhin 'khrungs ban btegs dgos pa red/ de nas lha khul mi drag khag dang mi dmangs tshos 'khrungs ban nas byin rlabs zhu ba dang 'khrungs gsos 'bul gyi red/ de'i nyin gyi 'khrungs ban gdan zhu'i byed sgo de'i ming la dkar me bskul bzhengs zer zhing / de'i don sngar lam gtsug lag khang gi dkar me'i kha gso dge bskul byed pa'i ming yin pa dang / mchod mar zhal 'debs lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs su bskyel dgos pas mi drag khyim tshang 'ga' zhig gi mchod rgyun gtong deb la'ang de ltar 'khod yod pa red/ yang bod zla drug pa'i zla smad dam/zla bdun pa'i tshes shar gang rung la lha sar 'ong bskor gtong dgos pas de nyin lha sa gnyer tshang pa dang mi dpon ngo ma 'khor bcas nas dmigs bsal gyi gzab mchor thog jo bo dbu skra'i rab gsal du bka' shag lhan rgyas kyis lha sa gnyer mi dpon la phyogs bzhi'i g.yang sgug zhes pa'i 'ong bskor byed sgo'i bka' khyab zhus te gnyer mi dpon gyi gyon chas zhwa mo sbu phru dang / snyan pad rī 'dogs pa/ phyu pa rgyan bzhi/ gser sked/ lha sa gnyer tshang pa ser mo bas 'phya gru chab stod thog tshang ma'i rta sga gser sga rgyag dgos la mgron gnyer yang khrid de g.yog por gos tshos man ser po dang / ga sog rgyab pa'i rta gral gyi sngon la rten gdung dang / phyag dar 'khyer mi sogs dang / lag stod pas zhwa nag gi chas gyon dgos pa/ rtse 'phags pa lha khang gi nang rten dang / lha sa jo bo'i na bza' sogs sku gnyer gyis gdan drangs te rta hrag sgrigs nas lha sa'i 'ong ga bskor te glang rur gur phub nas gdan khri dang / khri cog sogs gra rgyas yod par bzhugs gral gtong ba dang / gro ma 'bras 217

sil sogs bod zas rgyas pa cha tshang btang ste nyin gung lhod por sdod/dgong dro chu tshod dang po tsam la tshang mar gsol ston btang nas dngul phor btegs/ chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la rta gral sgrig nas 'ong ga 'phros rnams bskor ba dang sbrags phyir log byed dgos pa red/ 'ong bskor ma tshar bar lha sa 'ong gar btsas ma brnga mi chog pa'i sngar srol gtan 'bebs yod pa red/gor zhib las khungs do dam sngar lam mkhan rim thog mi dpon gcig 'gro dgos pa nga rang thog 'khel zhing / gor ṣa'i phyogs nas gal che'i skabs kab tan ngo ma yong ba las/ rnam kun ḍi ṭa dang / tha ka li gnyis yong zhing / gor ṣa'i mi dang bod mi'i dbar gnad don lhag na thun mong nas thag gcod byed dgos pa dang / gnad don che rigs bka' shag dang /skabs 'gar rtse 'gag tu gnas lugs zhu dgos/ gor zhib las khungs su rgyun sdod drung yig gcig ched mngags yod pa las khungs tshugs skabs ja dang zhal tog gtong dgos/ gor zhib dgos cha zhes pa zla re rtse shod las khungs khag nas drung yig rang gis blangs te gtong sgo yang 'gan len byed dgos pa dang / yig cha khag dkar chag dang sbrags drung yig la rtsis sprod yod pa bzhin khong rang nas bdag gnyer byed dgos/218 si

rang nyid gar pa byas pa'i 'brel yod gnas chul rags rim/gar dpon pa sangs don grub kyis/bod kyi gar pa 'di nyid thog mar rab byung 11chu rta (1642)lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho bod kyi lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i thog ma'i mdzad sgo'i skabs/ la dwags rgyal mo o rgyan bu 'khrid ngo mas gar dpon ma ṇi bde bas gtsos gar khrab mkhan sogs mi grangs nyi shu skor mnyam 'khrid kyis lha sar rgyal ba dgyes pa'i gar gyi 'khrab ston mchod sprin phul bar/ tā la'i bla ma dgyes tshor ha cang chen po byung nas o rgyan bu 'khrid la gar gyi tshogs pa zhig sbyong brdar dgos lugs bka' mngags dang bcas la dwags su gar sbyong mkhan mi kha shas gtong gnang mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar la dwags rgyal mos gar dpon gu ti ched gtong dang 'brel mnyam du gar chas dang / rol cha/ rol dbyangs sogs lha sar 'byor rjes nang don 'dra ba rnams phyogs sgrigs gnang yod pa dang /lo rgyus kyi yig lam ltar na sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos thugs 'gan bzhes te gar dpon gu ti dang / de'i bu bkra shis sogs kyi skabs gar pa'i glu tshig nang don sogs gar gyi 'khrab ston phun sum je tshogs su btang ste tā la'i bla mar bstod dbyangs 'bul ba'am/ bod kyi yul ljongs dang pho brang sogs la bstod pa'i gzhas tshig gi nang don yig thog bkod yod pa dang rol cha sna 219

mang phun sum tshogs po yod pa sogs gar gyi nang don dang rnam pa yar rgyas che tsam byung 'dug la sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rig rtsal la mnyes tsam yod pa ma zad/ mkhas pa'ang yin gshis/ skabs der gar gyi skor la'ang sde srid rang nyid nas thad kar dbu khrid gnang gi yod 'dra bas/ nga tsho'i gar pa'i dngos chas khongs dus phyis kyang sde srid kyi mchod zhal sogs yod pa red/sngar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs byung ba'i gar dpon gu ti'i bu bkra shis gar dpon gsum par bsko bzhag gnang ba nas bzung gar dpon rim byung gis ngos pa sangs don grub rang nyid kyi ( 1959) bar bod kyi gar pa 'di nyid rgyun mthud gnas thub pa byung yod pa ma zad nga rang gar dpon gyi las thog byas rjes 'os 'tsham kyi yar rgyas kyang song yod pa dper na/rol cha'i thog gsar 'phar yang ching dang / sgra snyan rgyud drug pa/ phred gling thebs drug bcas dang / de 'brel gar pa'i gzhas rgyun nang sngar med bod mi dmangs kyis ha cang dga' po byed pa'i rgyun gtong nang ma'i dal gzhas dang zhabs bro/ stod gzhas kyi rgyang gzhas le tshan khag dang khyug gzhas sogs bsnan te gar pa'i glu gar rol dbyangs de bas sna mang phun sum je tshogs su gyur yod/de snga gar 'khrab mkhan ‘‘gar phrug pa ’’zhes phru gu lo na bcu yas mas mi grangs bcu gsum skor dgos pa/ lo 'khor bcu gnyis re'i mtshams su lha sa zhol khongs dang / lho kha/ gtsang khul bcas kyi gzhung sger chos gsum khongs nas phru gu skyes mched gtsang zhing / shes rig ldan pa bsdu bskong gis de dag la khral rkang gcig gi khral rigs tshang ma chag yang gtong rgyu'i lag 'khyer sprod srol yod/ gar pa'i khrab chas thad gong bkod ltar de snga la dwags rgyal mos phul ba'i 'khrab dngos rnams kyi srol rgyun mnyam par bsdad 220

yod pa'i thog 1(ba59lo'i bar 'khrab chas cha tshang rab 'bring kha shas yod/sngar srol tā la'i bla ma pho brang yas mas su chibs bsgyur dang /dgongs rdzogs so so'i dus tshes la brda ma dang / bsu sna sogs kyi rol cha'i nang gtong yas gar glu khag nyi shu rtsa drug dang / gar dang mnyam gtong gzhas sum cu so gnyis bcas khyon gzhas sna khag lnga bcu nga brgyad yod/dngos gzhi'i gar rol 'khrab bya'i dus tshes ni lo ltar bod zla 1lo gsar tshes gcig nyin rtse po ta la'i tshoms chen du gar thengs gsum 'khrab dgos pa de'i nang don gcig de dpe mtshon du bshad na ‘‘gnas ri bo gru 'dzin gyi rtse mo la/gser zangs kyi rgya phibs dang / rgyal mtshan tsho 'phags ’’ces gtong srol/tshes 2nyin po ta la'i tshoms chen du gar thengs gnyis dang / gri gar gcig bcas la nang don gong mtshungs/ tshes 2dang tshes 27gnyis la rdzong rgyab tu shod skor dang / mi dmangs bcas pa'i 'du tshogs sar gar glu thengs gsum rol cha dang mnyam du gtong zhing / de'i gzhas tshig ni ‘‘lam du 'gro ba'i sa gzhi ni/ chu skyes rgyas pa'i khengs 'dug gang du sdod pa'i gnas mal ni/ lha yi khang bzang yin 'dug’’ces sogs dang nang ma bkra la shis pa sogs ridang stod gzhas kyi zhabs bro rgyag srol yod/ bod zla 1tshes 25nyin byams pa gdan 'dren skabs bar skor khrom tshogs sar brda ma dang /bsu sna/ 'khar rnga bcu pa brdungs te gar gzhas gtong srol/ gzhas tshig la ‘‘shar gsum shar nas shar byung / shar gyi drod 'jam nyi ma’’zhes sogs dang / bod zla 2tshes 20nyin tshogs mchod ser sbreng skabs thog mar gtsug lag khang khyams rwa'i sgo 'phyor 'og tu ser sbreng don skabs su bsu sna dang / brda ma brdungs te gar 'khrab bzhin pa'i ngang 'dod 'jo'i ba brdzi khyams rwa'i sgo 'phyor 'og nas don yong nas rtsed 'jo'i tshul gyis gar phrug 221

pa'i gar 'khrab stangs kyi lad mo byas kyang ji ma ji bzhin ma shes pa sogs bzhad gad dang 'khrug cha dod po yod stabs der yod lha khul dang phyogs mtha'i mi dmangs ltad mo ba rnams dang / se 'bras dgaljo gsum gyi dge 'dun bcas nas 'tshang ka shig thig gis gzigs kyi red/ je/ nas phebs rnga gtong bzhin par bar skor brgyud zhol nas khang yang steng du 'byor 'phral gong bzhin rol cha dang / gar 'khrab ston byed dgos pa dang / de nas ser sbreng dang mnyam du phebs rnga gtong bzhin par po ta la'i pho brang la skor ba byas te rwa che gtsug lag khang gi mdun du gong bzhin gar cha tshang zhig 'khrab ston byed srol bcas dang / bod zla 10nang lnga mchod gar sbyong dang /zla 12nang lo gsar gar spyong zhes/ lcang gseb shar dang / bzhugs khri gling kha'i nang nyin gsum tsam ring gar phrug pas gar dang / gar pa rgan gras su slebs pa rnams kyis rgyun gtan gyi gar chas min pa'i sger gyi gos chen sngon po zhe gcig gi mtshal phyu ma dang / zhwa mo sog zhwa bcas gzab mchor gang rgyas spras te ‘ dpe ston’’zer ba'i gar thengs gcig dang / mi bzhis gri gar thengs gcig 'khrab srol bcas la ltad mo ba mang tshogs sha stag red/ yang bod zla 7pa'i nang nor gling du zho ston lha mo'i skabs dpon rigs dang /lha mo 'khragremakhan tsho nyin gung zhal lag gi bar gseng du gar phrug pas gar chas ma yin pa'i rgyun gtan gyon chas gzab mchor gyis nang ma dang / stod gzhas sna tshogs btang ste ltad mo ba mang tshogs rnams la ltad mo'i le'u ston pa sogs gong gsal de dag gi thog nas de sngon bod kyi gar pa'i 'khrab rgyun 'di ni rgyun gtan mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi blta 'dod che ba'i ltad mo'i le'u zhig dang / mi dmangs dang 'brel 'dris dam zab yod pa zhig yin pa las/de snga'i bod kyi gar ni ‘‘pho brang nang dang / mtho rim mi sna kho na'i ched du 222

'khrab ston byed pa ’’tsam zhig gtan nas min/gar phrug byed ring du gzhung nas dmigs bsal gyi lo re'i gos rgya rtse phyag nas snam ljang thig gi gos dang / bla phyag nas ja mar/ zhol gnyer nas tshwa bul dang chang rgyu/ rtsam bzhes las khungs nas zla rer rtsam khal bzhi re bcas sprod lam dang / gar phrag lo dus gtsang rjes so so'i shes rig la stogazhigs pa'i rtse shod phyag nang ngam/ zhol drung dang rtse shod gnyer nang /zhol nang sogs gang 'os bsko gzhag byed srol yod/ gar dpon ni las 'gan 'khur mtshams nas bzung zhol drung bgres song tsho'i gral 'gor bsdad 'thus dmigs bsal yod thog zhol drung spyi 'dra'i phogs thob kyi khar/gar dpon la gar pa'i phogs rtsam dang / ja mar/ tshwa bul/ chang rgyu sogs mi skal gnyis re dang / rtse phyag nas snam can bubs gcig dang /gar pa rgan pa tshang mar gos rgyu bal 'os 'tshams bcas sprod srol 'dug1kha56lor bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang 'dzugs skabs tsung li gzhon pa khren dbyis tshogs gtso gnang ba'i krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa bod du phebs skabs bod kyi dmangs khrod zlos gar 'khrab ston gyi 'gan khur gar pa nas byed dgos lugs kyi bkod sgrig ltar nga rang nas 'gan khur gyis thog mar mdzad sgo'i thog nang ma dang / stod gzhas kyi le'u gang 'tsham 'khrab ston byas pa dang / de rjes mtshan tshogs shig la khren dbye phebs skabs gri gar sogs kyi gar 'khrab pa dang / stod gzhas nang ma'i gzhas dang zhabs bro'i le tshan 'khrab ston zin mtshams tshogs gtso khren dbyis dbus gtso gnang ba'i krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa 'khrab ston sding cha'i thog phebs te nga tsho tshang mar phyag btang gnang ba dang bod rigs kyi zlos gar la thugs ha cang dgyes tshor chen po gnang gi 'dug de rjes mi dmangs tho 223

thang chen du gar dang / stod gzhas/ nang ma bcas gong bzhin 'khrab gtong byas pa dang / krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa pe cin du phyir log ma gnang gong nor gling spyan bsal pho brang gi sding cha'i thog dbu gur bya g.yabs sgron pa'i nang bod lugs kyi zhal tog sna tshogs dang / gsol ja/ mchod chang / bzhes rag sogs btegs te dgyes ston gnang skabs su'ang gar pas nang ma dang / stod gzhas kyi dal gzhas/ khyug gzhas sogs kyi gzigs mo rim par phul ba yin/ skabs der krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pas nga tsho gar par og len sogs rol bya'i yo byad khag gcig gsol stsal dang 'brel ‘‘khyod tsho bod rigs kyi rig rtsal rkang 'dzin pa zhig tu 'gyur rgyu'i re ba yod’’ces skul lcag kyang gnang byung /1959lo'i zing 'khrug lhing 'jags tshun gra sgrig gnang ba'i ljongs yongs kyi skabs dang po'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi tshogs 'du thengs dang por rang nyid kyang dmigs bsal yong dgos gsungs pa ltar tshogs 'dur bcar zhing / skabs de'i tshogs 'du'i nang phyogs gang cir yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro lugs gsungs pa las gar pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul gang yang ma gsungs stabs/ tshogs chung gi gros bsdur thog rang nyid nas ‘‘gar pa 'di bzhin bod mi dmangs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i lo rgyus nges can yod pa zhig yin’’pa'i skor gyi gnas lugs ngo sprod cung zad zhus/ de rjes nga rang dge 'os slob grwar yong dgos gsungs don 'gro mus su/ grong khyer lha sa'i rig slob las khungs nas nga la ‘‘gar pa'i 'khrab rgyun 'phral du bskyar gso byed dgos ’’skor re 'dun gnang yang / gar rgyun gyi rig rtsal rnam grangs mang gshis mi re gnyis kyis lam seng bskyar gso byed thabs bral stabs sgrig 'dzugs rang bzhin gyi gra sgrig gnang na rim pas bskyar gso 'os 224

'tshams yong rgyu'i bsam 'char zol med zhu don bzhin/ 19rdo2lo mi grangs bcu gcig sgrig 'dzugs kyi gar pa bskyar gso'i sbyong brdar byed 'go btsugs shing / zla 5tshes 15nas bzung nga rang de snga gar phrug byed skabs bslabs myong ba'i 'khrab deb rtsa 'dzin yig cha'i nang pho gar rnam grangs bco lnga dang / mo gar rnam grangs bcu gnyis/ gri gar gcig sogs 'khrab sne nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa rnams so so'i 'khrab bya mi 'dra ba dang de bzhin tshig dang / gdangs dbyangs mi 'dra ba brda ma sogs pa'i rol cha'i rigs gtong stangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa rnams da cha cha tshang bskyar gso zhus zin pa bcas so/

de snga lho kha sa khul du dbyin ji dang 'jar man slebs 'byor byung skor/lho kha srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas tshogs chung gis/rwa sgreng rgyal thog dang / lho spyi gsum pa mkhan chung 'jam dpal skal bzang / sne gdong rdzong shod drung glang mthong ngo tshab dang / la thog zung mkhar gyi ngo tshab bcas kyi skabs lho kha sa khul du dbyin ji slebs pa'i skor rtsed thang khul du rgyus mnga' che gras rtsed thang du gtan sdod bal po'i mi khongs kyi de snga'i 'go khrid byed mkhan tha ga ling dgung lo bdun bcu don lnga dang /bya sa rgan po skal bzang tshe dbang dgung lo bdun cu don gsum/ rtsed thang dbang ldan gling ko ko yang san chon dgung lo brgyad cu gya drug son pa bcas la skabs de'i lo rgyus bka' dri zhus par thog mar lha sa nas rgod la brgyud rtsed thang du dbyin ji sab gcig dang / rogs pa mi gsum/ skad sgyur bher blon chen/ 'go snam mtshal ka'i gog tse gyon pa'i 'bras ljongs pa mi bco lnga bcas nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi btang ba'i lam yig 'khyer 'byor ltar sdod sgrig rtsed thang dga' chos pa'i chab zhugs gtong yul sku gsum gling ga'i nang yod kyang / kho rang tsho'i gur phub nas bsdad pa dang /bher blon chen rtsed khang grong dkyil lo ro ba'i rgan po blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyi nang du sdod sgrig byas par bsdad pa red/ rtsed thang du nyin gnyis bsdad pa'i nyin dang por rtsed thang mgon po ri'i spre'u brag phug la phyin nas phyi nang 226

gang ṭasdor par brgyab pa dang / de nas bod la mi dar nas thog ma'i zhing ga sba ras zhing dang / za ram zhing gnyis la par rgyag dgos zer bar mang tshogs nas phyi rgyal gyi mis par brgyab na sa bcud nyams kyi red ces zhing ga ngo ma ma bstan par gzhan gnyis bstan par par brgyab pa red/ de nas rtsed thang dga' chos dgon pa dang / lnga mchod grwa tshang sogs la chos mjal du skyod pa ma zad/ nye 'dabs yul ljongs dang / grong tsho/ khrom rwa sogs la par brgyab/ de'i sang nyin lho spyi'i sar phyin nas lho spyir lag btags sa bzhu gcig dang / cog tse'i steng 'jog rgyu'i chu tshod gcigardzong la chu tshod che ba re/ tsho dpon gnyis la dbyin sgor sum cu re/ rgan por dbyin sgor bco lnga bcas sprad 'dug sne gdong 'du spyis bya 'bras brgya tham pa sprad pa blangs ma song / da lam 'dir yong chog pa ni nga tshos sde pa gzhung la me mda' dbyin ji sprad pas yong rgyu byung ba las gang byung gis yong pa min zer/ rtsed thang nas g.yas g.yon bskyod skabs rta bzhon khar sab kyis rta bzhon nas skad cig rgyag 'dug pa de nas lam seng rta bzhon nas dal bur 'gro gi 'dug dbyin jis mang tshogs nas 'o ma nyo skabs ba phyugs khrid nas kho pa tsho'i mig gis mthong sar lag pa bkrus nas bzho 'jug gi 'dugade nas tsa ri'i khul gyi dag pa shel ri'i lho bar phyin nas ri brag dang / mtsho mtshe'u/ bya ri dwags/ gcan gzan/ shing sna me tog sogs la par brgyab/ yar lam slar yang rtsed thang du 'byor nas ngal gso rgyag skabs bzung ba'i bya rigs rnams pags pa bshus pa dang / rtswa rigs me tog sogs shog bu ser po'i stebs bar bcug pa tshos mdog ma log par sos pa ltar bsdad pa mthong 'dug yang dwags po khul rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos (1927)lo nang dbyin ji 'ga' zhig 'byor skabs dwags po rgya tsha lha 227

gsol gzhis khongs lcang rwa mkhar thog la bsdad nas mkhar thog gi ri der rin po che'i gter kha sna tshogs yod pa dang / lhag par dngul chu spyad na 'dzad mtha' med pa 'dug pas 'dzam gling gi dgos mkhor btang yang 'deng nges 'dug sa cha de dbyin jir lo lnga bcu'i ring sprad na dbyin jis bzo grwa btsugs te lo lnga bcu song mtshams bzo grwa 'phrul chas cha tshang phyir sprod chog gi red ces bshad yod tshod 'dug rwa sgreng rgyal thog skabs 'byor ba'i dbyin jis yar 'brog g.yu mtsho de btsags nas bed spyad na zhing chu 'dren gtong la bed spyod thub pa dang / mu ge byung na lo gsum gyi 'tsho ba 'deng thub pa 'dug ze bshad 'dug yang dbyin jis lha rgya ri'i sa khul gter ra dgon gyi nye 'dabs su brtag dpyad tho bkod byas tshod 'dug go thos la gong gsal sa khul der phyis rang re'i gter kha bsngogs 'don byed mkhan tshos sa 'og nas rdo la dbyin ji'i ang ki brgyab pa thon pa'i skad cha 'dugayang dbyin jis mtsho sna rdzong khongs sbyor ra khul slebarngasro nas gsum star na kha zhes par gur phub nas nyin gnyis bsdad/ de khul gyi rtswa shing me tog bya byi'u sogs la par brgyab nas phyin song / yang dbyin ji 'phyongs rgyas su yong nas 'phyongs rgyas rdzong khongs mchong phur nor bu ri zhes pa yod pa'i rtser dbyin ji mi grangs drug phyin te g.yas g.yon gyi ri tshang mar rtog zhib byas nas nor bu ri zhes pa 'dir rin po che'i gter kha mang po 'dug zer nas par brgyab 'dug ri de'i sgang la sa dkar gyi ri mo bris pa dang / ri de'i sa cha khag gcig la nor bu yod tshod kyi rdo tshugs btsugs pa de deng sang yang bsdad yod skad/sa cha der rin po che mchong khru gang tsam yod pa red ces bshad srol yod/yang 'phyongs rgyas su dbyin ji thengs gnyis pa yong dus/ sa cha de ga'i chu 228

'go tshang ma'i chu la brtag dpyad byas nas chu thur srang la 'degs 'gyogs byed skabs nor bu ri'i lho phyogs su chu mig gcig yod pa de'i chu de 'phyongs rgyas khul nas bzang shos red ces bshad 'dugalho kha spyi khyab par khang mkhan chen rgyal mtshan phun tshogs las thog skabs lha sa nas rgod la brgyud nya gru thon nas rtsed thang du 'jar man slebs pa'i skor gong gsal tha ga ling sogs bgres song gsum nas ngo sprod gnang bar 'jar man bu lnga dang / bu mo gnyis/ sne shan zhol pa bsam mkhar mkhyen rab kun bzang bcas rtsed thang khang byang gling gi nang sne 'du'i sdod sgrig yod kyang kho pa tsho'i nyal khri rkub stegs rang gshoms kyis bsdad pa dang /sne shan ngo g.yog lnga rtsed thang dga' chos khang khul du bsdad/ rtsed thang du sdod ring mgon po ri'i spre'u brag phug dang / srin mo brag phug khyung tshang brag phug bcas la bskyod skabs khang byang gling ga nas dam can khang bar rta bzhon/ de nas rkang thang du bskyod nas de'i dgong dro mar lam dam can khang gi lhag tsam la sa 'khod snyoms sa zhig gi sa bsngogs nas dngos po zhig sbas pa red/ mang tshogs kyis sa der lta bar 'gro bsam yang nyen khar ma bzod pas 'gro ma phod pa red/ yang dam can khang gi 'og tsam la mchod rten lnga yod pa'i nang nas mchod rten thog sa gnyis tsam byas pa gser zangs las grub pa'i chos 'khor bcu gsum dang / nyi zla bcas yod pa der 'jar man gyis de'i nang pha mes kyi sku gdung yod pa red zer nas phyogs bzhi nas par brgyab 'dug de snga nga tsho'i bod rigs rgan rabs tsho'i shod rgyun la mchod rten de'i gzungs su pha sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa'i dbu thod yod zer ba de/ 1960lor bskyar zhib skabs mchod rten gzhig 'phro bshigs nas mi zhig gis dbu thod de 'khyer song zer ba las da cha rtsad gcod thub ma 229

song / 'jar man gyis sger pa dang / za ra'i gling ga nas 'jol mo dang /byi'u/ 'ol pa/ bya rog phru gu sogs bzung nas rlung tse'i nang bcug ste mi ser glas nas 'khyer song ba dang / lto la sha 'khor lo'i nang btags nas bster gyi 'dug sku gsum gling gi zur nas rkang gsum thog par chas bsgar nas mgon po rir par brgyab/ yang don brag nyag gi shar sbyar rag rgyud nas par brgyab/ lho bye ma mgo ril ri mtshams nas sbar ras zhing la par brgyab pa ma zad/ zheng dkyus la tshad 'jal sogs byas/ rtsed thang mchod rten chen mor par brgyab pa dang / rtsed thang grong nang du thag 'thag mkhan dang / thag khri sogs la par brgyab rnga// de nas yar klung pho brang du phyin nas chos rgyal mes ag tshoms gyi bang so mjal (ri de la g.yung drung gi bzo dbyibs yod pa red zer ) mar lam btsan thang g.yu'i lha khang nang gnya' khri btsan po'i 'dra sku mjal/ de nas lho spyi sdod yul rtse tshogs spro khang du 'jar man gnyis phyin nas lho spyir dgung grangs 'dri ba dang / nga gnyis lo na ji tsam slebs 'dug ces dris par/ lho spyis khyed gnyis lo chung chung red lab par khong gnyis nas gcig lo nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / gcig lo nyi shu tham pa yin lugs bshad song lam bar du sha khyi dkar po 'khrid pa zhig 'phrad 'dugakhong gnyis kyis lho spyi brgyud khyi de spus tshong dgos lugs dang / rin pa ga tshod byas kyang sprad chog lab pa ltar lho spyis rdzong gad phun tshogs ched btang sha khyi'i bdag po 'byor ldan zer ba 'byor nas khyi de nga'i lto gos 'tshol rogs gtso bo zhig yin yang lho spyi'i bka' ngo yin tsang btsong chog rin pa gun med gnang rogs zhus par 'jar man gyis dbyin sgor brgya tham pa sprad 'dug de nas lho spyi'i lus la brtag dpyad byas nas sman sprad pa dang /lho spyi ngo g.yog la par brgyab/ rtsed thang du sdod ring ras sgang khrom gzhung la 230

par brgyab pa dang / bod rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i spyod chas sna tshogs nyos song zhes dang / paṇa chen shākya shri'i gsung 'bum dgos lugs rtsad gcod byas 'dug kyang mig ston byed mkhan byung mi 'dug yang 'jar man mi gsum grwa nang du yong nas byams gling mchod rten chen mor zhib 'jug byas nas par brgyab pa dang / dang po bzhengs skabs kyi rgya khyon dang / mtho tshad/ de bzhin las 'go tshugs nas ma grub bar gyi dus tshod lo rgyus bcas zhib phra 'khod pa'i dpe cha cha tshang yod pa bshu bcug ste shog lhe brgya lhag tsam byung 'dug shog lte rer gla cha bod dngul zho re sprad 'dug dpe cha bshu mkhan bag gro zer ba da lta'ang bsdad 'dug pa bcas so/
sa rgyal mas

'dzin mkhan rnams bsam gros ma mthun pa'i rtsod gleng byed mus su/ nyin gcig sne mgron thub bstan legs smon bka' shag tu yong ste ‘‘skyabs mgon srid skyong rin po ches (stag brag) sang nyin nor gling du bka' shag dang sku bcar spyi mkhan lhan rgyas srid skyong rin po che'i sku mdun du phebs dgos pa'i bka' phebs byung ’’zhes bshad don bzhin phyi nyin bka' shag nor gling du 'tshog rgyur spyi mkhan yang bka' shag tu phebs dgos kyi brda tho yig chung 'bul rgyu mgron drung la bkod mngags byas pa ltar yig chung phul ba dang /de'i phyi nyin nor gling du bka' shag 'tshogs te bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ nga rang (ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma)/ spyi mkhan mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bcas nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang nang srid skyong bzhugs yul du bcar bar srid skyong stag brag gis slolha sdod rgya gar gzhung gi ngo tshab ri car san gyis nga la nang gnas su deng sang rgya nag tu dus 'gyur che ba'i skabs 'dir bod du yod pa'i rgya mi rnams 'phral du phyir 'bud byed dgos/ de ltar ma byas na lha sar yod pa'i 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal sogs gud khran tang gi gsang nyul red la/ go min tang gi lha sdod don gcod khru'i las byed pa'i nang du'ang gung khran tang gi gsang nyul yod pas kho tsho phyi nang lag sbrel byas te gung khran tang bod du yong nyen chen po 'dug gshis/ bod du yod pa'i rgya mi rnams 'phral du phyir 'bud byed dgos zhes brjod 'dug cing / des na bod du yod pa'i rgya rigs rnams 'phral du phyir 'bud byed dgos/ 'di ni bstan srid kyi bde don gal cher brten gsang ba dam srung thog tshang masardog rtsa gcig sgril byed sgo gang ci bsam zhib gros bsdur gyis 'khur bsam cher skyed byed dgos ’’zhes gsungs song zhing / skabs der rgyal nang gi gnas tshul 233

la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste go min tang cang ce hre'i srid dbang snum zad mar me lta bu'i gnas su lhungs pa dang / rgyal yongs su bcings 'grol thob nyer brten a ri dang / dbyin ji/ hinatshordu bcas dang / de 'brel bod du yod pa'i kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang mi sna ches nyung shas bcas la dngangs skrag chen po skyes pa'i dus skabs yin stabs lha sdod rgya gar gzhung gi ngo tshab ri car san gyis lkog g.yo'i sbyor ba la brten nas bod nas ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud ’’zer ba'i don rkyen de byung ba las/ bod ljongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs zhing bran khri tsho brgya phrag rnams yar langs bcings 'grol 'thob rgyur skom pa chu 'dod ltar byed pa ni skabs de'i bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul yin par brten phran nas srid skyong dang / bka' shag spyi mkhan bcas lhan 'tshogs sar ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’byed rgyu e yod ces gang bsam zol med bshad par spyi mkhan mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin dang / bka' blon zur khang /bka' blon bla ma ram pa bcas nas ‘‘deng skabs rgya nag tu dus 'gyur che ba'i skabs 'dir rgya mi phyir 'bud byas na byed thub pa zhig yong nges thog phyin chad las don gang thad bya lam byed bde yong rgyur skyabs mgon srid skyong rin po che'i bka' bzhin ‘rgya mi phyir 'bud ’ byas na legs’’lugs gcig gyur gyis bar+shad song bas/ de don lha sdod go min tang srid gzhung gi dpon rit+pa/sa rnams dang / 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ gzhan yang gdan sa 'bras se dga' gsum dang / lha sa grong khyer nang sdod dwogs gnad yod pa'i rgya rigs rnams thengs dang po/ 1949lo'i zla 7tshes 11nyin dang /theng sa gnyis pa zla 7tshes 17 thengs gsum pa zla 7tshes 20bcas la lha sa nas rdog thon gyis rgya gar brgyud phyir slog btang ba dang / de bzhin khams khul du yod pa'i rgya rigs rnams kyang mdo spyi bka' blon lha klus phyir slog 234

btang ba red/spyi lo 194khazla 7tshes 20nyin lha sa nas rgya mi phyir slog zin pa'i gnangs nyin te/ zla 7tshes 22nyin ngos rang nor gling bka' shag tu lhan tshogs byed mus su glo bur du srid skyong sar yong dgos zhes pa'i lan brda byung don bzhin bskyod kyang srid skyong ngo mas ngo thug ma byas par shod gzim chung 'gag tu yong dgos zhes brjod pa dang / der bskyod skabs gzim chung nang srid skyong gi bzhugs khri'i 'gram nas sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis bka' bsgyur btang don ‘‘skyabs mgon srid skyong rin po che'i bka' spyi phebs su/ nye char bstan srid kyi bde don gal che ‘rgya mi phyir 'bud ’byed pa'i skabs der sprang phrug gcig gis khrom dkrog pa dang / khyod nas gsang ba phyir gyar gyis rgya mir lan bskyal ba sogs kyi gleng lhags 'di skor brtsad zhib mthil phyin zhig mi gnang mthu med la/ zhib gcod drung rtsis brgyad sbrel bsko gzhag gnang zin pas rtsa zhib kyis zhib cha'i bkod dpyad rjes su gnang rgyur de ring nas bzung khyed rang khyim du log mi chog par nor gling rtse phyag gi las shag tu sdod dgos pa ma zad/ phyi nang mi rigs thug 'phrad dang yig 'grul sogs byas mi chog’’ces brgyud bsgrags byas byung bas/ de nas ngos rang khyim du phyir log byed dbang med par nor gling rtse phyag las khungs su 'khrid thog lta zhib byed mkhan rtse shod drung rigs gnyis dang / sku srung dmag gi lding dpon gcig dang / dmag dkyus nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas srung byar btsugs te zla ba gcig tsam bkag nyar byas byung zhing / de dus ngos rang gi bsam par zhib gcod drung rtsis thun mong nas rgyu mtshan skad cha 'dri srid snyam byung yang ngos do bdag la skad cha tshig gcig kyang 'dri mkhan ma byung ba de las ldog ste 4rgya mi phyir 'bud skabs sprang phrug gcig gis khrom dkrog pa’’zhes 235

pa de ngos ka shod par bsnyon 'dzugs byed ched zhib sa nas phran gyi g.yog kun bzang rin chen dang / don grub/ phan thogs bcas mi gsum la rta lcag mang po btang ste tsha 'dri byas rung / kho tshos kyang bden pa mthar skyel gyi gdong bsher ra sprod byas stabs mthar nga tsho ngo g.yog su thad la'ang le khag med pa'i dngos ra 'phrod pa red/de rjes nyin gcig phran rang shod gzim chung 'gag tu yong dgos zhes zer don ltar bskyod skabs gzim chung nang srid skyong gi bzhugs khri'i mdun du sne mgron nas bka' bsgyur btang don/ ‘‘skyabs mgon srid skyong rin po che'i bka' spyi phebs su/ nye sngon 6rgya mi phyir 'bud ’skabs sprang phrug gcig gis khrom dkrog pa'i skor khyod rang la le khag mi 'dug kyang / rgyal zur rwa sgrong dang / khyod rang khyi spyang kha ris gcig pa'i blo phyir gtad kyis ‘rgya mi phyir 'bud byed rgyu e yod’ zer ba sogs bstan srid kyi bde don gal cher bsam shes med pa'i sdig nyes ji yod khyod rang gi blo mnga' sems gsal la brten rwa sgreng dang / mkhar rdo gnyis dang 'dra ba'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes dang 'brel nyes pa mig lar 'doms pa gcod 'os kyang / da lam yang bzos gang che'i blon las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung gis lho kha sne sa/dong rdzong du btson khang gsar rgyag dang 'brel tshe gang btson 'jug bya rgyu yin pas phyi nang mi rigs thug 'phrad dang / yig 'grul byas mi chog’’ces bkod dpyad ha cang nan po btang rjes lho spyi dang / sne gdong rdzong so sor bka' shag gi bkod rgya dang sbrags lha sa nas lho kha bar skyel sgrol du grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi lding dpon gcig dang / srung dmag bcu bcas btang ste lho kha sne gdong du tshe btson la bcug byung /phran rang lho kha sne gdong rdzong du rgyang 'bud btang 'byor skabs/ rdzong gi 236

nye 'gram du btson khang gsar rgyag byas 'dug pa de ni lcags ris bskor zhing /thog brtsegs gnyis ldan steng du phyi sgo gcig yod pa der rdo skas 'dzegs nas 'gro dgos pa dang / de min phyogs bzhir sge'u khung gcig kyang med pa/sgo de nas 'dzul te de'i 'og shod du phran 'jug yul gyi btson khang 'doms gang gru bzhi zer ba khang pa chung chung sge'u khung gcig las med pa'i nag khung der gnam sgo nas skas 'dzegs brgyud mar babs te 'gro dgos pa/ de'i thog khar btson srung gtso drag gcig bzhag yod pa de'i sdod khang dang / lho ngos su thab tshang khang chung gcig dang gsang spyod chung chung gcig las/ tha na thog khar 'gro sa'i skas khung tsam yang med pa'i shin tu ya nga ba de 'dra zhig gi nang du bcug thog srung bya gtso drag gcig dang mi ser bcu tham pa bcas nyin mtshan med par btsugs pa ma zad/ lho spyi dang sne gdong rdzong gis bskor g.yeng yang yang byed pa dang / lhag par du 1949zla 10tshes 1nyin rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhis krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes pa'i khyab bsgrags gnang rjes ngos bros byol du shor dogs kyis skabs der brtsed thang du bca' sdod bcu gnyis drug sna'i dmag sgar mda' tshab dga' bde ba rnam rgyal rdo rje 'go dmag khongs nas srung byar btsugs pa sogs kyi do dam nan che'i 'og dka' sdug brjod kyis mi langs pa zhig myang dgos byung /de ltar bod du yod pa'i ‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’byas pa dang / ngos rang bka' blon gnas dbyung gis tshe btson du bcug rjes srid skyong stag brag ru tshogs kyis log spyod zhing bran bdag po'i khe phan srung skyob byed ched btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang khyi spyang lag sbrel byas te bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong rgyu'i re stong bcangs nas bod skyod mi dmangs 237

rbecings 'grol dmag bkag 'gog ched ‘‘'du 'god las khungs ’’tsor ba'i dmag don las khungs shig ched mngags gsar 'dzugs byas nga de'i gtso bo'i 'gan khur bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs yim/ rngapre dang /gzhan yang bka' blon rnams dang drung rtsis rnams las bgos brgya ba ste ‘‘phyi 'brel’’dang ‘‘dmag don’’‘‘'du 'god’’sogs zhi drag las don smyo ham chen pos byas pa/ dper na/ bod ljongs rgya khyab tu dmag skul brgyab ste dmag sgar khag lnga gsar 'dzugs byas pa sogs rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs rnams la dka' sdug brdab gsig tshad med btang ba ma zad/stod shel dkar dang / gtsang khul rdzong gzhis khag nas dmag phogs 'bru khal 'bum gcig byang brgyud du dbor 'dren byed bcug cing / de dus bod du 'khor lo'i bgrod lam med gshis 'bru rigs tshang ma rta bong ngang tsā0/ g.yag la brten nas dbor 'dren byed dgos la/ bskyel 'dren sa thab/ kyang ring bas lam bar zla gnyis lhag tsam 'gor gyi yod pa dang / byang rgyud gnam gshis grang ngar che khar gzan rtswa med pa dang 'bru dos lci rkyen rta khal 'chi god sogs lam 'khel zhing 'brog mi ser rnams la brngabatshogasig dka' sdug shin tu mang ba myong dgos byung ba bcas so/238
h+phu spre

'dug sngar yod bzhugs khri rnying pa 'di gas 'grigs pa 'dug ’’ces gser khri gsar skrun bya rgyu zhal bzhes ma gnang bar brten skabs shig ring mtshams 'jog mi byed thabs med byung ba red/ de nas slar yang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis kyis gtsos chu bzhi sgang drug gi 'go pa mchod sbyin las khungs su bcar te ‘‘da res rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bus rgyal srid chos srid bzhes pa'i rten 'brel gyi ched du gser khri gsar bzhengs kyis 'bul rgyu yin pas nges par bzhes cha yong ba'i snyan seng gnang rogs’’zhes dbu nan gyis zhus par brten mchod sbyin las khungs nas snyan seng zhu rgyu'i khas len byas pa dang 'brel khyod tshos gser khri 'bul rgyu'i skor gyi snyan zhu zhig bris nas 'khyer shog lab don ltar/ de nas snyan zhu phul bar bka' lan chog mchan thob lugs khams pa tshor brgyud bsgrags gnang skabs khong tshos de 'phral lha bris pa skad btang nas gser khri'i dpe ris rab 'bring mtha' gsum bris nas tā la'i bla mar mchod sbyin las khungs nas mgron brgyud spyan bstar zhu rgyur 'bul lam zhus 'brel tā la'i bla mas gzigs zhib bskyangs te ‘‘dpe ris dang gnyis gnyis ka ha cang rgyas spros che bas brdab gsig kyi rgyu las dgos pa mi 'dug ’’ces dpe ris gsum pa de'i thog phyag rtags gnang ba red/ de don mchod sbyin las khungs kyis tā la'i bla ma'i bka' brgyud bsgrags gnang 'phral/khams rigs tshos lam seng zangs rdung las tshan pa rtsed gdong phun tshogs dbang 'dus sar phyin nas gser mang nyung ji dgos kyi rtsis phra zhig bzo gnang yod pa zhes bshad par/ phun tshogs dbang 'dus nas dbu chung bkra shis tshe ring dang gros sdur byas chog ces bshad song / de nas nyin shas song rjes slar yang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis sogs khams rigs 'ga' shas yong nas da cha shing rwa'i nang bzhugs khri'i shing sgrom bzos tshar bas de la 240

gzigs zhib kyis gser mang nyung ji dgos rtsis phra zhig 'don rogs gnang zhes zer song / skabs der kho rang tsho'i rtsis gzhir gser srang chig stong gis ldeng thub pa'i bsam tshul yod pa 'dra/ de nas/ rtsed gdong phun tshogs dbang 'dus dang / nga (bkra shis tshe ring)gnyis nas bzhugs khri'i shing sgrom la lta skabs mtho tshad spyi skar brgya dang bzhi bcu tsam dang / zheng tshad spyi skar brgya dang nyi shu tsam bzhugs khri'i dbu brnyes rgyab yol dang / khri cog bcas khyon bsdoms gser srang nyis stong lnga brgya dgos pa'i rtsis phra zhig bzos nas khams pa tshor sprad pa yin/ khong tshos rtsis phra der bltas nas ha las hon thor gyis 'di lta'i gser phon che gang nas sgrub thub kyi red dam ces ga byed 'di byed med par gyur pa red/ 'on kyang snyan seng zhus zin pa ma zad/ chog mchan phyag rtags kyang gnang grub stabs gser khri ma bzhengs par sdod thabs med par brten gros sdur rim par byas mthar khams rigs tshos ‘‘da cha gser srang chig stong lnga brgya tham pa rang med gzhan 'tshal gyis sgrub rgyu yin pas des gser khri bzhengs thub pa byed rogs’’zer 'dug pa ma zad/ mchod sbyin las khungs kyi 'go khrid rtsis dpon rnam sras gling dpal 'byor rdo rjes kyang ‘‘gser srang chig stong lnga brgya 'dis gser khri bzhengs thub pa byed dgos/ bya thabs ni gang srab srab brdung rgyu red’’zer don ltar gser srang chig stong lnga brgyas gser khri bzhengs rgyu'i thag bcad pa red/rtsed gdong phun tshogs dbang 'dus dang / nga rang / tshags pa dbu drung rdo rje/ dbu chen mig dmar/ ri mo'i dbu drung skal bzang dang de 'og byams pa skal bzang / khra bzo dbu drung dbang 'dus/ shing bzo dbu drung dbang ldan dpal 'bar bsod nams nor bu dang / dbu drung sha mdzod pa/ dbu chung skal bzang rdo rje sogs khyon bzo rigs 'go dmangs 241

sum cu so lnga tsam la 'dzugs ston gsol tshigs gzab rgyas nyin gcig phul te de'i sang nyin nas las 'go 'tshugs/ de nas rnam sras gling dpal 'byor rdo rje dang / a 'brug mgon po bkra shis/ zangs rdung dbu chen las tshan phun tshogs dbang 'dus/ nga rang (bkra shis tshe ring) bcas gros sdur byas te gser srab mthug tshags par gyi shog bu lta bu zhig brdungs rgyu'i thag gcod byas te rgyab mdun phyogs gsum ha lam brdungs zin la nye ba'i mtshams su gser phal cher rdzogs nyer brten slar yang srab tu gtong dgos zer ba ltar yang bskyar de bas srab tu btang na'ang da dung khri cog dang / bzhugs khri'i sku rgyab rgyab yol bcas kyi dmigs sgo byed stabs yang bskyar zangs rdung dbu chen phun tshogs dbang 'dus dang / nga rang / mchod sbyin las khungs kyi 'go khrid rtsis dpon rnam sras gling / a 'brug mgon po bkra this bcas tshogs 'du tshogs te ji dge'i gros sdur byed skabs rang nyid nas gser khri bzhengs lugs dang / gser zhal 'debs 'bul mkhan yod na shing rwa'i thog khar phebs zhes pa'i yi ge zhig shing byang thog bkod de shing rwa'i sgo mchor 'og bkal na dad ldan khag nas gser gyi zhal 'debs 'bul nges zhes pa'i gros zhig bton par thabs shes de yag po 'dug ces gong gsal nang don rnams 'khod pa'i shing byang bkal bas/ sang nyin de nas bzung gser gyi rna long dang / lag gdub/ tshig kheb/ ga'u/ a sgor sogs rim pas 'bul mkhan byung nas dus yun nyin bco lnga skor song mtshams ha lam gser srang lnga stong skor 'bul mkhan byung 'dugade nas shing byang de brje po rgyab nas shing byang gsar pa'i thog da cha gser 'deng nges byung song bas sang nyin nas bzung 'bul gnang ma dgos zhes bkod pa red/ de nas nyin zhig pha lha mgron che thub bstan 'od ldan 242

gser khri'i bzo dbyibs dang / spus ka phra rgyan sogs la lta zhib tu yong skabs gser khri'i mdun ngos kyi gser shog rnams la mdog 'don tshar ba ma zad/ tshags ris rnams kyang ha lam brkos zin pa red/ skabs der mgron che pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan gyi mig lam du star ched sbyar zin pa'i gser shog gcig bkog ste bstan skabs thub bstan 'od ldan nas 'di ha cang srab drag 'dug gser mang nyung gang 'dra 'dug gam zer song bar zangs brdungs las tshan phun tshogs dbang 'dus nas kha sngon gser srang chig stong lnga brgya tham pa gser khri bzhengs thub pa byed dgos stabs gser shog srab tsam ma brdung na 'deng thub kyi med pa red/ de rjes gser zhal 'debs 'bul mi phon che byung bas da cha gser mang po yod ces bshad song /mgron ches gser 'deng nges yod na bskyar brdung byas nas gser shog mthug tu gtong dgos zer song bar/ las tshan phun tshogs dbang 'dus nges gnyis nas de ltar bskyar brdung byed dgos byung na las yun ha cang 'gor 'gyangs yong rgyu ma zad/ sngon brdung gser shog rnams la mdog 'don dang / tshags ris kyang brkos zin zhes bshad par mgron ches de 'dra yin na gser bzos zin pa rnams bskyar brdung ma dgos par rang 'jags bzhag ste bzhugs khri'i rgyab yol dang / khri cog sogs gsar du brdung rgyu rnams kyi gser shog mthug tu gtong dgos zer ba ltar ha lam ldab gcig tsam mthug tu btang ba ma zad/ lhag par khri cog kha pang gi gser shog de bas mthug tu btang ba yin/ de skabs bar ston gsol tshigs nyin gcig btang ba red/ gsol ston skabs zangs brdung las tshan phun tshogs dbang 'dus la mjal dar a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo brgya dang lnga bcu/dbu chung nga rang la kha btags zub phyi dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo lnga/243

tshags pa dbu drung rdo rjer kha btags zub phyi dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo lnga/khra bzo dbu drung dbang 'dus la kha btags a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo bco lnga/ shing bzo dbu drung dbang ldan dpal 'bar bsod nams nor bur kha btags a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo bco lnga/ dmangs rgyugs rnams la kha btags zub phyi re dang / bod dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga re bcas sprad song /skabs der mchod sbyin las khungs kyi 'go khrid rnam sras gling dpal 'byor rdo rjes ‘‘yid bzhin nor bus (tā la'i bla ma) deng skabs lam rim gsung chos zhig gnang gi yod pa dang de dag 'grub 'phral dus 'khor dbang chen gnang rgyur de dus 'bul rgyu'i gser khri mgyogs myur bzo bskrun thub pa dgos’’rgyu'i 'bod bskul byas stabs nyin ma tshan ltos med kyis bzo dgos byung ba red/ khams tshong khag nas kyang sa bzhu phon che 'khyer yong nas shing rwa'i nang spar ste nyin mtshan ltos med kyis las ka byas stabs lam rim gsung chos ma 'grub tsam la gser khri gsar bzhengs thub tsam byung song / gser khri'i mdun ngos kyi rten mkhar rdo rje zer bar khra rgyan mu tig dang / byu ru/spos shel/ e ma khra si/ gzi bcas spel nas dngul skud la rgyus te ha cang mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig bzos pa dang de'i dkyil gyi mdun ngos su rnam sras gling dpal 'byor rdo rje nas phul ba'i g.yu gro dkar khyad 'phags seng ges nor bu bstegs pa lta bu'i bzo dbyibs ha cang thon la che chung ku shu 'bring tsam zhig yod pa de sbyar yod pa bcas gser khri gsar bzhengs kyi las 'gan legs grub zin pa dang gser khri bzo grwa'i las 'gan 'go tshugs pa nas mjug ma bsgril bar dus yun zla gsum tsam 'gor zhing / gser khri mjug bsgril zin mtshams chu bzhi sgang drug gi khams rigs tshos grol ston gsol 244

tshig nyin gcig gzab rgyas btang ba dang / de'i thog las tshan phun tshogs dbang 'dus la legs so'i kha btags a she gcig dang / sbag sbag rta gsum gyi shugs yod pa gcig sprad song yang phun tshogs dbang 'dus lags nas 'khor lo gtong mi shes pas nga la dgos yas mi 'dug gsungs par sbag sbag gi dod ṭam rdo lnga brgya tham pa sprad song / dbu chung nga rang la kha btags a she dang / ṭam rdo bco lnga/ tshags pa dbu drung rdo rjer kha btags a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo bco lnga/ khra bzo dbu drung dbang 'dus la kha btags a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo sum cu/ shing bzo dbu drung dbang ldan dpal 'bar bsod nams nor bur kha btags a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo sum cu/ dbu drung sha mdzod par kha btags a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo sum cu/ dbu chung skal bzang rdo rjer kha btags a she dang / bod dngul ṭam rdo bco lnga/ dmangs rgyugs rnams la kha btags zub phyi re dang / bod dngul srang brgya tham pa re bcas sprad nas tshang mas sku ngal la ma 'dzems par phyag las gnang bar thugs rje che zhes zhus song /gser khri bzhengs pa'i 'phros gser phon che tsam lhag 'dug pa rnams mchod sbyin las khungs dang / chu bzhi sgang drug gros sdur byas te jo'o shākya mu ner gser srang gsum brgya las grub pa'i gsol lhung gcig dang /'phags pa lo ki shā rar gser srang brgya dang lnga bcu las grub pa'i gsol lhung gcig byams pa mched bzhir gser srang lnga bcu tsam las grub pa'i gsol lhung gcig bcas bzos 'phros da dung gser lhag gang 'tsham 'dug pas/slar yang jo bo shākya mu ne+er gser srang lnga brgya lnga bcu las grub pa'i gser kong mtho tshad byis pa lo brgyad tsam yod pa zhig gsar bzhengs byas te gser 245

khri'i las ka'i mjug bsgril/dus 'khor dbang chen dbu tshugs pa'i nyin der nor bu gling ga'i sding cha'i dkyil du gser khri sgron nas tā la'i bla ma gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus te maṇ+ḍal rten gsum bteg pa dang de nas 'bul ba rnams phul nas mchod sbyin las khungs kyi mi sna dang / chu bzhi sgang drug gi 'go pa a 'brug mgon po bkra shis sogs kyis mjal kha zhus zin bstun rtse mgron zhig gis khong tshor kha btags re g.yogs nas sa/ser khri'i g.yon ngos su gral bstar 'grigs te gdan la 'khod pa dngos mthong byung /rgyus can bgres rabs 'ga' zhig gi gsan thos ltar na/ mdo smad chu bzhi sgang drug gis tā la'i bla mar gser khri phul ba de chos lugs thog nas dad 'bul zhus pa yin lugs song gshis/ chab srid thog gi nang don dmigs yul ji yin phyi tshul nas shes rtogs gsal po yong dka' yang /don du kho tsho'i chab srid kyi dmigs yu‘ra ni gser khri phul ba brgyud tā la'i bla ma dang de bzhin sa gnas srid gzhung dang kho tsho'i dbar gang ci'i 'brel lam 'dzugs bde yong ched yin pa de ni kho tshos gser khri 'bul skabs rten 'brel dang bcas lha yod chu bzhi sgang drug gi khams rigs nas tā la'i bla ma'i sger mjal zhus pa ma zad/ lo ltar dus tshod der chu bzhi sgang drug la tā la'i bla ma'i mjal kha thengs re yong rgyu'i re zhus gtan 'khel yang byas pa de thog nas shugs kyis mtshon thub pa bcas 246

de snga bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas mi sna ched gtong gis sbo khul rdzong gzhis khag gi mi sna bkug ste tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs pa'i skor/rgya tsha bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis/1959lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog dang / rtsis dpon rnam gling pa dpal 'byor 'jigs med/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus se ra stod pa mkhan po 'jam dpal 'phrin las can lho khar ched gtong thog lho khar sdod mus/ lho spyi mkhan chung thub bstan mchog grub dang shod drung 'byor rgyas pa dang bcas nas lho khul rdzong gzhis 22so so'i rdzong dang / gtso drag chos gzhis bcas kyi 'thus mi lho kha e gong khang du tshogs 'dzoms dgos pa'i yi ge btang 'byor ltar 'thus mi rnams 1959bod zla 1tshes 2〈nyin tshang 'dzoms byas par khyon mi grangs dgu bcu go brgyad 'dug cing / de nyin mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog mi 'dug pas/ rtsis dpon rnam gling pas gtso skyong 247

gis tshogs 'du de skor gyi nang don brgyud bsgrags byas shing / khong gis bshad don ‘‘khams khul sde dge phyogs su ngo rgol gsum dang / chag yang gnyis zhes pa'i las 'gul spel te dgon sde mang po rtsa gtor btang ba ma zad khyim tshang drag rigs kyi mkhar dbang btsan 'phrog chags rten dang bral ba bzos rkyen rgan skyor gzhon 'khrid sems thag gtsang bcad kyis phyi rgyal du bros byol 'gro rgyu las 'os ma 'das pas da cha khams rigs phal cher rgya gar du rim par 'gro bzhin yod pa red na gang ltar gsar brje zhes pa rtsa ba nas bya ma dgos par 6sa 'jam bong nyal’blo bde bag phebs yong thabs su bod gzhung nas krung dbyang la zhi ba'i bka' mol gnang dgos pa'i skor snyan zhu 'bul rgyur tshig thag gtsang chod zin pas khyed tsho mos mthun yod dam med’’ces bshad pa dang 'brel skul slong yang byas/ tshogs 'du'i thog 'thus mi tshos de ltar mos mthun gyis de skor sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan zhu btang ba ma zad‘‘'di skor re 'bras ma son bar zhi drag gang dge'i mthar skyel bya rgyu yin’’zhes 'thus mi tshang mas bshad de mna' gan bzhag nas lag bstar sa yig kyang bkod pa dang / skabs der 'phyongs rgyas rdzong sdod shod drung sding yon pa nas ‘‘da res tshogs 'du'i re 'dun ltar krung dbyang nas dgongs bzhes gnang na gang legs yong rgyu ma gtogs dmag 'khrug rgyag rgyu ni mi 'bor dang go lag gang gi thad nas kyang ya bzung thub thabs rtsa ba nas yong mi srid’’ces bshad/ 'on kyang de 'phral khong gis ‘‘rang nyid nas bsam zhib ma byas pa'i nor 'khrul gyi skad cha de 'dra thon song bas ngos len zhus chog pa’’zhes kyang bshad song / de'i sang nyin nga tsho tshogs 'thus rnams tshang ma lhun rtser bskyod de sde drug brag skor bla brang du tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa 'tshogs nas tshogs 'du'i nang don gong gsal skor gdan sa se 'bras 248

dga' gsum la rgyab skyor rogs mgon yong ba'i zhu yig re dang / gzhis rtse dang / mnga' ris skor gsum la tshogs 'dus sa gnas srid gzhung la btang ba'i snyan zin dang / gong khul la skul slong yi ge/ de bzhin nag chu sogs byang rigs khul/ kong po rgya mda'/ lha ri/ dpal 'bar/mchin 'brog khul sogs la'ang snyan zin dang yi ge bcas btang ste tshogs 'du grol/de nas 'thus mi rnams sa gnas so sor phyir log gis dmag skul rgyag rgyu'i las ka 'go btsugs shing dmag mi skyes pa rang lto bco brgyad nas sum cu so drug bar dang / dgon sde rnams nas ser dmag bsdus pa/ rdzong gzhis so so'i mi 'bor la gzhigs pa'i dmag 'bor 'os 'tshams bsdus thog rdzong gtso'i nang rgyab dang sprags e bla 'bring dgon par rug 'dzoms dgos rgyur khul so sor khyab 'doms sngon nas byas don bzhin khungs so so nas dmag mi khrid de skyod skabs chu bzhi sgang drug dmag dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag khra tshang yas mas su gdong thug byung bar brten khams rigs rnams kha 'thor zhing / dmag mi rtsis len byed mkhan med pas nga tsho dmag mi khrid yong mkhan rnams dmag mi dang bcas rang yul so sor phyir log byas pa dang rtsis dpon rnam gling pa ngo g.yog phyi rgyal du bros phyin pa bcas so/249

de snga'i bod dmag ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyi sgrig srol dang / rang nyid sku srung ru dpon byed mus su 1rdzo 59 lo'i zing 'khrug langs pa'i 'brel yod gnad don 'ga' zhigasreg shing blo bzang don grub kyis/de snga'i bod dmag ka dang sku srung dmag sgar ni chu byi ( 1kha12) lo lu'u cun rgya dmag phyir bslogs rjes mdo smad khul bod dmag khyon che btang 'jog dgos rkyen tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku srung zhu mkhan du sger pa 'don gcig dang gzhung rgyugs rkang gnyis re nas dmagu mi re skul bsdu byas te me sbrul (1917)lor 'phar 'dzugs byas pa zhig yin pa dang /sku srung dmag sgar ri pin bas jus bkod byas te gsar rgyag byas pa de'i gnas yul ni nor bu gling ga'i lho ngos su yod cing / dmag sgar de'i dkyil du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i gzims chung dang / tshoms chen/nang ma sgang sogs cha tshang dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis su mda' dpon gnyis dang / ru brgya yan gyi las shag mtha' skor du dmag dkyus bcas shong thub pa'i sdod khang dang / pho brang gi mdun ngos rdo gcal dang /me tog ldum rwa/ shing tog rwa ba bcas yod pa red/250

ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyi sgrig srol/sku srung dmag sgar gyi thog ma'i dmag gzhung nang gsal la khyon dmag mi dgu brgya skor yod pa de dag mda' khag gnyis su bgos shing / mda' dpon dang po zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan dang bshad zur chos mdzad ces pa gnyis dang ru dpon shod drung bde smon tshe dbang dbang 'dus sogs la bsko bzhag gnang yod pa dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa ma rdzogs bar gong gsal dmag mi gang yod lha sar sku srung du gtan nyar gnang gi yod kyang / sku phreng bcu gsum pa zhing du gshegs rjes dmag sgar phyed len gyis gtsang khul nas bsdu skul byas pa'i dmag mi rnams gzhis ka rtser 'brel mtshungs bca' sdod du bzhag pa de dag gi 'go 'doms sku srung ru dpon shod drung rgyal grong nang so btang ba dang / dbus khul nas bsdu skul byas pa'i dmag mi lnga brgya skor rnams lha sar sku srung du rang 'jags nyar ba red/ sku srung dmag mi'i dmag rtsed sogs dmag mi'i lugs srol rnams thog mar dbyin jis btang ba'i legs ldan sab zer ba des slob 'dzugs byas rjes mtho rim dpon rigs nyung shas kyis jus bkod 'og ri pin dang / u ru su/ dbyin ji/ sngar yod rgya sbyong dmag bcas kyi dmag rtsed lam lugs mi 'dra ba rigs bzhir dbye ste slob sbyong dang / 'gran bsdur/rgyugs len bcas byas khongs nas bdams gses kyis bod dmag yongs rdzogs dbyin ji'i dmag rtsed kyi lugs su bsgyur rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas thogasku drag gi bu phrug dang / dmag dkyus bcas kyi khongs nas gzhon nu khag 251

gcig dbyin yul dang / hin rdu/ rgyal rtse (skabs der rgyal rtser dbyin ji bsdad yod pas red)bcas par dmag don slob sbyong du btang ba red/mda' dpon gyi gyon chas ni/ dbyin ji nas bton pa'i zhwa mo thug khog ser po'i dbus su gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gangs seng gis btegs pa'i tshags ris can la mtha' skor mu tig dkyil du pha lam dang g.yu khra bcas kyis brgyan pa'i mo'o sgor dang / zhwa mo'i steng gser skud lhas ma can gyi sked 'ching zur du slod pa dang / dpung pa g.yon par gser skud kyi lhas thag ga sha can du gon pa/ brang steng gser skud nu ma gzugs su bkod pa'i 'phyang 'phrul nar mo star bsgrigs su btags pa/ 'go snam ser po'i stod dgos par ki bzhi ldan/ gong ba dang / phu thung / rgyab phyogs bcas su gos rgya selī rgyan spros can/ gser gyi thebs chi che chung sna tshogs yod pa/ smad bos sngon po zur ngos su shur thig ser po can/ lham 'jur rta yu ring /dpung pa g.yas g.yon du dpung rtags rgya se'i steng thebs chi rang 'grigs/dbyin jis bzos pa'i gri dpa' dam si shan gyis lhas pa'i gri thag dang 'chang bzung gser skud dzar can sked du 'dogs pa dang / mda' dpon dang /mda' tshab bar gyon chas la khyad par de tsam med/ru dpon dang brgya dpon yan gyi gyon chas ni/ 'go snam gyi stod thung ser po dang / smad thung sngon por shur thig ser po/ zhwa mo thug khog ser po'i dbus su gser gyi gangs seng rgya gram zur gsum pa tshags ris can g.yu skra/ sa brgyan pa'i mo'o sgor dang / dbyin bzos gri ring ko ba'i gri thag can/lham 'jur rta yu ring / brang steng gser skud rgyan spros ha lam mda' dpon dang phyogs 'dra ba 'dogs srol mchis/lding dpon dang / dmag dkyus yan gyi gyon chas ni/ sbyar tse 252

la'an par ser po'i stod thung dang / smad thung sngon po shur thig can/lham 'jur rta/ zhwa mo thug khog dkar po/ dbus su dngul gyi rdo rje gangs seng tshags ldan gyi la'an par/ lding dpon nas ko ba'i gri thag 'dogs pa/ —me byar dang dge rgan tshos sing btags mtshal ka leb mo'i 'dzoms rgyan tung skud lhas dzar can gyi ga sha gyon srol dang / rol cha gtong mkhan dang dar cha 'khyer mkhan so sos sing btags mtshal kha leb mo'i ga sha zhe mtshungs re gyon srol mchis/dmag mi'i rol cha ni rnga chen rdung mkhan bzhi yod pa de dag gis brjid nyams che ba'i gzig lpags kyi mgo shub re gyon pa dang / de min rnga chung bcu skor dang dmag dung gtong mkhan nyi shu skor phred gling gtong mkhan bcu skor bcas yod cing / rol cha'i gdangs dang nang don ni dbyin deb phu'u tse nas rgyun du slob khrid byed dgos la/ lhag par lo ltar nor bu gling gar zho ston skabs su snga dgong dmag sgar rnams gral bstar bsgrigs te tā la'i bla mar gus 'dud sa lam zhu srol skabs dmag spyis gzugs po srong por langs te dbyin skad kyi thog nas skad gdangs ring pos bkod 'doms byed srol dang / sku srung dmag sgar nas rol cha dkrol te gus 'dud zhu skabs kyi rol cha'i nang don ni dbyin ji'i rgyal glu gtong gi yod gshis/ skabs der bod sdod dbyin gzhung sku tshab yar langs te rol cha ma rdzogs bar sa lam len gyi 'dug gzhan yang nyal dung dang / lang dung / snga dgong dmag mi'i ja dung / 'dzom dung / dgra dung sogs dbyin lugs ltar gtong gi yod pa red/sku srung dmag mi'i dmag sbyong sogs rgyun gtan gyi byed sgo ni/ rnam kun dmag mi yongs rdzogs ru khag byas nas rkang thang gi dmag rtsed dang /253
