gzhan yang me skyogs dang sbag sbag meg sin ghan/ lu'u sin ghan sogs bshig sgrig 'phen rgyag slob sbyong byed dgos la// snga dro shed sbyong dang /dgong dro mdung rtsed/ skabs 'gar spo lo sogs sbyong dgos/ sku srung dmag sgar nas dmag sbyong thon pa'i dmag mi'i gras dmag sgar gzhan dag khag la dge rgan du gtong gi red/ rnam kun gyi las 'gan gtso bo tā la'i bla ma phar tshur chibs bsgyur skabs sam/ pho brang yas mas la bzhugs 'jags skabs sogs la sku phywar 'ga' srung zhu sgo ma zad/ ngal rtsol 'ga' zhig kyang byed dgos pa red/1951lo 〈bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉(don tshan bcu bdun)la ming rtags bkod cing / 〈gros mthun〉nang bod dmag rnams rim bzhin mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la bsgyur rgyu'i skor 'khod pa'i dgongs don gzhir bzung / 1956lo bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gsar du di bu si rīs pa dang chabs cig bod dmag yongs rdzogs nor gling sku srung dmag sga ra sgu 2 megs bsal tshogs chen skong tshogs thog bod dmag khul khang se chab srid u yon gzhon pa wang tā shan nas 〈bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun〉don tshan brgyad pa'i nang gsal/ bod dmag rnams mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la bsgyur rgyu'i dgongs don gsung bshad gnang ba dang /krung dbyang nas bod dmag gi 'go byed kyi go thob dang / sku srung dmag mi'i dmag chas sogs dngos su stsal thob bcas kyi mdzad sgo tshogs pa ma zad/de rjes bod dmag khul khang nas sku srung dmag sgar la dmigs bsal thugs khur che bzhes kyis 'go dmag gi las shag dang / tshogs khang / las khungs/ sman khang bcas 'dzugs skrun rgya che mdzad rogs gnang ba dang /254

sku srung dmag khongs nas gzhon nu bdams gses kyis bod dmag khul khang gi sman khang du sman don lag rtsal slob sbyong dang chabs cig sman sbyin gcig lcogs byed du bcug skabs der sman rigs ji dgos dmag khul khang nas nar mar stsal/ gzhan yang dmag khongs nas rlangs 'khor gtong rgyu slob sbyong dang / spyi tshogs slob grwar yang khag gcig gtong thub pa byung ba red/195〈— 59bar sku srung dmag sgar gyi dmag mi 'phar bskul dang bcas dmag grangs bdun brgya ma zin tsam yod cing / de skabs mda' dpon stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis yin pa dang / ru dpon gnyis/ brgya dpon bzhi/ lding dpon nyi shu/ dge rgan bcu/ dmag sgar drung yig gcig bcas yod/ dmag sgar gyi thab tshang dang / mdzod khang / las khungs 'tshogs yul/ go mdzod/ dmag mi'i rol cha slob sbyong khang /dar cha dang shel g.yugs 'phrin bskyel slob khang / skra bzhar khang /dmag sbyong dang spo lo rgyag thang bcas yod/ dmag mi'i go lag sngar yod thog kha snon ring mda' nyis brgya/ me skyogs ha'o dzar gcig de'i mdel sgam lnga bcu/ gnam blugs me skyogs bzhi de'i mdel sgam nyi shu rtsa lnga/gzhan yang meg sin ghan gsum dang / sbe ring ghan nyi shu rtsa lnga la khyon mdel sgam sum brgya skor bcas yod/rang nyid sku srung ru dpon byed mus su 195rdzolo'i zing 'khrug langs pa'i 'brel yod gnad don/rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi (195rdo) lo tsam la de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung nang gi dpon rigs khongs nas kha bral ring lugs pa nyung 255

shas kyis lkog tu rgyab skyor ngan slob byas 'og a 'brug tshang mgon po bkra shis sogs kyis gtsos mdo smad chu bzhi sgang drug zer ba'i jag dmag khyon che gri gur dpung bskyod kyis zing 'khrug slong ba'i don rkyen bzos par brten skabs der de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lho khar khams zing zhod 'jags kyi bkod khyab byed por dza sag smon skyid gling pa dang lho spyi mkhan chung tsha thor ba gnyis ched du bsko gtong byas kyang don 'bras ma byung khar zing cha je cher song stabs krung dbyang sku tshab nas de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung la ngo log zing slong 'di skor zhod 'jags thub pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos rgyu'i bka' nan che phebs 'og bka' shag nas bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms skong tshogs dang 'brel krung dbyang dgongs pa dwangs thabs dang /khams zing zhod 'jags yong thabs/ slad kyi lag len don 'khyol byed phyogs bcas kyi skor gros bsdur bya rgyur gtan 'khel gyis tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa'i 'thus mi bdams te lha sa gtsug lag khang gi nang khongs legs bcos las khungs 'tshog yul du bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa rgyun ring tshogs shing / skabs der 'thus mi'i gras su rang nyid kyang yod/ tshogs 'dus mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog dang /rtsis dpon rnam sras gling pa gnyis khams zing zhod 'jags byed po yin khul gyis gri gur ched gtong byas kyang rdo don phan med gnod bskyel lta bu las ma byung ba sogs kyi rkyen pas dus babs zang zing du gyur gshis/ tshogs 'dus sku srung dmag sgar nas tā la'i bla ma'i sku srung zhu sgo 'thus tshang dgos lugs 'gan dkri byas par brten sku srung dmag khongs nas de snga 'khor bzhag song rigs dang gzhis rtse khul yod rnams 'gugs 'bod kyi bkod rgya song don bzhin tshang ma rim 'byor yong rgyu yin cing / skabs der mda' 256

dpon phun bkra nas phran la ‘‘khyod rang mda' dpon gzhon pa dang / ru dpon gsar pa rma bya gzhon par bsko bzhag bya rgyu’’zhes brjod byung yang dngos su khyab bsgrags byas med pa red/ de rjes khams pa'i zing 'khrug de bas je cher song rkyen nor bu gling gar tā la'i bla ma'i sku srung la shugs snon brgyab ste mtshan mo lding khag re mos kyis skor g.yeng dang / sgo srung dmag mi 'phar snon bzhag pa dang / dmag mir me skyogs dang sbag sbag sogs g.yul mkho'i yo chas bed spyod byed stangasnas kyi slob sbyong la sngar bas shugs snon brgyab pa/ tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas steng nas khams pa'i zing 'khrug don rkyen gyis rkyen pas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi slad kyi byed sgo'i skor tshogs chung so so'i bsam 'char phyogs bsdus kyis shog lte bka' shag brgyud btang rung / 'di byed lan gsal ma byung bas/ de rjes tshogs 'du de 'tshogs mtshams bzhag pa red/de nas zla shas kyi mjug nyin gcig rang nyid kyi shag tu sang nyin legs bcos las khungs su tshogs 'dur yong dgos pa'i lan brda za zir zhig 'byor byung zhing / de'i phyi nyin sngar rgyun tshogs 'du lugs mthun yod shag gis bskyod par de gar gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi dang / dmag sgar khag gi 'thus mi ru brgya/ rtse shod mgron gnyer/ las tshan pa dang drung rigs ser skya'i 'thus mi/ drung gtogs kyi 'thus mi rnams bcas shing rwa'i sgo steng thog rim 'byor gyis rnam kun bzhin drung rtsis sogs tshogs 'du'i 'go 'dzin rnams phebs mkhan yod shag byas te sgug bsdad cing / de nas mi 'ga' shas kyis 'dir nga tsho mi mang po phungs gsog thebs nas sdod rgyu 'gab min la las khungs sbug tu 'dzul bsdad na zhes brjod don bzhin yar phyin te sdod skabs yud tsam nas rtse mgron bar gzhis chu 'khor bas yode ring nga tsho 257

tshogs 'du khyug tsam mi 'tshogs mthu med byung zhing / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs la rgya mis khams zing dang 'brel ba yod tshod 'os min yin lugs kyi gshe gshe tshad med btang yod pa ma zad/ yid bzhin nor bu yang rgya mis rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen (skabs gnyis pa)la gdan zhu zhu rtsis yod skad la 'di thad sku 'phywar blos 'gan bzod min la brten gnas skabs rgya nag tu chibs sgyur gnang ma dgos pa byung tshe khams pa'i zing 'a khrug 'jags thabs su nga tsho 'dir yod 'thus mi tshang ma gri gur 'gro dgos kyang phyin chog pa sogs kyi skor g.yu thog nang (skabaskyushrī der krung dbyang sku tshab de gar bzhugs yod pa) snyan zhu zhu bar 'gro rgyu dang / gzhi nas rtsa don 'di'i skor nga tsho tshang ma tshig bsgril dgos rgyu'i gan rgya zhig 'jog dgos’’zhes bshad de khong rang nas gan zin 'bri grabs byed mur/ gzhi rkang rang nyid la de dus yar thon gyi bsam pa med kyang / rnam kun tshogs 'du'i dbu bzhugs bka' blon zur khang pa dang / drung rtsis/ dza tha'i/nang ma mkhan sde bcas phebs kyi yod rung / de nyin phebs med pas las don 'di skyon thal zhig 'dug snyam ste ‘‘de ring tshogs 'du'i 'go 'khrid gcig kyang med par nga tshos rang 'tshams gan rgya 'jog rgyu blos 'gan bzod min la de ring ngang 'then gyis do nub de ring tshogs 'dur ma phebs pa'i dza tha'i dang / mkhan rim so sor bka' lan 'bul bar nga tsho las bgos kyis btang ste sang zhogs khong tshor bka' slob zhus thog gzhi nas tshogs gros byas na legs gnas yong rgyu ma gtogs skog tshogs 'di rigs nyen 'gan bzod min ma zad/ lar nas kha sa tshogs 'du yod ces lan brda gtong mkhan su yin nam’’zhes thad kar bshad par tshogs 'thus shod drung rma bya gzhon pas ‘‘khyed la lan gtong mkhan nga yin pas de dag dgongs dag’’ces 258

brjod byung / de bzhin 'thus mi gzhan ma tshor lan gtong mkhan 'ga' zhig nas kyang ngos len byas song / de mtshams bar gzhis rje drung nas ‘‘'o na de ring gan 'jog bya rgyu bde min yod na phyir 'then byas chog kyang / nga tsho tshang mas don snying gnad don 'di'i skor skad cha phyir gyar bya rgyu med pa dang / rdog rtsa tshig bsgril bya rgyur yid bzhin nor bu'i sku par mgo la bzhag nas mna' bskyel dam bca' 'jog dgos ’’zhes zer zhing / ngos rang gi bsam par de don ma byas na nga rang la'ang kho tshos lta stangs yong rgyur snyam ste mgo la sku par spyi mtshungs bzhag pa yin/ de nas nga tsho tshogs 'du grol skabs sku srung brgya dpon mig dmar tshe ring nas ngos la ‘‘nged gnyis rtse mgron thub bstan mtha' yas nas rtse mo'i thog khar (gtsug lag khang gi dpal lha lcog nang ) khyug tsam yong rogs zer gyi 'dug pas 'gro gi yin nam ’’zhes brjod byung bar ngos nas ‘‘gang yin nam ’’bshad par khong gis ‘‘der bde don tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du yod pa 'dra’’zer zhing / rang nyid kyi bsam par mda' dpon la dgongs skor tsam med par rang 'tshams bskyod rgyu 'gab min snyam ste ‘‘da ma 'gro ’’zhes bshad de log thog de nub rang nyid kyi grong mtshes bka' drung ldum rwa bar sang zhogs legs bcos las khungs su tshogs 'du yod lugs dang / snga 'byor dgos skor zhus par khong nas nga la rdzigs nyams dang bcas las khungs kyi brda tho tsam med par tshogs 'du rang dgar yong gi min lugs brjod byung bar ngos nas ‘‘khyed la lan ni phul yod phebs min khyed kyis dgongs bzhes gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad de log yong ba yin/ de nyin skad cha phyir gyar mi byed pa'i skor sogs la mna' bskyal yod stabs mda' dpon la gang yang shod rgyu byung ma song ba sogs kyis yin nam gang ltar de nas bzung mda' dpon gyis kyang nga la nam rgyun nang bzhin skad 259

cha gsal po rang mi shod pa sogs kyi lta stangs phran bu 'gyur 'dug de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa dza tha'i dang / mkhan sde che chung / rim bzhi/ sras rnam pa sogs tshogs 'thus mi 'bor gang 'tshams shig tshogs 'dur phebs 'byor gyis kha sa'i gnas tshul rnams bar gzhis rtse mgron nas zhib phra bshad song rjes dza sag smon skyid gling pas hang sang sang gi sgo nas ‘‘a rtsi khyed rnams pas 'di 'dra'i phyag las gnang ba yag po e yong ngam nga mi rgan la ltos yas gang yang med rung / phyis 'byung khyed rang tsho sdug po mthong yong ’’zhes sogs kyi gnas lugs gsung stabs/ de 'phral lam seng brel 'tshub ngang tshogs 'du grol song / gong gsal zur tshogs byas skor drung rtsis tshos tshor te dgong dro rtsis khang gad pa brgyud sang nyin rtsis khang thog khar tshogs 'du yod pas 'thus mi tshang ma sdebs 'dzoms dgos lugs brda tho 'byor pa ltar de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la rtsis khang thog khar drung rtsis dang / tshogs 'thus yongs rdzogs rim 'byor la bzhugs gdan tsam med par drung rtsis tshos brjod gsal/ ‘‘nga tsho drung rtsis la dgongs skor snyan seng tsam med par khyed tsho zur tshogs 'di lta bu byed dgos zhes sus bshad byung ngam/'os su ma mchis pas 'di dbang la gzhigs nas brtsad gcod nan po byed 'os kyang da lam thengs gcig ring yang pa byas shing / rjes su gong rim gyi bka' 'khrol med par rang dgar tshogs gros 'di rigs 'tshog mi chog pa dang / gal te de rigs gleng thog byung na brtsad gcod dang 'brel bkod 'doms yan por ma song ba shod rgyu yin’’lugs sogs nan po bshad de lam seng tshogs 'du grol song /de rjes nyin zhig nga tsho ru brgya rnams dgong dro'i dmag rtsed sbyong brdar 260

la lta zhib byas te bsdad yod pa'i sar mda' dpon phun bkra yong thog khong gis ‘‘sang nyin yid bzhin nor bu cun chus dmag sgar nang gzigs mor gdan zhu dang len gnang bar brten sang zhogs snga po 'char can sku srung dmag dkyus brgya tham pa go sgrigs kyis nor gling chab 'go'i phebs lam g.yas g.yon la 'grems dgos pa dang / lar nas gdan zhu'i gnas tshul 'di bzhin yag po mi 'dug cing / bod dmag khul khang nas brjod don la chibs zhabs dmag mi cun chus nas 'khrid mi chog la dmag mi kha shas yong yang go mtshon 'khyer mi chog zer gyi 'dug pas ji 'gab ’’ces bshad par/nga tsho 'go byed tshos ‘‘de 'dra yin tshe dmag sgar khag gi 'go khrid tshor yang gsung na ma gtogs 'grigs e yong ngam’’zhes brjod par mos mthun byung ste mda' dpon nas‘‘dmag sgar khag gi mda' dpon rnams sang nyin zhogs pa sku srung dmag sgar nang 'dzoms dgos pa'i lan brda gtong dgos’’zhes zer don lding dpon gcig lha sar mda' dpon khag la lan skyel bar btang yang /de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa chu tshod 〈pa tsam la nor gling gzhung sgo'i sgo srung dmag mis ‘‘lha sa nas mi mang po 'ur te yong gi 'dug pa ga re byed dgos sam’’zhes mda' dpon la kha par 'byor gshis/ mda' dpon nas‘‘'go byed ru brgya tsho mda' dpon las shag tu da lta lam seng yong dgos’’zhes pa'i lan btang 'byor byung don bzhin mda' dpon las shag tu 'byor skabs khong gis ‘‘lha sa nas mi mang po 'ur te nor gling du yong gi yod 'dra bas khyed tshos nor bu gling ga'i rgyal sgo rnams rgyobs shog’’ces bka' phab thog dza drag ngang mda' dpon rang tā la'i bla ma'i sku drung du snyan seng zhu bar bskyod song ba dang /nga tsho ru brgya rnams lam seng nor gling gzims sgo khag la blta bar bskyod skabs gzims sgo rnams brgyab zin 'dug pa dang / drung jar phebs pa'i 261

drung rigs ser skya khag gcig 'byor zin te phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed bzhin 'dug pa'i mur/ nyin dgung yol tsam la mda' dpon phyir 'byor gyis yud tsam song rjes nged gnyis nor bu gling gar skor g.yeng du bskyod dgos zhes zer don bzhin bskyod de nor gling gzhung sgo'i 'gram du 'byor skabs lcags ri'i phyi logs nas mi mang pos skad cor rgyag bzhin 'dug pas mda' dpon nged gnyis gzhung sgo'i thog khar bskyod cing / mda' dpon gyis am phrag nang nas par chas chung chung zhig bton te mi mang po de dag la par kha shas brgyab thog sgo srung lding dpon la gzhung sgo nas mi gang byung btang mi chog pa'i bkod mngags byas te khong rang‘‘tā la'i bla ma'i gzims chung du 'gro gi yin’’zhes yar phyin song ba dang / ngos rang dmag sgar nang log ste las khungs su phyin pa yin/ de nas phyi dro las khungs grol ma thag blos 'gan ma bzod par nor gling gzims sgo khag la skor g.yeng du bskyod skabs mda' dpon phun bkra par khang nas tshur yong ba dang thug byung zhing / nged gnyis nor gling gzims chung khams gsum zil gnon gyi mda' g.yab 'og khyug tsam bsdad de gleng mol byed skabs mda' dpon nas ‘‘sang nyin bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas pa 'tshog rgyur brten ru dpon lags khyed rang yang tshogs 'dur 'gro na dga' gi red ’’ces brjod byung / de nas mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu pa tsam la mda' dpon nas ru brgya rnams 'bod thog nga tsho nor bu gling ga'i nang skor g.yeng du 'khrid byung zhing / lcags ri'i phyogs bzhi so sor 'dzing rags bang khri brgyab steng du dmag mi go lag rang 'grigs bzhag nas bsdad 'dug pa ma zad/ khams dmag mang po zhig kyang nor gling lcags ri'i khor yug tu gur phub nas bsdad 'dug nga tsho spyan bsal gling kha'i 'gram du slebs skabs mda' dpon nas ru brgya rnams la ‘‘khyed tsho sngon tsam 262

la rgyugs’’zhes brjod de kho rang khams pa'i gur zhig gi nang 'dzul song /de'i phyi nyin bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'tshogs shing /tshogs 'du'i thog yab gzhis phyag mdzod dkon cog lha skyabs dang / kun gling sgo steng bud med kun bzang / zhol rta gtong jo lags sogs dang /rtse skor rtse phyag mkhan chung rgyal mtshan lags dang / rtse drung bstan ma lcogabar gzhis rje drung / lha gnyer las tshan rtse drung ngag dbang don grub sogs khag gcig gis ‘‘nyi ma de ring nas bzung ‘bod rang btsan ’ yin pa dang /'bras dang rtsam pa za mkhan dbye 'byed byed dgos’’zhes sogs bshad pa dang / dza tha'i dang nang ma mkhan sde/ mkhan chung / rim bzhi/ rtse skor las tshan/ shod skor las tshan/ rtse shod drung dkyus/ drung gtogs/dmag sgar khag gi ru brgya bcas sde tshan dbye nas tshogs chung so sos khas len shog lho bris te drung rtsis sar phul ba dang / de nas zing cha je cher song rkyen bka' shag dang drung rtsis/ gdan sa khag gi mkhan po/ drung rigs ser skya'i 'thus mi khag gcig bcas tā la'i bla ma'i sku mdun du yong dgos kyi bka' phebs pa 'dra/ rdo don drung rtsis thun mong nas tshogs 'du'i thog ‘‘tā la'i bla ma sku ngo mas nor bu gling ga'i nang zing cha 'di 'dra bslang na 'grigs kyi ma red bde 'jags la 'gan 'khur yag po dgos rgyu'i bka' slob gnang skabs tā la'i bla ma mchog zhal gshis kyang log 'dug’’ces khyab bsgrags gsal zab byas rjes tshogs 'dus ‘‘de ring nas bzung khams pa'i dmag mi nor gling khul nas phyir 'then byed dgos pa dang / nyi ma mang po zang zing byas na rgyal ba rin po che'i sku 'phywar nyen 'gan bzod min la brten da phyin don gal che rigs byung na nor gling nang bka' bkod khang btsugs zin gshis rgyal ba rin po che'i sku srung zhu sgo rnams sku srung dmag sgar la ci 263

'gan dkri bya rgyu dang / sang nyin zhogs pa nas bzung tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms zhol par khang du 'tshogs te krung dbyang la dgongs sel zhu rgyu sogs zhib phra'i gtan 'khel bya rgyu yin ’’zhes tshang mar ma thos ma khyab pa med pa'i bkod khyab byas song / 'on kyang khams dmag rnams kyis nyan sems med par mu mthud nor gling khul du bsdad pa dang / de rjes zhol par khang du tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'tshogs thog krung dbyang la dgongs sel zhu bar tshogs 'thus ngo bcar zhu gtan 'khel yang tshes cha yan kong 'khel tshul sogs ka kor gyis dus thog snyan seng zhu ma thub pa'i mur nyin zhig mda' dpon nas brjod gsal ‘‘da ni nga tsho log spyod pa chags song / dmag mi'i rdzas mdel 'phar snon dgos skor dmag spyir snyan gsol zin cing / des na ru brgya tsho gros bsdur gyis ji dgos shog lho bris te sang nyin dmag spyi khang nas zhus shog’’ces zer don ltar de'i phyi nyin dmag spyi khang du ngos dang brgya dpon lcang zhing mig dmar phun tshogs dang / brgya dpon srid thar phun tshogs bcas bskyod de rdzas mdel rnams zhus nas mo ṭa'i nang dbor 'dren gyis sku srung dmag sgar du bsdu bcug byas pa dang / mda' dpon nas dmag sgar gyi go lag khongs nas me sgrogs ‘‘ha'o dzar ’’zhes pa gnyis dang /gnam blugs me skyogs gnyis dmag sgar nub rgyud lcags ri'i nang du kha bsgrigs te bzhag 'dug de nyin dgong mo nas bzung 'go dmag tshang mas dgra zon cher skyed kyis nor bu gling ga'i nang mtshan gang bde 'jags skor g.yeng dang / 'dzing rags bzo ba/ nor gling sku srung dmag sgar nang nas khams pa'i lag mdar bton pa'i dbyin ji kha ring rnying song khag gcig dmag sgar nang 'phyis bdar gtong rogs kyang byas pa red/spyi zla 2tshes 5nyin de snga'i byang spyi rim bzhi sman stod pa bsod nams 264

dbang 'dus sku srung dmag sgar du 'byor te de nyin dgong dro mda' dpon phun bkras dmag sgar ru brgya rnams la ‘‘sman stod pa bka' shag nas nga'i las rogs su bsko gtong gnang ba zhig yin pas tshang mas bka' brtsi dang len byed dgos ’’zhes bsgrags/ sman stod pa tshes drug nyin nor gling lcags ri'i phyi nang srung dmag khag bgos yod tshad la bskor g.yeng du thengs gcig phyin pa tsam las/ de min las don byed khom ma byung bar/ tshes bdun nyin bka' shag nas khong zing dmag gi dmag phogs do dam par 'then pa red/ gong tshes nyin gyi dgong dro glo bur du dmag sgar nas mda' dpon rta bzhon te g.yog po kha shas dang bcas ra ma sgang gi phyogs su bskyod song zhing /phyir 'khor rjes 'di byas gang yang bshad ma byung yang / rdo don bros byol du 'gro rgyu'i sta gon byas pa yin 'dug tshes brgyad nyin gyi dgong dro lha sa'i chu tshod brgyad pa tsam la mda' dpon phun tshogs bkra shis nor gling nas ched mngags dmag sgar du yong thog ru brgya tshang ma dmag sgar gyi pho brang gzims chung mgon po khang du 'bod 'gugs kyis ‘‘de ring khyed tshor gal che'i skad cha zhig shod rgyu yod pas phyir gyar mi 'byung ched sngon la tshang mas mna' skyel dam bca' 'jog dgos ’’zhes zer don tshang mas mgon po tshad la btsugs te mna' skyel dam bca' bzhag rjes mda' dpon nas ‘‘dus babs kyis rkyen pas yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs bzod bde min stabs gnas skabs sa khul gzhan zhig la nyen g.yol gdan zhu bya rgyur/ khyed rang ru brgya rnams nas dmag sgar phyi nang gi las don 'thus tshang byed dgos ’’zhes brjod pa thos 'phral rang nyid sems ha cang pham ste mig zhag 'khor bzhin par ‘‘yid bzhin nor bu yun ring ma 'gor bar lha sar zhabs sor 'khod thabs yong ba'i skyabs 'jug thog da bar nga tshos bstan don snying bcangs kyis zhabs 265

'degs zhu gi yin’’zhes bshad par mda' dpon nas ‘‘lags so de ga rang sems bcang zhus chog ’’ces dang / mjug tu ‘‘da lta chibs zhabs rta dmag gi go lag rdzas mdel ji dgos len du bcug cig ru brgya tshos chibs zhabs dmag mir phogs dngul rnams da lta 'gro khar gtugs pas rgyag sprod byed dgos//’’ ‘‘khyed kyi nang mi rnams grong gseb cig la btang na legs shing gal te zing cha langs tshe bros shog ’’ces bshad de khong rang brel 'tshab ngang nor gling pho brang nang phyin song /de nub lha sa'i chu tshod bcu pa tsam la tā la'i bla ma dang rgyal yum/ tā la'i bla ma'i sku mched tshe ring sgrol ma sogs sku 'khor rnams nor gling nas dmag sgar brgyud ra ma sgang ngos su rdog thon byas pa dang / ngos rang chibs zhabs dmag mi'i phogs dngul rgyag rgyu sogs kyi las brel gyis rkyen pas tā la'i bla ma phebs khar mjal ma byung / de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa nor bu gling ga'i nang tā la'i bla ma bzhugs yod shag ltar gyi drung ja sngar rgyun bzhin tshugs kyang / don du nor gling nang gtso bo srid tshab bla ma blo bzang bkra shis gcig pu bzhugs yod skad las/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang bka' blon bla ma sne'u/ shar/ bka' blon zur khang pa/ bka' blon bshad zur/ spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang / gsol gzim mchod gsum bcas kyang chabs cig phebs thon zin 'dugazla gsum pa'i tshes dgu nas bcu bar rang nyid nas dmag sgar nang gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur byas te tshes bcu nyin dmag phogs rgyag dus 'khel 'ing / skabs der dmag grangs bdun brgya ma zin tsam yod pa nas chibs zhabs su thon pa phud/ de byings dmag mi phyed ka gdong mkhar khul du dmag phogs 'thag las su btang ba dang / de 'phros dmag mi ngo yod sum 266

brgya tsam bsdad yod pa rnams nor bu gling ga'i nang dang dmag sgar nang srung byar khag bgos kyis bzhag pa yin/ sngon du tā la'i bla ma phebs thon grub rjes phreng ring dza sag dmag sgar du bsdad song ba khong ni de snga phyi rgyal du me skyogs sogs rgyag 'phen slob sbyong byed myong yod pa red/ tshes bcu nyin gyi tho rengs tsam la zing 'khrug dngos su langs te glo bur me mda'i skad sgra shugs chen grags par brten rang nyid har langs kyis phreng ring dza sag sar ji 'gab skad cha 'dri bar bskyod par khong ni bros tshar 'dug cing / de 'phral dmag sgar gyi ltag sgo thon te bka' bkod khang du bskyod rtsis kyis nor gling sding cha'i bar phyin par rtsis dpon shud khud pa mar yong ba dang thug byung bas khong gis ‘‘khyed rang yar yong los mi 'dug cing / rkyang thang na kha nas nor gling du me skyogs mang po rgyag gi 'dug pas dmag sgar nas me skyogs rgyag mkhan kha shas gtong dgos ’’zhes gsung gi 'dug ngas sku srung dmag sgar nang du'ang me skyogs zhe drag rgyag gi 'dug ces shod mus su me skyogs kyi mdel gcig nged gnyis kyi nye 'gram du 'bar gas byas song gshis/ skad cha yang shod 'phros rtsis dpon shud khud pa phyir log phebs song ba dang / ngos/ rang dmag sgar du phyir log yong skabs chu bzhi sgang drug gi dmag mi khyon che nor gling lho rgyud lcags ri'i nye khul du 'thab rol tu song 'dug de nas ngos rang dmag sgar du 'byor 'phral brgya dpon gsum dang mda' dpon gyi gnyer pa bcas bskongs te da nang zhogs pa'i gnas tshul dang / rang srung rgol lan ji byed thad nor gling bka' bkod khang la kha par thog nas snyan seng dgongs skor zhus par mkhan chung rta ra ba mdo sngags mthar phyin nas yodamag 'thab ji dgos de nas blos dpyad dgos rgyu’’zhes brjod nyid kha par chad par brten kha par bskyar gtong byas kyang lan med stabs bya thabs bral 267

te rang nyid dang brgya dpon/ mda' gnyer bcas gros bsdur byas snying rang srung ched du me snyogs gcig dang / meg sin ghan sbag sbag che ba gcig khyer thog me skyogs rgyag mkhan dmag mi kha shas mnyam 'khrid kyis dmag sgar gyi lho ngos ltag sgo thon te lcang ma'i gseb nas me skyogs rgyag rgyu'i gra sgrig ka kor byed mur mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis gtsang po'i pha ri'i 'dzing rags nang nas me skyogs kha bsgrigs te brgyab yong ba'i mde'u'i zil shugs dang / thal 'tshub kyi 'og ga byed 'di byed med par gyur te yud tsam lus shing / de nas thal 'tshub phran bu 'jags 'phral phar lta tshur lta byed skabs gong gsal rogs pa rnams ltag sgo'i nang 'dzul zin te bsdad mi 'dug ngos dang g.yog po phru gu zhig yod pa nged gnyis dmag sgar nang 'dzul bde ma byung bas lcags ri'i phyi ngos dmag sgar nub rgyud dang / byang rgyud/ de nas rgya mtsho rgyud du slebs skabs spyan bsal gling ga'i rgyal sgo phye 'dug pas nang du 'gro skabs khams bod dmag mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu med khar/ nub phyogs brgyad gcig zhing rwa dang / byang phyogs rkyang thang na kha khul nas bcings 'grol dmag gis me sgrogs che chung dang sbag sbag sogs 'phen yong ba'i mde'u lcang ma'i gseb nas gsir sgra dang bcas te babs yong gi 'dug pas ngos rang bya thabs zad de spyan bsal gling ga brgyud dmag sgar pho brang gi tshoms chen nang bskyod par de gar 'go byed lding dpon dang dge rgan tshang ma gzim chung 'gag gi bzhugs gdan steng sgor 'khyil lir bsdad 'dug pas khong tsho mthong dus ngos rang khong khro chen po langs kyang dmag dus su song gshis rnam 'gyur gang mkhas kyis dmag sgar pho brang gi tshoms chen nang yud tsam bsdad de nang mis bag leb sogs kha stob 'khyer yong ba zos te sdod mur 'go byed brgya dpon rnams kyang skyon med ngang de gar 268

slebs byung yang / dmag sgar gyi rdo gcal mthil du me skyogs kyi mde'u 'bar gas kyi sgras shel khra rnams kyang rang bzhin sa la lhung 'gro ba sogs kyis sa chags thabs bral gshis/ nang mi bu phrug dang / g.yog phrug chung chung bcas nyen g.yol du nor gling chibs rwa mdor cung drag khul gyis bskyal nas ngos rang dmag sgar du phyir log byas te brgya dpon gsum dang / mda' gnyer don phun bcas rub 'dzoms kyis sdod mur brgya dpon sri thar phun tshogs nor gling gzhung sgo nas dmag sgar du slebs byung zhing / khong gis brjod don/ ‘‘nor bu gling ga'i nang me skyogs brgyab ste mi mang po shi rmas song 'dug pas 'thab re bral stabs sku drag tsho mgo btags zhu rtsis kyis brtag ril sgril gyi yod tshod 'dug cing / des na da nga rang tsho ga 'dra gnang rtsis yod dam’’zhes zer/ ngos rang gi bsam blor dmag mi'i 'go byed rnams kyang 'thab sems shor ba dang / dmag sgar gyi phyogs bzhi ni bcings 'grol dmag gis bskor zin pa/ rtse po ta lar blta tsam byed skabs me skyogs kyi mde'u 'phog ste thal 'tshub kyis bsgribs 'dug pas pho brang la skyon byung na gang min yong rgyu red snyam pa dang / de bas brgya dpon lags kyis bshad don bzhin mgo btags zhus na legs gnas snyam ste brgya dpon tsho dang gang 'gab gros bsdur gyis tshang mas bslu med mchog gsum yin gshis/ dmag sgar pho brang nang gi gzim chung mgon po'i spyan sngar brtag ril zhus na zer don ‘‘dmag sgar blos btang gis bros pa bzang ngam/mgo btags zhus na bzang ngam’’zhes pa'i brtag ril zhus par ‘‘mgo btags zhus na bzang’’zhes phebs stabs de don gros 'cham gyis mgo btags zhu mi brgya dpon sri thar phun tshogs ba/tan 'khel byas thog dmag sgar la bar lam rtsal ba'i skar lnga'i dar cha'i rtser kha btags a she zhig 269

btags te 'go dmag kha shas la mngags cha dang bcas khad nye'i phyogs su btang yang / 'di byas lan gsal ma 'byor stabs kho tsho 'dzin/ bzung byas pa min nam snyam byung / gang ltar mgo btags zhu rgyu gtan 'khel zin gshis dmag mi'i go lag gang yod dmag sgar gyi pho brang rdo gcal steng spungs dgos pa'i bkod khyab byas don spungs bzhag pa dang / skabs der dmagre/ mi'i bza' zla bud med rnams sku srung dmag sgar gsar par yo da pa nas rming pa'i nang bros te slebs byung zhing / so so'i bza' zla dang phan tshun 'thams 'khyud kyis ngu 'bod byed pa dang / brgya dpon lcang shing lags dang /brgya dpon tshe bsod gnyis nas ‘‘da yag po byung ma song’’zhes zer te phan tshun me mda' rgyag res bya rgyu yin lugs brjod pa ra rang nyid nas khong gnyis la 'gan yongs rdzogs ru dpon la yod lugs sogs dge bshad sdig bkrol gyi sems gso gang thub btang stabs mi tshang ma phran bu'i lhing 'jags lta bur gyur song / de nas sa ma rub tsam la bcings 'grol dmag mi rnams yong si/ 'dug ces zer ba thos 'phral rang nyid nas kha btags zub she zhig lag par 'khyer nas dmag sgar gyi rdo gcal mthil du sngon 'tshud nas spungs ba'agadzipa'i go lag rnams kyi 'gram du langs bsdad de kha btags g.yugs g.yugs byas pa yin/ dmag sgar gyi sgo'i zur nas me mda' ‘‘khrung h+phung chang’’'khyer ba'i bcings 'grol dmag lo chung zhig thon byung ba des ngos rang mthong ma thag phyir log gis de 'phral rogs pa zhig dang mnyam du the tshom med par nga tsho'i 'gram du slebs byung zhing / ‘‘dmag mi tshang ma gral sgrigs shog’’ces zer don gral sgrigs pa dang / de mtshams tshang ma dmag sga ra nas nor bu gling gar 'khrid byung / de gar nor bu gling ga'i nang yod ser skya sku drag dang / khams bod dmag kyang khyon che 'dug pa yud tsam zhig nas bcings 270

'grol dmag mi zhig gis ‘sku srung ru dpon gcig yod pa su yin nam yar longs shog’’ces zer don ngos rang yar langs shing / de 'phral 'dzin bzung gis rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig gi nang blugs te cun chus dmag sgar du bskyal byung /sku srung dmag sgar du yod pa'i go mdzod dang de snga dmag mir bkram pa'i go lag tshang ma dmag sgar rdo gcal nang mgo 'dogs zhu rgyu'i gra sgrigs kyis spungs yod pas de dag tshang ma skyon med bcings 'grol dmag mi'i phyag tu byung song ba bcas so/

gnyal lhun rtser chu bzhi sgang drug gi rten gzhi chags pa dang sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsis dpon rnam gling pa sogs zhi mol byed par yong khul byas skor/nor bu dbang 'dus kyis/1rdzo5〈lo'i bod zla 5tshes 15nyin chu bzhi sgang drug kha 'khyer gyis sangs rgyas bstan don yin zhes drag shugs che ba'i mi bzhi (skabs der khams brdzus zhes zer) 'byor te rta thab zan shing gi sgrig chas dang len mi byed mthu med khar/ da dung go mtshon dang / bzhon rta legs gras yod 'don dgos lugs 'ud shob bshad par brten lding dpon dang / rgan po/khral pa che rigs thun mong gis de ltar bsgrub mi thub pa'i gnas lugs ji ltar bshad kyang nus pa ma thon par de las ldog ste‘‘tshwa sgrub bstan 'dzin zhes pa rgya mi'i phogs za mkhan red’’ces rang shed kyis nyes brdung tshad med btang nas 'chi gson cha ma mchis par gyur thog khul de'i mtshon cha yod rigs khag gcig sngog bsher gyis me mda' ring thung drug tsam dang / rta drel legs gras bcu skor/ de min dngos zog bcas btsan 'phrog dang mi chos las 'das pa'i bud med la log g.yem sogs bya ngan ci rigs byas par brten/ sa gnas rdzong dpon rtse drung / 'jam dbyangs dkyil ngag dbang chos bzang 272

dang / shod drung lcog spe gnyis la gnas tshul zhus te khams pa dang gleng mol byas rung thabs nus ma thon par rdzong gnyis nyin shas ti'u ra dgon du nyen g.yol byas nas ring por ma song ba'i bod zla 6tshes shar du rdzong rtse drung ngo ma dang / nub dgon yab gzhis stag 'tsher phyag zur spel ser can bcas ngo g.yog drug gri gur ngo log zing slong pa'i rten gzhir ched bskyod kyis gros mol bgyis te phyir log byas 'phral lhun rtse 'du khongs skong tshogs sar rdzong rtse drung gis khyab bsgrags byas don/ ‘‘da lam nga tshos chu bzhi sgang drug gi tham kha ngo ma dngos su mthong byung / da nas bzung lag khyer thog tham kha de dag 'khod pa'i khams rigs su 'byor la nga tshos rgyab skyor rogs ram byed dgos pa dang /khams brdzus yod rigs zhib dpyod byed mi gri gu nas khams pa ngo g.yog sum cu skor 'byor nyer yod pas 'di ga rdzong du sdod sgrig rta thab sogs 'thus tshang dgos’’lugs brjod pa ltar dus 'byor byung bar mjal zhu rta chag do po bcu/mar khal lnga/ lug sha khog gnyis bcas sprad/ kho pa tshos sngon 'byor mi bzhi khams brdzus yin pa shes rtogs byung 'phral 'dzin bzung byas thogakhrims gcod nan po byas mthar mi gnyis se rwa dgon pa'i grwa pa yin pa mi khungs sde drug bla brang du rtsis sprod byas kyang mi gcig skabs der shi song /yang mi gcig ri thang chus khongs su rtsis sprod byas pa de'i ming la sba kong zer ba da lta'ang bsdad yod/ mi gcig zi'u phud gzhis khongs la rtsitra sprod byas rjes shi ba red/ gong gsal mi bzhi pos btsan 'phrog byas pa'i me mda' ring thung rnams do bdag so sor phyir sprod byas shing / rta drel rnams rjes su sprad 'thus brjod pa tsam las don dam sprad ma song / dus de nas bzung lhun rtse rdzong 'du khongs dang chu bzhi sgang drug ngan 'brel gyis lhun rtser khams jag gi rten gzhi dngos su 'dzugs 'go tshugs nas khams jag gis khams 273

brdzus zhib gcod byed pa dang / rdzong rtser yod pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi mdzod khang sngog bsher gyis dngos zog rnams gri gur dbor 'dren byas pa red/gnyal lhun rtser chu bzhi sgang drug gi rten gzhi chags pa/bod zla 6pa'i zla mjug tu slar yang rtswa gnyer nang sdod sgrig gzab rgyas byas te mkho sgrub phogs khang gsar btsugs kyis 'go pa cha 'phrin ye shes nyi ma dang / 'ba' pa dbang 'dus ngo g.yog brgyad la lhun rtse 'du khongs nas mjal rten rta chag dang / mar khal bcu/ bshas g.yag gcig bcas sprad de phan tshun ngo sprod dang 'brel rdzong dang phogs khang gros mol byas don snying por/ lhun rtse rdzong khongs gtso lding rgan bcas skong tshogs kyis mar kha'/ chig stong dang bshas g.yag bzhi brgya/ 'bru khal khri gnyis bcas mi ser nas yod 'don cha gses kyis bsdu rgyu'i khas len thog 'bru 'bab rnams brngod 'thag gang legs byed bcug ste sger gzhung chos bcas tshang ma'i rta khal bsdu rub kyis lha rgya ri sogs khams pa'i dmag sgar sdod sar skyel 'dren byed bcug pa ma zad/ de sngon rdzong don gcod las khungs nas dbul phongs rnams la skyed med bun g.yar 'bru khal chig stong skor gyi spa se yang phyir bsdu byas te dus bkag thog 'bru 'bab 'phral 'bul ma thub tshe do bdag dang khag theg so sor rta lcag brgya re gtong rgyu dang / chabs cig 'bru 'bab lha rgya rir rgyab khur gyis skyel dgos pa'i bka' btang stabs dngul dang bya 'bras thabs shes kyis skyabs rten btsugs te dus 'gyang yong ba'i re 'bod mthar re zhig ngang 'then gyis lo de rang gi ston dus grangs tshang sprod dgos 274

byung song /bod zla 7nang sa gnas srid gzhung gi a drung zhig lhun rtse rdzong du bka' rgya skyel bar 'byor skabs rdzong gnyis ti'u rwa dgon du bsdad yod pas thug 'phrad ma thub stabs a drung de nga'i (nor bu dbang 'dus) nang du 'byor zhing / skabs der tshwa sgrub bstan 'dzin gyis rtswa gnyer nang khams pa'i phogs khang yod sar a drung slebs tshul bshad 'phral a drung zhag gcig 'dzin bzung thog rta lcag btang ba dang sngog bsher yang byas song / sngog bsher skabs thon pa'i bka' rgya'i nang khams pa lhing 'jags gtong ched sa gnas srid gzhung nas go mtshon len par yong dgos lugs 'khod yod par brten a drung slar yang nga la rtsis sprod byas byung / a drung la rgya bod shan sbyar gyi lam yig cig 'khyer rgyu sprudug pa de nga la gsang thabs kyis bcol byung ba khams pas mthong ma song zhing / ngas gnad don de rdzong la snyan seng zhus par phogs khang dang gros mol gyis mthar a drung mtsho snar bka' rgya skyel bar btang song / bod zla 9zla mjug tu mkho sgrub phogs khang de rdzong dang 'brel ba bya rgyu stabs bde'i ched nga'i nang du spos nas zla lnga lhag tsam sdod ring kho tsho'i bkod par nyan dgos byung / bod zla 11nang slar yang phogs khang gis rdzong gi bkar khang nas g.yar khul gyis 'bru khal nyis stong bton te mi ser la 'thag las dang lha rgya rir dbor 'dren byed bcug pa dang / rdzong rtse dang / gad pa sa sbug so sor bcings 'grol dmag gi mdzod khang khag gnyis dang / rdzong zhol tshwa sgrub bstan 'dzin gyi sdod khang du yod pa'i rdzong don gcod khang gi dngos po bcol bzhag gzhan yang don gcod khang gsar rgyag byas pa'i khang pa bshig ral gtong skabs za chas rnams phogs khang gis bdag nyar byas pa phud dngos po che rigs dang lcam shing sogs sde 275

drug bla brang la dbor 'dren byas 'phros snyigs ro rnams mi dmangs la 'tshong sgyur gyis 'bru khal bzhi brgya skor bsdus pa dang / bod zla 11nang yang can dang snyan rong hor tshong khag gnyis kyi tshwa 'bru brje tshong bya rgyu'i tshwa khal chig stong 'phrog pa/ bod zla 12tshes shar du sho po shar brgyud rgya mi'i nyul ma red ces mgo zing zer ba gcig dang / de'i rogs zla mi gcig sde drug bla brang nas 'dzin bzung gis phogs khang la rtsis sprod byas 'phral mgo zing rgyug rdung btang ste dmar gsod btang ba dang / rogs pa de la'ang shi la khad tsam gyi nyes rdung btang ste bya yul rdzong du btson 'jug byas song / bod zla 12nang a 'brug tshang gi ab phrug red zer ba'i mi grangs bcu gnyis nyang mkhar lding dpon gyi nang du sdod sgrig byas thog 'du khongs nas mjal zhu rta chag dang mar sogs sprad song zhing / kho pa tsho ni tar gtong mkhan yin tshod 'dug1959lo'i bod zla 1tshes 2nyin phogs khang dang sde bla gnyis 'dzoms kyis ti'u ra dgon pa'i grwa pa brgyad kyis dung rgya'i spyan 'dren dang 'brel nga'i khang pa'i yang steng du gzab mchor gyi sgo nas dmag don gyi mdzad sgo tshugs pa dang / lha bsangs btang thog dmag dar ral gri rtags can zhig btsugs song / bod zla 1tshes 5 nyin 'du tshogs kyis gri gur dngos zog len mkhan khal rta drug cu tham pa yod 'don cha gses kyis tshes 11nyin thon nas nyin shas song rjes gnam gru nas dbyugs pa'i go mtshon khe gtsang rgyab drug cu dang khams rigs khag gcig 'byor ba khang grags su sdod sgrig byas pa dang /rjes 'byor khams pa tshos gza' skar dang bstun nas dgra lha gsol ba dang brag rir me sgrogs tsha kha'ang bltas song / bod zla 2tshes 25nyin yar klung khe smad nas yong ba'i na gzhon sman pa mi grangs nyi shu skor dang rmas dmag khrid rogs bcas mi grangs bzhi bcu tsam yang skyar nga'i nang du sdod sgrig byed 276

du bcug bod zla 2tshes 1nyin a 'brug tshang mgon po bkra shis grwa bskor dgon du 'byor skabs rta dmag lnga brgya lhag tsam dang / sku srung yang 'dug pa de dag la 'du khongs nas mjal zhu mar ltang gnyis dang / rta chag do po nyi shu sprad song ba de tsho spyi lo 1959bod zla 2tshes 7nyin mtsho sna brgyud thon song /rtsis dpon rnam gling pa sogs lhun rtser 'byor skor/195〈zla 7zla mjug tu mtsho sna rdzong ngam gri gur chags pa'i chu bzhi sgang drug gi gnas gzhi gang nas yong ba gsal po mi shes pa rtsis dpon rnam sras gling dang / bkras khang mkhan chung / lho spyi mkhan chung tshwa rdor ba/ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas lhun rtser yong rgyu'i brda yig 'byor zhing / lhun rtse rdzong nas mnga' khul gtso lding rnams la sdod sgrig byed dgos lugs kyi bkod khyab byung ba ltar gnyal stag gsum du sdod sgrig dang /khong tshor 'du khongs kyi gtso lding rgan bcas nas mjal zhu mar dang / rta chag gsol tshigs bcas sgrig 'bul byas/ skabs der lhun rtse rdzong rtse drung 'jam dbyangs dkyil sgo mang ngag dbang chos bzang gis 4khong tsho phebs don ni chu bzhi sgang drug nas zing cha slong gi yod pas de 'dra mi dgos ched bka' mol gnang bar phebes pa red’’ces bshad song / bod zla 12nang ser smad mkhan pos g.yul rgyal lhun rtser bsdad de mgon po k+ṣ-i ṭa pa la'i gtor bzlog brgyab/ lho spyi mkhan chung tshwa rdor gnyal nyang mkhar du gnas spos/ de rjes rim bzhin e gong po khang gsar brgyud lhun rtser bskyod nas re zhig bsdad rjes mtsho snar thon/ bod zla 12pa'i zla mjug tu lhun rtse rdzong 277

lcog spe tshe brtan 'byor rgyas/ gtso drag sde drug bla brang / gzhung rgyug gtso drag srib dgon tshe ring chos 'phel bcas lha rgya rir tshogs 'dur thon/195rdzolo'i bod zla 1nang lhun rtse rdzong du lho khul rdzong khag nyi shu rtsa gsum 'du 'tshogs byas shing / 'go gtso lhun rtse rdzong rtse drung 'jam dbyangs dkyil ngag dbang chos bzang dang / shod drung lcog spe tshe brtan 'byor rgyas/ sna dkar rtse rdzong rtse drung 'od zer dpal 'bar/ sne gdong rdzong khang gnyer bde skyid khang gsar/ rgya tsha ko tsa'i bsod nams stobs rgyal sogs rdzong khag gi spyi 'thus gtso rgan mi grangs brgya skor yod pa tshang mas thun mong bzhag pa'i gan rgya'i 'go brjod la bod ljongs srung ma dmar nag dpang du btsugs pa'i ‘‘mna' gan thu mo che’’zer ba'i nang don ni‘‘gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la snyan 'bul zhus te rgya bod bka' mol gyis rgya mi phyir log byed dgos pa dang de yang don thog ma 'khel na bod 'di ‘rang btsan’yong ched bod rigs ser skya mi dmangs rnams pho zad mo la ma thug bar dmaspu/ rgyag rgyur tshang mas khas len bya rgyu’’zhes pa sogs red/ tshogs 'du'i thog sne gdong rdzong khang gnyer bde khang gis ‘‘dper na shing sdong zhig la cha bzhag na yal ga bcad kyang rim bzhin skyed rgyu red/ rtsa ba bkog na skye thabs med pas de rtsis nga tshos bsam blo gtong dgos’’zhes bshad song / de nas tshogs 'du grol te sa gnas so sor phyir log gis dmag skul rgyag rgyu'i las 'gan bsgrub rgyu byas/lhun rtse rdzong khongs gtso lding rgan bcas nyin shas tshogs 'dzoms kyis skye bo ser skya rang lo bco brgyad yan nas bzhi bcu zhe lnga man tho blangs te dmag grabs byas pa'i dmag 'gro mi sna'i za gyon rnams sa gnas so so'i 'byor ldan khag gi 'gan len bya rgyu bcas kyi gros thag bcad nas de don lag len bstar ba bcas/278

tā la'i bla ma dang sku 'khor zur khang pa sogs mtsho sna brgyud rgya gar sa khongs su phros byol phebs skabs kyi gnas tshul mthong thos 'ga' zhig r+sha smra bo lcog bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/sa phag(1959) lo bod zla 2nang / phran rang rang dgon du sdod skabs lha sar zang zing chen po yod tshul go thos byung mur gri gu gzhis sdod khongs sger zur khang pa'i 'dzin khongs ka lung gzhis ka'i gzhis sdod chos 'byor lags phran gyi sar phebs te ‘‘da mgo tshod yas mi 'dug zur khang gi g.yog po phun tshogs zer ba 'byor byung zhing / zur khang lha yum dang /rim bzhi/ lha lcam/ g.yu thog lha lcam ngo 'khor bcas yar 'brog brag mda' (deng skabs sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs ) brgyud gri gur phebs kyi yod tshul brjod 'dug na da cha ji 'gab’’ces zer byung bas/ phran nas yophun tshogs ga par yod dam’’zhes bshad par ‘‘'dir yod’’zer te phun tshogs bos nas gnas tshul zhib 'dri byas par kho pas ‘‘gzim shag (zur khang )sku ngo (gong gsal ) rnams phebs kyi yod/ gnas tshul ji yin shes kyi mi 'dug brag mda' nas nga rang sngon bskyod kyis gri gur rta drel gyi gzan rtswa sogs gra sgrig byed dgos pa dang / gcig byas na rgyal ba rin po che'ang gri 279

gu— brgyud phebs kyi red ces gsung gi 'dug yi ge sogs gang yang med’’ces zer zhing / de 'phral sger chos tshang ma gri gur bskyod nas gri gu jo khang dbus khang pa legs gras la phebs sgrig zhus/ de nas zur khang ngo 'khor dang / kun gling dza sag ngo 'khor/ de nas mkhan chung rta ra mdo sngags mthar phyin ngo 'khor bcas khag so so rim bzhin 'byor te brel 'tshab chen po byed kyi 'dug de'i phyi nyin snga langs kyis thon song ba dang / zur khang ngo 'khor rnams gri gu nas ka lung du bskyod song /de nyin dgong dro yar klung mkhe gsum gzhis nas zur khang pa'i zhabs khongs gras phran gyi gcen po dbang 'dus rdo rjes khong rang gi g.yog bkra shis (da lta 'tsho bzhugs ) phran gyi sar btang 'byor mdun gcen po'i yig gsal du ‘‘7gong sa chen po ston 'khor 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen du phebs 'byor zin skabs lha sa nas dmag spyi mkhan chung mdo mthar lags kyi a drung ched 'byor snyan phul nang lha sar dmag shor song bas 'phral du chibs bsgyur bcag po gnang dgos gsal ba ltar gnyal g.yul rgyal lhun rtse brgyud phebs rgyur zur khang sku ngo rnams gang bcag phebs gal la rogs ram thog khyed rang mtsho snar phebs te ngos kyi tshab tu sa dbang chen mo'i sar mjal zhu zhig tu bcar dgos shing / dpon la dgos pa dus gcig dang / g.yog la dgos pa tshe gang gi dpe ltar ’’yin zhes nan bshad byas 'dug pas/ de'i phyi nyin zur khang ngo 'khor rnams sgo stod byang mar (deng skabs mtsho sna rdzong khongs ) phebs sgrig zhus/ de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa snga mo nas phran dang g.yog smra bo lcog dgon gyi grwa gnyis bcas mtsho snar bskyod pa'i lam bar gangs gzhod shin tu che mur de nub mtsho sna mtsho lung du 'byor zhing / zur khang gi mi ser rgan po tshe rdor rtsad gcod kyis khong gi nang du bsdad pa dang / phyi 280

nyin nyi ma ma shar gong nas rta pa mang po slebs 'dug zer ba ma zad/ mtsho lung gi 'go nas dgon rtse bar bsangs phungs khag mang yod pa dang / lam gyi g.yas g.yon du rdo bstar nyis sgrig dang sa dkar ser gyi thig bcas kyang 'then 'dug ngos nas bzhon dre'u bzung mkhan pho gzhon zhig 'khrid de lam zur zhig tu zur khang phebs sgug zhus bsdad cing / rta pa bco lnga nyi shu tsam bar med yong gi 'dug nyin dgung ma zin gong tsam la nam mkha' gsal zhing dwangs ba'i dbus gnam gru zhig yong ste rta dbang phyogs su bskyod nas rang log phyin song / de nas gang 'tsham zhig la rta pa khag gcig yong gi 'dug pa de'i dkyil du rgyal yum yang 'dug de nas rta pa khyon che yong ba de dag gi rjes tsam la bka' blon sne'u shar thub bstan mthar pa dre'u zhig bzhon te gcig pur yong 'dug pas phran nas phyag 'bul zhus thog zur khang sa dbang chen mo phebs kyi yod dam zhes zhus par khong gis ‘‘dgong dro ma gtogs da lta phebs kyi med sa dbang chen mo phebs rjes gzhan dag yong mi gtan nas med pa red’’ces zer gyi 'dug de nas nyin dgung tsam la mtsho sna rdzong ngo g.yog lnga rta bzhon nas mgyogs par yong ste yosku bsangs sbyong ’’zhes 'bod skul byas song / de mtshams rta pa nyi shu skor gyis sngon rjes byas shing / g.yas g.yon so sor rta dmag bzhi re rgyang khyad phran bu re byas pa'i dbus su tā la'i bla ma rta rkyang po rdzi dkar zhig tu bcibs shing na gza' 'go snam mam ther ma ji yin tshos gzhi rgya smug gi phyu chen dang / zhabs 'ju yu ring / u su dkar po'i dbu zhwa/ zhal dkris dkar po zhig bcas bzhes te chibs zhabs rnams dang lhan cig rtsol phebs kyis mtsho sna dgon rtser chibs bsgyur bskyangs song zhing / de'i dgong dro yongs 'dzin gling tshang dang / khri 'chang gnyis phebs pa dang nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la zur khang 281

dbang chen dge legs phebs 'byor byung bar phran nas phyag 'bul zhus thogalam steng du zhal tog btegs 'bul zhus pa dang zur khang nas a ma lags skor 'dri gi 'dug pas ‘‘do nub mtsho lung du phebs 'byor gnang ba yod’’ces zhus par thugs rje che zhes gsungs/ de nas phran dang zur khang mnyam bskyod kyis mtsho sna dgon par 'byor zhing / bka' shag gi mtsher yig sbyar 'dug pa der phebs song ba sne'u shar dang / bshad zur sogs kyang der bzhugs 'dug phran rang zur khang dang mnyam du bsdad pa yin/ dgon pa rtse'i gsum thog tu tā la'i bla ma dang / yongs 'dzin gnyis/ mgron gnyer chen mo sogs bzhugs sgrig zhus 'dug pa der kun gling dza sag dang /mkhan chung mdo mthar sogs kyang phebs 'dug khong rnams gzim chung du tshogs 'dur phebs te nam phyed tsam la zur khang log phebs byung / dgon rtse phyag mdzod nas phran rang brgyud mjal dar a she gcig dang sbrags lha rab mi dmangs dang / mthar dgon rtse'i grwa btsun rnams la rgyal ba rin po che'i mjal kha zhig yong ba zhes snyan seng zhus par zur khang nas ‘‘snyan seng zhus chog’’ces bshad song yang / phyag mdzod song rjes zur khang nas phran la ‘‘mjal kha yod pa ma red/ da gin tshogs 'du'i sar sang nyin nam gsal ma gsal tsam la mtsho sna'i spang ldebs su chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu gtan 'khel song ’’zhes zer gyi 'dugade nas zur khang mal nang tsog pur bsdad de yang lā bdun spar nas yi ge 'bri gi 'dug pas phran nas ‘‘sku bsil yong ’’zhes zhus pa dang zur khang gis phran la bshad don ‘‘nga tshos hin rdur phebs 'thus chog pa zhu mi skya ser gnyis sngon la btang yod pas nyin gnyis tsam las mi 'gor bar hin rdur 'byor rgyu red/ 'bum de la babs nas hin rdu'i sa sne dang po'i rdzong ti si 282

sbug zer ba der phebs rgyu dang / rgyal ba rin po che nas gsal bsgrags shig gnang dgos pas de'i gsung bshad kyi zin bris yin’’zhes zer te 'bri deb glang chen la'an par shog grangs bca gsam tsam bris song zhing / de'i 'go ༄ ra brjod la ‘‘rgya mi dang bod mi gnyis rtsa ba nas mi 'dra zhing ’’zer ba zhig bris 'dug pa phran nas mthong byung /phyi nyin zhogs pa snga po nas tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor rnams chibs bskyod zin pa dang / phran dang zur khang mtsho lung du bskyod cing / der zur khang mi ngo rnams mjal rjes mtsho sna ya ma rong la bskyod pa dang / de nas mtsho sna bshad grar kun gling dza sag dang khams rigs mang po 'dug pa dgong mo phyi po bar bsdad song / mtsho sna khang gcig la zur khang lha yum sogs phebs grabs yod pas zur khang nas ‘‘da nga 'gro gi yin o'o lags rim bzhi da lta 'phral du shog lab ā/ gang yin zer na/ chibs zhabs nang dbyin skad shes pa mi 'dug pas gsung sgyur dgos kyi 'dug’’ces zer/ de nas zur khang sa dbang dang / g.yog por lam bar 'o rags naspo'akhrid yong ba'i bkras bde'i rnam rgyal rdo rje gnyis nyin dgung yol tsam la thon song / de rjes zur khang rim bzhi dang lha lcam yang thon bskyod byas pa dang / de'i phyi nyin lha yum dang g.yu thog sogs thon song ba bcas ni skabs der 'brel yod dngos mthong rags risna tsam mo/283

19 5rdzolo'i ngo log zing 'khrug skabs lho khul rgyal gces mi snar ngo log jag pas gnod 'che btang ba'i skor/lho kha srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas rtsom 'bri tshogs chung gis/sne gdong snang ldum ra ba las drung byams pa de nyid spyi lo 1956lor lho kha sa gnas spyi khyab don gcod las khungs 'dzugs skabs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur nang zhugs te tang la blo dkar gyis las don sgrub mur spyi lo 195trulor zing slong jag pa'i rten gzhi lho khar gtsugs pa'i lo de'i dbyar smad kyi nyin zhig khra 'brug lo ro ba phun tshogs kyi bu mo'i bza' zla khams dar rgyas dgon gyi grwa log cig yod pa des snang ldum du yong ste khyod kyi me mda' de gnas skabs nga la g.yar rogs rjes su phyir sprod bya rgyu'i 'dzin zhig sprad chog zer ba sogs kyi phar bshad tshur nyan gleng mol mang po byas pa'i rdo don byams pa lags kyis me mda' khong rang sar med lugs mtha' 'bud gnang rkyen khos am phrag nas thung mda' zhig bton te byams pa lags zhugs sa'i ka phibs gyang ldebs su brgyab nas dgra ngoms byas rung / byams pa lags dpa' zhum pa'i ngang tshul gang yang ma mngon stabs/ kho pa ci bya gtol bral gyis rjes su 'phrad yong zhes bshad de phyir log de'i dgun dus su lho spyi tsha 284

rdor ba dang / bde skyid khang gsar gnyis sne gdong khral pa bkra shis dpal khang du rdzong 'byor rgyas gnas spo sar 'dzoms te rdzong gi gad pa blo bzang rdo rje zer ba byams pa lags rta bzhon te 'phral du yong dgos pa'i brda skyel bar mngags 'byor ltar rdzong dpon sar bskyod dgos byung 'dug de'i dgong mo nang mi bu phrug tshos byams pa lags sa phyogs gar phebs ma shes stabs phyi nyin zhogs pa bkra shis dpal khang du phyin nas 'dri rtsad skabs yar stod brgyud lha rgya rir phebs mkhan yin —pa 'dra zer/ nyin de rang du 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u nas las byed (da lta rig slob chus krang chos 'phel lags)ched phebs kyis byams pa de nyid gar song zhib rtsad gnang 'dug pa dang / de'i sang nyin 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u la bzhugs mol zhig gnang skabs nga tshor pu'u krang gis dgongs 'char gsungs don ‘‘nga tsho'i grogs po gcig kyang 'phro brlag gtong mi nyan/ khyed tshos thabs shes btsal nas byams pa gsang ba'i thog 'gug thabs byed dgos’’zhes gsungs/de rjes yun ring ma song bar lha klu'i bkras mthong gzhis sdod ngag dbang blo gsal lags kyis snang ldum nang mi dang nang mol gyis gsang gnas yi ge zhig rtsam khug nang blugs nas sprod rgyur bskur ba sprod yul du 'byor ba'i nang khams jag gis dogs bsher byas rkyenu yi ge zhig thon stabs de bas khrims gcod nan po phog pa'i byams pa lags tsha nan ma bzod par thog brtsegs brgyad dgu yod pa'i g.yang zar nas mchongs ste rang srog dor dgos byung ba red/ yi ge dgra lag tu son nas yun ring ma song ba'i nub cig bkras mthong gzhis su khams jag go lag rang 'grigs rta pa gsum ched 'byor gyis mtshan dgung de rang la ngag dbang blo gsal lha rgya rir btsan 'khrid byas te khong la'ang tsha 'dri nan po byas rjes pho brang gzhis su khams jag gi rten gzhi 285

yod sar 'khrid de mu mthud 'dri rtsad skabs 'phyongs rgyas rdzong zhol sding dpon gyis 'go 'dren gnang bas thar tsam byung ba red/snang ldum byams pa btsan 'khrid byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni rdzong gnyis kyi phyogs su langs rgyu'i 'dod mos med par bde skyid khang gsar gyi ngan bskul byas pa'i rkyen las byung ba zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin dang / spyi tshogs thog gi gleng phyogs gang thad nas ra 'phrod yod 'dug bde skyid khang gsar snang ldum la 'khon 'dzin yong rkyen ni snang ldum byam/sa pa lags las drung byas rjes rim pas shes tshor byung ba ste sne gdong rdzong khongs khral stong son khal brgyad cu skor 'gro ba'i sa char bde skyid khang gsar nas sa bogs snga rabs kyi rtsis srol kha/ la ṭam zhes khal rer dngul sne sel tsam sprad de lo mang 'debs skyong byed mus de dag gi skor sne gdong khral pa rgan gras la snang ldum las drung gis rgyab skyor 'bod skul byas pa'i sa cha'i gyod gzhi zhig chags rkyen gyis yin lugs nga tshor (da yod rtsom bri'i mi sna) yang bshad myong / bde skyid khang gsar khams jag dang ngan pa khyu gcig yin pa ni rgya ri nas ngo g.yog rnams bde 'jags ngang sne gdong rang khyim du phyir log byed stangs kyi thog nas ra 'phrod yod pa dang / snang ldum byams pa de nyid log rgyu ma byung khar/ g.yog po rig 'dzin yang re zhig 'das gson ji byas cha med du gyur/yang dper na/ grwa sa ser byes yin pa sne gdong tshwa sgrub las 'dzin mtshan 'phel lags ni spyi lo 1956lor lho kha sa gnas don gcod las khungs gsar 'dzugs skabs gsar brjer zhugs nas spyi bde las khungs kyi ‘las ka gnang mus su spyi lo 195〈lor zing slong khams jag lho khar 'byor nas rim bzhin rgya cher gyur te gong lo'i ston mtshams su zangs ri klu khang gru brgyud khams jag phon che yong ba sa gnas spyi bde nas mkhyen te gnas tshul 286

rtog zhib tu phebs rgyur mtshan 'phel lags snang ldum byams pa lags kyi sar phebs nas ‘‘grogs po/ de ring klu khang gru khar khams jag rtog zhib byed par 'gro mkhan yin pas khyed kyi gzhon rta de g.yar rogs ’’zhes gsungs par snang ldum byams pa lags kyis gal che'i gnad don de lta bur bzhon rta g.yar po los 'bul/ yin na'i dgra bo thug dus gzab gzab ma gnang na nga'i rta dang / khyed kyi mgo gnyis ka shor yong zhes ku re'i tshul du gsungs/de nas spyi bde'i las byed da yod phun tshogs lags sogs mi drug yod tshod/kho tsho chu phar ri nas ljang brgyud phebs te gru khar khams jag dang gdong thug 'thab ra 'phrod skabs stabs mi legs par mtshan 'phel lags dang /rtsed thang tha li'i bu bkra shis dbang rgyal gnyis dgra bo'i mtshon 'og tu shor ba red/sne gdong rdzong khongs pra nub rje drung lags spyi lo 1956lor spyi khyab don gcod las khungs gsar 'dzugs skabs rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi khongs mir zhugs nas gsar brje'i bya bzhag la yi rangs zhu mus su spyi lo 195radabyar dus lho kha'i zing slong khams jag thog mar gri gur 'byor nas bzung / langs phyogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rgyal gces mi sna yod tshad la rgya mi'i phogs zan zhes 'bod tshig sna tshogs bsgrags te nyen kha che stabs rang srung gab g.yol ched sne gdong rtse tshogs dgon pa'i grwa shag cig tu bzhugs skabs go thos la mi gzhan gyis ma dga' zhe 'dzin byas te khams jag la ngan rgyus byas skad don du grwa shag der khams jag yong nas rje drung de nyid bzung 'khrid kyis mkhe gsum gzhis su khams jag phogs khang 'go gtso a 'brug bla ma'i sar 'khrid thog khrims gcod sna tshogs btang nas yun ring bkag nyar byas pa dang / spyi lo 1959 lo'i zla 2pa'i nang lho kha'i zing 287

'khrug zhod 'jags gtong skabs zing jag rnams 'tshab 'tshub kyis bros byol 'gro dus yar stod pho brang gzhis bar 'khrid de de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa khams jag sa cha de nas ma bros gong khong dmar gsod btang ba red/ zing cha de'i dus su rje drung dam pa'i bza' zla skyid 'dzoms mkhe gsum gzhis su slebs dus rje drung lags gar song gar khrid gsal shes ma byung stabs rtsad zhib byed par 'phyongs rgyas phyogs su bskyod kyang ngo 'phrad lta zhog gar khrid tsam yang go rgyu med par phyir log yong dus lam bar yar stod nas yong mkhan zhig la dris par pho brang du yod pa'i khams pa de tshos mi gcig gsad lugs go thos byung ba tsam las gsal po shes ma byung zhes pa'i brjod tshul la dogs 'char ngal dub ngang nga'i khyim du slebs byung bar sems gso gang shes zhus nes khong rang gi nang la phyir slog ste g.yog po de pho brang du zhib brtsad byed par btang ba red/ rjes su dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs 'das po'i bza' zla skyid 'dzoms 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yis sgrig 'dzugs gnang ba'i slob sbyong nang zhugs rjes rang khyim du phyir log nas da lta'ang ma mas tshang ma de snga'i sdod gnas su zhing pa byas nas sdod mus red/grwa nang rdzong bre mo rta rmig gi bu rgan shos mthu stobs spyi lo 1956lor rdzong rim pa'i don gcod las khungs gsar 'dzugs skabs bskong bsdu byas nas gsar brjer zhugs shing / de rjes las khungs khu bsdu byas rjes grwa nang rdzong gzhung btsugs slob grwa'i dge rgan byed mus su lho khar zing 'khrug brten gzhi chags nas ma rung dgra sdes spyir na gsar brjer zhugs snga ba'i rgyal gces pa mtha' dag la ‘‘rgya mi'i phogs zan ’’zhes pa'i ming bsgrags te gsod brdung 'phrog bcom gyi spyod ngan spel ba dang / sgos su rta rmig pha bu tshang ma rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi yang rtser son pa zhig red zer ba'i bshad tshul yod la/288

skabs der pa pha 'chi med bstan rgyas lags bsam pho'i bka' 'brel spo mda'i ngo tshab tu sa skyar phebs bzhugs gnang ste nang du bzhugs med rung nang mi bu phrug la btsan pos snyom gnon bsnyad 'dogs 'khel rgyu nyag cig la brten sding che dgon pa'i lcog grwa rin po che khong tsho dang sku mched yin pas der gab g.yol byas nas nyin shas song yang nang mi'i 'brel gtugs ma byung stabs mtshan dgung zhig la khong rang dang bu gzhon pa rin chen gnyis nang la yong ba'i lam bar khams jag dang gdong thug brgyab ste mthu stobs lags ngo shes nas 'ju bzung ka kor byed ring bu gzhon pa rin chen grwa chas gyon pas snang med du gyur pa des mtshan mo de rang la ri la ri brgyud kyis rtsed thang sgang sbug tang ud du phebs pa red/ tang ud kyis khong la byams brtse'i slob gso dang / thugs khur tshad med gnang 'og skabs de rang du nang sar slob sbyong byed par ched mngags btang ba'i drin gyis slob grwa thon nas deng skabs grong khyer lha sa khreng kon chus khongs phyugs nad sman pa byas nas sdod mus dang / bu rgan pa mthu stobs 'ju bzung byas pa'i mtshan mo de rang la khams jag gi rten gzhi yod sa 'phyongs rgyas 'bum thang du 'khrid de gsod la khad kyi 'dri rtsad byed bzhin par nang mis smin gling gcung rin po cher mgo 'dren skyabs 'jug zhus don bla na med pa'i mgon skyabs gnang ste gsol dpon o rgyan chos grags ched mngags 'phyongs rgyas su gtong gnang mdzad pa sogs kyi bka' drin gyis tshe srog ma shor bar phyir slog byas kyang dwo yang dkar po lnga stong tham pa 'phral sgrub dgos pa'i nyes chad tsha 'gel byas par chag yang zhus rung bsam gzhigs bya rgyu lta zhog ‘‘khyed tsho pha bu tshang mas nā yang gsog 'angog byas pa sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du ma sprad na su zhig la sprod rtsis yod dam ’’zhes btsan bka' phab ste rgyu mtshan shod sa med par rang med gzhan 'tshol 289

gyis sgrub dgos byung ba red/ de nas zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang nas dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur rjes mthu stobs slob grwa'i dge rgan sngar rgyun byed mur rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul brgyud rim nang ‘‘mi bzhi shog kha'i ’’dug skyon gyis rkyen pas 'thab rtsod dza drag ha cang che ba'i gnas tshul 'og stabs ma legs par rang shi rgyag dgos byung ba red/

lha rgya rir ngo log jag pa'i dmag sgar chags pa'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhiga'ajigs rnam gyis/ 195rdolo'i bod zla 4pa'i nang lha rgya rir ngo log khams jag khyon che glo bur du 'byor nas rgya ri'i khri chen rnam rgyal rgya mtshor rgya mi'i las 'gan sgrub mkhan yin stabs de mur gtan nas 'jog thabs med ces gzim chung nang bkar nas me mda' bton te gsod grabs kyi 'jigs skul byas shing /skabs der dwags po grwa tshang gi tshogs dmangs rgya rir ṣ+pebs bzhugs dang 'khel bas khong rnams rgya ri phyag mdzod kyis zhu snar drangs te dwags grwa mkhan po grwa dmangs kyi ngo chen la brten/ khri chen rin po che nyen kha las grol tsam byung rjes lha sar gsang stabs kyis nyen g.yol du phebs 'dug kyang / lha rgya ri'i snod bcud 'dzin dbang mtha' dag khams jag gis bdag bzung byas pa dang / bod zla 12tshes 29dgong dro lab 'bru tshong mkhan gtsang pa mi gcig slebs pa rgya mi'i gsang nyul du brtsis nas lam seng bsad pa red/sne gdong rdzong gi las drung snang ldum ra ba byams pa zer ba btson 'jug mnar gcod tshad med btang ba ma bzod par btson khang nas gsang bros kyis lha rgya ri'i rgyab ngos g.yang sa nas mchongs te rang shi brgyab pa dang / bod zla 5nang rgya ri'i zhabs khongs don grub rdo rje zer bar rta pho spus legs shig yod pa kho pa tshor ma sprad par brten kho pa ka bar btags nas nyes brdung tshad 291

med dang rta lcag mang po btang bas khong nad gcong du gyur te dka' ngal ci che byung song / khams jag rgya rir sdod ring gtor bzlog rgyag pa dang / rgya ri'i shar ngos dkar po thang zhes par khams jag 'du 'dzoms bsang gsol lha zhu sogs byed kyi yod pa red/ de mjug zing 'khrug lang skabs rgya ri sras chung snyan grags thabs zad kyis khams jag dang mnyam du e chu mdo gyang brgyud nas phyi rgyal du bros/1kha5ṭ+wāṃlo lha rgya rir khams jag yod mus thog bod zla 1kyanang nyin zhig snga dro glo bur du nga rang sdod gnas dmar mtha'i shar phyogs nas go lag 'khyer ba'i khams jag rta pa drug dza drag ngang yong gi 'dug nga'i bsam blor the tshom dang zhed snang chen po byung rung bya thabs dben mur kho pa tshos khyi la yang ma 'dzems par nang du yong nas drag shugs kyis bshad don ‘‘nga tsho sangs rgyas bstan don sgrub mkhan yin cing / bza' 'bru dang gzan chag mi 'deng pa'i dka' ngal 'dug pa khyed nas 'bru dang / sran ma/ sha mar/gro khal 50skor bcas spus tshong dgos/’’zhes zer bar nga rang nas chos gzhis sogs yong khungs mang po med pas phran tsam sprad 'thus brjod de/sha mar phran bu dang sran ma do 1sprod dgos byung / kho pa tsho'i mtshon srung ga'u la rab gnas byed rogs zer bar 'dod bstun ltar byas pa dang /gong gi bza' bca'i rin 'bab yin ces rta lnga drug tsam bzhag rjes lha sku rten gsum la mgo bo sgur tsam re byas te thon song / yang de mjug khams jag grwa gzugs mi lnga yong nas bza' chas sprod dgos zer don phran bu sprad cing /mar lam mi ser sogs kyi lag nas bza' chas 'phrog bcom byas par brten mang tshogs gzhon pa mang po rug 'dzoms rdo rub brgyab nas khams jag rnams rang dbang med par phyir bros bya dgos byung song ba bcas/292

khams jag gis zangs rir mi byed dgu byed byas pa'i skor/zangs ri skyid khang ye shes bstan 'dzin gyis/195ṭ+wāṃlo'i bod zla 5tsam nas bzung khams jag mang po gri gur 'du 'dzoms byed skabs 'bri g.yag dang / mdzo mo sogs ded nas zangs ri klu khang gru brgyud rim bskyod byas shing / thengs shig khams jag gi sems can khyon che yod pa khag gcig zangs ri khul 'byor te klu khang gru kha bar sems can 'ded rogs gtong dgos zhes mi ser la btsan bskul byas pa ma zad/zengs ri 'du spyi nas kyang lam g.yas g.yon gyi lo tog la gnod skyon mi 'byung ched lam sgrol mi brgyad btang rjes kho tsho'i gras nas brjod gsal lter na/skabs der gtsang chu rgyas sgang yin gshis nyin re gru thengs gcig gam gnyis las gtong mi thub pas de nyin gru thengs dang po btang zin tsam la khams chas spras pa'i rta pa bzhi ljang sa khul nas gru kha gcig tu 'byor te/ gong gsal sems can ded nas 'gro mkhan rnams dang thug 'phral kho tsho skad cha shod res kha shas byas rjes kha brtsod brgyab pa dang lam seng 'khrug 'dzing byas mthar rta pa bzhi po ri ldebs su bros pa khams pas rjes 'ded byas te mi gnyis bsad pa dang / mi gnyis bros thar ba red/ de nas sems can 'bri g.yag dang /rta sogs rub rub bzos te gru thengs gnyis pa gtong rgyu'i gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'i skabs der rtse thang phyogs nas bcings 'grol dmag de gar phebs 293

'byor gyis gtsang chu'i lho phyogs ri ngos nas me mda' ser drag babs pa ji bzhin brgyab pas/ khams jag bud med phru gu dang bcas srog mgo gang thon zangs rir phyir bros byas stabs sems can 'ded rogs zangs ri khul nas btsan bskul byas pa'i mi ser tsho'ang phyir bros byas pa red/ bros phyin pa'i khams jag gi 'bri g.yag khyon che bdag med du lus khongs nas 'ol dga' rdzing phyi'i mang tshogs kyi rmod g.yag de sngon khams pas 'phrog bcom byas pa ngos 'dzin thub pa ngo grangs nyi shu skor do bdag la rtsis sprad 'phros 'bri g.yag brgya dang bzhi bcu lhag tsam 'dug pa de dag ji byed skor zangs ri 'du spyis rtsed thang sgang sbug tu bcings 'grol dmag la snyan seng zhus pa'i phyir lan la 'on chos sding du bskyel dgos gsungs pa ltar rtsis 'bul zhus/de rjes khams jag gis nya mgo'i gru de dag zangs ri klu khang gru'i tshab tu bskyal yang der 'byor khams jag khag gcig la glo bur du zhed snang byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig thos te gru la me brgyab nas phan mi thogs pa bzos pa red/gong lo'i bod zla rdonang lha sa nas 'on chos sding bla brang gi tshong pa thub bstan zangs rir tshong rgyag par 'byor te nyin shas song mtshams rong nas khams jag rta pa bco lnga skor yong nas tshong pa thub bstan rong la 'khrid de rgya mi'i gsang nyul red ces bsnyon 'dzugs kyis 'dri brtsad nan po byas 'dug pa ma zad/ de'i phyi nyin khams jag rta pa gsum tshong pa thub bstan gyi gnas tshang du yong ste thub bstan gyis bzhag pa'i dngos por zhib bsher byed skabs thub bstan nas de sngon khren tur tshong rgyag tu 'gro skabs kyi gnas tshang gi ming dang / kha par ang grangs bcas rgya yig bris pa zhig thon 'dug pa jag pa'i lag tu son 'phral gsang nyul 'khrul med red ces thub bstan srog thog tu 294

gtong rgyu'i thag bcad de rong na rā rta ra'i ka bar btags thog mgo la ras dkar po zhig bkab nas me mda' rgyag nye'i mtshams rong gzhis sdod sogs kyi zhu ngor rkyen lam du ma btang tsam byung yod rung / zing 'khrug lhing 'jags ma byung bar btang shor med pa'i thog rjes su rtsis sprod dgos zhes brjod de sa gnas zangs rir rtsis sprod byas pa dang / de rjes zing 'khrug lhing 'jags mtshams tshong pa thub bstan lha sar phyir log thub pa byung yod pa bcas/

de sngon nag tshang khul du phyi rgyal gyi mi sna 'ga' zhig 'byor ba'i don rkyen mdor bsdus/'jam dpal gyis/de sngon nag tshang byang rgyud du so sa bcu gsum dang / gtso gnad so sa lnga yod cing / rgyun gtan ha sag rigs dang / gzhan yang jag rkun yod med lta srung bya ra byed mkhan khul so so'i khongs nas btsugs pa'i rta dmag nyi shu skor so sa so sor rgyun sdod byed mus khar/ 1949lo bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas ka dang sku srung dmag mi nyis brgya skor khul der btang 'byor gyis so sa khag la res mos kyis skor skyod byed bzhin yod pas/ 1950lo byang stong so sa sog dkar zhes pa der (da lta mtsho gnyis don gcod khang khongs su yod ) nag tshang sa khul gyi so lta dmag bco lnga yod pa'i thog gsar du ka dang dmag bcu shog gcig 'byor te sdod mur/ shin cang sa mtshams nas rnga mong lnga ded pa'i rta mi lnga yong ba mthong ste kho tsho byang nas yong lugs kyis ha sag sogs kyi dgra jag yin shag byas te lam seng nag tshang gi yul dmag dang / bod dmag bcu bcas mnyam bskyod kyis tho rengs khar mi lnga po'i mtha' bskor thog me mda' 'phang res kyi rgol 'dzings dmag 'thab byas mthar nyin dgung tsam la kho tsho mi lnga yod pa nas gsum de rang du bsad pa dang / gnyis 'dzin bzung byas pa yang mi gcig rkang pa bcag pa dang /296

gcig shos de'ang lag par rmas skyon btang yod pa red/ rmas ma gnyis po nyin der dmag sa nas khrid rung skad brda ma 'phros stabs gang nas gang yin ma shes kyang kho tsho'i rgyu dngos che rigs rta lnga dang / rnga mong lnga/ me mda' ring mda' bzhi dang thung mda' gcig yang sgam zhig gi nang thung mda' drug bcas yod pa/ de dag shan rtsa rdzong dang rdzong du bca' sdod dmag mi'i 'go 'dzin la sprod rgyu bzhag pa phud/ de min rgyu dngos chung tshags rnams der yod dmag mi'i dmag nom du bgos pa red/ de nas nyin lnga song rjes shan rtsa rdzong nas a drung zhig nyin mtshan ltos med btang mdun bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' rgya zhig dang / shan rtsa rdzong gi ngos 'byor sogs khyer yod cing / a drung so sar 'byor phral nga tsho'i nag tshang gi der yod dmag gi so dpon dang / bod dmag gi bcu dpon bcas nas bka' rgya dang dmag rdzong gi yi ge lta klog byed skabs nang don du byang shin cang nas yong mkhan mi lnga yod pa khong tsho lam 'khel nges med gang nas byung rung bde bgrod byed thub pa'i 'gan len dang 'brel/ mi ser rnams nas rta khal sdod sgrig dgos rgyu sogs gsal yod pa red/ bka' rgya dang yi ge'i nang rdon mthong ma thag sa srung 'go dmag rnams hang sangs te ci bya bltos med du gyur/gong gsal gyi mi sna bsad rmas byed po bcu dpon de dang yul dmas/ gi so dpon 'go rgan gzhan dag re zung bcas nyin mtshan bltos med shan rtsa rdzong du bskyod de gnas tshul zhus par/ shan rtsa rdzong dang dmag 'go nas lam seng sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul thog phyi rgyal ba rmas ma gnyis por sdod sgrig gang yag dang / nad g.yog sogs lta skyong hur dag dang rgyu dngos rnams tshang ma phyir slog byas pa red/ de nas mi ring par sa gnas srid gzhung gi lan du/ thal cha de rigs 297

ni shin tu 'os min yin lugs mang tsam bshad 'dug pa/ rdo don thag gcod la ‘‘lha sa nas shan rtsa bar gyi sa tshigs khag gi bka' rgya 'gor skyil byed po le 'khri so so'i 'go pa rer rta lcag brgya re gzhu dgos pa de dag sa gnas so so'i rdzong gzhis sne mo bas 'phral du lag bstar byed dgos ’’zhes dang /bod dmag gi ru dpon rdo rje dbang phyug ru dpon gyi go gnas 'phral du gnas dbyung gtong rgyu dang / sa gnas nag tshang gi so dpon dang bcu dpon/bod dmag gi zhal ngo tshe phun/ bcu dpon zla ba bcas phyi rgyal ba bsad rmas lag bstar byed po so sor lus steng rta lcag nyis brgya re gzhu rgyu sogs kyi bka' bcad btang ba red/ skabs der nag tshang sgar dpon gnyis nag tshang gi spyi khyab kyang yin pa dang / dmag bkod byed sar dngos zhugs med stabs go gnas rang 'jags thog lus thog nyes pa btang yod pa ma red/'on kyang skabs der phyi rgyal gyi mi gsod mkhan lag dmar ba dngos su yin 'di yin ngos ma zin stabs dmigs bkar khrims gcod 'di byed byung ma song bcas so 298
rmi — smre

'dra'i dbu che ba la ang / lha sa nas nor bu gling khar mi mang po 'di 'dra yong gi 'dug cing / khyed kyi sa khongs chab 'go zam pa nas/ nor gling rgyal sgo'i 'gram bar yin kyang / de dag la sdod bya mi 'dug pas/ des na khyed rang gis chab 'go zam pa nas mi gcig kyang btang mi chog’’ces bshad byung bar de lan ngos nas 4da bar shes ma byung /’’zhes brjod 'phral chab 'go zam par ltag log gis nor gling du yong mi rnams bkag sdom byed rtsis byas rung bkag thub thabs mi 'dugade nas dus yun gang 'tsham song rjes 'phags pa lha'i mkhan chung bsad pa dang / bka' blon bsam pho ba'i mgo bor rdo bzhus pa sogs kyi gnas tshul byung zin te mi mang che ba lha sar log rjes ngos rang nor gling rgyal sgo'i 'gram du bskyod par mkhan chung tshul khrims nyi ma dang / mu bya gnyis tshogs 'du grol te log yong ba dang thug cing / khong gnyis nas ‘‘khyed rang nang du ma log par zhol las khungs su phebs rogs ’’zhes brjod byung don/ngos rang yar lam zhol pa las khungs su bskyod 'byor skabs zhol pa las sbrel 'byor zin 'dug pas mkhan chung tshul khrims nyi mas ‘‘de ring nor bu gling khar tshogs 'du tshogs pa dang / tshogs 'dus gtan 'bebs byas don mang dag kyang rang re dang 'brel yod skor zhus na nga rang (mkhan chung tshul khrims nyi ma ) rtse po ta la'i srung bya'i spyi khyab par bsko bstsal dang / rim bzhi mu bya ba zhol sa khul gyi srung bya'i spyi khyab bar bsko bstsal/ khyed rang (phran ye shes smon lam ) tshogs 'du khag sogs la gtong sgo gtong rgyu'i 'gan 'khur byed mkhan du gtan 'bebs bcas gnang thog khyed nas gtong sgo khag le thog med pa dgos lugs gsung gi 'dug pas de don dgongs 'jags gnang rogs’’zhes bshad byung zhing / de nub rang shag so 300

sor log ste phyi nyin tshes 11zhogs pa nor bu gling khar bskyod par nor gling gzhung sgo srung bya rnam kun sku srung dmag mi las med rung / de nyin gzhung sgo'i g.yas g.yon du srung bya khams pa dang / rtse drung / shod drung kha shas 'dug pas phran la yogang du 'gro'am ’’zhes 'dri rtsad byas te ka kor gyis lcags ri'i nang du mi gtong ba ma zad/ skabs der zhol du sdod pa'i dmag spyi khang gi las bya zhig yod pa des khams pa gcig la mig btsum brgyab song bas khams pa des lam seng phran rang bzung bar slebs byung bas/ de 'phral phran nas am phrag nang me mda'‘‘pi si tob’’gcig yod pa de bton te rgyag rtsis byed dus nye 'khor du yod pa'i mi rnams kyis phan tshun gnyis kar de ltar byed rgyu med pa'i skad cor dang bcas zang zing byed mur mi kha shas tshogs 'dur gnas tshul snyan seng zhu bar song 'dug pa phyir 'khor gyis ‘‘nang du gtong shog’’ces pa'i lan 'byor stabs phran rang nor gling nang du bskyod par zhabs brtan lha khang nang tshogs 'du 'tshog bzhin 'dug cing / tshogs 'du'i 'go gtso mkhan chung rta ra mdo sngags mthar phyin nas phran la slode snga gzhung gi tshogs 'du yod phyin rtse gsol thab nas gsol ja dang / zhol pa las khungs nas rtsam pa gtong dgos gshis/ da lam 'dir rtse gsol thab nas ja gtong bzhin 'dug kyang / khyed kyis rtsam pa mi gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam ’’zhes bshad byung bar phran nas da nang tshogs 'du yod pa shes ma byung zhes brjod par mkhan chung rta ra bas ‘‘de 'dra'i mgo che ba la/ lam seng log ste rtsam pa gtong dgos’’zhes bshad 'phral phran rang lam seng zhol las khungs su bskyod thog nor gling du tshogs 'du ba rnams la rtsam pa skyel mkhan 'phral gtong byas pa ma zad/ de min tshogs 'du khag gi gtong sgo dang / 'char can gyi gtong sgo khag kyang le thogs med pa btang khar/301

zhol lcags ri'i nang gi mang tshogs khag gcig bskul te lcags rilī nub sgo dang / gzhung sgo/ shar sgo bcas la rdo rtsigs rgyag tu bcug nas sgo chung re ma gtogs bkag rgyu'i las 'gan 'khur du blangs/ de nas spyi zla di/tshes 17nyin zing 'khrug dngos su langs shing / me mda' dang / me sgrogs kyi sgra'i khrod du dmag spyi blo mkhas lags zhol las khungs su yong ste/ 6‘khye narang las khungs nang 'dzul te bsdad na ga la 'grigs/ zhol gyi 'gan 'a khrikhyed la yod pas rgyal sgo gsum dang srung bya ba tshor rtog zhib byed daso/sari’tshesag brjod de phyin song / de nas yud tsam song rjes dza sag tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul lha sa nas zhol du brel tshabs ngang yong ste phran la brjod don// ‘‘nga/ gang 'dra byed dam ’’zer gyi 'dug pas phran nas ‘‘dmag brgyab pa 'di 'grigs ma song / de las mgo btags zhus na ’’zhes brjod par tsha rong gis ‘‘mgo btags zhu rgyu 'di bzhin zhol gnyer mi bzhi yod pas khyed rang gcig pos thag chod e yong ’’zer gyi 'dug par de lan phran/ nas ‘‘nga rni gtong sgo gtong rgyu'i las 'gan tsam yin rung / de'i thad ngas thag sa/cod thub’’ces brjod kyang / tsha rong gis ‘‘de ltar yin na do nub pye po chags 'dug pas khyed phyin na mi 'grigs shing / sang nyin snga dro gsham 'og gi mi gnyis gtong dgos’’zhes zer don bzhin phran nas de'i phyi nyin zhogs pa zhol pa rta gtong pa dang / zhol drung gcig la kha btags bskur nas gzhung sgo phye ste mgo btags zhu bar btang zhing / de nas yud tsam song rjes bcings 'grol dmag phebs byung bas phran nas rgyus yod kyis zhol khul gyi go lag tshang ma bsdu rub byas te rtsis 'bul zhus pa ma zad/ dmag spyi khang gi bo/ lag rnams kyang rtsis 'bul zhus nas log grabs byed dus skad sgyur 'ba' pa skal bzang nas phran la ‘‘khyed rtse po ta 'a/ra yong dgos’’zhes gsung byung bar phran 302

nas rtse po ta la rtse phyag las khungs kyis do dam byed kyi yod pa las ngos rang gi do dam khongs min tshul zhus kyang khong gis ‘‘'grigs kyi ma red/ mgo btags zhu mkhan khyed rang yin pas de khul tshang ma khyed rang nas 'gan len dgos ’’zhes gsungs par brten phran rang rtse po ta lar mnyam bcar gyis go lag rnams bsdu rub rtsis 'bul zhus pa dang / ngo log zing slong pa bsad pa dang bros pa'i lhag 'phro rnams 'dzin bzung gnang zhing / phran yang de dag dang mnyam du 'dzin bzung gis do dam slob gso'i sgyur bkod zhus pa bcas/
spucirī byu—tsho —༷rtaphuci ci jitram̐2—cho cizi ri snaci wastazlo snarngo sku ci / 5tsho tsā —ci〉gyi 7 skuwi— ci cho 5cici tsordoji —wa— gepho r+sha byu
